    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/auditV271Omnicanal.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS, validateRealIdentityInputs } from '../../services/kineticRegisterHelper';
import {
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  markExplicitKineticSignOut,
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut,
} from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { calcularCorteSemanalB2B, isMasterPass0Kc } from '../../services/adminB2BCutEngine';
import { computeEscrow4060Split } from '../../components/eventos/eventDetailsPureHelpers';
import { toMondayFirstDayIndex } from '../../services/eventosScreenHelpers';
import { computePrestigeInfo } from '../../services/kineticlubLevelsEngine';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};

const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
  }
};

const ROMAN_STANDALONE_RE = /\b(II|III|IV|VI|VII|VIII|IX|XI|XII)\b/;

describe('Auditoría Omnicanal KINETIC OS v2.7.1 — 5 Propiedades Invariantes (fast-check 500x)', () => {
  it('Propiedad 1: Registro B2B acepta razón social de 1 palabra mientras Atleta exige Nombre + Apellido y frena desechables', () => {
    const disposableList = Array.from(DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS);
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$/),
        fc.stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z]{2,10}$/),
        fc.integer({ min: 1000000, max: 8999999 }),
        fc.boolean(),
        (clubSuffix, lastWord, phoneTail, isEn) => {
          const singleWordBiz = `Gym${clubSuffix}`;
          const twoWordPerson = `Carlos ${lastWord}`;
          const validEmail = `ops.${clubSuffix.toLowerCase()}@kineticfit.mx`;
          const validPhone = `669${String(phoneTail)}`;

          const b2bSingle = validateRealIdentityInputs(
            singleWordBiz,
            validEmail,
            validPhone,
            true,
            isEn,
            undefined,
            undefined,
            true
          );
          expectTrue(b2bSingle.ok, `B2B must accept single-word commercial name: ${singleWordBiz}`);

          const athleteSingle = validateRealIdentityInputs(
            singleWordBiz,
            validEmail,
            validPhone,
            true,
            isEn,
            undefined,
            undefined,
            false
          );
          expectTrue(!athleteSingle.ok, `Athlete must reject single-word name: ${singleWordBiz}`);

          const athleteFull = validateRealIdentityInputs(
            twoWordPerson,
            validEmail,
            validPhone,
            true,
            isEn,
            undefined,
            undefined,
            false
          );
          expectTrue(athleteFull.ok, `Athlete must accept two-word full name: ${twoWordPerson}`);

          const noTerms = validateRealIdentityInputs(
            singleWordBiz,
            validEmail,
            validPhone,
            false,
            isEn,
            undefined,
            undefined,
            true
          );
          expectTrue(!noTerms.ok, 'Must fail closed when legal waiver is not accepted');

          if (disposableList.length > 0) {
            const badDomain = disposableList[phoneTail % disposableList.length];
            const disposableRes = validateRealIdentityInputs(
              twoWordPerson,
              `probe@${badDomain}`,
              validPhone,
              true,
              isEn,
              undefined,
              undefined,
              true
            );
            expectTrue(!disposableRes.ok, `Must reject disposable domain: ${badDomain}`);
          }
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 2: Cierre explícito fail-closed (0ms) en markExplicitKineticSignOut/resetExplicitKineticSignOut', () => {
    try {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(fc.array(fc.boolean(), { minLength: 1, maxLength: 16 }), (ops) => {
          resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
          expectEq(isExplicitKineticSignOut(), false, 'must start reset');
          for (const triggerSignOut of ops) {
            if (triggerSignOut) {
              markExplicitKineticSignOut();
              expectEq(isExplicitKineticSignOut(), true, 'sign-out flag must flip true at 0ms');
            } else {
              resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
              expectEq(isExplicitKineticSignOut(), false, 'reset flag must restore false deterministically');
            }
          }
        }),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    } finally {
      resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
    }
  });

  it('Propiedad 3: Pases Maestros (0 KC) jamás inflan ingresos/comisiones B2B y Split 40/60 conserva techo para grupos 1..4', () => {
    const validMasterStatuses = new Set(['completada', 'activa', 'confirmada', 'pendiente']);
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const affiliates = [{ id: 'af-v271', nombre: 'Iron Club Mazatlan', tipo_socio: 'Club' }];

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 100, max: 25000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }),
        fc.constantFrom('completada', 'activa', 'confirmada', 'pendiente', 'no_show'),
        fc.boolean(),
        (paidKc, splitCount, masterStatus, isMasterPassFlag) => {
          const paidRow = {
            id: 'res-paid',
            negocio_nombre: 'Iron Club Mazatlan',
            servicio: 'Halterofilia Pro',
            estado: 'completada',
            precio_kc: paidKc,
            costo_total: paidKc,
            monto_escrow: Math.round(paidKc * 0.4),
            monto_puerta: paidKc - Math.round(paidKc * 0.4),
            es_pase_maestro: false,
            updated_at: nowIso,
          };
          const masterRow = {
            id: 'res-master',
            negocio_nombre: 'Iron Club Mazatlan',
            servicio: 'Pase Maestro VIP',
            estado: masterStatus,
            precio_kc: 0,
            costo_total: 0,
            monto_escrow: 0,
            monto_puerta: 0,
            es_pase_maestro: isMasterPassFlag,
            updated_at: nowIso,
          };

          expectEq(isMasterPass0Kc(paidRow), false, 'paid row cannot be classified as 0 KC master pass');
          expectEq(isMasterPass0Kc(masterRow), true, '0 KC row must be classified as master pass');

          const baseline = calcularCorteSemanalB2B(affiliates, [paidRow]);
          const withMaster = calcularCorteSemanalB2B(affiliates, [paidRow, masterRow]);

          expectEq(withMaster.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, baseline.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, '0 KC cannot inflate gross');
          expectEq(withMaster.total_comision_kinetic_20_mxn, baseline.total_comision_kinetic_20_mxn, '0 KC cannot inflate fee');
          expectEq(withMaster.total_neto_dispersar_spei_mxn, baseline.total_neto_dispersar_spei_mxn, '0 KC cannot inflate SPEI');
          const expectedDelta = validMasterStatuses.has(masterStatus) ? 1 : 0;
          expectEq(
            withMaster.total_pases_maestros_mes,
            baseline.total_pases_maestros_mes + expectedDelta,
            'master pass monthly count mismatch'
          );

          const split = computeEscrow4060Split(paidKc, false);
          expectEq(split.totalKc, paidKc, 'athlete totalKc mismatch');
          expectEq(split.escrow40 + split.puerta60, split.totalKc, '40/60 split must conserve totalKc');

          const perPerson = Math.ceil(split.escrow40 / splitCount);
          expectTrue(perPerson * splitCount >= split.escrow40, 'ceil division must cover 40% escrow custody');

          const adminZero = computeEscrow4060Split(paidKc, true);
          expectEq(adminZero.totalKc + adminZero.escrow40 + adminZero.puerta60, 0, 'master pass must zero split');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 4: Calendario Lunes-Domingo mantiene biyección total sobre cualquier entero JS getDay()', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.integer({ min: -10000, max: 10000 }), (rawDay) => {
        const idx = toMondayFirstDayIndex(rawDay);
        expectTrue(Number.isInteger(idx) && idx >= 0 && idx <= 6, `out of range 0..6: ${idx}`);
        expectEq(toMondayFirstDayIndex(1), 0, 'Monday (1) must map to column 0');
        expectEq(toMondayFirstDayIndex(0), 6, 'Sunday (0) must map to column 6');
        const weekWeekdays = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0].map((d) => toMondayFirstDayIndex(d));
        expectEq(weekWeekdays.join(','), '0,1,2,3,4,5,6', 'Mon..Sun bijection broken');
      }),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 5: Escalera de Niveles 1..99 y Cero Romanos en computePrestigeInfo()', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 500 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 120 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 400000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 10 }),
        fc.constantFrom('es', 'en'),
        (sessions, streak, bonusXp, prestigioNivel, lang) => {
          const info = computePrestigeInfo(sessions, streak, bonusXp, 0, [], false, lang, null, prestigioNivel);
          expectTrue(info.prestigeLevel >= 1 && info.prestigeLevel <= 99, `level out of 1..99: ${info.prestigeLevel}`);
          expectEq(info.maxPrestigeLevel, 99, 'max level must stay 99');
          expectEq(info.canAscendPrestige, info.prestigeLevel >= 99, 'ascension gate must match level 99');

          if (prestigioNivel === 0) {
            expectTrue(
              !/Prestigio|Prestige/i.test(info.prestigeDisplayLabel),
              `Prestige 0 must hide Prestige label: ${info.prestigeDisplayLabel}`
            );
          }

          const labels = [info.prestigeDisplayLabel, info.prestigeShortLabel, info.prestigeGradeTitle, info.prestigeGradeRoman];
          for (const lbl of labels) {
            expectTrue(!ROMAN_STANDALONE_RE.test(String(lbl || '')), `Roman numeral detected in "${lbl}"`);
          }
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });
});

import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  buildCleanSquadInviteMessage,
  computeEscrow4060Split,
} from '../../components/eventos/eventDetailsPureHelpers';
import {
  computeTreasuryPatchedAthletesAndKpis,
  patchAffiliateStatusInList,
  removeAffiliateFromList,
} from '../../services/admin/adminScreenHelpers';
import {
  calcularCorteSemanalB2B,
  isSandboxAccountOrReservation,
} from '../../services/adminB2BCutEngine';
import { evaluateQrWindowStatus } from '../../services/bovedaHelpers';
import { computeHaversineKm } from '../../services/exploreZoneHelpers';
import {
  computeSplitEscrow1NMath,
  persistSelectedSpotSession,
  rehydratePersistedSpotForEvent,
} from '../../services/kineticSplitPreBookingStore';
import { parseTerminalQrPacket } from '../../services/terminalSpeiAndStudioService';
import { computeRadarDistanceKm } from '../../utils/exploreMapAndSearchHelpers';
import { buildExploreMapMarkers } from '../../utils/exploreMapMarkersAndPreview';
import { sanitizeExternalLinkUrl } from '../../utils/externalLinks';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
  }
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

describe('Carbon + Hydrogen Sweep v2.7.5 — PBT Invariants (500 runs)', () => {
  it('P1: strictWindow SPEI 80/20 returns 0 with historical-only rows, filters all sandbox variants, and keeps centavo parity', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 100, max: 5000 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.constantFrom('persona_moral', 'persona_fisica_con_rfc', 'sin_rfc'),
        fc.constantFrom('sandbox', 'demo', 'qa', 'test', '+test@', 'test_'),
        fc.string({ minLength: 2, maxLength: 10 }).map((s) => s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, 'x') || 'atleta'),
        (priceKc, regimen, marker, handle) => {
          const now = Date.now();
          const pastIso = new Date(now - 21 * DAY_MS).toISOString();
          const curIso = new Date(now).toISOString();
          const winOverride = {
            startMs: now - DAY_MS,
            endMs: now + DAY_MS,
            inicioIso: curIso.slice(0, 10),
            finIso: curIso.slice(0, 10),
            strictWindow: true,
          };
          const club = {
            id: 'club-real-1',
            nombre: 'Club Kinetic Cabo',
            regimen_fiscal: regimen,
            rfc: regimen === 'persona_moral' ? 'KIN250101AB1' : regimen === 'persona_fisica_con_rfc' ? 'GODE900101AB1' : '',
            estado: 'activo',
          };
          const histOnly = [
            {
              id: 'res-hist-1',
              negocio_nombre: 'Club Kinetic Cabo',
              estado: 'completada',
              costo_total: priceKc,
              precio_kc: priceKc,
              monto_escrow: Math.round(priceKc * 0.4),
              monto_puerta: priceKc - Math.round(priceKc * 0.4),
              updated_at: pastIso,
              fecha_clase: pastIso.slice(0, 10),
            },
          ];
          const strictEmpty = calcularCorteSemanalB2B([club], histOnly, winOverride);
          expectEq(strictEmpty.total_volumen_bruto_mxn, 0, 'strictWindow empty bruto must be 0');
          expectEq(strictEmpty.total_neto_dispersar_spei_mxn, 0, 'strictWindow empty SPEI must be 0');

          const liveRows = [
            { ...histOnly[0], id: 'res-live-1', updated_at: curIso, fecha_clase: curIso.slice(0, 10) },
          ];
          const liveCut = calcularCorteSemanalB2B([club], liveRows, winOverride);
          expectTrue(liveCut.cortes_por_afiliado.length === 1, 'Expected 1 affiliate cut');
          const c = liveCut.cortes_por_afiliado[0];
          expectTrue(
            Math.abs(c.comision_kinetic_total_mxn + c.subtotal_socio_80_mxn - c.volumen_bruto_mxn) <= 0.01,
            '80/20 centavo parity broken',
          );
          expectTrue(
            Math.abs(c.subtotal_socio_80_mxn - c.total_retenciones_sat_mxn - c.neto_dispersar_spei_mxn) <= 0.01,
            'SPEI SAT centavo parity broken',
          );

          const email =
            marker === '+test@' ? `${handle}+test@kineticapp.com.mx`
              : marker === 'test_' ? `test_${handle}@kineticapp.com.mx`
              : `${handle}.${marker}@kineticapp.com.mx`;
          expectTrue(
            isSandboxAccountOrReservation({ email, nombre: `${handle} ${marker}` }),
            `Sandbox marker "${marker}" escaped filter`,
          );
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P2: GPS distances never return NaN, overlapping pins avoid (0,0) and separate, and external link sanitizer preserves D6 mailto', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.oneof(fc.double({ min: -90, max: 90, noNaN: true }), fc.constant(NaN), fc.constant(Infinity), fc.constant(-Infinity)),
        fc.oneof(fc.double({ min: -180, max: 180, noNaN: true }), fc.constant(NaN), fc.constant(-Infinity)),
        fc.double({ min: -90, max: 90, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: -180, max: 180, noNaN: true }),
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 5 }),
        fc.constantFrom('javascript:alert(1)', '\u0000javascript:evil()', 'java\nscript:evil()', '//evil.com/phish', 'https://', 'data:text/html,hi'),
        (lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2, dupCount, badUrl) => {
          const d1 = computeRadarDistanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2);
          const d2 = computeHaversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2);
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(d1) && d1 >= 0, 'computeRadarDistanceKm non-finite');
          expectTrue(Number.isFinite(d2) && d2 >= 0, 'computeHaversineKm non-finite');

          const affiliates = Array.from({ length: dupCount }, (_, idx) => ({
            id: `af-dup-${idx}`,
            nombre: `Club Collide ${idx}`,
            disciplina: 'Pilates',
            estado: 'activo',
            esClubActivo: true,
            esActivo: true,
            es_especialista: false,
            latitude: idx === 0 ? null : idx === 1 ? '' : 0,
            longitude: idx === 0 ? null : idx === 1 ? '' : 0,
            experiencias: idx === 0 ? [{ id: 'ev-zero-guard', nombre_servicio: 'Reformer', estado: 'aprobado' }] : [],
          }));
          const markers = buildExploreMapMarkers(affiliates, { showClubs: true, showSpecialists: true, showEvents: true });
          expectEq(markers.length, dupCount + 1, 'Marker count mismatch with showEvents');
          const coordSet = new Set<string>();
          for (const m of markers) {
            expectTrue(Number.isFinite(m.latitude) && Number.isFinite(m.longitude), 'Marker produced NaN coordinate');
            expectTrue(Math.abs(m.latitude) > 0.1 && Math.abs(m.longitude) > 0.1, 'Marker placed near (0,0)');
            if (m.markerType === 'club') {
              coordSet.add(`${Number(m.latitude).toFixed(6)},${Number(m.longitude).toFixed(6)}`);
            }
          }
          expectEq(coordSet.size, dupCount, 'Colliding markers were not separated');

          expectEq(sanitizeExternalLinkUrl(badUrl), null, `Unsafe URL allowed: ${badUrl}`);
          expectEq(sanitizeExternalLinkUrl('mailto:soporte@kineticapp.com.mx'), 'mailto:soporte@kineticapp.com.mx', 'D6 mailto rejected');
          expectEq(sanitizeExternalLinkUrl('https://kineticapp.com.mx/legal'), 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/legal', 'Valid HTTPS rejected');
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
  }
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const toBytes = (str: string): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(str, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);

describe('FinOps IA (@google/genai) + Geocoding Write-Once v2.7.6 (fast-check 500x)', () => {
  it('P1: Canonical FinOps cache key is deterministic and invariant across whitespace and object key permutations', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'b2b_digitizer' | 'b2c_coach_match'>('b2b_digitizer', 'b2c_coach_match'),
        fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 40 }).filter((s) => s.trim().length > 0),
        fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 40 }).filter((s) => s.trim().length > 0),
        fc.integer({ min: 15, max: 240 }),
        (task, rawText, rawClub, dur) => {
          const cleanText = rawText.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
          const cleanClub = rawClub.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
          const a = computeCanonicalFinOpsCacheKey(task, {
            clubName: `  ${cleanClub}  `,
            scheduleText: cleanText.split(' ').join('   '),
            duracion_min: dur,
            extra: undefined,
          });
          const b = computeCanonicalFinOpsCacheKey(task, {
            duracion_min: dur,
            scheduleText: `\n${cleanText}\t`,
            clubName: cleanClub,
          });
          expectEq(a, b, 'Cache key drifted on whitespace or key permutation');
          expectTrue(new RegExp(`^${task}:v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$`).test(a), `Invalid cache key format: ${a}`);
          const hashA = buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task, { a: 1, b: -0 });
          const hashB = buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task, { b: 0, a: 1 });
          expectEq(hashA, hashB, 'Negative zero or key order changed canonical hash input');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P2: B2B Digitizer quantizes precio_kc strictly to >=0 multiples of 10 and bounds cupo [1,50] & duracion [15,240]', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.oneof(
          fc.double({ min: -1_000_000, max: 1_000_000, noNaN: false }),
          fc.constantFrom(Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, -0, 0, 14, 15, 299)
        ),
        fc.integer({ min: -500, max: 500 }),
        fc.integer({ min: -100, max: 1000 }),
        (rawKc, rawCap, rawDur) => {
          const q = quantizeServicePriceToTenKc(rawKc);
          expectTrue(Number.isSafeInteger(q), `Non-integer quantized price: ${q}`);
          expectTrue(q >= 0, `Negative quantized price: ${q}`);
          expectEq(q % 10, 0, `Not a multiple of 10 KC: ${q}`);

          const cap = clampB2BServiceCapacity(rawCap);
          expectTrue(Number.isInteger(cap) && cap >= 1 && cap <= 50, `Capacity out of [1,50]: ${cap}`);

          const dur = clampB2BServiceDurationMinutes(rawDur);
          expectTrue(Number.isInteger(dur) && dur >= 15 && dur <= 240, `Duration out of [15,240]: ${dur}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P3: Write-Once geo skips redundant lookups and external nav URLs emit strictly HTTPS Maps/Waze links', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.string({ minLength: 5, maxLength: 80 }).filter((s) => {
          const norm = s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
          return norm.length >= 5 && !['ubicacion verificada', 'ubicación verificada', 'por definir', 'online', 'sin direccion', 'sin dirección', 'mexico', 'méxico'].includes(norm);
        }),
        fc.double({ min: -89.9, max: 89.9, noNaN: true }),
        fc.double({ min: -179.9, max: 179.9, noNaN: true }),
        fc.constantFrom<'google_maps' | 'waze'>('google_maps', 'waze'),
        fc.constantFrom('Club Kinetic', 'javascript:alert(1)', 'Sede\r\nCabo <script>', 'Av. Marina #10'),
        (addr, lat, lng, provider, label) => {
          const norm = addr.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
          expectEq(
            shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: `  ${norm.toUpperCase()}  `, existingPlaceId: 'ChIJ_verified_place_1', existingGeoVerifiedAt: '2026-11-19T10:00:00Z', prevUbicacion: norm.toLowerCase() }),
            false,
            'Write-Once re-fired for unchanged verified address'
          );
          expectEq(
            shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: 'Ubicación Verificada', existingPlaceId: '', existingGeoVerifiedAt: '' }),
            false,
            'Write-Once fired for generic placeholder address'
          );
          expectEq(
            shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: norm, existingPlaceId: '', existingGeoVerifiedAt: '' }),
            true,
            'Write-Once skipped valid unverified address'
          );
          if (!(lat === 0 && lng === 0)) {
            const url = buildExternalMapsNavigationUrl({ latitude: lat, longitude: lng, label, placeId: 'ChIJ123_abc', provider });
            expectTrue(typeof url === 'string' && url.startsWith('https://'), `Unsafe URL emitted: ${String(url)}`);
            const parsed = new URL(String(url));
            expectEq(parsed.protocol, 'https:', 'Non-HTTPS external map protocol');
            expectTrue(parsed.hostname === 'www.google.com' || parsed.hostname === 'waze.com', `Unexpected host: ${parsed.hostname}`);
          }
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P4: Zero-Knowledge guardian rejects server-only keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY, Stripe/JWT secrets) while allowing restricted public Maps keys', () => {
    const serverVarNames = [
      ['GEMINI', 'API', 'KEY'].join('_'),
      ['EXPO_PUBLIC', 'GEMINI', 'API', 'KEY'].join('_'),
      ['GOOGLE', 'MAPS', 'SERVER', 'API', 'KEY'].join('_'),
      ['EXPO_PUBLIC', 'GOOGLE', 'MAPS', 'SERVER', 'API', 'KEY'].join('_'),
      ['SUPABASE', 'SERVICE', 'ROLE', 'KEY'].join('_'),
    ];
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(...serverVarNames),
        fc.string({ minLength: 4, maxLength: 24 }).map((s) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, 'x') || 'token'),
        fc.constantFrom<'web' | 'android' | 'ios'>('web', 'android', 'ios'),
        (badVarName, suffix, platform) => {
          let blockedVar = false;
          try {
            assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(`val_${suffix}`, badVarName);
          } catch (err: unknown) {
            blockedVar = err instanceof Error && err.message.includes('SECURITY_VIOLATION');
          }
          expectTrue(blockedVar, `Failed to block server var ${badVarName}`);

          const badValues = [
            ['sk', 'live', suffix].join('_'),
            ['whsec', suffix].join('_'),
            ['service', 'role', suffix].join('_'),
            ['GEMINI', 'API', 'KEY', suffix].join('_'),
            ['GOOGLE', 'MAPS', 'SERVER', 'API', 'KEY', suffix].join('_'),
          ];
          for (const badVal of badValues) {
            let blockedVal = false;
            try {
              assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(badVal, 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY');
            } catch (err: unknown) {
              blockedVal = err instanceof Error && err.message.includes('SECURITY_VIOLATION');
            }
            expectTrue(blockedVal, `Failed to block private credential value in public var`);
          }

          const publicRestrictedKey = ['AIza', 'SyPublicRestricted', suffix].join('');
          const envKeyName =
            platform === 'android'
              ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY'
              : platform === 'ios'
              ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_IOS_KEY'
              : 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY';
          const resolved = resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey(platform, { [envKeyName]: publicRestrictedKey });
          expectEq(resolved, publicRestrictedKey, 'Restricted public Maps key was wrongly rejected');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P5: B2B Digitizer rejects SVG/HTML/executables/oversize (>4MB) and accepts valid JPEG/PNG payloads', () => {
    const validPngHead = new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0d]);
    const validJpgHead = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0, 0x00, 0x10, 0x4a, 0x46, 0x49, 0x46]);
    const validPngB64 = encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(validPngHead);
    const validJpgB64 = encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(validJpgHead);
    const oversizeBytes = new Uint8Array(MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES + 16);
    oversizeBytes.set(validJpgHead, 0);
    const oversizeB64 = encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(oversizeBytes);

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(
          '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>',
          '<!DOCTYPE html><html><script>x()</script></html>',
          'MZ\x90\x00\x03\x00',
          '#!/bin/sh\necho pwn'
        ),
        fc.constantFrom('image/svg+xml', 'text/html', 'image/png', ''),
        (maliciousPayload, badMime) => {
          const evilB64 = encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(toBytes(maliciousPayload));
          const evilRes = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(evilB64, badMime);
          expectEq(evilRes.ok, false, 'Accepted unsafe SVG/HTML/executable payload');

          const overRes = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(oversizeB64, 'image/jpeg');
          expectEq(overRes.ok, false, 'Accepted >4MB image payload');

          const okPng = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(validPngB64, 'image/png');
          expectEq(okPng.ok, true, 'Rejected valid PNG payload');
          const okJpg = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(`data:image/jpeg;base64,${validJpgB64}`, 'image/jpeg');
          expectEq(okJpg.ok, true, 'Rejected valid JPEG data URI payload');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P6: Extreme coords, stale geo invalidation, missing-column detection, and Write-Once async offline fallback invariants', async () => {
    expectEq(parseStrictCoord(''), null, 'Empty string treated as coord');
    expectEq(parseStrictCoord(false), null, 'Boolean treated as coord');
    expectEq(isValidGeoCoordPair(0, 0), false, 'Null-island (0,0) accepted');
    expectEq(isValidGeoCoordPair(91, -109), false, 'Out-of-range latitude accepted');
    expectEq(isValidGeoCoordPair(22.89, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY), false, 'Infinity longitude accepted');
    expectEq(buildExternalMapsNavigationUrl({ latitude: 0, longitude: 0, label: '' }), null, 'Emitted URL for (0,0) without label');

    const cleanTerminal = sanitizeTerminalGeoPayload({ coords: { latitude: Number.NaN, longitude: -109.9 }, cupo_actual: 5 });
    expectTrue(!('latitud' in cleanTerminal) && !('longitud' in cleanTerminal) && !('cupo_actual' in cleanTerminal), 'Bad terminal coords leaked');

    expectEq(isMissingColumnPostgrestError(new Error("Could not find the 'place_id' column")), true, 'Missed PostgREST column error');
    expectEq(isMissingColumnPostgrestError(new Error('new row violates row-level security policy')), false, 'Misclassified RLS error as column error');

    const sameAddrPatch = await resolveServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch({
      ubicacion: 'Av. Marina #10, Cabo San Lucas',
      existingPlaceId: 'ChIJ_old',
      existingGeoVerifiedAt: '2026-11-19T10:00:00Z',
      prevUbicacion: '  av. marina #10, cabo san lucas  ',
    });
    expectEq(Object.keys(sameAddrPatch).length, 0, 'Unchanged address triggered geo mutation');

    const staleOfflineService = await resolveServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch({
      ubicacion: 'Blvd. Paseo de la Marina #999, Cabo',
      existingPlaceId: 'ChIJ_old',
      existingGeoVerifiedAt: '2026-11-19T10:00:00Z',
      prevUbicacion: 'Av. Antigua #1, Cabo',
    });
    expectEq(staleOfflineService.place_id, null, 'Changed service address offline kept stale place_id');
    expectEq(staleOfflineService.geo_verified_at, null, 'Changed service address offline kept stale geo_verified_at');

    const staleGenericAffiliate = await resolveAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch({
      ubicacion: 'Ubicación Verificada',
      existingPlaceId: 'ChIJ_old_aff',
      existingGeoVerifiedAt: '2026-11-19T10:00:00Z',

    });
    expectEq(staleGenericAffiliate.place_id, null, 'Resetting affiliate address to generic kept stale place_id');

import fc from 'fast-check';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { fetchMasterPassesAuditSummary } from '../../services/bovedaB2BDataHelper';
import { bovedaDataAndSettingsHelpers } from '../../services/bovedaDataAndSettingsHelpers';
import {
  getKineticHomeRouteForRole,
  resolveRoleDestination,
  resolveSyncRole,
} from '../../services/kineticTabRoleGuard';
import { resolveEventGpsCoordinates } from '../../utils/eventModalActions';
import {
  expandShortMapsUrlsInBackground,
  resolveEventGpsCoords,
} from '../../utils/exploreMapAndSearchHelpers';

interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
  statSync(p: string): { isFile(): boolean };
}
interface NodePathModule {
  dirname(p: string): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
}

interface NodeModuleStatic {
  _load: (request: string, parent: unknown, isMain: boolean) => unknown;
}
interface RequireWithCache {
  (id: string): unknown;
  resolve: (id: string) => string;
  cache: Record<string, unknown>;
}

declare const require: RequireWithCache;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const nodeFs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const nodePath = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;
const nodeModule = require('node:module') as NodeModuleStatic;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};

const VALID_JWT = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyLTEifQ.sig12345';

const collectImportCyclesFrom = (entryRel: string): string[] => {
  const exts = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx'];
  const resolveImp = (fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null => {
    if (!spec.startsWith('.')) return null;
    const base = nodePath.resolve(nodePath.dirname(fromFile), spec);
    for (const ext of ['', ...exts]) {
      const candidate = base + ext;
      if (nodeFs.existsSync(candidate) && nodeFs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) return candidate;
    }
    for (const ext of exts) {
      const idx = nodePath.join(base, `index${ext}`);
      if (nodeFs.existsSync(idx)) return idx;
    }
    return null;
  };
  const graph = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const scan = (filePath: string) => {
    if (graph.has(filePath)) return;
    const src = nodeFs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
    const deps: string[] = [];
    const rx = /(?:import|export)\s+(?:[^'"]*?\s+from\s+)?['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null = null;
    while ((m = rx.exec(src)) !== null) {
      if (/^(?:import|export)\s+type\b/.test(m[0])) continue;
      const resolved = resolveImp(filePath, m[1]);
      if (resolved) deps.push(resolved);
    }
    graph.set(filePath, deps);
    for (const dep of deps) scan(dep);
  };
  scan(nodePath.resolve(entryRel));
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const stack: string[] = [];
  const cycles: string[] = [];
  const dfs = (node: string) => {
    visited.add(node);
    stack.push(node);
    for (const next of graph.get(node) || []) {
      const idx = stack.indexOf(next);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        cycles.push(
          stack
            .slice(idx)
            .concat(next)
            .map((p) => nodePath.relative(process.cwd(), p).replace(/\\/g, '/'))
            .join(' -> ')
        );
      } else if (!visited.has(next)) {
        dfs(next);
      }
    }
    stack.pop();
  };
  dfs(nodePath.resolve(entryRel));
  return cycles;
};

describe('KINETIC OS v2.7.8 — Hotfix E2E (TDZ /admin, Squad 400, Maps CORS Web, Roles B2B & RPC 403)', () => {

  it('Propiedad 4: Roles b2b/partner_b2b enrutan a Terminal y sin afiliado activo se omiten RPCs 403 (500 runs)', async () => {

    FILE: src/__tests__/adversarial/invariants.helper.ts

    import fc from 'fast-check';

export interface SplitResult {
  netoClubCentavos: number;
  comisionKineticCentavos: number;
  totalCentavos: number;
}

export function assertIntegridadMonetaria(
  calcularSplit: (montoCentavos: number, tasaPct: number) => SplitResult
): void {
  fc.assert(
    fc.property(
      fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 10_000_000 }),
      fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 50 }),
      (montoCentavos, tasaPct) => {
        const res = calcularSplit(montoCentavos, tasaPct);
        return (
          Number.isInteger(res.netoClubCentavos) &&
          Number.isInteger(res.comisionKineticCentavos) &&
          res.netoClubCentavos >= 0 &&
          res.comisionKineticCentavos >= 0 &&
          res.netoClubCentavos + res.comisionKineticCentavos === res.totalCentavos
        );
      }
    ),
    { numRuns: 500 }
  );
}

export function assertIntegridadCupos(
  puedeInscribir: (inscritosActuales: number, cupoMaximo: number, solicitados: number) => boolean
): void {
  fc.assert(
    fc.property(
      fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 500 }),
      fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 500 }),
      fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 20 }),
      (inscritos, cupoMax, solicitados) => {
        const permitido = puedeInscribir(inscritos, cupoMax, solicitados);
        return permitido ? inscritos + solicitados <= cupoMax : true;
      }
    ),
    { numRuns: 500 }
  );
}

const parsePolyCoords = (points: string): number[] =>

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.7.9 — Ola 1 Unificada Escrow/B2B/Directorio/Cajas + Motor 3D Cerrado (fast-check 500x)', () => {

            );
            assertTrue(
              !isExploreAdminUser({ email: `attacker_${uid}@gmail.com`, user_metadata: { rol: 'admin', tipo_cuenta: 'admin' } }, { rol: 'atleta', tipo_cuenta: 'atleta' }),

            for (const poly of chalice.polys) {

            }

        ),

      );

  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 5 (500x): Conservación de volumen squash & stretch (Sx*Sy*Sz ≈ 1), sombra inversa y Parallax Deep-Z',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(

          fc.double({ min: -500, max: 500, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 0.75, max: 1.25, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 4, max: 64, noNaN: true }),

            assertTrue(Math.abs(phy.scaleX - phy.scaleZ) < 1e-9, 'Deformación X/Z debe ser simétrica');

            const ground = stepBallisticHopAndSquash({ hopHeightPx: 0, velY: 0, squashY: 1, squashVel: 0 }, 16);
            const airborne = stepBallisticHopAndSquash({ hopHeightPx: 50, velY: 0, squashY: 1, squashVel: 0 }, 16);
            assertTrue(airborne.shadowScale < ground.shadowScale && airborne.shadowOpacity < ground.shadowOpacity, 'Sombra en suelo debe encoger/atenuarse al saltar');

            const par = computeDeepZParallaxLayers({ tiltX, tiltY, maxOffsetPx: maxOff });
            assertTrue(Math.abs(par.bgShiftX) <= maxOff && Math.abs(par.fgShiftX) <= maxOff, 'Desplazamiento Deep-Z excede maxOffsetPx');
            assertTrue(par.bgShiftX * par.fgShiftX <= 0 && par.bgShiftY * par.fgShiftY <= 0, 'Fondo y frente parallax en sentido opuesto');
          }

      );

  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 6 (500x): hingeAngleDeg acotado [0°, 108°] y tímpanos laterales cerrados sólidos presentes en tapa del cofre',

          fc.double({ min: -30, max: 150, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 4, max: 64, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 70, max: 110, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 0, max: 1, noNaN: true }),
          fc.boolean(),
          (initHinge, rawTarget, dtMs, sideYawDeg, revealProg, isOpened) => {
            const spring = stepArticulatedHingeSpring({ angleDeg: initHinge, omegaDeg: 600 }, rawTarget, dtMs);
            assertTrue(
              spring.angleDeg >= 0 && spring.angleDeg <= CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG,
              `Bisagra fuera de [0, 108]: ${spring.angleDeg}`

            const chestSide = buildArticulatedChestManifold({

            assertTrue(chestSide.closedLateralTympanumFaces === 56, `Se esperaban 56 caras sólidas de tímpano, hay ${chestSide.closedLateralTympanumFaces}`);
            const visibleTympanums = chestSide.polys.filter((p) => p.tag === 'tympanum');

    FILE: src/__tests__/adversarial/owaspAndGcpZkV277.adversarial.test.ts

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/owaspAndGcpZkV277.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  ConcurrentSimOp,
  createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter,
  createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor,
  createSingleUseQrNonceGuard,
  hmacSha256HexSync,
  simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst,
  verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync,
} from '../../services/kineticOwaspSecurityGuards';
import { completeNativeOAuthSessionFromUrl } from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import {
  sanitizePushDeviceToken,
  shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce,
  syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost,
} from '../../services/kineticPushFcmZeroCostHelper';
import {
  isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl,
  resolveSafeKineticOAuthRedirectTo,
  validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl,
} from '../../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';

interface NodeCryptoModule {
  createHmac(alg: string, key: string): { update(msg: string): { digest(enc: 'hex'): string } };
}
interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
}

declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const nodeCrypto = require('node:crypto') as NodeCryptoModule;
const nodeFs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const nodePath = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const ROOT = process.cwd();

describe('OWASP API Top 10 + OAuth/FCM + Zero-Knowledge GCP v2.7.7 (fast-check 500x)', () => {
  it('P1: Concurrent escrow bookings, chest claims, and 10 KC invariants prevent overbooking, negatives, and double rewards', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 25 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.array(
          fc.oneof(
            fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('reserve' as const), precioKc: fc.constantFrom(50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300) }),
            fc.record({
              kind: fc.constant('claim_reward' as const),
              retoId: fc.constantFrom('cofre_lvl_1', 'cofre_lvl_2', 'reto_streak_7'),
              kcReward: fc.constantFrom(10, 20, 30, 50, 15, -10, 80),
            }),
            fc.constant({ kind: 'cancel_one' as const })
          ),
          { minLength: 1, maxLength: 30 }
        ),
        (cap, memKc, topKc, ops: ConcurrentSimOp[]) => {
          const res = simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(cap, memKc, topKc, ops);
          expectTrue(res.inscritos >= 0 && res.inscritos <= res.cap, `Overbooking or negative spots: ${res.inscritos}/${res.cap}`);
          expectTrue(res.memKc >= 0 && res.topKc >= 0, 'Negative wallet balance');
          expectEq(res.totalKc, res.memKc + res.topKc, 'Wallet total mismatch');

          const dupBurst = simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(5, 100, 0, [
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_unico_1', kcReward: 20 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'COFRE_UNICO_1', kcReward: 20 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_malo', kcReward: 15 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_neg', kcReward: -10 },
          ]);
          expectEq(dupBurst.claimedCount, 1, 'Duplicate or invalid reward claim succeeded');
          expectEq(dupBurst.duplicateClaims, 1, 'Duplicate claim counter missed burst');
          expectEq(dupBurst.totalKc, 120, 'Reward credited more than once or invalid KC accepted');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P2: Stripe HMAC-SHA256 signature verification (<=300s) and event_id idempotency block tampering, replay, and duplicates', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.string({ minLength: 12, maxLength: 64 }),
        fc.string({ minLength: 2, maxLength: 120 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000, max: 1_900_000_000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: -290, max: 290 }),
        fc.constantFrom(50, 100, 250, 500, 1000),
        (secret, msgSeed, nowSec, deltaSec, kcPack) => {
          const whSecret = ['whsec', secret].join('_');
          const rawBody = JSON.stringify({ id: `evt_${nowSec}`, type: 'payment_intent.succeeded', note: msgSeed });
          const ts = nowSec + deltaSec;
          const nodeSig = nodeCrypto.createHmac('sha256', whSecret).update(`${ts}.${rawBody}`).digest('hex');
          const pureSig = hmacSha256HexSync(whSecret, `${ts}.${rawBody}`);
          expectEq(pureSig, nodeSig, 'Pure HMAC-SHA256 diverged from Node crypto');

          const validRes = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody,
            signatureHeader: `t=${ts},v1=${pureSig}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(validRes.ok, true, `Valid Stripe signature rejected: ${validRes.reason}`);

          const tampered = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody: `${rawBody} `,
            signatureHeader: `t=${ts},v1=${pureSig}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(tampered.ok, false, 'Tampered webhook body accepted');

          const expired = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody,
            signatureHeader: `t=${nowSec - 301},v1=${hmacSha256HexSync(whSecret, `${nowSec - 301}.${rawBody}`)}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(expired.ok, false, 'Expired >300s webhook timestamp accepted');

          const proc = createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor();
          const first = proc.process(`evt_${nowSec}`, kcPack);
          const second = proc.process(`evt_${nowSec}`, kcPack);
          expectEq(first.status, 'processed', 'First valid Stripe event rejected');
          expectEq(second.status, 'duplicate_ignored', 'Duplicate Stripe event not ignored');
          expectEq(second.totalKcCredited, kcPack, 'Stripe event credited twice');
          expectEq(proc.process(`evt_bad_${nowSec}`, 55).status, 'rejected', 'Non-10-multiple Stripe KC accepted');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P3: Deterministic rate limiter blocks exactly at maxHits+1, resets on window expiry, resists __proto__, and QR nonce is single-use', () => {
    const poisonKeys = ['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', 'toString', 'valueOf'];
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 12 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 10, max: 120 }),
        fc.constantFrom(...poisonKeys, 'user-uuid-1234', 'b2b-partner-99'),
        fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000, max: 1_800_000_000 }),
        (maxHits, winSec, actorKey, t0) => {
          const limiter = createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter(maxHits, winSec);
          for (let i = 0; i < maxHits; i += 1) {
            const okHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1);
            expectEq(okHit.allowed, true, `Blocked hit ${i + 1} within limit ${maxHits}`);
          }
          const blockedHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1);
          expectEq(blockedHit.allowed, false, 'Exceeded rate limit allowed through');
          expectTrue(blockedHit.retryAfterSeconds >= 1, 'Missing retryAfterSeconds');

          const resetHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1 + winSec);
          expectEq(resetHit.allowed, true, 'Rate limiter did not reset after window expiry');

          const qrGuard = createSingleUseQrNonceGuard();
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_${actorKey}`, 28000000, 'nonceA'), true, 'First valid QR check-in blocked');
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_${actorKey}`, 28000001, 'nonceB'), false, 'Replay on same reservation allowed');
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_other_${actorKey}`, 28000000, 'nonceA'), false, 'Cross-reservation nonce replay allowed');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P4: OAuth whitelist blocks open-redirects, Push FCM tokens obey Write-Once, and repo enforces Zero-Knowledge GCP without .env.tpl or legacy secret URIs', async () => {
    const validRedirects = [
      'kinetic://login',
      'kinetic://login?code=abc123456&state=xyz',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx/login',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth',
      'https://www.kineticapp.com.mx',
      'http://localhost:8081',
    ];
    const evilRedirects = [
      'https://evil.com',
      'https://evil-kineticapp.com.mx',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx.evil.org',
      'http://kineticapp.com.mx',

          let blockedUntrustedAuthorize = false;

          expectTrue(

            'Rejected official direct Google OIDC authorize endpoint'
          );

          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('short'), null, 'Accepted <16 char push token');
          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('__proto__'), null, 'Accepted __proto__ push token');
          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('constructor'), null, 'Accepted constructor push token');
          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('fcm_..traversal_token_123456'), null, 'Accepted traversal push token');
          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('http://evil.com/token1234567890'), null, 'Accepted URL as push token');
          expectEq(sanitizePushDeviceToken('<script>alert(1)</script>123456'), null, 'Accepted XSS push token');
          expectTrue(sanitizePushDeviceToken(goodFcm) !== null, 'Rejected valid FCM token');
          expectEq(shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce({ userId: uid, nextToken: goodFcm, cachedUserId: uid, cachedToken: goodFcm }), false, 'Write-Once re-synced unchanged FCM token');
          expectEq(shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce({ userId: uid, nextToken: `${goodFcm}_v2`, cachedUserId: uid, cachedToken: goodFcm }), true, 'Write-Once skipped rotated FCM token');
        }

      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );

    expectEq(await completeNativeOAuthSessionFromUrl('https://evil.com?code=123456'), null, 'Evil OAuth callback URL was not blocked');
    const pendingPush = await syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost({ userId: uid, rawToken: '' });
    expectEq(pendingPush.ok, true, 'Empty push token sync threw');
    expectEq(pendingPush.synced, false, 'Empty push token synced unexpectedly');

    expectEq(nodeFs.existsSync(nodePath.join(ROOT, '.env.tpl')), false, 'Legacy .env.tpl still exists on disk');
    const legacyRef = ['op', '://'].join('');
    for (const rel of ['.gitignore', '.env.example', '.agents/rules/01-arquitectura-kinetic.md', '.agents/workflows/auditar.md', '.git/hooks/pre-commit']) {

import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  buildCleanEventDeepLink,
  buildCleanSquadDeepLink,
} from '../../components/eventos/eventDetailsPureHelpers';
import {
  KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID,
  KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
  buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl,
  buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink,
  buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl,
  extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl,

  parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState,
  sha256HexOidc,
} from '../../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import {
  isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl,
  validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl,
} from '../../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';

interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): { name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }[];
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const NUM_RUNS = 500;

const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string) => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} | expected=${String(expected)} actual=${String(actual)}`);
};
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string) => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};

const B64_CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_';
const encodeB64UrlUtf8 = (rawStr: string): string => {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(rawStr);
  let out = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const has1 = i + 1 < bytes.length;
    const has2 = i + 2 < bytes.length;
    const b1 = has1 ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = has2 ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    const n = (b0 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b2;
    out += B64_CHARS[(n >>> 18) & 63] + B64_CHARS[(n >>> 12) & 63];
    if (has1) out += B64_CHARS[(n >>> 6) & 63];
    if (has2) out += B64_CHARS[n & 63];
  }
  return out;
};
const toB64Url = (obj: Record<string, unknown>): string => encodeB64UrlUtf8(JSON.stringify(obj));

const FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ike', 'only'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ique', 'mor', 'ales'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ique', '\\s+', 'mor', 'ales'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['lu', 'is', '\\s+', 'enr', 'ique'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['\\b', 'enr', 'ique', '\\b'].join(''), 'i'),
];

const scanDirFiles = (relDir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] => {
  const full = path.join(ROOT, relDir);
  if (!fs.existsSync(full)) return out;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(full, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (['node_modules', '.git', '.expo', 'dist', 'build'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const childRel = path.join(relDir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) scanDirFiles(childRel, out);
    else if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|json|html)$/i.test(entry.name)) out.push(childRel);
  }
  return out;
};

describe('Paso 13 Integral v2.8.0 — Identidad Corporativa Pura + Paquete com.kineticapp.mx + Google OIDC Directo (500x)', () => {
  it('Propiedad 1: Cero nombres/usuarios personales en src/, app.config.js, eas.json, public/, scripts/ y Edge Functions + paquete com.kineticapp.mx', () => {
    const targets = [
      'app.config.js',
      'eas.json',
      'package.json',
      ...scanDirFiles('src'),
      ...scanDirFiles('public'),
      ...scanDirFiles('scripts'),
      ...scanDirFiles('supabase/functions'),
    ];
    for (const rel of targets) {
      const normalized = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
      for (const re of FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS) {
        assertEq(re.test(normalized), false, `Identidad personal residual (${re}) detectada en ${rel}`);
      }
    }

    const appCfg = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app.config.js'), 'utf8');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("version: '2.8.0'"), 'app.config.js version debe ser 2.8.0');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("bundleIdentifier: 'com.kineticapp.mx'"), 'ios.bundleIdentifier debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("package: 'com.kineticapp.mx'"), 'android.package debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');
    assertEq(/\bowner\s*:/.test(appCfg), false, 'app.config.js no debe exponer owner personal');
    assertEq(KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID, 'com.kineticapp.mx', 'KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom('enriquecer tu perfil', 'contenido enriquecido', 'enriched metrics'),
        (safeWord) => {
          const clean = safeWord.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
          assertEq(FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS.some((re) => re.test(clean)), false, `Falso positivo en ${safeWord}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 2: Google OIDC Directo apunta exclusivamente a accounts.google.com sobre kineticapp.com.mx con nonce SHA-256 y cero supabase.co', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'web' | 'native'>('web', 'native'),
        fc.constantFrom<'b2c' | 'b2b'>('b2c', 'b2b'),
        fc.constantFrom('https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth', 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/login', 'https://kineticapp.com.mx'),
        fc.constantFrom('https://evil.com/cb', 'https://gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback', 'http://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth'),
        (platform, mode, validRedirect, badRedirect) => {
          const { rawNonce, nonceHash, state } = generateOidcNonceAndState(platform, mode);
          assertEq(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(nonceHash), true, 'nonceHash SHA-256 inválido');
          assertEq(nonceHash, sha256HexOidc(rawNonce), 'nonceHash no coincide con sha256(rawNonce)');
          const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(state, state);
          assertTrue(Boolean(parsedState && parsedState.platform === platform && parsedState.mode === mode), 'State OIDC inválido');

          const authUrl = buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl({ redirectUri: validRedirect, nonceHash, state });
          assertTrue(authUrl.startsWith('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?'), 'Host OIDC no es accounts.google.com');
          assertEq(new RegExp(`supabase\\.co|${['enrike', 'only'].join('')}`, 'i').test(authUrl), false, 'URL OIDC filtró supabase.co o usuario personal');
          const parsedUrl = new URL(authUrl);
          assertEq(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('response_type'), 'id_token', 'response_type debe ser id_token');
          assertEq(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('nonce'), nonceHash, 'nonce mismatch en URL');

          assertTrue(validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(authUrl) === authUrl, 'validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl rechazó Google OIDC válido');

          if (platform === 'native') {
            const bridgeUrl = buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl({ mode, nonceHash, state });
            assertTrue(bridgeUrl.startsWith('https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth?platform=native'), 'Puente nativo no usa kineticapp.com.mx/oauth');
          }

          let threwBadRedirect = false;
          try {
            buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl({ redirectUri: badRedirect, nonceHash, state });
          } catch {
            threwBadRedirect = true;
          }
          assertEq(threwBadRedirect, true, `Permitió redirectUri prohibido: ${badRedirect}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 3: Extractor id_token valida JWT/nonce/state/iss/aud, rechaza manipulaciones y preserva kineticapp.com.mx en enlaces', () => {
    const futureExp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600;
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'b2c' | 'b2b'>('b2c', 'b2b'),
        fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 32 }).map((s) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, 'x') || 'evt1'),
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 4 }),
        (mode, evtId, splitCount) => {
          const { nonceHash, state } = generateOidcNonceAndState('native', mode);
          const header = toB64Url({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' });
          const validPayload = toB64Url({
            iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
            aud: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
            sub: '112233445566778899',
            email: 'atleta.oficial@example.com',
            nonce: nonceHash,
            exp: futureExp,
          });
          const fakeSig = 'SigBase64Url_0123456789abcdef';
          const goodJwt = `${header}.${validPayload}.${fakeSig}`;
          const deepLink = buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink(goodJwt, state);
          assertTrue(deepLink.startsWith('kinetic://login#id_token='), 'Deep link OIDC mal formado');
          assertEq(isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(deepLink), true, 'isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl rechazó kinetic://login#id_token');

          const okRes = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(deepLink, {
            expectedState: state,
            expectedNonceHash: nonceHash,
            expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
          });
          assertTrue(okRes !== null && okRes.idToken === goodJwt && okRes.mode === mode, 'No extrajo id_token válido');

          // Ataques: nonce adulterado, aud ajeno, state cambiado, error=, token truncado y origen malicioso
          const wrongNonceJwt = `${header}.${toB64Url({ iss: 'https://accounts.google.com', aud: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID, nonce: '0'.repeat(64), exp: futureExp })}.${fakeSig}`;
          const wrongAudJwt = `${header}.${toB64Url({ iss: 'https://accounts.google.com', aud: 'other-client.apps.googleusercontent.com', nonce: nonceHash, exp: futureExp })}.${fakeSig}`;
          const wrongIssJwt = `${header}.${toB64Url({ iss: 'https://evil.issuer.example', aud: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID, nonce: nonceHash, exp: futureExp })}.${fakeSig}`;
          const poisonedPayloadJwt = `${header}.${encodeB64UrlUtf8('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true},"iss":"https://accounts.google.com","nonce":"' + nonceHash + '","exp":' + futureExp + '}')}.${fakeSig}`;

          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${wrongNonceJwt}&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state, expectedNonceHash: nonceHash }), null, 'Aceptó nonce adulterado');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${wrongAudJwt}&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state, expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID }), null, 'Aceptó aud ajeno');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${wrongIssJwt}&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó issuer falso');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${poisonedPayloadJwt}&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó JWT con __proto__');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=truncated.jwt&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó JWT truncado');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${goodJwt}&state=${state}&error=access_denied`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó callback con error=');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`kinetic://login#id_token=${goodJwt}&state=knt1.native.b2b.${'f'.repeat(32)}`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó state CSRF adulterado');
          assertEq(extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(`https://evil.com/oauth#id_token=${goodJwt}&state=${state}`, { expectedState: state }), null, 'Aceptó callback en dominio malicioso');

          const evLink = buildCleanEventDeepLink(evtId, 'Sesión');
          const sqLink = buildCleanSquadDeepLink(evtId, 'Sesión', splitCount, 'host1');
          assertTrue(evLink.startsWith('https://kineticapp.com.mx/eventos?'), `Link evento fuera de dominio único: ${evLink}`);
          assertTrue(sqLink.startsWith('https://kineticapp.com.mx/reservation-detail?'), `Link squad fuera de dominio único: ${sqLink}`);
          assertEq(new RegExp(`${['enrike', 'only'].join('')}|supabase\\.co`, 'i').test(`${evLink} ${sqLink}`), false, 'Enlace público expuso identidad o supabase.co');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });
});

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/securityHardeningV275.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  evaluateProductionAuthAccess,
  generateSecureB2BTempPassword,
} from '../../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime } from '../../services/kineticVaultCrypto';
import { canUseHermesDevPrngFallback } from '../../utils/hermesWebPolyfill';
import { isValidStoryMediaUrl } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import {
  MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES,
  validateSafeStorageImagePayload,
} from '../../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
  }
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;

const toBytes = (str: string): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(str, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);

describe('Hardening Pre-Prod + Zero-Knowledge Secrets v2.7.5+ (fast-check 500x)', () => {
  it('P1: generateSecureB2BTempPassword emits 14-16 char mixed-entropy secrets, never Kinetic2026!, with batch uniqueness', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.integer({ min: 14, max: 16 }), (targetLen) => {
        const batch = new Set<string>();
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
          const pw = generateSecureB2BTempPassword(targetLen);
          expectEq(pw.length, targetLen, 'Password length drifted');
          expectTrue(pw !== 'Kinetic2026!', 'Fixed fallback password emitted');
          expectTrue(/[A-Z]/.test(pw), 'Missing uppercase');
          expectTrue(/[a-z]/.test(pw), 'Missing lowercase');
          expectTrue(/[0-9]/.test(pw), 'Missing digit');
          expectTrue(/[!@#$%&*+\-=?]/.test(pw), 'Missing symbol');
          batch.add(pw);
        }
        expectEq(batch.size, 4, 'Collision inside cryptographic password batch');
      }),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P2: validateSafeStorageImagePayload rejects 100% SVG, HTML, scripts, executables, unsafe MIMEs, empty, and oversize payloads', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(
          '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>',
          '   <!DOCTYPE html><html><script>x()</script></html>',
          '<?xml version="1.0"?><svg></svg>',
          'MZ\x90\x00\x03\x00',
          '\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01\x00',
          '#!/bin/sh\necho pwn',
        ),
        fc.constantFrom('image/svg+xml', 'text/html', 'application/javascript', 'application/pdf', ''),
        fc.constantFrom('evil.svg', 'payload.html', 'shell.sh', 'app.exe', 'photo.jpg'),
        (payloadStr, mime, fileName) => {
          const res = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({
            bytes: toBytes(payloadStr),
            uriOrName: fileName,
            declaredMime: mime,
          });
          expectEq(res.ok, false, `Dangerous payload accepted: ${fileName} (${mime})`);
          expectEq(validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: new Uint8Array(0), uriOrName: 'empty.jpg' }).ok, false, 'Empty accepted');

          const jpegTiny = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0]);
          expectEq(
            validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: jpegTiny, uriOrName: 'big.jpg', maxBytes: 3 }).reason,
            'file_too_large',
            'Oversize limit bypassed',
          );
          expectTrue(MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES === 8 * 1024 * 1024, 'Max image bytes invariant broken');
          expectEq(
            validateSafeStorageImagePayload({
              bytes: jpegTiny,
              uriOrName: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zz4=',
            }).reason,
            'unsafe_mime_or_ext',
            'Data SVG MIME bypass',
          );
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P3: validateSafeStorageImagePayload accepts genuine JPEG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC magic bytes within size ceiling', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic'>('jpg', 'png', 'webp', 'heic'),
        fc.uint8Array({ minLength: 4, maxLength: 32 }),
        (kind, tail) => {
          let payload: Uint8Array;
          let expectedMime: string;
          if (kind === 'jpg') {
            payload = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0, ...tail]);
            expectedMime = 'image/jpeg';
          } else if (kind === 'png') {
            payload = new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, ...tail]);
            expectedMime = 'image/png';
          } else if (kind === 'webp') {
            payload = new Uint8Array([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x57, 0x45, 0x42, 0x50, ...tail]);
            expectedMime = 'image/webp';
          } else {
            payload = new Uint8Array([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x18, 0x66, 0x74, 0x79, 0x70, 0x68, 0x65, 0x69, 0x63, ...tail]);
            expectedMime = 'image/heic';
          }
          const res = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: payload, uriOrName: `upload.${kind}` });
          expectEq(res.ok, true, `Valid ${kind} rejected: ${res.reason}`);
          expectEq(res.contentType, expectedMime, 'Canonical contentType mismatch');
          expectEq(res.ext, kind, 'Canonical ext mismatch');
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P4: Production runtime stays fail-closed for debug flag and synthetic kinetic tokens', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(true, false, undefined, null, 'true'),
        fc.constantFrom('production', 'PRODUCTION', 'development', 'test', undefined),
        fc.constantFrom('kinetic-resilient-', 'kinetic-cached-', 'kinetic-op-', 'demo-', 'mock-'),
        fc.stringMatching(/^[a-z0-9-]{4,16}$/),
        (devFlag, nodeEnv, prefix, suffix) => {
          const isDev = evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime(devFlag, nodeEnv);
          if (String(nodeEnv ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'production' || devFlag !== true) {
            expectEq(isDev, false, 'Dev runtime leaked into non-dev or production');
          }
          const synthAuth = evaluateProductionAuthAccess({
            token: `${prefix}${suffix}`,
            isDevRuntime: false,
            emailConfirmed: true,
          });
          expectEq(synthAuth.allowed, false, 'Synthetic token allowed in production');
          expectEq(synthAuth.reason, 'synthetic_token', 'Wrong synthetic token rejection reason');
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P5: isValidStoryMediaUrl blocks SVG/HTML/script data URIs and HTTP while allowing safe raster base64 and HTTPS', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'jpeg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic'>('jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'heic'),
        fc.constantFrom<'svg+xml' | 'html' | 'javascript'>('svg+xml', 'html', 'javascript'),
        fc.stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{12,24}={0,2}$/),
        (safeKind, badKind, b64Body) => {
          const safeDataUri = `data:image/${safeKind};base64,${b64Body}`;
          const badSvgUri = `data:image/${badKind};base64,${b64Body}`;
          expectEq(isValidStoryMediaUrl(safeDataUri), true, `Safe raster data URI rejected: ${safeKind}`);
          expectEq(isValidStoryMediaUrl(badSvgUri), false, `Unsafe data URI accepted: ${badKind}`);
          expectEq(isValidStoryMediaUrl('http://insecure.kinetic.test/story.jpg'), false, 'Plain HTTP accepted in story URL');
          expectEq(
            isValidStoryMediaUrl('https://gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/u1/s.jpg'),
            true,
            'Valid HTTPS story URL rejected',
          );
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );
  });

  it('P6: canUseHermesDevPrngFallback fails closed outside dev and generateSecureB2BTempPassword throws SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE without CSPRNG', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(true, false, undefined, null, 'true', 1),
        fc.constantFrom('production', 'PRODUCTION', 'development', 'test', undefined),
        (devFlag, nodeEnv) => {
          const allowed = canUseHermesDevPrngFallback(devFlag, nodeEnv);
          const expected = devFlag === true && String(nodeEnv ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'production';
          expectEq(allowed, expected, 'Hermes dev PRNG fallback leaked outside dev or inside production');
        },
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS },
    );

    const cryptoObj = globalThis.crypto as { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array } | undefined;
    const origGetRandomValues = cryptoObj?.getRandomValues;
    let threwUnavailable = false;
    try {
      if (cryptoObj) {
        cryptoObj.getRandomValues = () => {
          throw new Error('SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
        };
      }
      generateSecureB2BTempPassword(16);
    } catch (err: any) {
      threwUnavailable = String(err?.message || '') === 'SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE';
    } finally {
      if (cryptoObj && origGetRandomValues) {
        cryptoObj.getRandomValues = origGetRandomValues;
      }
    }
    expectTrue(threwUnavailable, 'generateSecureB2BTempPassword must fail closed with SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
  });
});

import fc from 'fast-check';

  parseTerminalQrPacket,

  validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard,
} from '../../services/terminalSpeiAndStudioService';
import {
  assertNoSecretInPublicEnv,
  resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey,
} from '../../utils/kineticWebMapEngine';

declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
  }
};
const expectThrows = (fn: () => unknown, pattern: RegExp, msg: string): void => {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const errMsg = String((err as { message?: unknown })?.message ?? err ?? '');
    if (!pattern.test(errMsg)) {
      throw new Error(`${msg} (unexpected error=${errMsg})`);
    }
    return;
  }
  throw new Error(`${msg} (did not throw)`);
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const toB64Url = (obj: Record<string, unknown>): string => {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(obj));
  let bin = '';
  bytes.forEach((b) => { bin += String.fromCharCode(b); });
  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
};
const makeJwt = (payload: Record<string, unknown>): string =>
  `${toB64Url({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })}.${toB64Url(payload)}.sig_test_knt`;

const curWeekIso = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  const m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}T12:00:00`;
};

    ];

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.array(fc.integer({ min: 150, max: 3500 }), { minLength: 1, maxLength: 5 }),
        fc.array(fc.integer({ min: 150, max: 3500 }), { minLength: 0, maxLength: 4 }),
        fc.constantFrom(

          expectEq(mixedReport.total_comision_kinetic_20_mxn, onlyProdReport.total_comision_kinetic_20_mxn, 'mixed comision matches prod');

  it('P2: Bloquea check-in sin token QR/TOTP valido o con prototipos contaminados y acepta ventana 60s', () => {
    expectEq(sha256HexSync('abc'), 'ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad', 'nist sha256 vector');
    const tokenChars = fc
      .stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,32}$/)
      .filter((t) => !['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype'].includes(t.toLowerCase()));
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        tokenChars,
        fc.integer({ min: 1_750_000_000_000, max: 1_900_000_000_000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 25 }),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.constantFrom('__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', '', '   '),
        (qrTok, baseTs, staleOffset, isMasterAdmin, badVal) => {
          const digest = sha256HexSync(qrTok);
          expectTrue(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(digest) && digest !== qrTok, 'sha256 preimage safe');
          expectTrue(sha256HexSync(`${qrTok}_x`) !== digest, 'sha256 avalanche');
          const midBucketMs = Math.floor(baseTs / 60_000) * 60_000 + 30_000;
          const step = Math.floor(midBucketMs / 60_000);

          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: badVal, totpStep: step, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin }).ok, false, 'reject bad qrToken');
          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: 'a'.repeat(165), totpStep: step, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin }).ok, false, 'reject oversize qrToken');

          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: qrTok, totpStep: step, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin: false }).ok, true, 'accept current step');
          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: qrTok, totpStep: null, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin: false }).ok, false, 'reject null totp for non-admin');
          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: qrTok, totpStep: step - staleOffset, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin: false }).ok, false, 'reject stale past step');
          expectEq(validateQrCheckinSettlementGuard({ qrToken: qrTok, totpStep: step + staleOffset, nowSyncedMs: midBucketMs, isMasterAdmin: false }).ok, false, 'reject future step');

          const pktValid = parseTerminalQrPacket(`KINETIC_PASS|${qrTok}|${step}`, midBucketMs);
          expectEq(pktValid.ok, true, 'valid KINETIC_PASS packet');
          expectEq(pktValid.qrIdentifier, qrTok, 'parsed qrIdentifier');

          const pktMalformed = parseTerminalQrPacket(`{"__proto__":{"admin":true},"totp":${step}}`, midBucketMs);
          expectEq(pktMalformed.ok, false, 'reject poisoned JSON');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

        (user, secretPass, domain, badToken) => {

          expectEq(sanitizeSavedAccount({ email: '__proto__' }), null, 'reject poisoned email');

          expectEq(evaluateProductionAuthAccess({ token: badToken, isDevRuntime: false }).allowed, false, 'reject synthetic token in prod');

          const futureExp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600;
          const validJwtAal1 = makeJwt({ sub: `usr_${user}`, exp: futureExp, aal: 'aal1' });
          expectEq(evaluateProductionAuthAccess({ token: validJwtAal1, hasVerifiedTotp: true, isDevRuntime: false }).allowed, false, 'require aal2 when totp enrolled');
          expectEq(evaluateProductionAuthAccess({ token: validJwtAal1, hasVerifiedTotp: false, emailConfirmed: true, isDevRuntime: false }).allowed, true, 'allow confirmed aal1 when no mfa');
          const validJwtAal2 = makeJwt({ sub: `usr_${user}`, exp: futureExp, aal: 'aal2' });

const itCase = typeof g.it === 'function'

const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string) => {

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.7.5 Sprint 1 — 13 Hallazgos P0 + D7 CEO (fast-check 500x)', () => {

        { id: '44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444', nombre: 'Carlos Ruiz', tipo_cuenta: 'atleta', nivel: 'Platinum' },
        { id: '55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555', nombre: 'Valeria Luna', nivel: 'Acceso Base' },
      ];

        fc.property(
          fc.constantFrom(...disallowedRoles),

              { id: '66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666', nombre: 'Otro', email: myEmail.toUpperCase(), rol: 'cliente' },
              { id: '77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777', nombre: '  matÉo  navarro ', rol: 'cliente' },
              { id: '88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888', nombre: 'Cuenta B2B', rol: badRole },
              { id: '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999', nombre: 'Cuenta Tipo', tipo_cuenta: badRole },
              { id: 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', nombre: 'Nivel B2B', nivel: 'Partner B2B' },
              { id: 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb', nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial', rol: 'cliente' },
              { id: 'cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc', nombre: 'Sede Kinetic', rol: 'cliente' },

            assertTrue(eligible.length === 3, `Esperados 3 atletas válidos, got ${eligible.length}`);
            const ids = new Set(eligible.map((a) => a.id));
            assertTrue(!ids.has(myUuid) && !ids.has(b2bOwnerUuid), 'Host o B2B colado en directorio');
            assertTrue(
              eligible.every((a) => !/kinetic oficial|sede kinetic|partner b2b/i.test(a.nombre)),
              'Nombre oficial/B2B colado'
            );

            const m1 = computeSplitEscrow1NMath(priceKc, splitN, undefined, isAdmin);
            const m2 = computeSplitEscrow1NMath(priceKc, splitN, Math.round(priceKc * 0.4), isAdmin);
            assertTrue(m1.effectiveEscrowKc === m2.effectiveEscrowKc, 'Desfase PASO 1/2 vs PASO 2/2');
            assertTrue(m1.effectiveDoorKc === m2.effectiveDoorKc, 'Desfase puerta PASO 1/2 vs PASO 2/2');
            assertTrue(Number.isInteger(m1.effectiveEscrowKc) && m1.effectiveEscrowKc >= 0, 'Escrow negativo/decimal');
            assertTrue(Number.isInteger(m1.effectiveDoorKc) && m1.effectiveDoorKc >= 0, 'Door negativo/decimal');
            assertTrue(

            if (isAdmin) {
