          (amount, badInput) => {
            const formatted = formatMxnCurrency(amount);
            assertTrue(!/NaN|undefined|null/i.test(formatted), `Formato corrupto: ${formatted}`);
            assertTrue(
              /^\$\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.00\u00A0MXN$/.test(formatted),
              `Regex MXN inválida: ${formatted}`
            );
            if (amount >= 1000) {
              assertTrue(formatted.includes(','), `Falta coma de miles en ${formatted}`);
            }
            const safeBad = formatMxnCurrency(badInput);
            assertTrue(safeBad === '$0.00\u00A0MXN', `Entrada malformada no sanitizada: ${safeBad}`);
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );

      assertTrue(formatMxnCurrency(1000) === '$1,000.00\u00A0MXN', '1000 MXN inválido');
      assertTrue(formatMxnCurrency(1549) === '$1,549.00\u00A0MXN', '1549 MXN inválido');
      assertTrue(formatMxnCurrency(3600) === '$3,600.00\u00A0MXN', '3600 MXN inválido');
      assertTrue(localizeVipTierName('Platinum', false) === 'Platino', 'Platinum ES debe ser Platino');

              { id: ghostUuid, estado: badState, activo: true },
              { id: 'dddddddd-4444-4444-8444-444444444444', estado: 'aprobado', activo: false },
              { id: 'eeeeeeee-5555-4555-8555-555555555555', estado: 'aprobado', eliminado: true },

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/stressAuditV274.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy } from '../../services/kineticCancellationPolicyHelper';
import {
  buildConciergePureReply,
  classifyConciergeSemanticIntent,
} from '../../services/kineticConciergeIntentEngine';
import { resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing } from '../../services/kineticFlashSaleHelper';
import {
  buildGridForTotalSpots,
  clampStudioGridToMaxSpots,
  computePinCameraFocusOffset,
  MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS,
} from '../../services/kineticStudioAndMapPureMath';

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite = typeof g.describe === 'function'
  ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
  : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase = typeof g.it === 'function'
  ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
  : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string) => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.7.4 — Adversarial PBT Suite (Flash VIP + Cancel <4h + Concierge + Map/Studio 50)', () => {
  itCase(
    'Propiedad 1: Ventas Flash <3h + Descuentos VIP Exactos (0%/5%/10%/15%/20% + atributos override y suma Escrow 40%+60%, 500 runs)',
    () => {
      const tierPctMap: Record<string, number> = {
        'Acceso Base': 0,
        Bronze: 5,
        Silver: 10,
        Gold: 15,
        Platinum: 20,
      };
      const fixedNowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 16, 12, 0, 0);
      const localBaseDate = new Date(fixedNowMs + 60 * 60_000);
      const isoSoon = `${localBaseDate.getFullYear()}-${String(localBaseDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(localBaseDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const horaSoon = `${String(localBaseDate.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(localBaseDate.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 300 }).map((n) => n * 10),
          fc.constantFrom('Acceso Base', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum'),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.constantFrom(0, 10, 20, 25),
          (baseKc, vipLevel, isAdmin, isEn, explicitFlash, attrPct) => {
            const eventObj = explicitFlash
              ? { precio_kc: baseKc, es_venta_flash: true, atributos: attrPct > 0 ? { descuento_flash_pct: attrPct } : {} }
              : { precio_kc: baseKc, fecha: isoSoon, hora_inicio: horaSoon, atributos: attrPct > 0 ? { descuento_flash_pct: attrPct } : {} };

            const res = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
              event: eventObj,
              vipLevel,
              isAdmin,
              nowMs: fixedNowMs,
              isEn,
            });

            assertTrue(res.discountedTotalKc >= 0, 'discountedTotalKc must be >= 0');
            assertTrue(res.escrow40 >= 0 && res.puerta60 >= 0, 'escrow40 & puerta60 must be >= 0');
            assertTrue(
              res.escrow40 + res.puerta60 === res.discountedTotalKc,
              `Escrow + Puerta mismatch: ${res.escrow40} + ${res.puerta60} !== ${res.discountedTotalKc}`
            );

            if (isAdmin) {
              assertTrue(res.discountedTotalKc === 0 && res.escrow40 === 0 && res.puerta60 === 0, 'Admin must be 0 KC');
              assertTrue(
                res.flashBadgeText === (isEn ? 'FLASH UP TO -20% VIP' : 'FLASH HASTA -20% VIP'),
                `Unexpected admin flash badge: ${res.flashBadgeText}`
              );
              return;
            }

            const baseTierPct = tierPctMap[vipLevel] ?? 0;
            const expectedPct = baseTierPct > 0 ? Math.max(baseTierPct, attrPct) : 0;
            assertTrue(res.discountPct === expectedPct, `Expected pct ${expectedPct}, got ${res.discountPct}`);
            const expectedTotal = Math.round(baseKc * (1 - expectedPct / 100));
            assertTrue(res.discountedTotalKc === expectedTotal, `Expected total ${expectedTotal}, got ${res.discountedTotalKc}`);
            if (baseTierPct === 0) {
              assertTrue(
                res.flashBadgeText === (isEn ? 'FLASH UP TO -20% VIP' : 'FLASH HASTA -20% VIP'),
                `Acceso Base must show VIP promo badge, got ${res.flashBadgeText}`
              );
            } else {
              assertTrue(Boolean(res.flashBadgeText?.includes(`-${expectedPct}%`)), `VIP badge must include -${expectedPct}%`);
            }
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 2: Política de Cancelación (<4h Retención 40% sin falso mensaje de perdones VIP, 72h–4h VIP, >=72h/<=5m 100%, 500 runs)',
    () => {
      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.double({ min: -4, max: 120, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 0, max: 120, noNaN: true }),
          fc.constantFrom('Acceso Base', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum'),
          fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 4 }),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.boolean(),
          fc.integer({ min: 40, max: 1200 }),
          fc.boolean(),
          (hoursUntilEvent, minutesSinceCreated, vipLevel, usedCount, isAdminUser, isZeroKcPass, montoEscrow, isEn) => {
            const pol = evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy({
              hoursUntilEvent,
              minutesSinceCreated,
              vipLevel,
              usedForgivenessCount: usedCount,
              isAdminUser,
              isZeroKcPass,
              montoEscrow,
              isEn,
            });

            if (isAdminUser || isZeroKcPass || minutesSinceCreated <= 5 || hoursUntilEvent >= 72) {
              assertTrue(pol.shouldRefund === true, 'Free/Admin/Grace/72h+ must refund 100%');
              assertTrue(pol.usedVipForgiveness === false, 'Must not consume VIP forgiveness');
            } else if (hoursUntilEvent < 4) {
              assertTrue(pol.shouldRefund === false, '<4h must retain 40%');
              assertTrue(pol.isUnder4hWindow === true && pol.windowType === 'under_4h_strict_retention', 'Must identify <4h strict retention');
              assertTrue(
                pol.actionButtonLabel === (isEn ? 'CANCEL SESSION (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR SESIÓN (RETENCIÓN 40%)'),
                `Bad <4h button label: ${pol.actionButtonLabel}`
              );
              const mergedMsg = `${pol.windowMessage} ${pol.resultMessage}`.toLowerCase();
              assertTrue(
                !mergedMsg.includes('sin perdones vip') && !mergedMsg.includes('no vip forgiveness left'),
                `False exhausted VIP forgiveness claim inside <4h window: ${mergedMsg}`
              );
            } else {
              assertTrue(pol.isUnder4hWindow === false, '4h..72h is not <4h');
              if (pol.usedVipForgiveness) {
                assertTrue(pol.shouldRefund === true, 'Used VIP forgiveness must refund');
              }
            }
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 3: Enrutador Semántico Concierge IA ES/EN (No-Show/tarde/<4h/cancelar/Flash/QR/SAT nunca caen en tutorial de reserva, 500 runs)',
    () => {
      const cases: Array<{ prompt: string; expected: string }> = [
        { prompt: '¿Qué pasa si llego tarde o hago no-show a mi clase?', expected: 'no_show_late_penalty' },
        { prompt: 'What happens if I arrive late to class or miss it?', expected: 'no_show_late_penalty' },
        { prompt: '¿Puedo cancelar mi clase a menos de 4 horas?', expected: 'cancel_window_4h_72h' },
        { prompt: 'Can I get a refund if I cancel my class within 72h?', expected: 'cancel_window_4h_72h' },
        { prompt: '¿Cómo funcionan los descuentos Flash VIP de última hora?', expected: 'flash_vip_discounts' },
        { prompt: 'How do QR TOTP dynamic passes work at check-in?', expected: 'qr_totp_checkin' },
        { prompt: '¿Cómo funcionan las retenciones SAT y mi CLABE SPEI?', expected: 'sat_cfdi_spei_b2b' },
      ];

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.integer({ min: 0, max: cases.length - 1 }),
          fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 16 }),
          fc.boolean(),
          (idx, rawName, isB2B) => {
            const target = cases[idx];
            const intent = classifyConciergeSemanticIntent(target.prompt);
            assertTrue(intent === target.expected, `Expected ${target.expected} for "${target.prompt}", got ${intent}`);
            assertTrue(intent !== 'how_to_book' && intent !== 'general_fallback', 'Specific prompt fell into booking/fallback');
            const reply = buildConciergePureReply(target.prompt, rawName || 'Atleta', isB2B, 'es');
            assertTrue(reply.length > 40, 'Reply must be informative');
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );

  itCase(
    'Propiedad 4: Enfoque de Pin sin tapar Mini-Card (shift hacia arriba) y Aforo Studio 50 exacto sin celdas + PASILLO fantasma (500 runs)',
    () => {
      const eqArb = fc.constantFrom<'reformer' | 'bike' | 'barre' | 'bag' | 'court' | 'spot'>(
        'reformer', 'bike', 'barre', 'bag', 'court', 'spot'
      );

      fc.assert(
        fc.property(
          fc.double({ min: -60, max: 60, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: -170, max: 170, noNaN: true }),
          fc.double({ min: 0.001, max: 0.25, noNaN: true }),
          fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 120 }),
          fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 12 }),
          fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 12 }),
          eqArb,
          (pinLat, pinLng, latDelta, reqSpots, rawR, rawC, eqType) => {
            const cam = computePinCameraFocusOffset(pinLat, pinLng, latDelta);
            assertTrue(cam.latitude < pinLat, `Camera center ${cam.latitude} must shift south (< ${pinLat}) so pin moves upward`);
            assertTrue(cam.webOffset[1] < 0, `Web pixel Y offset must be negative, got ${cam.webOffset[1]}`);

            const built = buildGridForTotalSpots(reqSpots, eqType);
            assertTrue(built.totalSpots >= 1 && built.totalSpots <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, `Built spots out of range: ${built.totalSpots}`);
            const clamped = clampStudioGridToMaxSpots(rawR, rawC, [], eqType);
            assertTrue(clamped.totalSpots >= 1 && clamped.totalSpots <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, `Clamped spots exceeded 50: ${clamped.totalSpots}`);

            if (reqSpots >= 50) {
              const layout50 = buildGridForTotalSpots(50, eqType);
              assertTrue(layout50.totalSpots === 50, `Expected 50 spots, got ${layout50.totalSpots}`);
              assertTrue(layout50.rows * layout50.cols === 50, `Expected exact 50 grid, got ${layout50.rows}x${layout50.cols}`);
              assertTrue(layout50.disabledCells.length === 0, `Expected 0 phantom aisle cells at 50, got ${layout50.disabledCells.length}`);
            }
          }
        ),
        { numRuns: 500 }
      );
    }
  );
});

import { Feather } from "@expo/vector-icons";

import * as Font from "expo-font";

import * as SplashScreen from "expo-splash-screen";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Animated, Easing, FlatList, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
import { KineticInstallPromptModal } from "../components/shared/KineticInstallPromptModal";
import { KineticStripeProvider } from "../components/KineticStripeProvider";

  KineticIntroOverlay,
  KineticNativeCrashShield,
  getIntroWebVideoUri,
} from "../components/navigation/KineticRootShellGuards";
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";
import { KineticPreferencesProvider, readInitialWebPreferencesSync, syncNativeAndWebThemeSurface, useKineticPreferences } from "../context/KineticPreferencesContext";
import { COLORS } from "../styles/globalStyles";
import { isKineticWebLandingHost } from "../components/web/KineticWebLanding";
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut, isRealSupabaseJwt, readPersistedKineticSessionSync } from "../services/kineticSessionPersistence";
import { resolveRoleDestination } from "../services/kineticTabRoleGuard";
import { getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge } from "../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards";
import { doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, isPendingMfaGateActive } from "../services/kineticSecurityMfaService";
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from "../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine";

const PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY = "@kinetic_pending_oauth_mode_v1";

const PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES = new Set([
  "",
  "index",
  "login",
  "login-type",
  "login_type",
  "login_b2b",
  "register",
  "register-type",
  "register_type",
  "register_b2b",
]);
const PROTECTED_STAY_ROUTES = new Set([
  "(tabs)",
  "privacidad",
  "terminos",
  "reservation-detail",
  "reservation-details",
]);

const enforceDarkNativeWindowAndWebLocks = (
  resolved?: "dark" | "light",
  lang?: "es" | "en"
) => {
  if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    const bootPrefs = readInitialWebPreferencesSync();
    syncNativeAndWebThemeSurface(resolved ?? bootPrefs.resolvedTheme, lang ?? bootPrefs.language);
    if (typeof document !== "undefined" && !document.getElementById("kinetic-web-button-cleaner")) {
      const cleaner = document.createElement("style");
      cleaner.id = "kinetic-web-button-cleaner";
      cleaner.textContent = 'button, [role="button"] { outline: none !important; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important; }';
      document.head.appendChild(cleaner);
    }
  }
};

enforceDarkNativeWindowAndWebLocks();

const applyGlobalSystemLocks = () => {
  try {
    const TextAny = Text as any;
    if (TextAny) {
      TextAny.defaultProps = { ...(TextAny.defaultProps || {}), allowFontScaling: false, maxFontSizeMultiplier: 1 };
    }
    const TextInputAny = TextInput as any;
    if (TextInputAny) {
      TextInputAny.defaultProps = { ...(TextInputAny.defaultProps || {}), allowFontScaling: false, maxFontSizeMultiplier: 1 };
    }
    if (Platform.OS === "android") {
      const FlatListAny = FlatList as any;
      if (FlatListAny) FlatListAny.defaultProps = { ...(FlatListAny.defaultProps || {}), removeClippedSubviews: false };
      const ScrollViewAny = ScrollView as any;
      if (ScrollViewAny) ScrollViewAny.defaultProps = { ...(ScrollViewAny.defaultProps || {}), removeClippedSubviews: false };
    }
  } catch {}
};

applyGlobalSystemLocks();
try { SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync().catch(() => {}); } catch {}

const KineticTheme = {
  ...DarkTheme,
  colors: { ...DarkTheme.colors, background: "#050505", card: "#050505", text: COLORS.textPrimary, border: "#181A20", primary: COLORS.cyan, notification: COLORS.cyan },
};

const KineticLightTheme = {
  ...DefaultTheme,
  colors: { ...DefaultTheme.colors, background: "#ECF1F8", card: "#FFFFFF", text: "#0F172A", border: "#CBD5E1", primary: "#006B82", notification: "#006B82" },
};

export { resolveRoleDestination };

function RootNavigationGuard({ fontsLoaded }: { fontsLoaded: boolean }) {
  const { session, user, profile, isLoading: isAuthLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
  const router = useRouter();
  const segments = useSegments();
  const navigationState = useRootNavigationState();
  const isLandingHost = useMemo(() => isKineticWebLandingHost(), []);

  const alreadyPlayedWebIntro = useMemo(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== "web" || typeof window === "undefined") return false;
    if (isLandingHost) return true;
    try {
      if (window.location?.pathname?.startsWith("/oauth")) return true;
      if (window.sessionStorage?.getItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25") === "1") return true;
      if (!isExplicitKineticSignOut() && readPersistedKineticSessionSync()?.user?.id && window.location?.pathname !== "/") {
        window.sessionStorage?.setItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25", "1");
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [isLandingHost]);

  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(alreadyPlayedWebIntro ? 0 : 1)).current;
  const logoPulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0.96)).current;
  const [showOverlay, setShowOverlay] = useState(!alreadyPlayedWebIntro);
  const [introFinished, setIntroFinished] = useState(Platform.OS !== "web" || alreadyPlayedWebIntro);
  const hasHiddenSplashRef = useRef(false);
  const hasStartedFadeOutRef = useRef(false);
  const [forceSystemReady, setForceSystemReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const bootSafetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setForceSystemReady(true);
      setIntroFinished(true);
      if (!hasHiddenSplashRef.current) {
        hasHiddenSplashRef.current = true;
        SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
      }
    }, 1200);
    return () => clearTimeout(bootSafetyTimer);
  }, []);

  const isNavMounted = Boolean(navigationState?.key);
  const isSystemReady = (fontsLoaded && !isAuthLoading && isNavMounted) || (forceSystemReady && isNavMounted);

  const webVideoUri = useMemo(() => getIntroWebVideoUri(), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showOverlay) return;
    const useNative = Platform.OS !== "web";
    const pulseLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(logoPulseAnim, {
          toValue: 1.04,
          duration: 750,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
          useNativeDriver: useNative,
        }),
        Animated.timing(logoPulseAnim, {
          toValue: 0.96,
          duration: 750,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
          useNativeDriver: useNative,
        }),
      ])
    );
    pulseLoop.start();

    const fallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIntroFinished(true);
    }, Platform.OS === "web" ? 2400 : 520);

    return () => {
      pulseLoop.stop();
      clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
    };
  }, [logoPulseAnim, showOverlay]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fontsLoaded && !hasHiddenSplashRef.current) {
      hasHiddenSplashRef.current = true;
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [fontsLoaded]);

  const finishIntroNow = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try { window.sessionStorage?.setItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25", "1"); } catch {}
    }
    setIntroFinished(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSystemReady || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;

    const explicitSignOut = isExplicitKineticSignOut();
    const liveRequiresMfa = Boolean(getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge().required || (session && doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(session)));
    const rawSnap = !explicitSignOut && !liveRequiresMfa ? readPersistedKineticSessionSync() : null;
    const persistedSnap = rawSnap && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(rawSnap.session) ? rawSnap : null;
    const effectiveSession = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (session || persistedSnap?.session || null);
    const effectiveToken = (effectiveSession as any)?.access_token as string | undefined;
    const hasRealJwt = isRealSupabaseJwt(effectiveToken);
    const effectiveUser = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (user || persistedSnap?.user || null);
    const effectiveProfile = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (profile || persistedSnap?.profile || null);

    const currentRoot = String(segments[0] || "");
    const currentTab = String(segments[1] || "");
    if (currentRoot === "oauth") return;
    const inTabsGroup = currentRoot === "(tabs)";
    const isPublicEntryRoute = PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES.has(currentRoot);
    const isProtectedStayRoute = PROTECTED_STAY_ROUTES.has(currentRoot);

    // 1) Sin sesión o tras cierre explícito: fail-closed 0ms fuera de (tabs), quieto en rutas públicas/legales
    if (!effectiveUser || explicitSignOut) {
      if (inTabsGroup) {
        try {
          router.replace(explicitSignOut ? "/login" : "/");
        } catch {}
      }
      return;
    }

    // 2) Guardias internos de rol solo cuando está en tabs privilegiados
    if (inTabsGroup && (currentTab === "admin" || currentTab === "terminal")) {
      const profileRol = String(effectiveProfile?.rol || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      const validAdminRol = ["admin", "fundador", "ceo"].includes(profileRol);
      const validTermRol = validAdminRol || ["socio", "club", "especialista", "afiliado", "negocio", "estadio", "partner b2b"].includes(profileRol);

  const isLandingRoute = isLandingHost && (!seg0 || seg0 === "index");
  return (

          <Stack.Screen name="register-type" />
          <Stack.Screen name="register" />
          <Stack.Screen name="register_b2b" />
          <Stack.Screen name="oauth" />

export default function RootLayout() {

import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';

export default function TabLayout() {
  const { user, profile, isLoading: isAuthLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState(() => isExplicitKineticSignOut());

    setIsSigningOut(isExplicitKineticSignOut());
    return subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut(setIsSigningOut);
  }, []);

  if (!user?.id || isSigningOut || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
    return <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: themeColors.background }} />;
  }

  return <AuthenticatedTabsShell user={user} profile={profile} isAuthLoading={isAuthLoading} />;
}

function AuthenticatedTabsShell({

  const needsSocioRedirect =

        ? window.location.pathname || ''
        : '';
    const onAdminOrExplore =
      !isCheckingDBRole &&
      (pathname === '/admin' ||
        pathname.endsWith('/admin') ||
        webPath === '/admin' ||
        webPath.endsWith('/admin') ||
        webPath === '/explorar' ||
        webPath.endsWith('/explorar'));
    const onBlockedTerminal =
      !isCheckingDBRole &&

const AndroidTabBarSyncBridge = React.memo(
  ({
    state,
    navigation,
    onSync,
  }: {
    state: any;
    navigation: any;
    onSync: (next: { state: any; navigation: any }) => void;
  }) => {
    const activeKey = state?.routes?.[state?.index]?.key || '';
    const routeKeys = Array.isArray(state?.routes)
      ? state.routes.map((r: any) => `${r.key}:${r.name}`).join('|')
      : '';
    useLayoutEffect(() => {
      onSync({ state, navigation });
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [state?.index, activeKey, routeKeys, navigation, onSync]);
    return null;
  }
);

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Platform,
  StatusBar,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { KineticButton } from '../components/KineticButton';
import { KineticWebLanding, isKineticWebLandingHost } from '../components/web/KineticWebLanding';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../assets/logo.png');

export default function WelcomeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme, t } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['logoBadgeBox']), [resolvedTheme]);
  const showCommercialLanding = useMemo(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return false;
    return isKineticWebLandingHost();
  }, []);

  if (showCommercialLanding) {
    return <KineticWebLanding />;
  }

  if (isLoading || user) {
    return <View style={[styles.mainContainer, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]} />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={[styles.mainContainer, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />

      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
          <View style={styles.logoBadgeBox}>
            <Image
              source={KINETIC_LOGO}
              style={styles.logoImage}
              contentFit="contain"
              cachePolicy="memory-disk"
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
          {/* ACCESO DIRECTO AL LOGIN UNIFICADO */}
          <KineticButton
            title={t('auth.elite_access')}
            iconName="arrow-right"
            iconPosition="right"
            variant="purple"
            style={styles.btnFull}
            onPress={() => router.push('/login')}
          />

          <Text style={[styles.helperText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{t('auth.new_on_court')}</Text>

          <KineticButton
            title={t('auth.create_account')}
            iconName="user-plus"
            iconPosition="left"
            variant="cyan"
            style={styles.btnFull}
            onPress={() => router.push('/register')}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const BG_IMAGE =
  'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534438327276-14e5300c3a48?q=80&w=600&auto=format&fit=crop';

export default function LoginTypeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { tx, themeColors, resolvedTheme, isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
  const navLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    Image.prefetch(BG_IMAGE).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const navigateSafely = useCallback(
    (targetRoute: '/login' | '/login_b2b' | '/register-type' | '/') => {
      if (navLockRef.current) return;
      navLockRef.current = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        navLockRef.current = false;
      }, 300);

      triggerHaptic(targetRoute === '/' ? 'Light' : 'Medium');

      if (targetRoute === '/') {
        router.replace('/');
      } else {
        router.push(targetRoute as any);
      }
    },
    [router]
  );

  return (
    <View style={styles.mainContainer}>
      <View style={styles.bgMediaWrap} pointerEvents="none">
        <Image
          source={{ uri: BG_IMAGE }}
          style={styles.bgImage}
          contentFit="cover"
          cachePolicy="memory-disk"
        />
        <View
          style={[
            styles.bgOverlay,
            isLightMode && { backgroundColor: 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0.92)' },
          ]}
        />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={[
          styles.container,
          {
            paddingTop: insets.top + 16,
            paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 24) + 24,
          },
        ]}
        bounces={false}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
      >
        <View style={styles.topNav}>
          <View style={styles.securityPill}>
            <View style={[styles.securityDot, { backgroundColor: themeColors.green }]} />
            <Text style={styles.securityPillText}>{tx('ACCESO SEGURO TOTP', 'TOTP SECURE ACCESS')}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.spacer} />

        <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.mainTitle}>{tx('SELECCIONA TU ACCESO', 'SELECT YOUR ACCESS')}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            {tx('ELIGE TU PUNTO DE ENTRADA AL ECOSISTEMA KINETIC', 'CHOOSE YOUR ENTRY POINT TO THE KINETIC ECOSYSTEM')}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.cardsContainer}>
          {/* Carril Atleta (B2C - Azul Cian #00F0FF) */}
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.roleCard}
            activeOpacity={0.82}
            delayPressIn={0}
            onPress={() => navigateSafely('/login')}
          >
            <View style={styles.iconContainerBox}>
              <Feather name="user" size={24} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.roleTextContainer}>
              <View style={styles.roleTitleRow}>
                <Text style={styles.roleTitle}>{tx('BÓVEDA DE ATLETA', 'ATHLETE VAULT')}</Text>
                <View style={styles.roleTagCyan}>
                  <Text style={styles.roleTagCyanText}>{tx('ATLETA', 'ATHLETE')}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.roleDesc}>
                {tx('Ingresa a tu perfil, gestiona tus reservas Escrow 40/60 y consulta tus Kineticoins.', 'Access your profile, manage your 40/60 Escrow bookings and check your Kineticoins.')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Feather name="arrow-right" size={20} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {/* Carril Afiliado Operativo (B2B - Morado) */}
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.roleCard,
              styles.roleCardB2B,
              isLightMode && { borderColor: '#7C3AED', borderBottomColor: '#6D28D9' },
            ]}
            activeOpacity={0.82}
            delayPressIn={0}
            onPress={() => navigateSafely('/login_b2b')}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.iconContainerBox,
                isLightMode
                  ? { backgroundColor: '#F5F3FF', borderColor: '#7C3AED' }
                  : { backgroundColor: 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.14)', borderColor: 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.35)' },
              ]}
            >
              <Feather name="briefcase" size={24} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.roleTextContainer}>
              <View style={styles.roleTitleRow}>
                <Text style={[styles.roleTitle, { color: themeColors.purpleText }]}>
                  {tx('CLUB O ESPECIALISTA', 'CLUB OR SPECIALIST')}
                </Text>
                <View style={styles.roleTagPurple}>
                  <Text style={styles.roleTagPurpleText}>{tx('AFILIADO', 'PARTNER')}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.roleDesc}>
                {tx('Accede a la Terminal B2B para escanear llaves Pase QR y auditar tu operación.', 'Access the B2B Terminal to scan dynamic QR passes and audit your operation.')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Feather name="arrow-right" size={20} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.spacer} />

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.bottomRegisterLink}
          activeOpacity={0.75}
          delayPressIn={0}
          onPress={() => navigateSafely('/register-type')}
        >
          <Text style={styles.bottomRegisterText}>
            {tx('¿Nuevo en la red Kinetic?', 'New to the Kinetic network?')}{' '}
            <Text style={styles.bottomRegisterHighlight}>
              {tx('Crear una cuenta', 'Create an account')}
            </Text>
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <View style={styles.bottomThumbRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.backThumbBtn}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            onPress={() => navigateSafely('/')}
          >
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={16} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            <Text style={[styles.backThumbText, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>{tx('ATRÁS', 'BACK')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';

export function UnifiedLoginScreen({ initialMode = 'b2c' }: { initialMode?: 'b2c' | 'b2b' }) {

  const [credsB2B, setCredsB2B] = useState<SafeSavedAccountMeta | null>(null);

  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
  const emailInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const passwordInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);

  const readAutofilledWebInputs = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined') return { domEmail: '', domPassword: '' };
    const emailEl = (document.getElementById('kinetic-login-email') as HTMLInputElement | null) || (document.querySelector('input[autocomplete="email"], input[type="email"]') as HTMLInputElement | null);
    const passEl = (document.getElementById('kinetic-login-password') as HTMLInputElement | null) || (document.querySelector('input[autocomplete="current-password"], input[type="password"]') as HTMLInputElement | null);
    return { domEmail: String(emailEl?.value || '').trim(), domPassword: String(passEl?.value || '').trim() };
  }, []);

  const clearLoginInputsAtomically = useCallback(() => {
    setEmail('');
    setPassword('');
    setPasswordInputResetKey((k) => k + 1);
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const emailEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-login-email') as HTMLInputElement | null;
      const passEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-login-password') as HTMLInputElement | null;
      if (emailEl) emailEl.value = '';
      if (passEl) passEl.value = '';
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const syncFromDom = () => {
      const { domEmail, domPassword } = readAutofilledWebInputs();
      if (domEmail) setEmail((prev) => (prev ? prev : domEmail.slice(0, 120)));
      if (domPassword) setPassword((prev) => (prev ? prev : domPassword.slice(0, 128)));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(syncFromDom, 350);
    document.addEventListener('change', syncFromDom, true);
    return () => { clearTimeout(timer); document.removeEventListener('change', syncFromDom, true); };
  }, [readAutofilledWebInputs]);

  const [alertConfig, setAlertConfig] = useState({

  const showTacticalAlert = useCallback((title: string, message: string, type = 'alert') => {
    const isAuthDenied = /ACCESO DENEGADO|ACCESS DENIED/i.test(String(title || ''));
    setAlertConfig({
      visible: true,

      cancelText: '',
      onConfirm: null,
      secondaryActionText: isAuthDenied ? tx('¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?', 'Forgot password?') : '',
      onSecondaryAction: isAuthDenied
        ? () => {
            setAlertConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }));
            scheduleLoginTimer(() => setShowRecoveryModal(true), 60);

  useEffect(() => () => {

    loginTimersRef.current = [];

  const handleGoogleSSO = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (isSsoLoading) return false;

  const handleForgetAccount = useCallback(async (accountEmail: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');

    setAccountsMap(nextMap);
    if (credsB2C?.email?.trim().toLowerCase() === normAcc) setCredsB2C(null);

  }, [accountsMap, credsB2C, credsB2B, email, clearLoginInputsAtomically]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const showEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillShow' : 'keyboardDidShow';
    const hideEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillHide' : 'keyboardDidHide';
    const subShow = Keyboard.addListener(showEv, (e) => {
      setKeyboardHeight(e.endCoordinates?.height || 260);
      scheduleLoginTimer(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: 124, animated: true }), 80);
    });
    const subHide = Keyboard.addListener(hideEv, () => setKeyboardHeight(0));
    return () => { subShow.remove(); subHide.remove(); };
  }, [scheduleLoginTimer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    loadSanitizedLoginAccounts().then(({ bioEnabled, safeB2C, safeB2B, sanitizedMap }) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      setIsBiometricSwitchEnabled(bioEnabled); setCredsB2C(safeB2C); setCredsB2B(safeB2B); setAccountsMap(sanitizedMap);
      const preferred = initialMode === 'b2b' ? safeB2B || safeB2C : safeB2C || safeB2B;

    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [initialMode]);

  const savedAccountList = useMemo(() => {
    const merged: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};
    for (const acc of [...Object.values(accountsMap), credsB2C, credsB2B]) {
      if (!acc?.email) continue;
      const norm = acc.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!norm || norm === '__proto__' || norm === 'constructor' || norm === 'prototype') continue;
      const prev = merged[norm];
      merged[norm] = prev
        ? { email: norm, nombre: acc.nombre || prev.nombre, rol: prev.rol === 'b2b' || acc.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c' }
        : { ...acc, email: norm };
    }
    return Object.values(merged);
  }, [accountsMap, credsB2C, credsB2B]);

    saveSanitizedLoginAccount(targetEmail, targetMode, accountsMap)
      .then(({ isB2B, safeMeta, nextMap }) => { setAccountsMap(nextMap); if (isB2B) setCredsB2B(safeMeta); else setCredsB2C(safeMeta); })
      .catch(() => {});

  }, [accountsMap]);

  const onSubmitLogin = useCallback(async () => {
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    const { domEmail, domPassword } = readAutofilledWebInputs();
    const cleanEmail = (String(email || '').trim() || domEmail).trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);

  const handleConfirmMfaCode = useCallback(async (code: string) => {

    const bioOk = await runSafeBiometricAuth(tx('Verifica tu biometría para entrar a Kinetic', 'Verify your biometrics to sign in to Kinetic'), tx('Usar PIN del dispositivo', 'Use device PIN'), tx('Usar contraseña', 'Use password'));
    if (!bioOk) { fallbackToManualPassword(); return; }

  const noSel: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

  const lightInput3D = themeColors.isLight
    ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#C084FC' : '#38BDF8', borderBottomColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4', shadowColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4', shadowOpacity: 0.18, elevation: 0 }
    : { backgroundColor: '#05070B' };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[loginStyles.safeArea, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: themeColors.background }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 12 : 0}
      >
        <ScrollView
          ref={scrollRef}
          contentContainerStyle={[
            loginStyles.scrollContent,
            { backgroundColor: themeColors.background, paddingBottom: keyboardHeight > 0 ? keyboardHeight + 44 : 24 },
          ]}

          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >


          <View style={loginStyles.centerContentWrapper}>

                />

                {t('auth.login_subtitle')}

                    autoCorrect={false}

                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    maxLength={128}
                    textContentType="password"

                    onFocus={() => scheduleLoginTimer(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: 168, animated: true }), 75)}

                    <Feather name={showPass ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} size={16} color={themeColors.textMuted} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>

              </View>

              <View style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                <KineticButton
                  title={isAuthSubmitting ? t('auth.signing_in') : t('auth.sign_in')}
                  iconName="zap"
                  disabled={isAuthSubmitting || isSsoLoading}
                  onPress={onSubmitLogin}
                />
              </View>

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[loginStyles.switchLink, noSel]}
                delayPressIn={0}
                onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); router.push('/register'); }}
              >
                <Text style={[loginStyles.switchLinkText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
                  {t('auth.no_account_q')} <Text style={loginStyles.switchHighlight}>{t('auth.create_account')}</Text>
                </Text>

              style={[loginStyles.backThumbBtn, (isAuthSubmitting || isVerifyingMfa) && { opacity: 0.55 }, noSel]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              disabled={isAuthSubmitting || isVerifyingMfa}
              onPress={async () => {

                triggerHaptic('Light');
                if (pendingMfaChallenge) { pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current = null; await cancelPendingMfaLogin(); }

              }}
            >

              <Text style={[loginStyles.backThumbText, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>{t('auth.back')}</Text>

        email={pendingMfaChallenge?.email}
        friendlyName={pendingMfaChallenge?.friendlyName}
        isVerifying={isVerifyingMfa}
        errorMsg={mfaErrorMsg}
        onVerifyCode={handleConfirmMfaCode}
        onCancel={handleAbortMfaChallenge}
      />
      <TwoStepRecoveryModal
        visible={showRecoveryModal && !alertConfig.visible && !pendingMfaChallenge}
        isDark={!themeColors.isLight}
        initialEmail={email}
        onClose={() => setShowRecoveryModal(false)}
        onSubmitEmail={async (targetEmail) => {
          try {
            const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(targetEmail);
            setShowRecoveryModal(false);
            scheduleLoginTimer(() => {
              if (error) {
                triggerHaptic('Error');
                showTacticalAlert(tx('FRICCIÓN DE RECUPERACIÓN', 'RECOVERY ERROR'), mapSupabaseAuthError(error.message, isEn), 'error');
              } else {
                triggerHaptic('Success');
                showTacticalAlert(tx('ENLACE ENVIADO', 'LINK SENT'), tx(`Instrucciones enviadas a ${targetEmail}`, `Instructions sent to ${targetEmail}`), 'success');
              }
            }, 240);
          } catch (err: any) {
            setShowRecoveryModal(false);
            scheduleLoginTimer(() => {
              triggerHaptic('Error');
              showTacticalAlert(
                tx('FRICCIÓN DE RECUPERACIÓN', 'RECOVERY ERROR'),
                mapSupabaseAuthError(String(err?.message || ''), isEn),
                'error',
              );
            }, 240);
          }
        }}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function LoginAtletaScreen() {
  return <UnifiedLoginScreen initialMode="b2c" />;

    if (hash.includes('id_token=')) {

      const hashToken = String(hashParams.get('id_token') || '').trim();
      const parsedHashState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(hashState);
      scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();

      if (parsedHashState?.platform === 'native') {
        try {
          window.location.replace(buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink(hashToken, hashState));
        } catch {
          setErrorMsg(tLocal('Token de Google inválido o expirado.', 'Invalid or expired Google token.'));
        }
        return;
      }

      void (async () => {
        try {
          const challenge = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
          if (!challenge) throw new Error('OIDC_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED');
          const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(currentUrl, {
            expectedState: challenge.state,
            expectedNonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
            expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
          });
          if (!extracted) throw new Error('OIDC_CALLBACK_INVALID');
          const { data, error } = await exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(extracted.idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
          if (error || !data?.user || !data?.session) throw error || new Error('OIDC_SESSION_EMPTY');
          const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot().catch(() => null);
          if (doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(data.session) || mfaSnap?.requiresMfaChallenge || !mfaSnap || mfaSnap.checkFailed) {
            await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
            await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
            if (!cancelled) {
              setErrorMsg(
                tLocal(
                  'Tu cuenta requiere verificación 2FA en /login para completar el acceso.',
                  'Your account requires 2FA verification on /login to complete sign-in.'
                )
              );
              setTimeout(() => { if (!cancelled) latestRef.current.router.replace('/login'); }, 1200);
            }
            return;
          }
          const profile = await ensureFirstTimeProfile(data.user).catch(() => null);
          if (cancelled) return;
          latestRef.current.activateResilientSession(data.user, profile, data.session);
          latestRef.current.router.replace(resolveRoleDestination(data.user, profile, data.session.access_token) as never);
        } catch {
          if (!cancelled) setErrorMsg(tLocal('No fue posible validar tu sesión con Google.', 'Unable to verify your Google session.'));
        }
      })();
      return () => { cancelled = true; };
    }

    if (reqPlatform === 'native') {
      setNativeBridgeMode(true);
      const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(reqState);
      if (!parsedState || parsedState.platform !== 'native' || !SHA256_HEX_RE.test(reqNonce)) {
        setErrorMsg(tLocal('Solicitud de enlace móvil inválida o expirada.', 'Invalid or expired mobile bridge request.'));
        return;
      }
      setShowNativeButton(true);
      setStatusMsg(tLocal('Elige tu cuenta de Google para entrar a Kinetic', 'Choose your Google account to enter Kinetic'));
      let attempts = 0;
      const tryMount = () => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (!gisSlotRef.current) {
          attempts += 1;
          if (attempts < 30) { rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tryMount); return; }
          setErrorMsg(tLocal('No se pudo inicializar el selector de Google.', 'Could not initialize Google Sign-In.'));
          return;
        }
        void mountKineticGoogleGisWidget({
          container: gisSlotRef.current,
          nonceHash: reqNonce,
          locale: langLocal === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es',
          isAborted: () => cancelled,
          onError: () => {
            if (!cancelled) setErrorMsg(tLocal('Google no devolvió credenciales válidas.', 'Google did not return valid credentials.'));
          },
          onCredential: (idToken) => {
            if (cancelled) return;
            setStatusMsg(tLocal('Regresando a la app Kinetic…', 'Returning to the Kinetic app…'));
            window.location.replace(buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink(idToken, reqState));
          },
        })
          .then((dispose) => {
            if (cancelled) { dispose(); return; }
            disposeGis = dispose;
          })
          .catch(() => {
            if (!cancelled) setErrorMsg(tLocal('No se pudo cargar el selector de Google.', 'Could not load Google Sign-In.'));
          });
      };
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tryMount);

      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        disposeGis();
      };
    }

    latestRef.current.router.replace('/login');
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [router]);

  const handleBackPress = () => {
    if (nativeBridgeMode && Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.location.replace(`${KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK}?cancelled=1`);
        return;
      } catch {}
    }
    router.replace('/login');
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.root}>
      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.brand}>KINETIC</Text>
        <Text style={styles.domain}>kineticapp.com.mx</Text>
        {!errorMsg && !showNativeButton && <KineticLoader size={24} color="#00F0FF" />}
        <Text style={errorMsg ? styles.errorText : styles.statusText}>{errorMsg || statusMsg}</Text>
        {showNativeButton && !errorMsg && Platform.OS === 'web' && (
          <View style={styles.slotWrap}>
            {React.createElement('div' as unknown as React.ElementType, {
              ref: gisSlotRef,
              style: { display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', minHeight: 44 },
            })}
          </View>
        )}
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={handleBackPress} activeOpacity={0.85}>
          <Text style={styles.backText}>{tx('VOLVER A INICIAR SESIÓN', 'BACK TO SIGN IN')}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

    // === src/app/register.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, StatusBar, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { TacticalAlertModal } from '../components/KinetiClubModals';
import { LegalTermsModal } from '../components/LegalTermsModal';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { KineticFastAuthPanel } from '../components/auth/KineticFastAuthPanel';
import { LoginMfaChallengeModal } from '../components/auth/LoginMfaChallengeModal';
import { UnifiedRegisterFormBody } from '../components/auth/UnifiedRegisterFormBody';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { mapSupabaseAuthError, useKineticAuth } from '../hooks/useKineticAuth';
import { executeKineticRegistration, validateRealIdentityInputs } from '../services/kineticRegisterHelper';
import { baseRegisterStyles } from '../styles/register.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const RFC_REGEX = /^[A-ZÑ&]{3,4}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$/i;
const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

export function UnifiedRegisterScreen({ initialMode = 'b2c' }: { initialMode?: 'b2c' | 'b2b' }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const { refreshProfile, activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseRegisterStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);

  const [regMode, setRegMode] = useState<'b2c' | 'b2b'>(params?.mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : initialMode);
  const [tipoSocio, setTipoSocio] = useState<'Club' | 'Especialista'>('Club');
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [rfc, setRfc] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [telefono, setTelefono] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPass, setShowConfirmPass] = useState(false);
  const [avatarUri, setAvatarUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [avatarBase64, setAvatarBase64] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [acceptedTerms, setAcceptedTerms] = useState(false);
  const [showTermsModal, setShowTermsModal] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [keyboardExtraPad, setKeyboardExtraPad] = useState(0);
  const isSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
  const centerTopYRef = useRef(0);
  const pendingScrollYRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const scrollTimersRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[]>([]);

  const [alertConfig, setAlertConfig] = useState({ visible: false, title: '', message: '', type: 'alert', confirmText: 'ENTENDIDO', onConfirm: null as (() => void) | null });
  const showTacticalAlert = useCallback((title: string, message: string, type = 'alert') => {
    setAlertConfig({ visible: true, title, message, type, confirmText: tx('ENTENDIDO', 'GOT IT'), onConfirm: null });
  }, [tx]);

  const {
    isSsoLoading, handleGoogleSignIn, pendingMfaChallenge, isVerifyingMfa,
    mfaErrorMsg, verifyPendingMfaLogin, cancelPendingMfaLogin,
  } = useKineticAuth(triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert);

  useEffect(() => {
    const showEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillShow' : 'keyboardDidShow';
    const hideEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillHide' : 'keyboardDidHide';
    const onShow = (e: any) => {
      const kbHeight = Number(e?.endCoordinates?.height || 0);
      if (Platform.OS !== 'ios' && kbHeight > 0) setKeyboardExtraPad(kbHeight);
      if (pendingScrollYRef.current !== null) {
        const y = pendingScrollYRef.current;
        scrollTimersRef.current.push(setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y, animated: true }), 60));
      }
    };
    const onHide = () => {
      setKeyboardExtraPad(0);
      pendingScrollYRef.current = null;
    };
    const s1 = Keyboard.addListener(showEv, onShow);
    const s2 = Keyboard.addListener(hideEv, onHide);
    return () => {
      s1.remove();
      s2.remove();
      scrollTimersRef.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
      scrollTimersRef.current = [];
    };
  }, []);

  const handleFieldFocusScroll = useCallback((localY: number) => {
    const targetY = Math.max(0, centerTopYRef.current + localY - 72);
    pendingScrollYRef.current = targetY;
    scrollTimersRef.current.push(setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: targetY, animated: true }), 110));
  }, []);

  const handleGoogleSSO = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (isLoading || isSsoLoading || isSuccess) return false;
    return handleGoogleSignIn(regMode);
  }, [isLoading, isSsoLoading, isSuccess, handleGoogleSignIn, regMode]);

  const isAffiliateMode = regMode === 'b2b';

  const handlePickAvatar = async () => {
    try {
      triggerHaptic('Light');
      const res = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], allowsEditing: true, aspect: [1, 1], quality: 0.45, base64: true });
      if (!res.canceled && res.assets?.[0]) {
        setAvatarUri(res.assets[0].uri);
        if (res.assets[0].base64) setAvatarBase64(`data:image/jpeg;base64,${res.assets[0].base64}`);
        triggerHaptic('Success');
      }
    } catch {
      showTacticalAlert(tx('ERROR DE GALERÍA', 'GALLERY ERROR'), tx('No se pudo abrir selector de imágenes.', 'Unable to open image picker.'), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRegister = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isSubmittingRef.current || isLoading || isSuccess) return;
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    const validation = validateRealIdentityInputs(
      nombre,
      email,
      telefono,
      acceptedTerms,
      isEn,
      showTacticalAlert,
      triggerHaptic,
      regMode === 'b2b'
    );
    if (!validation.ok) return;

    const { cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone } = validation;
    const cleanPass = password.trim().slice(0, 128);
    const cleanConfirmPass = confirmPassword.trim().slice(0, 128);
    const cleanRfc = rfc.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-ZÑ&0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 13);
    const isAffiliate = regMode === 'b2b';
    const disciplinaSeleccionada = tipoSocio === 'Especialista' ? 'Fisioterapia' : 'Fuerza';

    if (isAffiliate && cleanRfc.length > 0 && !RFC_REGEX.test(cleanRfc)) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      return showTacticalAlert(tx('RFC INVÁLIDO', 'INVALID TAX ID'), tx('Ingresa un RFC válido de 12 o 13 caracteres o déjalo vacío por ahora.', 'Enter a valid 12 or 13 character RFC or leave it blank for now.'), 'warning');
    }
    if (cleanPass.length < 6) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      return showTacticalAlert(tx('CONTRASEÑA CORTA', 'SHORT PASSWORD'), tx('Debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.', 'Must be at least 6 characters long.'), 'warning');
    }
    if (cleanPass !== cleanConfirmPass) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      return showTacticalAlert(
        tx('LAS CONTRASEÑAS NO COINCIDEN', 'PASSWORDS DO NOT MATCH'),
        tx('Verifica que la contraseña y su confirmación sean exactamente iguales.', 'Make sure password and confirmation match.'),
        'warning',
      );
    }

    isSubmittingRef.current = true;
    setIsLoading(true);
    triggerHaptic('Medium');

    try {
      const targetRoute = await executeKineticRegistration({
        isAffiliate,
        tipoSocio,
        cleanNombre,
        cleanEmail,
        cleanPass,
        cleanRfc,
        cleanPhone,
        disciplinaSeleccionada,
        avatarUri,
        avatarBase64,
        refreshProfile,
        activateResilientSession,
      });
      setIsSuccess(true);
      router.replace(targetRoute);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Intenta nuevamente.', 'Please try again.');
      if (errMsg === 'EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED') {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        showTacticalAlert(
          tx('CONFIRMA TU CORREO', 'CONFIRM YOUR EMAIL'),
          tx(
            'Tu cuenta fue creada. Confirma el enlace enviado a tu correo electrónico para iniciar sesión.',
            'Your account was created. Confirm the verification link sent to your email before signing in.'
          ),
          'success'
        );
        router.replace('/login');
        return;
      }
      triggerHaptic('Error');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('FRICCIÓN EN REGISTRO', 'SIGN UP ERROR'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg, isEn), 'error');
    } finally {
      isSubmittingRef.current = false;
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [
    isLoading, isSuccess, nombre, email, telefono, password, confirmPassword, rfc,
    regMode, avatarUri, avatarBase64, acceptedTerms, tipoSocio, refreshProfile, activateResilientSession, router, showTacticalAlert, tx, isEn,
  ]);

  const accentColor = isAffiliateMode ? '#9D4EDD' : '#00F0FF';
  const isManualBusy = isLoading || isSuccess;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safeArea, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: themeColors.background }} behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}>
        <ScrollView
          ref={scrollRef}
          contentContainerStyle={[
            styles.scrollContent,
            { backgroundColor: themeColors.background, paddingBottom: 18 + keyboardExtraPad },
          ]}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          <View style={styles.bottomThumbSplitRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.backThumbHalfBtn, NO_SEL, { borderColor: `${accentColor}55` }]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              onPress={() => {
                triggerHaptic('Light');
                router.replace('/');
              }}
            >
              <Feather name="arrow-left" size={15} color={isLightMode ? (isAffiliateMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#006B82') : accentColor} />
              <Text style={[styles.backThumbHalfText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{tx('ATRÁS', 'BACK')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <View style={styles.modeSwitchLargePill}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.modeLargeOption, NO_SEL, !isAffiliateMode && styles.modeOptionActiveCyan]}
                activeOpacity={0.85}
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setRegMode('b2c');
                }}
              >
                <Feather name="user" size={12} color={!isAffiliateMode ? '#050505' : isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF'} />
                <Text style={!isAffiliateMode ? styles.modeActiveDark : styles.modeInactiveCyan}>{tx('ATLETA', 'ATHLETE')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.modeLargeOption, NO_SEL, isAffiliateMode && styles.modeOptionActivePurple]}
                activeOpacity={0.85}
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setRegMode('b2b');
                }}
              >
                <Feather name="briefcase" size={12} color={isAffiliateMode ? '#FFFFFF' : isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#C77DFF'} />
                <Text style={isAffiliateMode ? styles.modeActiveLight : styles.modeInactivePurple}>{tx('AFILIADO', 'PARTNER')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View
            style={styles.centerContentWrapper}
            onLayout={(e) => {
              centerTopYRef.current = e.nativeEvent.layout.y;
            }}
          >
            <View style={styles.headerBox}>
              <Text style={[styles.title, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                {isAffiliateMode ? tx('ACTIVAR TERMINAL', 'ACTIVATE TERMINAL') : tx('REGISTRO DE ATLETA', 'ATHLETE SIGN UP')}
              </Text>
              <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
                {isAffiliateMode
                  ? tx('Integra tu Club o consulta de Especialista al ecosistema Escrow 40/60.', 'Connect your Club or Specialist practice to the 40/60 Escrow ecosystem.')
                  : tx('Crea tu identidad élite y desbloquea tu Bóveda Kinetic.', 'Create your elite identity and unlock your Kinetic Vault.')}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.fastAuthWrap}>
              <KineticFastAuthPanel
                mode={regMode}
                isBusy={isSsoLoading}
                onGooglePress={handleGoogleSSO}
              />
              <View style={styles.dividerRow}>
                <View style={styles.dividerLine} />
                <Text style={[styles.dividerText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
                  {tx('O REGISTRO MANUAL CON CORREO', 'OR MANUAL EMAIL REGISTRATION')}
                </Text>
                <View style={styles.dividerLine} />
              </View>
            </View>

            <UnifiedRegisterFormBody
              styles={styles}
              isAffiliateMode={isAffiliateMode}
              accentColor={accentColor}
              isLightMode={isLightMode}
              themeColors={themeColors}
              tx={tx}
              isAnyBusy={isManualBusy}
              isLoading={isLoading}
              isSuccess={isSuccess}
              avatarUri={avatarUri}
              handlePickAvatar={handlePickAvatar}
              tipoSocio={tipoSocio}
              setTipoSocio={setTipoSocio}
              nombre={nombre}
              setNombre={setNombre}
              rfc={rfc}
              setRfc={setRfc}
              email={email}
              setEmail={setEmail}
              telefono={telefono}
              setTelefono={setTelefono}
              password={password}
              setPassword={setPassword}
              confirmPassword={confirmPassword}
              setConfirmPassword={setConfirmPassword}
              showPass={showPass}
              setShowPass={setShowPass}
              showConfirmPass={showConfirmPass}
              setShowConfirmPass={setShowConfirmPass}
              acceptedTerms={acceptedTerms}
              setAcceptedTerms={setAcceptedTerms}
              setShowTermsModal={setShowTermsModal}
              handleSubmitRegister={handleSubmitRegister}
              onGoToLogin={() => router.replace('/login')}
              onFieldFocusScroll={handleFieldFocusScroll}
            />
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      <LegalTermsModal
        isVisible={showTermsModal}
        onClose={() => setShowTermsModal(false)}
        onAccept={() => setAcceptedTerms(true)}
        initialTab={isAffiliateMode ? 'b2b' : 'atleta'}
      />
      <TacticalAlertModal alertConfig={alertConfig} setAlertConfig={setAlertConfig} triggerHaptic={triggerHaptic} />
      <LoginMfaChallengeModal
        visible={Boolean(pendingMfaChallenge) && !alertConfig.visible}
        email={pendingMfaChallenge?.email}
        friendlyName={pendingMfaChallenge?.friendlyName}
        isVerifying={isVerifyingMfa}
        errorMsg={mfaErrorMsg}
        onVerifyCode={verifyPendingMfaLogin}
        onCancel={() => { void cancelPendingMfaLogin(); }}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  return <UnifiedRegisterScreen initialMode="b2c" />;
}

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import type { SafeSavedAccountMeta } from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import { isValidTotpSixDigitCode, sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode } from '../../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticLoader } from '../SharedUI';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;
const DARK_INK: any = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

export interface LoginMfaChallengeModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  email?: string;
  friendlyName?: string;
  isVerifying: boolean;
  errorMsg?: string | null;
  onVerifyCode: (code: string) => Promise<boolean> | void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const LoginMfaChallengeModal = memo((props: LoginMfaChallengeModalProps) => {
  const { visible, email, friendlyName, isVerifying, errorMsg, onVerifyCode, onCancel } = props;
  const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['verifyBtn']), [resolvedTheme]);
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    setCode('');
    submitLockRef.current = false;
    const t = setTimeout(() => { try { inputRef.current?.focus(); } catch {} }, 180);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [visible]);

  const canSubmit = isValidTotpSixDigitCode(code) && !isVerifying;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!canSubmit || submitLockRef.current) return;
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    try { await onVerifyCode(code); } finally { submitLockRef.current = false; }
  };

  const handlePasteCode = async () => {
    try {
      let clip = '';
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.readText) {
        clip = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
      } else {
        const expClip = requireOptionalNativeModule<any>('ExpoClipboard');
        if (expClip?.getStringAsync) clip = await expClip.getStringAsync();
      }
      const clean = sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode(clip);
      if (clean) setCode(clean);
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <ReactNativeModal
      isVisible={Boolean(visible)}
      onBackdropPress={isVerifying ? undefined : onCancel}
      onBackButtonPress={isVerifying ? undefined : onCancel}
      avoidKeyboard={true}
      animationInTiming={200}
      animationOutTiming={180}
      backdropTransitionOutTiming={0}
      backdropTransitionInTiming={0}
      hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
      backdropColor={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : COLORS.background}
      backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.92}
      useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}
    >
      <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined} style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
        <View
          style={[
            globalStyles.bottomSheet,
            KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
            {
              backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : themeColors.surface,
              borderColor: isLightMode ? '#38BDF8' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)',
              paddingBottom: 28,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={isVerifying ? () => {} : onCancel} />
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <View style={[styles.shieldCircle, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' }]}>
              <Feather name="shield" size={22} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
              {tx('VERIFICACIÓN 2FA (AAL2)', '2FA VERIFICATION (AAL2)')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {tx(
                `Ingresa el código dinámico de 6 dígitos de ${friendlyName || 'tu app autenticadora'}${email ? ` para ${email}` : ''}.`,
                `Enter the 6-digit code from ${friendlyName || 'your authenticator app'}${email ? ` for ${email}` : ''}.`
              )}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <TextInput
            ref={inputRef}
            style={[
              styles.codeInput,
              {
                color: themeColors.textPrimary,
                backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : 'rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.9)',
                borderColor: errorMsg ? COLORS.red : isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)',
              },
            ]}
            value={code}
            onChangeText={(v) => setCode(sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode(v))}
            placeholder="000000"
            placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
            keyboardType="number-pad"
            maxLength={12}
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            autoFocus={false}
            returnKeyType="done"
            onSubmitEditing={handleSubmit}
          />
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={handlePasteCode} disabled={isVerifying} style={{ alignSelf: 'center', marginTop: 8, paddingVertical: 4, paddingHorizontal: 10 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', color: themeColors.cyanText }}>{tx('Pegar código del portapapeles', 'Paste code from clipboard')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {Boolean(errorMsg) && (
            <View style={styles.errorBox}>
              <Feather name="alert-circle" size={13} color={isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF6B6B'} />
              <Text style={[styles.errorTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF6B6B' }]}>{errorMsg}</Text>
            </View>
          )}

          <TouchableOpacity
            {...DARK_INK}
            style={[styles.verifyBtn, !canSubmit && { opacity: 0.55 }, NO_SEL]}
            disabled={!canSubmit}
            onPress={handleSubmit}
          >
            {isVerifying ? (
              <KineticLoader size={18} color="#050505" />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.verifyBtnTxt}>{tx('VERIFICAR Y ENTRAR A BÓVEDA', 'VERIFY & ENTER VAULT')}</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.cancelBtn, NO_SEL]} disabled={isVerifying} onPress={onCancel}>
            <Text style={[styles.cancelBtnTxt, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {tx('Cancelar e iniciar con otra cuenta', 'Cancel & sign in with another account')}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </ReactNativeModal>
  );
});

export const SavedLoginAccountsStrip = memo(({
  accounts, currentEmail, loginStyles, themeColors, onSelect, onForget,
}: {
  accounts: SafeSavedAccountMeta[]; currentEmail: string; loginStyles: any; themeColors: any;
  onSelect: (acc: SafeSavedAccountMeta) => void; onForget: (email: string) => void;
}) => {
  if (accounts.length === 0) return null;
  const normCur = currentEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
  const solidEdge = themeColors?.background || (themeColors?.isLight ? '#ECF1F8' : '#050505');
  const fadeTransparent = themeColors?.isLight ? 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0)' : 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0)';
  return (
    <View style={loginStyles.savedAccountsWrap}>
      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={loginStyles.savedAccountsScroll}>
        {accounts.map((acc) => {
          const isSelected = normCur === acc.email.trim().toLowerCase();
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={acc.email.trim().toLowerCase()}
              style={[loginStyles.savedAccountChip, NO_SEL, isSelected && loginStyles.savedAccountChipActive]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              onPress={() => onSelect(acc)}
            >
              <Feather name={acc.rol === 'b2b' ? 'briefcase' : 'user'} size={12} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
              <Text style={[loginStyles.savedAccountText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>{acc.email}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity
                hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                onPress={(e) => { e.stopPropagation?.(); onForget(acc.email); }}
                style={loginStyles.chipRemoveBtn}
              >
                <Feather name="x" size={11} color={themeColors.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={[solidEdge, fadeTransparent]}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0.5 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 0.5 }}
        style={loginStyles.savedAccountsEdgeFadeLeft}
      />
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={[fadeTransparent, solidEdge]}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0.5 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 0.5 }}
        style={loginStyles.savedAccountsEdgeFadeRight}
      />
    </View>
  );
});
