    import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert, Platform, KeyboardAvoidingView } from 'react-native';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';

export async function getSafeLocalAuth() {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try { return requireOptionalNativeModule<any>('ExpoLocalAuthentication') || null; } catch { return null; }
}

export async function runSafeBiometricAuth(
  promptMsg = 'Autenticación biométrica KINETIC',
  fallbackMsg = 'Usar PIN del dispositivo',
  cancelMsg = 'Usar contraseña'
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return false;
  try {
    const localAuth = await getSafeLocalAuth();
    if (!localAuth?.hasHardwareAsync || !localAuth?.isEnrolledAsync || !localAuth?.authenticateAsync) return false;
    const [hasHardware, isEnrolled] = await Promise.all([
      localAuth.hasHardwareAsync(),
      localAuth.isEnrolledAsync(),
    ]);
    if (!hasHardware || !isEnrolled) return false;
    const res = await localAuth.authenticateAsync({
      promptMessage: promptMsg,
      cancelLabel: cancelMsg,
      fallbackLabel: fallbackMsg,
      disableDeviceFallback: false,
    });
    return res?.success === true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

interface TwoStepRecoveryModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  isDark?: boolean;
  initialEmail?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmitEmail: (email: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const TwoStepRecoveryModal: React.FC<TwoStepRecoveryModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  isDark = true,
  initialEmail = '',
  onClose,
  onSubmitEmail,
}) => {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(String(initialEmail || '').trim());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [inlineError, setInlineError] = useState('');
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      setValue(String(initialEmail || '').trim());
      setInlineError('');
      submitLockRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [visible, initialEmail]);

  const bgModal = isDark ? '#12121A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0F172A';
  const subColor = isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#475569';
  const placeholderInk = isDark ? 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.46)';
  const inputBg = isDark ? '#1C1C28' : '#F8FAFC';
  const borderCol = isDark ? '#2D2D3D' : '#CBD5E1';

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (submitLockRef.current || loading) return;
    const clean = value.trim();
    if (!clean || !clean.includes('@')) {
      setInlineError(tx('Por favor ingresa un correo electrónico válido.', 'Please enter a valid email address.'));
      return;
    }
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    setInlineError('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmitEmail(clean);
      onClose();
      setValue('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setInlineError(e?.message || tx('No se pudo procesar la recuperación.', 'Could not process account recovery.'));
    } finally {
      submitLockRef.current = false;
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <View style={[styles.overlay, { backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(4, 6, 12, 0.88)' : 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72)' }]}>
          <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: bgModal, borderColor: borderCol }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textColor }]}>{tx('Recuperar Cuenta', 'Recover Account')}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.desc, { color: subColor }]}>
            {tx(
              'Ingresa tu correo registrado para recibir el enlace de restablecimiento:',
              'Enter your registered email to receive the password reset link:'
            )}
          </Text>

          <TextInput
            style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: inlineError ? '#EF4444' : borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
            placeholder={tx('correo@ejemplo.com', 'email@example.com')}
            placeholderTextColor={placeholderInk}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            keyboardType="email-address"
            value={value}
            onChangeText={(txt) => {
              if (inlineError) setInlineError('');
              setValue(txt);
            }}
          />
          {Boolean(inlineError) && (
            <Text style={{ color: isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#B91C1C', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700', marginBottom: 10 }}>
              {inlineError}
            </Text>
          )}

          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnCancel} onPress={onClose} disabled={loading}>
              <Text style={[styles.btnCancelText, { color: subColor }]}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnSubmit} onPress={handleSend} disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#0B0B10" size="small" />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.btnSubmitText}>{tx('Enviar Enlace', 'Send Link')}</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
};

interface GoogleInAppModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  isDark?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (email: string, fullName?: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const GoogleInAppModal: React.FC<GoogleInAppModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  isDark = true,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
}) => {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [gmail, setGmail] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) submitLockRef.current = false;
  }, [visible]);

  const bgModal = isDark ? '#12121A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0B0B10';
  const subColor = isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280';
  const inputBg = isDark ? '#1C1C28' : '#F3F4F6';
  const borderCol = isDark ? '#2D2D3D' : '#E5E7EB';

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (submitLockRef.current || loading) return;
    let cleanEmail = gmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cleanEmail) {
      Alert.alert(tx('Atención', 'Notice'), tx('Ingresa tu cuenta de Google.', 'Enter your Google account.'));
      return;
    }
    if (!cleanEmail.includes('@')) cleanEmail = `${cleanEmail}@gmail.com`;
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm(cleanEmail, name.trim() || undefined);
      onClose();
      setGmail('');
      setName('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      Alert.alert(tx('Error Google In-App', 'Google In-App Error'), e?.message || tx('No se pudo vincular la cuenta.', 'Could not link account.'));
    } finally {
      submitLockRef.current = false;
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView style={{ flex: 1 }} behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}>
        <View style={styles.overlay}>
          <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: bgModal, borderColor: borderCol }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textColor }]}>{tx('Acceso Seguro Google', 'Secure Google Sign-In')}</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.desc, { color: subColor }]}>
              {tx(
                'Inicia sesión o vincula tu cuenta Google directamente sin salir de la app:',
                'Sign in or link your Google account directly without leaving the app:'
              )}
            </Text>

            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx('Nombre completo (opcional)', 'Full name (optional)')}
              placeholderTextColor={subColor}
              value={name}
              onChangeText={setName}
            />
            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx('usuario@gmail.com', 'user@gmail.com')}
              placeholderTextColor={subColor}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              keyboardType="email-address"
              value={gmail}
              onChangeText={setGmail}
            />

            <View style={styles.actions}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnCancel} onPress={onClose} disabled={loading}>
                <Text style={[styles.btnCancelText, { color: subColor }]}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnSubmit} onPress={handleConfirm} disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? <ActivityIndicator color="#0B0B10" size="small" /> : <Text style={styles.btnSubmitText}>{tx('Continuar', 'Continue')}</Text>}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { Platform, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

interface RegisterB2BFieldsSectionProps {

  nombre: string;
  setNombre: (v: string) => void;
  rfc: string;

}

  styles,
  isLightMode,
  themeColors,
  tx,
  iconAccent,
  inputBevelOverride,
  tipoSocio,
  setTipoSocio,
  nombre,
  setNombre,
  rfc,
  setRfc,
  onSubmitToNext,
}) => {
  const rfcInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);

  return (
    <>
      <View style={styles.typeSelectorRow}>
        {(['Club', 'Especialista'] as const).map((item) => {
          const active = tipoSocio === item;
          const displayLabel =

              ? tx('ESPECIALISTA', 'SPECIALIST')
              : tx('CLUB', 'CLUB');
          return (

              key={item}
              style={[
                styles.typeCard,
                NO_SEL,
                isLightMode && !active && {
                  backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF',
                  borderColor: '#C084FC',
                  borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
                  borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED',
                  shadowColor: '#7C3AED',
                  shadowOpacity: 0.22,
                  elevation: 0,
                },
                active && styles.typeCardActive,
              ]}
              onPress={() => {
                triggerHaptic('Selection');
                setTipoSocio(item);
              }}
            >
              <Feather
                name={item === 'Club' ? 'map-pin' : 'award'}
                size={14}
                color={active ? '#FFFFFF' : isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#C77DFF'}
              />
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.typeCardText,
                  active
                    ? { color: '#FFFFFF' }
                    : isLightMode
                    ? { color: '#6D28D9' }
                    : undefined,
                ]}
              >
                {displayLabel}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.formBox}>
        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx(
              'NOMBRE OFICIAL DEL CLUB / ESPECIALISTA',

            )}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather
              name="briefcase"
              size={16}
              color={iconAccent}
              style={styles.icon}
            />
            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx(
                'Ej. Nombre de tu Club, Estudio o Consultorio',
                'e.g. Name of your Club, Studio, or Practice'
              )}
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              autoCorrect={false}
              maxLength={80}
              value={nombre}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setNombre(txt.slice(0, 80))}
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={() => rfcInputRef.current?.focus()}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx(
              'RFC FISCAL (OPCIONAL · 12 O 13 CARACTERES)',
              'TAX ID / RFC (OPTIONAL · 12 OR 13 CHARS)'
            )}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather
              name="file-text"
              size={16}
              color={iconAccent}
              style={styles.icon}
            />
            <TextInput
              ref={rfcInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder="ESF260101AAA"
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              autoCapitalize="characters"
              autoCorrect={false}
              importantForAutofill="no"
              maxLength={13}
              value={rfc}
              onChangeText={(txt) =>
                setRfc(txt.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-ZÑ&0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 13))
              }
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={onSubmitToNext}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </>
  );
};

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Platform,
  StyleProp,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../styles/globalStyles';
import { triggerHaptic } from './SharedUI';

interface KineticBackButtonProps {
  color?: string;
  onPress?: () => void;
  fallbackRoute?: string;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export function KineticBackButton({
  color = '#00F0FF',
  onPress,
  fallbackRoute = '/',
  style,
}: KineticBackButtonProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const isNavigatingRef = useRef(false);

  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {
    if (isNavigatingRef.current) return;
    isNavigatingRef.current = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      isNavigatingRef.current = false;
    }, 280);

    triggerHaptic('Light');

    if (onPress) {
      onPress();
      return;
    }

    const cleanPath = String(pathname || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    // Navegación determinista en pantallas de acceso para evitar rebotes con /(tabs) tras cerrar sesión
    if (
      cleanPath === '/login-type' ||
      cleanPath === '/login_type' ||
      cleanPath === '/register-type' ||
      cleanPath === '/register_type'
    ) {
      router.replace('/');
      return;
    }

    if (
      cleanPath === '/login' ||
      cleanPath === '/login_b2b' ||
      cleanPath === '/login-b2b'
    ) {
      router.replace('/login-type');
      return;
    }

    if (
      cleanPath === '/register' ||
      cleanPath === '/register_b2b' ||
      cleanPath === '/register-b2b'
    ) {
      router.replace('/register-type');
      return;
    }

    if (router.canGoBack()) {
      router.back();
    } else {
      router.replace((fallbackRoute || '/') as any);
    }
  }, [onPress, pathname, router, fallbackRoute]);

  const normalizedColor = String(color || '#00F0FF').toUpperCase();
  const isPurple = normalizedColor === '#A855F7' || normalizedColor === '#9D4EDD';

  const resolvedIconColor = isLightMode ? (isPurple ? '#6D28D9' : '#006B82') : color;
  const dynamicStyles = isLightMode
    ? {
        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
        borderColor: isPurple ? 'rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.4)' : 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.4)',
        borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
        borderBottomColor: isPurple ? '#7C3AED' : '#0284C7',
        shadowColor: '#0F172A',
      }
    : {
        backgroundColor: isPurple ? 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.14)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12)',
        borderColor: isPurple ? 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.45)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.42)',
        borderTopColor: isPurple ? 'rgba(224, 170, 255, 0.65)' : 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.65)',
        borderBottomColor: isPurple ? '#4A1478' : '#006B78',
        shadowColor: isPurple ? COLORS.purple : COLORS.cyan,
      };

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      style={[styles.backButton, dynamicStyles, style]}
      onPress={handlePress}
      delayPressIn={0}
      activeOpacity={0.72}
      hitSlop={{ top: 14, bottom: 14, left: 14, right: 14 }}
    >
      <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color={resolvedIconColor} />
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

export default KineticBackButton;

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backButton: {
    width: 42, height: 42, borderRadius: 13, borderWidth: 1.2, borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderBottomWidth: 4.2,
    shadowColor: COLORS.cyan, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 5 }, shadowOpacity: 0.36, shadowRadius: 10, elevation: 8,
    justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center',
  },
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  Platform,
  StyleProp,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextStyle,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { triggerHaptic } from './SharedUI';

interface KineticButtonProps {
  title: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  iconName?: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  iconPosition?: 'left' | 'right';
  variant?: 'cyan' | 'purple';
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  textStyle?: StyleProp<TextStyle>;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function KineticButton({
  title,
  onPress,
  iconName,
  iconPosition = 'left',
  variant = 'cyan',
  style,
  textStyle,
  disabled = false,
}: KineticButtonProps) {
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const translateYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const useNative = Platform.OS !== 'web';

  const handlePressIn = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.spring(scaleAnim, {
        toValue: 0.982,
        tension: 310,
        friction: 20,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
      Animated.spring(translateYAnim, {
        toValue: 3,
        tension: 310,
        friction: 20,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
    ]).start();
  };

  const handlePressOut = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.spring(scaleAnim, {
        toValue: 1,
        tension: 290,
        friction: 18,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
      Animated.spring(translateYAnim, {
        toValue: 0,
        tension: 290,
        friction: 18,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
    ]).start();
  };

  const isPurple = variant === 'purple';
  const noSel: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

  const lipColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#CBD5E1'
      : '#1E293B'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#6D28D9'
      : '#0284C7'
    : isPurple
    ? '#581C87'
    : '#009FB8';

  const faceBorderColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#CBD5E1'
      : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#C084FC'
      : '#06B6D4'
    : isPurple
    ? 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.78)'
    : 'rgba(95, 255, 255, 0.78)';

  const iconColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#94A3B8'
      : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#6D28D9'
      : '#006B82'
    : isPurple
    ? '#E0AAFF'
    : '#5FFFFF';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      activeOpacity={1}
      onPress={onPress}
      onPressIn={handlePressIn}
      onPressOut={handlePressOut}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={[
        { backgroundColor: 'transparent', width: '100%' },
        noSel,
        Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ outlineStyle: 'none' } as any) : null,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          styles.extrusionBase,
          {
            backgroundColor: lipColor,
            shadowColor: disabled ? 'transparent' : isPurple ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4',
            shadowOpacity: disabled ? 0 : isLightMode ? 0.22 : 0.34,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <Animated.View
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            borderRadius: 15,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }, { translateY: translateYAnim }],
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.glassBubble,
              isPurple && styles.glassBubblePurple,
              isLightMode && (isPurple ? styles.glassBubblePurpleLight : styles.glassBubbleLight),
              disabled && (isLightMode ? styles.disabledBubbleLight : styles.disabledBubble),
              { borderColor: faceBorderColor },
            ]}
          >
            {iconName && iconPosition === 'left' && (
              <Feather name={iconName} size={18} color={iconColor} style={styles.iconLeft} />
            )}
            <Text
              style={[
                styles.title,
                isLightMode && { color: isPurple ? '#5B21B6' : '#0F172A' },
                disabled && (isLightMode ? styles.disabledTextLight : styles.disabledText),
                textStyle,
              ]}
            >
              {title}
            </Text>
            {iconName && iconPosition === 'right' && (
              <Feather name={iconName} size={18} color={iconColor} style={styles.iconRight} />
            )}
          </View>
        </Animated.View>
      </View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

export default KineticButton;

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  extrusionBase: {
    width: '100%',
    borderRadius: 16,
    paddingBottom: 4,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 5 },
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  glassBubble: {
    width: '100%',
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: '#0A0D14',
    borderWidth: 1.5,
    borderTopWidth: 1.6,
    borderRadius: 15,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    paddingVertical: 16,
    paddingHorizontal: 22,
    borderTopColor: 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.56)',
    elevation: 0,
  },
  glassBubbleLight: {
    backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF',
    borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
  },
  glassBubblePurple: {
    backgroundColor: '#120A1E',
    borderTopColor: 'rgba(224, 170, 255, 0.68)',
  },
  glassBubblePurpleLight: {
    backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF',
    borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
  },
  disabledBubble: {
    backgroundColor: '#141720',
    borderWidth: 1,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  disabledBubbleLight: {
    backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0',
    borderWidth: 1,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  iconLeft: {
    marginRight: 10,
  },
  iconRight: {
    marginLeft: 10,
  },
  title: {
    color: '#FFFFFF',
    fontSize: 13,
    fontWeight: '900',
    letterSpacing: 2,
  },
  disabledText: {
    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
  },
  disabledTextLight: {
    color: '#94A3B8',
  },
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticLiquidGlassSurface } from '../shared/KineticLiquidGlassSurface';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut, subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut } from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen } from '../../utils/kineticOverlayStack';
import { IS_COMPACT_SCREEN, KINETIC_DOCK_CLEARANCE, SPACING } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';

export { KINETIC_DOCK_CLEARANCE };

interface KineticTabRouteItem {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  params?: any;
}

interface KineticLiquidGlassTabBarProps {
  state: {
    index: number;
    routes: KineticTabRouteItem[];
  };
  navigation: {
    emit: (options: any) => any;
    navigate: (...args: any[]) => void;
  };
  descriptors?: Record<string, any>;
  insets?: any;
  visibleRouteNames: readonly string[];
  labelsByRoute: Record<string, string>;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  cyanText: string;
  inactiveColor: string;
  bottomOffset: number;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  hasActiveStreak: boolean;
  blurTargetRef?: React.RefObject<any>;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  blurTargetDimensions?: { width: number; height: number } | null;
}

const ROUTE_ICON_MAP: Record<string, keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap> = {
  admin: 'pie-chart',
  index: 'compass',
  eventos: 'calendar',
  kineticlub: 'users',
  terminal: 'monitor',
  boveda: 'user',
};

export const KineticLiquidGlassTabBar: React.FC<KineticLiquidGlassTabBarProps> = ({
  state,
  navigation,
  visibleRouteNames,
  labelsByRoute,
  isLightMode,
  cyanText,
  inactiveColor,
  bottomOffset,
  isAdmin,
  hasActiveStreak,
  blurTargetRef,
  blurTargetReady = false,
  blurTargetDimensions = null,
}) => {
  const isFullOverlayOpen = useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen();
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState(() => isExplicitKineticSignOut());
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsSigningOut(isExplicitKineticSignOut());
    return subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut(setIsSigningOut);
  }, []);
  const router = useRouter();
  const visibleSet = new Set(visibleRouteNames);
  const routesToRender = state.routes.filter((r) => visibleSet.has(r.name));
  const activeRouteKey = state.routes[state.index]?.key;
  const activeVisibleIdx = Math.max(
    0,
    routesToRender.findIndex((r) => r.key === activeRouteKey)
  );
  const [trackWidth, setTrackWidth] = useState(0);
  const lensIndexAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(activeVisibleIdx)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    const anim = Animated.spring(lensIndexAnim, {
      toValue: activeVisibleIdx,
      tension: 280,
      friction: 24,
      useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
    });
    anim.start();
    return () => {
      anim.stop();
    };
  }, [activeVisibleIdx, lensIndexAnim]);

  if (isSigningOut || isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isFullOverlayOpen || routesToRender.length === 0) return null;

  const activeTint = isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF';
  const activeLabelColor = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const slotCount = Math.max(1, routesToRender.length);
  const slotWidth = trackWidth > 0 ? trackWidth / slotCount : 0;
  const maxIdx = Math.max(1, slotCount - 1);
  const lensTranslateX =
    slotWidth > 0
      ? lensIndexAnim.interpolate({
          inputRange: [0, maxIdx],
          outputRange: [0, slotCount > 1 ? (slotCount - 1) * slotWidth : 0],
        })
      : 0;
  const sixTabs = isAdmin || slotCount >= 6;
  const manyTabs = sixTabs || slotCount >= 5;
  const scrimColors: readonly [string, string, string] = isLightMode
    ? ['rgba(236, 241, 248, 0)', 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0.88)', 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0.98)']
    : ['rgba(5, 5, 5, 0)', 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.88)', 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.98)'];

  return (
    <View collapsable={false} pointerEvents="box-none" style={styles.outerDockHost}>
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={scrimColors}
        locations={[0, 0.48, 1]}
        style={[
          styles.bottomFadeScrim,
          { height: Math.max(14, bottomOffset) + 34, elevation: 0 },
        ]}
      />
      <View
        collapsable={false}
        pointerEvents="box-none"
        style={[
          styles.dockWrap,
          {
            bottom: bottomOffset,
            left: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 10 : SPACING.md,
            right: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 10 : SPACING.md,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticLiquidGlassSurface
          isLight={isLightMode}
          active={false}
          accent="cyan"
          borderRadius={34}
          interactive={true}
          blurTargetRef={blurTargetRef}
          blurTargetReady={blurTargetReady}
          blurTargetDimensions={blurTargetDimensions}
          style={[styles.glassPill, { paddingHorizontal: sixTabs ? 6 : manyTabs ? 5 : 8 }]}
        >
          <View
            collapsable={false}
            style={styles.trackRow}
            onLayout={(e) => {
              const w = Math.round(e.nativeEvent.layout.width || 0);
              if (w > 0 && Math.abs(w - trackWidth) > 1) setTrackWidth(w);
            }}
          >
            {slotWidth > 12 && (
              <Animated.View
                pointerEvents="none"
                style={[
                  styles.liquidLens,
                  {
                    left: sixTabs ? 2 : 3,
                    width: Math.max(36, slotWidth - (sixTabs ? 4 : 6)),
                    backgroundColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.14)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16)',
                    borderColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.34)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.36)',
                    borderTopColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)'
                      : 'rgba(186, 255, 255, 0.56)',
                    transform: [{ translateX: lensTranslateX as any }],
                  },
                ]}
              />
            )}
            {routesToRender.map((route) => {
              const focused = route.key === activeRouteKey;
              const rawLabel = labelsByRoute[route.name] || route.name;
              const label = rawLabel;
              const iconName = ROUTE_ICON_MAP[route.name] || 'circle';
              const color = focused ? activeTint : inactiveColor;
              const showStreakDot = route.name === 'kineticlub' && !focused && hasActiveStreak;

              const onPress = () => {
                triggerHaptic('Selection');
                const event = navigation.emit({
                  type: 'tabPress',
                  target: route.key,
                  canPreventDefault: true,
                });
                if (!focused && !event.defaultPrevented) {
                  try {
                    navigation.navigate(route.name, route.params);
                  } catch {
                    router.navigate(
                      (route.name === 'index' ? '/(tabs)' : `/(tabs)/${route.name}`) as any
                    );
                  }
                }
              };

              const onLongPress = () => {
                navigation.emit({
                  type: 'tabLongPress',
                  target: route.key,
                });
              };

              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={route.key}
                  preset="dockTab"
                  onPress={onPress}
                  onLongPress={onLongPress}
                  accessibilityRole="tab"
                  accessibilityState={focused ? { selected: true } : {}}
                  accessibilityLabel={label}
                  style={styles.tabPressItem}
                  contentContainerStyle={[styles.tabPressInner, sixTabs && { paddingHorizontal: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 1 : 2 }]}
                >
                  <View style={styles.iconSlot}>
                    {route.name === 'kineticlub' ? (
                      <View style={styles.teamIconWrap}>
                        <Feather name="users" size={18} color={color} />
                        <View style={styles.teamZapBadge}>
                          <Feather name="zap" size={9} color={focused ? activeTint : cyanText} />
                        </View>
                      </View>
                    ) : (
                      <Feather name={iconName} size={20} color={color} />
                    )}
                    {showStreakDot && (
                      <View style={[styles.streakDot, { backgroundColor: cyanText }]} />
                    )}
                  </View>
                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                    minimumFontScale={0.72}
                    allowFontScaling={false}
                    ellipsizeMode="clip"
                    style={[
                      styles.tabLabel,
                      {
                        color: focused ? activeLabelColor : inactiveColor,
                        fontWeight: focused ? '900' : '700',
                        fontSize: sixTabs
                          ? route.name === 'kineticlub'
                            ? IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 7.8 : 8.5
                            : IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 8.3 : 8.8
                          : manyTabs
                            ? 9.5
                            : 10.5,
                        letterSpacing: sixTabs ? -0.25 : manyTabs ? 0 : 0.2,
                        paddingHorizontal: sixTabs ? (IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 1.5 : 2.5) : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {label}
                  </Text>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.activeBar,
                      { backgroundColor: focused ? activeTint : 'transparent' },
                    ]}
                  />
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </KineticLiquidGlassSurface>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { router as globalRouter } from 'expo-router';
import * as SplashScreen from 'expo-splash-screen';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { readInitialWebPreferencesSync } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit,
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  readPersistedKineticSessionSync,
} from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../../assets/logo.png');

let INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE: any = null;
if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE = require('../../../assets/intro.mp4');
  } catch {
    INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE = null;
  }
}

export const resolveWebVideoUri = (rawSource: any): string | null => {
  if (!rawSource) return null;
  if (typeof rawSource === 'string') return rawSource;
  if (typeof rawSource?.default === 'string') return rawSource.default;
  if (typeof rawSource?.uri === 'string') return rawSource.uri;
  return null;
};

export const getIntroWebVideoUri = (): string | null =>
  Platform.OS === 'web' ? resolveWebVideoUri(INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE) : null;

export class KineticNativeCrashShield extends React.Component<
  { children: React.ReactNode },
  { hasError: boolean; error: any; errorMsg: string }
> {
  private restartTimerRef: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  constructor(props: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorMsg: '' };
  }

  componentWillUnmount() {
    if (this.restartTimerRef) {
      clearTimeout(this.restartTimerRef);
      this.restartTimerRef = null;
    }
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: any) {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error,
      errorMsg: String(error?.message || 'Reintentando montaje seguro...'),
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch() {
    try {
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
    } catch {}
  }

  handleRestart = async () => {
    const validSnap = !isExplicitKineticSignOut() ? readPersistedKineticSessionSync() : null;
    const hasValidProfile = Boolean(validSnap?.user?.id && validSnap?.profile?.id);
    if (!hasValidProfile) {
      try {
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
      } catch {}
    }
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorMsg: '' });
    if (!hasValidProfile) {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location) {
        window.location.replace('/login');
      } else {
        if (this.restartTimerRef) clearTimeout(this.restartTimerRef);
        this.restartTimerRef = setTimeout(() => {
          try {
            globalRouter.replace('/login');
          } catch {}
        }, 16);
      }
    }
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      const retryLabel = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'RESTART INTERFACE' : 'REINICIAR INTERFAZ';
      const techMessage = String(this.state.error?.message || this.state.errorMsg || '').trim();
      const isLightBoot = Platform.OS === 'web' && readInitialWebPreferencesSync().resolvedTheme === 'light';
      return (
        <View style={[guardBaseStyles.fallbackLogoWrap, isLightBoot && { backgroundColor: '#ECF1F8' }]}>
          <View style={guardBaseStyles.logoBadgeBox}>
            <Image
              source={KINETIC_LOGO}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', borderRadius: 32 }}
              contentFit="contain"
            />
          </View>
          <Text style={[guardBaseStyles.errorShieldTitle, isLightBoot && { color: '#006B82' }]}>KINETIC OS</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={guardBaseStyles.errorRetryBtn} onPress={this.handleRestart}>
            <Text style={[guardBaseStyles.errorRetryTxt, isLightBoot && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{retryLabel}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          {Boolean(techMessage) && (
            <Text
              style={{
                color: isLightBoot ? 'rgba(15,23,42,0.55)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)',
                fontSize: 10,
                marginTop: 10,
                paddingHorizontal: 28,
                textAlign: 'center',
              }}
              numberOfLines={3}
            >
              {techMessage}
            </Text>
          )}
        </View>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export const KineticIntroOverlay = React.memo(
  ({
    resolvedTheme,
    backgroundColor,
    fadeAnim,
    logoPulseAnim,
    webVideoUri,
    onFinishIntro,
  }: {
    resolvedTheme: 'dark' | 'light';
    backgroundColor: string;
    fadeAnim: Animated.Value;
    logoPulseAnim: Animated.Value;
    webVideoUri: string | null;
    onFinishIntro: () => void;
  }) => {
    const styles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(guardBaseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['logoBadgeBox']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    return (
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, styles.loaderContainer, { backgroundColor, opacity: fadeAnim }]}
      >
        {Platform.OS === 'web' && webVideoUri ? (
          React.createElement('video' as any, {
            src: webVideoUri,
            autoPlay: true,
            muted: true,
            playsInline: true,
            onEnded: onFinishIntro,
            onError: onFinishIntro,
            style: {
              width: '100%',
              height: '100%',
              objectFit: 'cover',
              backgroundColor: '#050505',
            },
          })
        ) : (
          <View style={[styles.fallbackLogoWrap, { backgroundColor }]}>
            <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: logoPulseAnim }] }}>
              <View style={styles.logoBadgeBox}>
                <Image
                  source={KINETIC_LOGO}
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', borderRadius: 32 }}
                  contentFit="contain"
                  cachePolicy="memory-disk"
                />
              </View>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        )}
      </Animated.View>
    );
  }
);

// Motor Visual 3D Táctil Obsidian v2.5 (Cofre 3D Volumétrico Vivo + Pase QR Wallet + Botones Glow)
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, Easing, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';

import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export type TKinetic3DVariant = 'cyan' | 'purple' | 'gold' | 'green' | 'obsidian';

const VARIANT_PALETTE: Record<
  TKinetic3DVariant,
  { bg: string; border: string; lip: string; text: string; topRim: string }
> = {
  cyan: { bg: '#00D8E8', border: '#5CEEFF', lip: '#006B78', text: '#04080E', topRim: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)' },
  purple: { bg: '#8B38CC', border: '#C77DFF', lip: '#4A1478', text: '#FFFFFF', topRim: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)' },
  gold: { bg: '#F5B800', border: '#FFE169', lip: '#8A6200', text: '#050505', topRim: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)' },
  green: { bg: '#00E05A', border: '#6BFF9E', lip: '#00752E', text: '#04080E', topRim: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.52)' },
  obsidian: { bg: '#0F1623', border: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.42)', lip: '#06090F', text: '#FFFFFF', topRim: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' },
};

// 1. Botón 3D Táctil con Luz Cenital, Labio 3D y Glow Difuminado
export const Kinetic3DButton = React.memo(
  ({
    title,
    subtitle,
    variant = 'cyan',
    iconName,
    onPress,
    disabled = false,
    style,
  }: {
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    variant?: TKinetic3DVariant;
    iconName?: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
    onPress?: () => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
    style?: ViewStyle;
  }) => {
    const { isLightMode, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
    const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const [pressed, setPressed] = useState(false);
    const springAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const pal =
      variant === 'obsidian' && isLightMode
        ? { bg: '#FFFFFF', border: '#0284C7', lip: '#0369A1', text: '#0F172A', topRim: '#FFFFFF' }
        : VARIANT_PALETTE[variant] || VARIANT_PALETTE.cyan;
    const springTo = (toValue: number) => {
      Animated.spring(springAnim, {
        toValue,
        tension: 290,
        friction: 18,
        useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
      }).start();
    };
    return (
      <Pressable
        disabled={disabled}
        onPressIn={() => {
          setPressed(true);
          springTo(1);
          triggerHaptic();
        }}
        onPressOut={() => {
          setPressed(false);
          springTo(0);
        }}
        onPress={onPress}
      >
        <Animated.View
          style={[
            styles.btn3DBase,
            {
              backgroundColor: pal.bg,
              borderTopWidth: 1.8,
              borderLeftWidth: 1.4,
              borderRightWidth: 1.4,
              borderBottomWidth: pressed ? 1.8 : 4.8,
              borderColor: pal.border,
              borderBottomColor: pal.lip,
              shadowColor: pal.bg,
              shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: pressed ? 2 : 6 },
              shadowOpacity: 0.45,
              shadowRadius: 12,
              elevation: pressed ? 3 : 10,
              transform: [
                { perspective: 900 },
                { translateY: springAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0, 2.5] }) },
                { scale: springAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [1, 0.96] }) },
              ],
              opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
              ...(Platform.OS === 'web'
                ? ({
                    boxShadow: pressed
                      ? 'inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35)'
                      : 'inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), inset 0 -3.5px 0 ' + pal.lip + ', 0 6px 14px -4px rgba(0,240,255,0.28)',
                  } as any)
                : {}),
            },
            style,
          ]}
        >
          <View style={[styles.topSpecularRim, { backgroundColor: pal.topRim }]} />
          <View style={styles.btn3DContentRow}>
            {iconName ? <Feather name={iconName} size={15} color={pal.text} /> : null}
            <Text style={[styles.btn3DTitle, { color: pal.text }]}>{title}</Text>
          </View>
          {subtitle ? <Text style={[styles.btn3DSubtitle, { color: pal.text }]}>{subtitle}</Text> : null}
        </Animated.View>
      </Pressable>
    );
  }
);

        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1.035, duration: 650, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 0.985, duration: 650, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        ])
      );
      idleLoop.start();
      return () => idleLoop.stop();
    }, [scaleAnim]);

    const handleChestTap = () => {
      triggerHaptic();
      ringAnim.setValue(0);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -10, duration: 45, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 10, duration: 45, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -7, duration: 45, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 7, duration: 45, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 0, duration: 45, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        ]),
        Animated.timing(ringAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 480, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      ]).start();

      setTapStep((prev) => {
        const next = prev >= 2 ? 0 : prev + 1;
        if (next === 2 && onEvolutionComplete) onEvolutionComplete();
        return next;
      });
    };

    const ringScale = ringAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.85, 1.45] });
    const ringOpacity = ringAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 0.3, 1], outputRange: [0, 0.85, 0] });
    const boxPressAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const springChestTo = (toValue: number) => {
      Animated.spring(boxPressAnim, {
        toValue,
        tension: 260,
        friction: 20,
        useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
      }).start();
    };

    return (
      <Pressable
        onPressIn={() => springChestTo(1)}
        onPressOut={() => springChestTo(0)}
        onPress={handleChestTap}
      >
        <Animated.View
          style={[
            styles.luckyBox3D,
            {
              borderColor: isLightMode ? current.titleColor : current.color,
              transform: [
                { scale: boxPressAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [1, 0.975] }) },
                { translateY: boxPressAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0, 2] }) },
              ],
            },
          ]}
        >
        <View style={styles.chestHeaderBadgeRow}>
          <Text style={styles.luckyStarsText}>{current.stars}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.luckyStageTitle, { color: current.titleColor }]}>{tRarity(current.label)}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.chestStageArea}>
          <Animated.View
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={[
              styles.energyShockwaveRing,
              { borderColor: current.color, opacity: ringOpacity, transform: [{ scale: ringScale }] },
            ]}
          />
          <Animated.View
            {...({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as any)}
            style={[styles.chest3DWrapper, { transform: [{ translateX: shakeAnim }, { scale: scaleAnim }] }]}
          >
            {/* Tapa Superior Biselada 3D */}
            <View style={[styles.chestLid3D, { borderColor: current.color, backgroundColor: current.coreBg }]}>
              <View style={styles.chestLidTopRim} />
              <View style={[styles.chestLatchGem, { backgroundColor: current.color }]}>
                <Text style={styles.chestLatchIcon}>{tapStep >= 2 ? '🔓' : '⚡'}</Text>

            {/* Cuerpo Volumétrico Central + Base con Labio 3D */}

              <View style={styles.chestCoreCenter}>

                <Text style={[styles.chestCoreSubText, { color: current.chestTextColor }]}>
                  {tapStep >= 2 ? tx('¡PREMIOS LISTOS!', 'REWARDS READY!') : tx('GOLPEA EL COFRE', 'TAP THE CHEST')}
                </Text>

    // === src/components/shared/KineticB2BSelectorsCard.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SORTED_CATEGORIES, isWellnessCategory } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { KINETIC_OPERATING_DAYS_OPTIONS, KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M } from '../../constants/kineticEventCatalogs';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { openExternalLinkSafe } from '../../utils/externalLinks';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords } from '../../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import {
  AffiliateDisciplinePickerModal,
  AffiliateOperatingHoursModal,
  CUSTOM_WEEKDAYS,
  resolveCanonicalDaysEs,
  resolveShortDaysDisplay,
} from '../admin/AdminAffiliateSubModals';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const B2B_LOCK_KEYS = [
  'mapsBtn3D', 'mapsBtnLight', 'inputWrap3D', 'inputWrapLight',
  'selectorBtn3D', 'selectorBtnLight', 'selectorBtnPurpleLight',
  'medallionCyanDark', 'medallionCyanLight', 'medallionPurpleDark', 'medallionPurpleLight',
];

export const parseOperatingHoursDraft = (rawHorarios?: string | null) => {
  const full = String(rawHorarios || '').trim();
  const igMatch = full.match(/(\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+|\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+)/i);
  const igSuffix = igMatch ? igMatch[0] : '';
  const clean = full
    .replace(/(\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+|\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+)/gi, '')
    .replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1')
    .trim();

  const timeMatch = clean.match(/(\d{2}:\d{2})\s*(?:a|to|-|–)\s*(\d{2}:\d{2})/i);
  const openHour = timeMatch && KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M.includes(timeMatch[1]) ? timeMatch[1] : '06:00';
  const closeHour = timeMatch && KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M.includes(timeMatch[2]) && timeMatch[2] > openHour ? timeMatch[2] : '21:00';

  const daysPart = clean.split('•')[0]?.trim() || '';
  const lower = daysPart.toLowerCase();
  let daysKey = 'mon_sat';
  let customDaysEs: string[] = ['Lunes', 'Miércoles', 'Viernes'];

  const preset = KINETIC_OPERATING_DAYS_OPTIONS.find(
    (o) => o.key !== 'custom' && (o.es.toLowerCase() === lower || o.en.toLowerCase() === lower)
  );
  if (preset) {
    daysKey = preset.key;
  } else if (lower.includes('lunes a viernes') || lower.includes('monday to friday') || lower.includes('mon–fri') || lower.includes('lun a vie')) {
    daysKey = 'mon_fri';
  } else if (lower.includes('todos') || lower.includes('every day') || lower.includes('daily') || lower.includes('lunes a domingo')) {
    daysKey = 'mon_sun';
  } else if (lower.includes('sábado y domingo') || lower.includes('fin de semana') || lower.includes('sat & sun')) {
    daysKey = 'weekends';
  } else if (daysPart.includes(',')) {
    const matched = CUSTOM_WEEKDAYS.filter((d) => lower.includes(d.es.toLowerCase()) || lower.includes(d.en.toLowerCase())).map((d) => d.es);
    if (matched.length > 0) {
      daysKey = 'custom';
      customDaysEs = matched;
    }
  }

  return { daysKey, customDaysEs, openHour, closeHour, igSuffix };
};

export const openGoogleMapsVenueSearch = (venueName?: string) => {
  triggerHaptic('Light');
  const q = String(venueName || '').trim();
  const url = q
    ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`
    : 'https://www.google.com/maps';
  openExternalLinkSafe(url).catch(() => {});
};

const extractReadableCityText = (val?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(val || '')
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, '')
    .replace(/^[\s•|–—-]+|[\s•|–—-]+$/g, '')
    .trim();
  if (
    !clean ||
    clean === 'Ubicación Verificada' ||
    clean === 'Verified Location' ||
    clean.includes('google.com/maps') ||
    clean.includes('maps.app.goo.gl') ||
    clean.includes('goo.gl/maps')
  ) {
    return '';
  }
  return clean;
};

export const KineticGoogleMapsLinkField = memo(
  ({
    venueName,
    value,
    onChangeValue,
    onDetectedCoords,
    labelEs = 'DIRECCIÓN / ENLACE DE UBICACIÓN',
    labelEn = 'ADDRESS / LOCATION LINK',
  }: {
    venueName?: string;
    value: string;
    onChangeValue: (val: string) => void;
    onDetectedCoords?: (coords: { lat: number | null; lng: number | null }) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ lat: number | null; lng: number | null }>({ lat: null, lng: null });
    const lastReadableCityRef = useRef<string>(extractReadableCityText(value));

    const currentReadable = extractReadableCityText(value);
    if (currentReadable) {
      lastReadableCityRef.current = currentReadable;
    }

    const displayVal = value === 'Ubicación Verificada' || value === 'Verified Location' ? '' : value;

    const handleChange = (raw: string) => {
      const parsed = extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords(raw);
      if (parsed.url) {
        const inlineCity = extractReadableCityText(raw);
        const isShortLink = /maps\.app\.goo\.gl|goo\.gl\/maps/i.test(parsed.url);
        const preservedCity = inlineCity || (isShortLink ? lastReadableCityRef.current : parsed.detectedZone || lastReadableCityRef.current);
        const nextVal = preservedCity ? `${preservedCity} • ${parsed.url}` : parsed.cleanValue;
        onChangeValue(nextVal);
        setCoords({ lat: parsed.lat, lng: parsed.lng });
        onDetectedCoords?.({ lat: parsed.lat, lng: parsed.lng });
      } else {
        const typedReadable = extractReadableCityText(raw);
        if (typedReadable) lastReadableCityRef.current = typedReadable;
        onChangeValue(raw);
        if (!raw.trim()) {
          lastReadableCityRef.current = '';
          setCoords({ lat: null, lng: null });
          onDetectedCoords?.({ lat: null, lng: null });
        }
      }
    };

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{tx(labelEs, labelEn)}</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          style={[s.mapsBtn3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.mapsBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
          onPress={() => openGoogleMapsVenueSearch(venueName)}
        >
          <Text selectable={false} style={[s.mapsBtnTxt, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
            {tx(
              '📍 Toca aquí para buscar en Google Maps y copiar el enlace',
              '📍 Tap here to search on Google Maps and copy the link'
            )}
          </Text>
          <Feather name="external-link" size={13} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <View style={[s.inputWrap3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.inputWrapLight]}>
          <Feather name="map-pin" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          <TextInput
            style={[s.textInput, { fontSize: 16, color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}
            placeholder={tx('Pega aquí el link de Google Maps...', 'Paste the Google Maps link here...')}
            placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            value={displayVal}
            onChangeText={handleChange}
          />
        </View>
        {coords.lat !== null && coords.lng !== null && (
          <Text style={{ color: themeColors.green, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800', marginTop: 4 }}>
            {tx(
              `✓ Coordenadas GPS detectadas (${coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${coords.lng.toFixed(4)})`,
              `✓ GPS coordinates detected (${coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${coords.lng.toFixed(4)})`
            )}
          </Text>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export const KineticDisciplineSelectorField = memo(
  ({
    selectedDiscipline,
    onSelectDiscipline,
    labelEs,
    labelEn,
  }: {
    selectedDiscipline: string;
    onSelectDiscipline: (disc: string) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx, tDisc } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const activeDisc = selectedDiscipline || 'Fuerza';
    const isWell = isWellnessCategory(activeDisc);
    const lowDisc = activeDisc.toLowerCase();
    const medallionIcon: any = isWell
      ? lowDisc.includes('fisio') || lowDisc.includes('masaje') || lowDisc.includes('rehab')
        ? 'heart'
        : 'sun'
      : lowDisc.includes('cross') || lowDisc.includes('hiit') || lowDisc.includes('box')
        ? 'zap'
        : 'activity';

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
          {tx(
            labelEs || `DISCIPLINA PRINCIPAL (${SORTED_CATEGORIES.length})`,
            labelEn || `PRIMARY DISCIPLINE (${SORTED_CATEGORIES.length})`
          )}
        </Text>
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          style={[s.selectorBtn3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
          onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setOpen(true); }}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              s.medallionBase,
              isWell
                ? isLightMode ? s.medallionPurpleLight : s.medallionPurpleDark
                : isLightMode ? s.medallionCyanLight : s.medallionCyanDark,
            ]}
          >
            <Feather
              name={medallionIcon}
              size={13}
              color={isWell ? (isLightMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#E0AAFF') : isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan}
            />
          </View>
          <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {tDisc(activeDisc)}
          </Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={isWell ? themeColors.purpleText : themeColors.cyanText} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <AffiliateDisciplinePickerModal
          visible={open}
          selectedDiscipline={activeDisc}
          onSelectDiscipline={onSelectDiscipline}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export const KineticOperatingHoursDualField = memo(
  ({
    horariosValue,
    onChangeHorarios,
    labelEs = 'HORARIOS DE ATENCIÓN',
    labelEn = 'OPERATING HOURS',
  }: {
    horariosValue?: string;
    onChangeHorarios: (nextCanonicalHorarios: string) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const initial = useMemo(() => parseOperatingHoursDraft(horariosValue), [horariosValue]);

    const [daysKey, setDaysKey] = useState(initial.daysKey);
    const [customDaysEs, setCustomDaysEs] = useState<string[]>(initial.customDaysEs);
    const [openHour, setOpenHour] = useState(initial.openHour);
    const [closeHour, setCloseHour] = useState(initial.closeHour);
    const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState<'days' | 'hours' | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const parsed = parseOperatingHoursDraft(horariosValue);
      setDaysKey(parsed.daysKey);
      setCustomDaysEs(parsed.customDaysEs);
      setOpenHour(parsed.openHour);
      setCloseHour(parsed.closeHour);
    }, [horariosValue]);

    const emitSchedule = (dKey: string, cDays: string[], oH: string, cH: string) => {
      const canonical = `${resolveCanonicalDaysEs(dKey, cDays)} • ${oH} a ${cH}${initial.igSuffix}`;
      onChangeHorarios(canonical);
    };

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{tx(labelEs, labelEn)}</Text>
        <View style={s.dualRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[s.selectorBtn3D, { flex: 1.12 }, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setModalMode('days'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="calendar" size={13} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {resolveShortDaysDisplay(daysKey, customDaysEs, isEn)}
            </Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[s.selectorBtn3D, { flex: 0.96 }, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnPurpleLight, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setModalMode('hours'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="clock" size={13} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
            <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {`${openHour} ${isEn ? 'to' : 'a'} ${closeHour}`}
            </Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        <AffiliateOperatingHoursModal
          mode={modalMode}
          selectedDaysKey={daysKey}
          customDaysEs={customDaysEs}
          openHour={openHour}
          closeHour={closeHour}
          onApplyDays={(nextKey, nextCustom) => {
            setDaysKey(nextKey);
            setCustomDaysEs(nextCustom);
            emitSchedule(nextKey, nextCustom, openHour, closeHour);
          }}
          onApplyHours={(nextOpen, nextClose) => {
            setOpenHour(nextOpen);
            setCloseHour(nextClose);
            emitSchedule(daysKey, customDaysEs, nextOpen, nextClose);
          }}
          onClose={() => setModalMode(null)}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }
);

import React, { memo, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { GestureResponderEvent, LayoutChangeEvent, Platform, StyleProp, StyleSheet, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { computeDeepZParallaxLayers } from '../../services/kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';

export interface IKineticDeepParallaxCard3DProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  accentColor?: string;
  secondaryColor?: string;
  maxOffsetPx?: number;
  isLightMode?: boolean;
}

export const KineticDeepParallaxCard3D = memo(({
  children,
  style,
  accentColor = '#00F0FF',
  secondaryColor = '#9D4EDD',
  maxOffsetPx = 6,
  isLightMode = false,
}: IKineticDeepParallaxCard3DProps) => {
  const [tilt, setTilt] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const sizeRef = useRef<{ w: number; h: number }>({ w: 320, h: 160 });

  const handleLayout = useCallback((e: LayoutChangeEvent) => {
    const { width, height } = e.nativeEvent.layout;
    if (width > 10 && height > 10) {
      sizeRef.current = { w: width, h: height };
    }
  }, []);

  const updateTiltFromLocalPoint = useCallback((locX: number, locY: number) => {
    const { w, h } = sizeRef.current;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(locX) || !Number.isFinite(locY)) return;
    const nx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (locX / w) * 2 - 1));
    const ny = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (locY / h) * 2 - 1));
    setTilt({ x: nx, y: ny });
  }, []);

  const handleTouchStartOrMove = useCallback((e: GestureResponderEvent) => {
    const ne = e.nativeEvent;
    if (typeof ne?.locationX === 'number' && typeof ne?.locationY === 'number') {
      updateTiltFromLocalPoint(ne.locationX, ne.locationY);
    }
  }, [updateTiltFromLocalPoint]);

  const resetTilt = useCallback(() => {
    setTilt({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  }, []);

  const layers = useMemo(
    () => computeDeepZParallaxLayers({ tiltX: tilt.x, tiltY: tilt.y, maxOffsetPx }),
    [tilt.x, tilt.y, maxOffsetPx]
  );

  const webMouseHandlers = Platform.OS === 'web'
    ? ({
        onMouseMove: (ev: { clientX: number; clientY: number; currentTarget?: { getBoundingClientRect?: () => { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number } } }) => {
          const rect = ev?.currentTarget?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
          if (rect && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
            updateTiltFromLocalPoint(ev.clientX - rect.left, ev.clientY - rect.top);
          }
        },
        onMouseLeave: resetTilt,
      } as Record<string, unknown>)
    : {};

  return (
    <View
      onLayout={handleLayout}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStartOrMove}
      onTouchMove={handleTouchStartOrMove}
      onTouchEnd={resetTilt}
      onTouchCancel={resetTilt}
      {...webMouseHandlers}
      style={[
        dpStyles.cardShell,
        isLightMode ? dpStyles.shellLight : dpStyles.shellDark,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {/* Capa Z profunda (halo ambiental contenido dentro del borde sin rebalsar) */}
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.deepHaloOrb,
          {
            backgroundColor: accentColor,
            opacity: isLightMode ? 0.11 : 0.16,
            transform: [{ translateX: layers.bgShiftX }, { translateY: layers.bgShiftY }],
          },
        ]}
      />
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.deepHaloOrbSecondary,
          {
            backgroundColor: secondaryColor,
            opacity: isLightMode ? 0.09 : 0.14,
            transform: [{ translateX: layers.midShiftX }, { translateY: layers.midShiftY }],
          },
        ]}
      />

      {/* Bisel especular reactivo en Z superficial */}
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.specularEdgeHighlight,
          {
            left: `${Math.max(6, Math.min(62, layers.specularShiftPct - 18))}%`,
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)' : 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.55)',
          },
        ]}
      />

      <View
        style={{
          transform: [
            { translateX: Number((layers.fgShiftX * 0.25).toFixed(2)) },
            { translateY: Number((layers.fgShiftY * 0.25).toFixed(2)) },
          ],
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
});

const dpStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  cardShell: {
    position: 'relative',
    overflow: 'hidden',
    elevation: 0,
  },
  shellDark: {
    borderRadius: 22,
  },
  shellLight: {
    borderRadius: 22,
  },
  deepHaloOrb: {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 150,
    height: 150,
    borderRadius: 75,
    top: -54,
    right: -28,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  deepHaloOrbSecondary: {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 120,
    height: 120,
    borderRadius: 60,
    bottom: -48,
    left: -24,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  specularEdgeHighlight: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    width: '36%',
    height: 2,
    borderRadius: 2,
    elevation: 0,
  },
});

import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, Platform, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { computeSplitEscrow1NMath } from '../../services/kineticSplitPreBookingStore';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { GpuProgressBar, triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { SplitEscrowInviteModal, shareTacticalMessageSafe } from '../eventos/SplitEscrowInviteModal';
import { baseDisruptiveWidgetStyles as baseDw } from './KineticDisruptiveWidgets.styles';

const getCurrentIsoWeekKey = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const utc = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()));
  const dayNum = utc.getUTCDay() || 7;
  utc.setUTCDate(utc.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(utc.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  const weekNo = Math.ceil(((utc.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
  return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-W${String(weekNo).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export interface ISquadSplitEscrowButtonProps {
  eventId?: string | number;
  title: string;
  discipline: string;
  clubName: string;
  location: string;
  readableDate: string;
  totalKc: number;
  escrow40: number;
  enabled?: boolean;
  maxPersonas?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  inlineOverlay?: boolean;
  onOpenInviteOverride?: () => void;
  activeSplitCount?: number;
  activeGuestCount?: number;
  activePerPersonEscrow?: number;
}

export const SquadSplitEscrowButton = memo(
  ({
    eventId, title, discipline, clubName, location,
    readableDate, totalKc, escrow40, enabled = false, maxPersonas = 4,
    inlineOverlay = false, onOpenInviteOverride,
    activeSplitCount = 1, activeGuestCount = 0, activePerPersonEscrow,
  }: ISquadSplitEscrowButtonProps) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const [inviteOpen, setInviteOpen] = useState(false);
    const dw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseDw, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    if (!enabled) return null;

    const cleanEscrow = Math.max(0, Number(escrow40) || Math.round((Number(totalKc) || 0) * 0.4));
    const safeMax: 2 | 3 | 4 = maxPersonas === 2 ? 2 : maxPersonas === 3 ? 3 : 4;
    const minShare = computeSplitEscrow1NMath(totalKc, safeMax, cleanEscrow).effectiveEscrowKc;
    const isActiveSplit = activeSplitCount > 1;
    const badgeKc = isActiveSplit
      ? activePerPersonEscrow ?? computeSplitEscrow1NMath(totalKc, activeSplitCount, cleanEscrow).effectiveEscrowKc
      : minShare;

    return (
      <>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            dw.squadSplitBtn,
            isActiveSplit && { borderColor: isLightMode ? '#059669' : COLORS.green },
            isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#F5F3FF', borderColor: isActiveSplit ? '#059669' : '#7C3AED', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#6D28D9' },
          ]}
          activeOpacity={0.86}

            triggerHaptic('Medium');
            if (onOpenInviteOverride) onOpenInviteOverride();

          }}

            <Ionicons name="people" size={15} color={isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#E0AAFF'} />
            <Text style={[dw.squadSplitTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#F3E8FF' }]} numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit>
              {isActiveSplit
                ? tx(`DIVISIÓN 1/${activeSplitCount} ACTIVA${activeGuestCount > 0 ? ` (${activeGuestCount} inv.)` : ''}`, `1/${activeSplitCount} SPLIT ACTIVE${activeGuestCount > 0 ? ` (${activeGuestCount} inv.)` : ''}`)
                : tx('INVITAR EQUIPO (DIVIDIR 40% ESCROW)', 'INVITE TEAM (SPLIT 40% ESCROW)')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[dw.squadSplitBadge, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' }]}>

              {badgeKc} {isActiveSplit ? tx('KC hoy', 'KC today') : tx('KC c/u', 'KC ea.')}

interface ISteelContractStoredState {
  active: boolean;
  weekKey: string;
  activatedAt: string;
  baselineSessions: number;
}

export interface IWeeklySteelContractCardProps {
  userId?: string;
  completedSessionsCount?: number;
}

export const WeeklySteelContractCard = memo(
  ({ userId, completedSessionsCount = 0 }: IWeeklySteelContractCardProps) => {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const { resolvedTheme, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const dw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseDw, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const effectiveUserId = String(userId || user?.id || 'guest').trim();
    const storageKey = `@kinetic_steel_contract_v25_${effectiveUserId}`;
    const currentWeekKey = useMemo(() => getCurrentIsoWeekKey(), []);
    const totalDone = Math.max(0, Number(completedSessionsCount) || 0);

    const [contractState, setContractState] = useState<ISteelContractStoredState>({
      active: false,
      weekKey: currentWeekKey,
      activatedAt: '',
      baselineSessions: totalDone,
    });
    const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
      let mounted = true;
      AsyncStorage.getItem(storageKey)
        .then((raw) => {
          if (!mounted) return;
          if (raw) {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
              if (parsed && parsed.weekKey === currentWeekKey && parsed.active) {
                setContractState({
                  active: true,
                  weekKey: currentWeekKey,
                  activatedAt: String(parsed.activatedAt || ''),
                  baselineSessions: Math.max(0, Number(parsed.baselineSessions) || 0),
                });
                setIsLoaded(true);
                return;
              }
            } catch {}
          }
          setContractState({
            active: false,
            weekKey: currentWeekKey,
            activatedAt: '',
            baselineSessions: totalDone,
          });
          setIsLoaded(true);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (mounted) setIsLoaded(true);
        });
      return () => {
        mounted = false;
      };
    }, [storageKey, currentWeekKey, totalDone]);

    const weeklyCompleted = useMemo(() => {
      if (!contractState.active) return 0;
      return Math.min(4, Math.max(0, totalDone - contractState.baselineSessions));
    }, [contractState.active, contractState.baselineSessions, totalDone]);

    const progressPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((weeklyCompleted / 4) * 100));
    const isCompleted = contractState.active && weeklyCompleted >= 4;

    const handleActivateContract = useCallback(async () => {
      if (contractState.active) {
        triggerArcadeHaptic(isCompleted ? 'levelUp' : 'shield');
        return;
      }
      const nextState: ISteelContractStoredState = {
        active: true,
        weekKey: currentWeekKey,
        activatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        baselineSessions: totalDone,
      };
      setContractState(nextState);
      triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
      try {
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextState));
      } catch {}
    }, [contractState.active, isCompleted, currentWeekKey, totalDone, storageKey]);

    return (
      <View
        style={[
          dw.steelCard,
          contractState.active && dw.steelCardActive,
          isCompleted && dw.steelCardCompleted,
        ]}
      >
        <Text style={dw.steelTitle}>
          {tx('🛡️ CONTRATO DE ACERO SEMANAL (4 SESIONES QR = +150 XP BONUS)', '🛡️ WEEKLY STEEL CONTRACT (4 QR SESSIONS = +150 XP BONUS)')}
        </Text>
        <Text style={dw.steelDesc}>
          {tx('Compromiso de Acero 1.5X XP: completa 4 check-ins QR esta semana para multiplicar tu XP y acreditar +150 XP Bonus.', '1.5X XP Steel Commitment: complete 4 QR check-ins this week to multiply your XP and earn +150 Bonus XP.')}
        </Text>
        <View style={dw.steelProgressMetaRow}>
          <Text style={dw.steelProgressLabel}>{weeklyCompleted} / 4 {tx('sesiones completadas', 'sessions completed')}</Text>
          <Text style={[dw.steelMultiplierBadge, isCompleted && { color: themeColors.green }]}>
            {isCompleted ? '🏆 +150 XP BONUS' : contractState.active ? tx('⚡ 1.5X XP ACTIVO', '⚡ 1.5X XP ACTIVE') : tx('LUN–DOM', 'MON–SUN')}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <GpuProgressBar
            progress={progressPct}
            color={isCompleted ? COLORS.green : COLORS.cyan}
            height={8}
          />
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            dw.steelActivateBtn,
            contractState.active && dw.steelActivateBtnSigned,
            isCompleted && dw.steelActivateBtnCompleted,
          ]}
          disabled={!isLoaded}
          activeOpacity={0.86}
          onPress={handleActivateContract}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name={isCompleted ? 'trophy' : contractState.active ? 'shield-checkmark' : 'flash'}
            size={15}
            color={contractState.active ? (isCompleted ? themeColors.green : themeColors.cyanText) : '#050505'}
          />
          <Text
            style={[
              dw.steelActivateBtnTxt,
              contractState.active && { color: isCompleted ? themeColors.green : themeColors.cyanText },
            ]}
          >
            {isCompleted
              ? tx('CONTRATO DE ACERO CUMPLIDO (+150 XP) ✓', 'STEEL CONTRACT COMPLETED (+150 XP) ✓')
              : contractState.active
              ? tx('CONTRATO ACTIVO • 1.5X XP EN JUEGO ✓', 'CONTRACT ACTIVE • 1.5X XP IN PLAY ✓')
              : tx('ACTIVAR COMPROMISO DE ACERO (1.5X XP)', 'ACTIVATE STEEL CONTRACT (1.5X XP)')}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }
);
