const getHoyLocalYmdWidget = (): string => {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

const isPassWithin45MinToday = (res: any): boolean => {
  if (!res) return false;
  const rawFecha = String(res?.fecha_clase || res?.servicios?.fecha || res?.fecha || res?.fecha_hora || '').trim();
  const ymdMatch = rawFecha.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
  const fechaClase = ymdMatch ? ymdMatch[1] : '';
  if (!fechaClase || fechaClase !== getHoyLocalYmdWidget()) return false;
  const rawHora = String(
    res?.hora || res?.hora_inicio || res?.servicios?.hora_inicio || (rawFecha.includes('T') ? rawFecha.split('T')[1] : '') || ''
  ).trim();
  const hmMatch = rawHora.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!hmMatch) return false;
  const hh = Number(hmMatch[1]);
  const mm = Number(hmMatch[2]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return false;
  const now = new Date();
  const diff = hh * 60 + mm - (now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes());
  return diff >= 0 && diff <= 45;
};

export interface IAutoPopReceptionQrBannerProps {
  primaryReservation: any;
  reservations?: any[];
  activeCount: number;
  onInstantOpenQr: (reserva: any) => void;
}

export const AutoPopReceptionQrBanner = memo(
  ({ primaryReservation, reservations, activeCount, onInstantOpenQr }: IAutoPopReceptionQrBannerProps) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const dw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseDw, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const readyReservation = useMemo(() => {
      const candidates = Array.isArray(reservations) && reservations.length > 0
        ? reservations
        : primaryReservation ? [primaryReservation] : [];
      return candidates.find(isPassWithin45MinToday) || null;
    }, [reservations, primaryReservation]);
    const hasReservation = Boolean(readyReservation);

    useEffect(() => {
      pulseAnim.setValue(0);
      if (!hasReservation) return;
      const loop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
            toValue: 1,
            duration: 900,
            easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
          }),
          Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
            toValue: 0,
            duration: 900,
            easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
          }),
        ])
      );
      loop.start();
      return () => loop.stop();
    }, [pulseAnim, hasReservation]);

    if (!readyReservation) return null;

    const scale = pulseAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [1, 1.016] });
    const dotOpacity = pulseAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.45, 1] });
    const serviceTitle = readyReservation?.servicio || tx('Sesión Kinetic', 'Kinetic Session');
    const clubTitle = readyReservation?.negocio_nombre || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official');
    const horaLabel = String(readyReservation?.hora || readyReservation?.hora_inicio || readyReservation?.servicios?.hora_inicio || '08:00').substring(0, 5);

    return (
      <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale }], marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            dw.autoPopBanner,
            resolvedTheme === 'light' && {
              backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#E2E8F0', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
              borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1', shadowColor: '#0F172A', shadowOpacity: 0.06,
            },
          ]}
          activeOpacity={0.86}
          onPress={() => { triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn'); onInstantOpenQr(readyReservation); }}
        >
          <View style={dw.autoPopLeft}>
            <View style={dw.autoPopMicroRow}>
              <Animated.View style={[dw.autoPopLiveDot, { opacity: dotOpacity }]} />
              <Text style={[dw.autoPopMicroLabel, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#047857' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                {tx('⚡ PASE LISTO PARA RECEPCIÓN (AUTO-POP QR • 60S)', '⚡ PASS READY FOR RECEPTION (AUTO-POP QR • 60S)')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={[dw.autoPopTitle, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {serviceTitle} • {horaLabel} hrs
            </Text>
            <Text style={[dw.autoPopSub, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              📍 {clubTitle}
              {activeCount > 1
                ? tx(` (+${activeCount - 1} pase adicional)`, ` (+${activeCount - 1} extra pass)`)
                : tx(' • Abre tu llave TOTP en 1 toque', ' • Open your TOTP key in 1 tap')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={dw.autoPopRightCta}>
            <Ionicons name="qr-code" size={16} color="#050505" />
            <Text numberOfLines={1} style={dw.autoPopRightCtaTxt}>{tx('ABRIR QR ›', 'OPEN QR ›')}</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </Animated.View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/shared/KineticFullscreenLightboxModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Dimensions, Modal, PanResponder, Platform, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { isValidStoryMediaUrl } from '../../services/kineticlubHybridUiHelpers';
import { lightboxStyles as ls } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { renderInWebPortal } from '../../utils/kineticWebPortal';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;

export interface KineticFullscreenLightboxModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  images: string[];
  initialIndex?: number;
  caption?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  inlineOverlay?: boolean;
}

const touchDistance = (touches: any[]): number => {
  if (!touches || touches.length < 2) return 0;
  const dx = Number(touches[0].pageX || 0) - Number(touches[1].pageX || 0);
  const dy = Number(touches[0].pageY || 0) - Number(touches[1].pageY || 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
};

export const KineticFullscreenLightboxModal: React.FC<KineticFullscreenLightboxModalProps> = memo(
  ({ visible, images, initialIndex = 0, caption, onClose, inlineOverlay = false }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const cleanImages = useMemo(
      () => (Array.isArray(images) ? images.map((u) => String(u || '').trim()).filter((u) => isValidStoryMediaUrl(u)) : []),
      [images]
    );
    const [win, setWin] = useState(() => Dimensions.get('window'));
    const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
    const [zoomScale, setZoomScale] = useState(1);

    const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
    const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const panXAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const panYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const dismissYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    const scaleRef = useRef(1);
    const panRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    const pinchBaseDistRef = useRef(0);
    const pinchBaseScaleRef = useRef(1);
    const dragStartPanRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    const lastTapRef = useRef(0);

    const resetTransform = useCallback(
      (animated = false) => {
        scaleRef.current = 1;
        panRef.current = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        setZoomScale(1);
        if (animated) {
          Animated.parallel([
            Animated.spring(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(panXAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(panYAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(dismissYAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
          ]).start();
        } else {
          scaleAnim.setValue(1);
          panXAnim.setValue(0);
          panYAnim.setValue(0);
          dismissYAnim.setValue(0);
        }
      },
      [scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim, dismissYAnim]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      const sub = Dimensions.addEventListener('change', ({ window }) => setWin(window));
      return () => sub?.remove?.();
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!visible || cleanImages.length === 0) return;
      const safeIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, initialIndex));
      setCurrentIndex(safeIdx);
      resetTransform(false);
      const t = setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ x: safeIdx * win.width, animated: false }), 30);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }, [visible, initialIndex, cleanImages.length, win.width, resetTransform]);

    const toggleDoubleTapZoom = useCallback(
      (tapX?: number, tapY?: number) => {
        triggerHaptic('Selection');
        if (scaleRef.current > 1.08) {
          resetTransform(true);
          return;
        }
        const z = 2.2;
        const maxX = ((z - 1) * win.width) / 2;
        const maxY = ((z - 1) * win.height) / 2.4;
        const rawX = Number.isFinite(tapX) ? (win.width / 2 - Number(tapX)) * (z - 1) : 0;
        const rawY = Number.isFinite(tapY) ? (win.height / 2 - Number(tapY)) * (z - 1) : 0;
        const nx = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, rawX));
        const ny = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, rawY));
        scaleRef.current = z;
        panRef.current = { x: nx, y: ny };
        setZoomScale(z);
        Animated.parallel([
          Animated.spring(scaleAnim, { toValue: z, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
          Animated.spring(panXAnim, { toValue: nx, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
          Animated.spring(panYAnim, { toValue: ny, useNativeDriver: true, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
        ]).start();
      },
      [win.width, win.height, resetTransform, scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim]
    );

    const panResponder = useMemo(
      () =>
        PanResponder.create({
          onStartShouldSetPanResponder: (evt) => (evt.nativeEvent.touches?.length || 0) >= 2,
          onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (evt, gs) => {
            const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches?.length || 0;
            if (touches >= 2) return true;
            if (scaleRef.current > 1.05) return Math.abs(gs.dx) > 4 || Math.abs(gs.dy) > 4;
            return gs.dy > 12 && Math.abs(gs.dy) > Math.abs(gs.dx) * 1.25;
          },
          onPanResponderGrant: (evt) => {
            const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
            if (touches.length >= 2) {
              pinchBaseDistRef.current = touchDistance(touches);
              pinchBaseScaleRef.current = scaleRef.current;
            } else {
              dragStartPanRef.current = { ...panRef.current };
            }
          },
          onPanResponderMove: (evt, gs) => {
            const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
            if (touches.length >= 2) {
              const dist = touchDistance(touches);
              if (pinchBaseDistRef.current > 8) {
                const next = Math.max(1, Math.min(3.5, pinchBaseScaleRef.current * (dist / pinchBaseDistRef.current)));
                scaleRef.current = next;
                scaleAnim.setValue(next);
              }
              return;
            }
            if (scaleRef.current > 1.05) {
              const maxX = ((scaleRef.current - 1) * win.width) / 2;
              const maxY = ((scaleRef.current - 1) * win.height) / 2.4;
              const nx = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, dragStartPanRef.current.x + gs.dx));
              const ny = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, dragStartPanRef.current.y + gs.dy));
              panRef.current = { x: nx, y: ny };
              panXAnim.setValue(nx);
              panYAnim.setValue(ny);
            } else if (gs.dy > 0) {
              dismissYAnim.setValue(gs.dy);
            }
          },
          onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
            pinchBaseDistRef.current = 0;
            setZoomScale(scaleRef.current);
            if (scaleRef.current <= 1.05) {
              if (gs.dy > 95 || gs.vy > 0.85) {
                triggerHaptic('Light');
                onClose();
                return;
              }
              resetTransform(true);
            }
          },
        }),
      [win.width, win.height, scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim, dismissYAnim, resetTransform, onClose]
    );

    const handleSlideTap = useCallback(
      (evt: any) => {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastTapRef.current < 280) {
          lastTapRef.current = 0;
          const tapX = evt?.nativeEvent?.pageX;
          const tapY = evt?.nativeEvent?.pageY;
          toggleDoubleTapZoom(typeof tapX === 'number' ? tapX : undefined, typeof tapY === 'number' ? tapY : undefined);
        } else {
          lastTapRef.current = now;
        }
      },
      [toggleDoubleTapZoom]
    );

    const goToSlide = useCallback(
      (idx: number) => {
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, idx));
        resetTransform(false);
        setCurrentIndex(clamped);
        scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ x: clamped * win.width, animated: true });
      },
      [cleanImages.length, win.width, resetTransform]
    );

    if (!visible || cleanImages.length === 0) return null;

    const onMediaProps: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } : {};
    const viewerBody = (
      <View
        {...onMediaProps}
        style={[
          ls.root,
          { backgroundColor: 'rgba(5, 7, 12, 0.94)', elevation: 0 },
          Platform.OS === 'web'
            ? ({ position: 'fixed', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100vw', height: '100dvh', zIndex: 99999 } as any)
            : null,
        ]}
      >
        <View style={[ls.topBar, { top: Math.max(insets.top + 8, 22) }]}>
          {cleanImages.length > 1 ? (
            <View style={ls.counterPill}>
              <Text selectable={false} style={ls.counterTxt}>{`${currentIndex + 1} / ${cleanImages.length}`}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View />
          )}
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => {
              triggerHaptic('Light');
              onClose();
            }}
            hitSlop={{ top: 16, bottom: 16, left: 16, right: 16 }}
            accessibilityLabel={tx('Cerrar visor', 'Close viewer')}
            style={[ls.closeBtn, NO_SEL]}
          >
            <Feather name="x" size={21} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <Animated.View style={[ls.stageWrap, { transform: [{ translateY: dismissYAnim }] }]} {...panResponder.panHandlers}>
          <ScrollView
            ref={scrollRef}
            horizontal
            pagingEnabled
            scrollEnabled={zoomScale <= 1.05 && cleanImages.length > 1}
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            scrollEventThrottle={16}
            onMomentumScrollEnd={(e) => {
              const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, Math.round(e.nativeEvent.contentOffset.x / Math.max(1, win.width))));
              if (next !== currentIndex) {
                resetTransform(false);
                setCurrentIndex(next);
              }
            }}
          >
            {cleanImages.map((uri, i) => {
              const isActive = i === currentIndex;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={`${uri.slice(-24)}_${i}`}
                  activeOpacity={1}
                  onPress={handleSlideTap}
                  style={{ width: win.width, height: win.height, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}
                >
                  <Animated.View
                    style={{
                      width: win.width,
                      height: win.height * 0.84,
                      transform: isActive ? [{ translateX: panXAnim }, { translateY: panYAnim }, { scale: scaleAnim }] : [{ scale: 1 }],
                    }}
                  >
                    <Image source={{ uri }} style={ls.fullImg} contentFit="contain" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />
                  </Animated.View>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>
        </Animated.View>

        {cleanImages.length > 1 && Platform.OS === 'web' && (
          <>
            {currentIndex > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ls.webNavBtn, { left: 14 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => goToSlide(currentIndex - 1)}>
                <Feather name="chevron-left" size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
            {currentIndex < cleanImages.length - 1 && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ls.webNavBtn, { right: 14 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => goToSlide(currentIndex + 1)}>
                <Feather name="chevron-right" size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        <View style={[ls.bottomBar, { bottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 16, 24) }]} pointerEvents="none">
          {Boolean(caption && caption.trim()) && <Text style={ls.captionTxt} numberOfLines={2}>{caption}</Text>}
          {cleanImages.length > 1 && (
            <View style={ls.dotsRow}>
              {cleanImages.map((_, i) => (
                <View key={`lb_dot_${i}`} style={[ls.dot, i === currentIndex && ls.dotActive]} />
              ))}
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    );

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      return renderInWebPortal(viewerBody);
    }

    if (inlineOverlay) {
      return (
        <View style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, zIndex: 9999, elevation: 0 }}>
          {viewerBody}
        </View>
      );
    }

    return (
      <Modal
        visible={visible}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={onClose}
        statusBarTranslucent
      >
        {viewerBody}
      </Modal>
    );
  }
);

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY = '@kinetic_pwa_prompt_dismissed';
const SNOOZE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const SHOW_DELAY_MS = 4500;

type InstallMode = 'android' | 'ios' | null;

// Captura temprana de beforeinstallprompt (Chrome puede dispararlo antes del montaje)
let deferredInstallEvent: any = null;
const installListeners = new Set<() => void>();
if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e: any) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredInstallEvent = e;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb());
  });
  window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
    deferredInstallEvent = null;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb());
  });
}

const isStandaloneDisplay = (): boolean => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;
  const mql = typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' ? window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') : null;
  return Boolean(mql?.matches) || (window.navigator as any)?.standalone === true;
};

const detectMobilePlatform = (): 'android' | 'ios' | null => {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return null;
  const ua = String(navigator.userAgent || '');
  if (/android/i.test(ua)) return 'android';
  const isIPadOS = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && Number((navigator as any).maxTouchPoints) > 1;
  if (/iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(ua) || isIPadOS) return 'ios';
  return null;
};

export const KineticInstallPromptModal = React.memo(() => {
  const { tx, isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<InstallMode>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || isStandaloneDisplay()) return;
    const platform = detectMobilePlatform();
    if (!platform) return;
    let active = true;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const evaluate = () => {
      if (!active || isStandaloneDisplay()) {
        setMode(null);
        return;
      }
      if (platform === 'ios') setMode('ios');
      else setMode(deferredInstallEvent ? 'android' : null);
    };

    AsyncStorage.getItem(PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY)
      .then((raw) => {
        const dismissedAt = Number(raw) || 0;
        if (!active || Date.now() - dismissedAt < SNOOZE_MS) return;
        timer = setTimeout(evaluate, SHOW_DELAY_MS);
        installListeners.add(evaluate);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    return () => {
      active = false;
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      installListeners.delete(evaluate);
    };
  }, []);

  const dismiss = useCallback(() => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    setMode(null);
    AsyncStorage.setItem(PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY, String(Date.now())).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const installAndroid = useCallback(async () => {
    const evt = deferredInstallEvent;
    if (!evt) return;
    triggerHaptic('Medium');
    try {
      await evt.prompt();
      const choice = await evt.userChoice;
      deferredInstallEvent = null;
      if (choice?.outcome === 'accepted') {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        setMode(null);
      } else {
        dismiss();
      }
    } catch {
      setMode(null);
    }
  }, [dismiss]);

  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || !mode) return null;

  const cyan = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF';
  const textPrimary = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textMuted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.68)';

  return (
    <View pointerEvents="box-none" style={styles.overlay}>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.card,
          isLightMode
            ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' }
            : { backgroundColor: '#0B0B0F', borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)', borderTopColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)', borderBottomColor: '#006B78' },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <View style={[styles.iconBadge, { borderColor: cyan }]}>
            <Feather name="smartphone" size={16} color={cyan} />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textPrimary }]}>
              {tx('KINETIC EN PANTALLA COMPLETA', 'KINETIC IN FULL SCREEN')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { color: textMuted }]}>
              {tx('Instálala y úsala como app nativa, sin barra del navegador.', 'Install it and use it like a native app, no browser bar.')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={dismiss} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }} accessibilityLabel={tx('Cerrar', 'Close')}>
            <Feather name="x" size={18} color={textMuted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {mode === 'android' ? (
          <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.85} style={styles.installBtn} onPress={installAndroid}>
            <Feather name="download" size={15} color="#050505" />
            <Text style={styles.installBtnTxt}>{tx('INSTALAR APP EN TU TELÉFONO', 'INSTALL APP ON YOUR PHONE')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.stepsBox}>
            <View style={styles.stepRow}>
              <Text style={[styles.stepNum, { color: cyan, borderColor: cyan }]}>1</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.stepTxt, { color: textPrimary }]}>
                {tx('Toca Compartir ', 'Tap Share ')}
                <Feather name="share" size={13} color={cyan} />
                {tx(' (cuadro con flecha)', ' (square with arrow)')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.stepRow}>
              <Text style={[styles.stepNum, { color: cyan, borderColor: cyan }]}>2</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.stepTxt, { color: textPrimary }]}>
                {tx('Selecciona “Agregar a pantalla de inicio”', 'Select “Add to Home Screen”')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity onPress={dismiss} style={styles.laterBtn}>
          <Text style={[styles.laterTxt, { color: textMuted }]}>{tx('Ahora no', 'Not now')}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
});

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: { position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingBottom: 18, zIndex: 1200 },
  card: {
    borderRadius: 18, borderWidth: 1, borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderBottomWidth: 4, padding: 14,
    shadowColor: '#000', shadowOpacity: 0.45, shadowRadius: 18, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 8 }, elevation: 14,
  },
  headerRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  iconBadge: { width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 10, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  title: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.8 },
  subtitle: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '600', marginTop: 2, lineHeight: 16 },
  installBtn: {
    marginTop: 12, height: 46, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: '#00F0FF', flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8, borderBottomWidth: 3, borderBottomColor: '#00A8B5',
  },
  installBtnTxt: { color: '#050505', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.8 },
  stepsBox: { marginTop: 12, gap: 8 },
  stepRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 },
  stepNum: {
    width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: 11, borderWidth: 1, textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 20, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '900',
  },
  stepTxt: { flex: 1, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' },
  laterBtn: { alignSelf: 'center', marginTop: 10, paddingVertical: 4, paddingHorizontal: 10 },
  laterTxt: { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 0.6 },
});

export default KineticInstallPromptModal;

import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleProp, StyleSheet, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';

let NativeGlassView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;
let checkLiquidGlassAvailable: (() => boolean) | null = null;
let NativeBlurView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;
let NativeBlurTargetView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;

try {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
  const mod = require('expo-glass-effect');
  NativeGlassView = mod?.GlassView || null;
  checkLiquidGlassAvailable =
    typeof mod?.isLiquidGlassAvailable === 'function'
      ? mod.isLiquidGlassAvailable
      : null;
} catch {}

try {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
  const blurMod = require('expo-blur');
  NativeBlurView = blurMod?.BlurView || null;
  NativeBlurTargetView = blurMod?.BlurTargetView || null;
} catch {}

export const KineticBlurTargetContainer: React.ComponentType<any> = NativeBlurTargetView || View;

export type LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan' | 'purple' | 'neutral';

export interface ICanMountAndroidDimezisBlurParams {
  isAndroid: boolean;
  hasNativeBlur: boolean;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  layoutReady?: boolean;
  hasTargetNode: boolean;
  rafCommitted?: boolean;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  targetWidth?: number;
  targetHeight?: number;
}

export const canMountAndroidDimezisBlur = (
  params: ICanMountAndroidDimezisBlurParams
): boolean => {
  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return false;
  const ready = Boolean(params.blurTargetReady ?? params.layoutReady);
  if (!params.isAndroid || !params.hasNativeBlur || !ready || !params.hasTargetNode) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!params.rafCommitted) return false;
  const w = Number(params.width ?? params.targetWidth ?? 0);
  const h = Number(params.height ?? params.targetHeight ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(w) || !Number.isFinite(h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

export const canRenderIosLiquidGlass = (): boolean => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'ios' || !NativeGlassView || !checkLiquidGlassAvailable) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    return Boolean(checkLiquidGlassAvailable());
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export const KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA = 'rgba(8, 12, 22, 0.78)';

export interface ILiquidGlassSurfaceSpec {
  backgroundColor: string;
  androidFrostedBg: string;
  tintColor: string;
  alpha: number;
  elevation: 0;
}

export const resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec = (
  isLight: boolean,
  active = false,
  accent: LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan'
): ILiquidGlassSurfaceSpec => {
  if (isLight) {
    const bg = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(243, 232, 255, 0.86)'
        : 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.86)'
      : 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.78)';
    const frosted = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(243, 232, 255, 0.68)'
        : 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.68)'
      : 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.64)';
    const tint = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.16)'
        : 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.16)'
      : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74)';
    return { backgroundColor: bg, androidFrostedBg: frosted, tintColor: tint, alpha: active ? 0.86 : 0.78, elevation: 0 };
  }
  const darkBg = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : 'rgba(8, 12, 22, 0.80)';
  const darkFrosted = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA;
  const darkTint = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA;
  return { backgroundColor: darkBg, androidFrostedBg: darkFrosted, tintColor: darkTint, alpha: active ? 0.78 : 0.8, elevation: 0 };
};

/**
 * Construye estilos de superficie Liquid Glass multiplataforma.
 * Candado Android: todo fondo rgba(...) DEBE mantener elevation: 0.
 */
export const buildLiquidGlassPillStyle = (
  isLight: boolean,
  active = false,
  accent: LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan'
): ViewStyle => {
  const accentHex =
    accent === 'purple'
      ? isLight
        ? '#7C3AED'
        : '#9D4EDD'
      : accent === 'neutral'
      ? isLight
        ? '#0F172A'
        : '#94A3B8'
      : isLight
      ? '#0284C7'
      : '#00F0FF';

  const bg = resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec(isLight, active, accent).backgroundColor;

  const borderColor = active
    ? accentHex
    : isLight
    ? 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44)'
    : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20)';

  const borderTopColor = isLight
    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)'
    : active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(233, 213, 255, 0.78)'
      : 'rgba(186, 255, 255, 0.74)'
    : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34)';

  const borderBottomColor = isLight
    ? active
      ? accentHex
      : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.48)'
    : active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.85)'
      : 'rgba(0, 145, 168, 0.85)'
    : 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.85)';

  return {
    backgroundColor: bg,
    borderColor,
    borderTopColor,
    borderBottomColor,
    shadowColor: active ? accentHex : '#000000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 },
    shadowOpacity: isLight ? 0.14 : 0.28,
    shadowRadius: 12,
    elevation: 0,
    ...(Platform.OS === 'web'
      ? ({
          backdropFilter: 'blur(32px) saturate(200%)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(32px) saturate(200%)',
        } as any)
      : null),
  };
};

export interface KineticLiquidGlassSurfaceProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isLight: boolean;
  active?: boolean;
  accent?: LiquidGlassAccent;
  borderRadius?: number;
  interactive?: boolean;
  blurTargetRef?: React.RefObject<any>;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  blurTargetDimensions?: { width: number; height: number } | null;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export const KineticLiquidGlassSurface = memo(
  ({
    children,
    isLight,
    active = false,
    accent = 'cyan',
    borderRadius = 24,
    interactive = false,
    blurTargetRef,
    blurTargetReady = false,
    blurTargetDimensions = null,
    style,
  }: KineticLiquidGlassSurfaceProps) => {
    const [rafCommitted, setRafCommitted] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (
        Platform.OS !== 'android' ||
        !blurTargetReady ||
        !blurTargetRef?.current ||
        !(Number(blurTargetDimensions?.width) > 0) ||
        !(Number(blurTargetDimensions?.height) > 0)
      ) {
        setRafCommitted(false);
        return;
      }
      const rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setRafCommitted(true);
      });
      return () => {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      };
    }, [
      blurTargetReady,
      blurTargetRef,
      blurTargetDimensions?.width,
      blurTargetDimensions?.height,
    ]);

    const glassStyle = buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLight, active, accent);
    const surfaceSpec = resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec(isLight, active, accent);
    const tintColor = surfaceSpec.tintColor;

    const gradientColors: readonly [string, string, string] = isLight
      ? ['rgba(255,255,255,0.44)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', 'rgba(148,163,184,0.14)']
      : ['rgba(255,255,255,0.16)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)'];

    const useNativeIosGlass = canRenderIosLiquidGlass() && NativeGlassView;
    const useAndroidDimezisBlur = canMountAndroidDimezisBlur({
      isAndroid: Platform.OS === 'android',
      hasNativeBlur: Boolean(NativeBlurView),
      blurTargetReady: Boolean(blurTargetReady),
      hasTargetNode: Boolean(blurTargetRef?.current),
      rafCommitted,
      width: blurTargetDimensions?.width ?? 0,
      height: blurTargetDimensions?.height ?? 0,
    });
    const Container: React.ComponentType<any> = useNativeIosGlass
      ? (NativeGlassView as React.ComponentType<any>)
      : View;

    const nativeProps = useNativeIosGlass
      ? {
          glassEffectStyle: 'regular',
          tintColor,
          isInteractive: interactive,
          colorScheme: isLight ? 'light' : 'dark',
        }
      : {};

    const androidFrostedBg = useAndroidDimezisBlur ? surfaceSpec.androidFrostedBg : undefined;

    return (
      <Container
        {...nativeProps}
        collapsable={false}
        style={[
          styles.baseFrame,
          { borderRadius },
          !useNativeIosGlass ? glassStyle : { elevation: 0 },
          style,
          useAndroidDimezisBlur ? { backgroundColor: 'transparent', elevation: 0 } : null,
        ]}
      >
        {useAndroidDimezisBlur && NativeBlurView ? (
          <>
            <NativeBlurView
              blurTarget={blurTargetRef}
              experimentalBlurMethod="dimezisBlurView"
              blurMethod="dimezisBlurView"
              blurReductionFactor={isLight ? 6 : 8}
              intensity={isLight ? 92 : 100}
              tint={isLight ? 'light' : 'dark'}
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { borderRadius, elevation: 0 }]}
            />
            <View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[
                StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
                { borderRadius, backgroundColor: androidFrostedBg, elevation: 0 },
              ]}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}
        <LinearGradient
          pointerEvents="none"
          colors={gradientColors}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { borderRadius, elevation: 0 }]}
        />
        <View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={[
            styles.specularRim,
            {
              backgroundColor: isLight
                ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)'
                : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)',
            },
          ]}
        />
        {children}
      </Container>
    );
  }
);
KineticLiquidGlassSurface.displayName = 'KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  baseFrame: {
    overflow: 'hidden',
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderTopWidth: 1.5,
    borderBottomWidth: 2,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  specularRim: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 1,
    left: 16,
    right: 16,
    height: 1.2,
    borderRadius: 999,
  },
});

    // === src/components/shared/KineticListFilterSortBar.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

export interface IKineticFilterChip {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface IKineticSortOption {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

type GlobalFilterSelectListener = (filterKey: string) => void;
let _globalFilterSelectListener: GlobalFilterSelectListener | null = null;
const _openMenuDismissListeners = new Set<() => void>();
export const dismissOpenFilterSortMenus = () => {
  _openMenuDismissListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch {}
  });
};
export const registerGlobalFilterBarSelectListener = (fn: GlobalFilterSelectListener | null) => {
  _globalFilterSelectListener = fn;
  return () => {
    if (_globalFilterSelectListener === fn) _globalFilterSelectListener = null;
  };
};

export interface KineticListFilterSortBarProps {
  searchQuery: string;
  onChangeSearch: (q: string) => void;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  filterChips?: IKineticFilterChip[];
  activeFilter?: string;
  onSelectFilter?: (key: string) => void;
  sortOptions?: IKineticSortOption[];
  activeSort?: string;
  onSelectSort?: (key: string) => void;
  hideSearch?: boolean;
  hideFilter?: boolean;
  hideSort?: boolean;
  rightSlot?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const KineticListFilterSortBar = memo(
  ({
    searchQuery,
    onChangeSearch,
    searchPlaceholder,
    filterChips = [],
    activeFilter = 'all',
    onSelectFilter,
    sortOptions = [],
    activeSort,
    onSelectSort,
    hideSearch = false,
    hideFilter = false,
    hideSort = false,
    rightSlot,
  }: KineticListFilterSortBarProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, resolvedTheme, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const styles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState<'filter' | 'sort' | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const dismiss = () => setOpenMenu(null);
      _openMenuDismissListeners.add(dismiss);
      return () => { _openMenuDismissListeners.delete(dismiss); };
    }, []);

    const effectiveFilters = useMemo<IKineticFilterChip[]>(
      () =>
        filterChips.length > 0
          ? filterChips
          : [{ key: 'all', label: tx('Todos', 'All') }],
      [filterChips, tx]
    );

    const effectiveSorts = useMemo<IKineticSortOption[]>(
      () =>
        sortOptions.length > 0
          ? sortOptions
          : [{ key: 'default', label: tx('Predeterminado', 'Default') }],
      [sortOptions, tx]
    );

    const currentFilterOption = useMemo(
      () =>
        effectiveFilters.find((f) => f.key === activeFilter) ||
        effectiveFilters[0],
      [effectiveFilters, activeFilter]
    );

    const currentSortOption = useMemo(
      () =>
        effectiveSorts.find((s) => s.key === activeSort) || effectiveSorts[0],
      [effectiveSorts, activeSort]
    );

    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleInk = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#D8B4FE';
    const searchGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, searchQuery.length > 0, 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode, searchQuery.length]
    );
    const filterGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, openMenu === 'filter', 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode, openMenu]
    );
    const sortGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, openMenu === 'sort', 'purple'),
      [isLightMode, openMenu]
    );
    const filterValueStr =
      typeof currentFilterOption.count === 'number'
        ? `${currentFilterOption.label} (${currentFilterOption.count})`
        : currentFilterOption.label;

    return (
      <View style={styles.wrapper}>
        {(!hideSearch || Boolean(rightSlot)) && (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            {!hideSearch && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.searchContainer,
                  { flex: 1 },
                  isLightMode ? styles.searchContainerLight : styles.searchContainerDark,
                  searchGlassStyle,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="search" size={15} color={cyanInk} />
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.searchInput, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
                  placeholder={searchPlaceholder || tx('Buscar...', 'Search...')}
                  placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChangeText={onChangeSearch}
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  multiline={false}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                  returnKeyType="search"
                />
                {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Light');
                      onChangeSearch('');
                    }}
                    hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
                    style={[
                      styles.clearBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: isLightMode
                          ? '#E2E8F0'
                          : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.clearBtnText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                      ✕
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )}
              </View>
            )}
            {rightSlot}
          </View>
        )}

        {(!hideFilter || !hideSort) && (
          <View style={styles.splitRow50}>
            {!hideFilter && (
              <KineticPhysicsPressable
                preset="tactileChip"
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setOpenMenu((prev) => (prev === 'filter' ? null : 'filter'));
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.halfBtn3D,
                  isLightMode ? styles.filterBtnLight : styles.filterBtnDark,
                  filterGlassStyle,
                  openMenu === 'filter' &&
                    (isLightMode
                      ? styles.filterBtnOpenLight
                      : styles.filterBtnOpenDark),
                  Platform.OS === 'web'
                    ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any)
                    : null,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="filter" size={11} color={cyanInk} />
                <Text
                  style={[styles.halfBtnText, { color: cyanInk }]}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {tx('Filtrar', 'Filter')}: {filterValueStr}{' '}
                  {openMenu === 'filter' ? '▲' : '▼'}
                </Text>
              </KineticPhysicsPressable>
            )}

            {!hideSort && (
              <KineticPhysicsPressable
                preset="tactileChip"
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setOpenMenu((prev) => (prev === 'sort' ? null : 'sort'));
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.halfBtn3D,
                  isLightMode ? styles.sortBtnLight : styles.sortBtnDark,
                  sortGlassStyle,
                  openMenu === 'sort' &&
                    (isLightMode ? styles.sortBtnOpenLight : styles.sortBtnOpenDark),
                  Platform.OS === 'web'
                    ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any)
                    : null,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="sliders" size={11} color={purpleInk} />
                <Text
                  style={[styles.halfBtnText, { color: purpleInk }]}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {tx('Ordenar', 'Sort')}: {currentSortOption.label}{' '}
                  {openMenu === 'sort' ? '▲' : '▼'}
                </Text>
              </KineticPhysicsPressable>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {openMenu === 'filter' && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.dropdownSheet,
              isLightMode
                ? styles.dropdownFilterLight
                : styles.dropdownFilterDark,
              filterGlassStyle,
            ]}
          >
            <ScrollView
              nestedScrollEnabled
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ maxHeight: 215 }}
            >
              {effectiveFilters.map((chip) => {
                const isSelected = chip.key === currentFilterOption.key;
                const rowLabel =
                  typeof chip.count === 'number'
                    ? `${chip.label} (${chip.count})`
                    : chip.label;
                return (
                  <KineticPhysicsPressable
                    key={chip.key}
                    preset="tactileChip"
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Selection');
                      _globalFilterSelectListener?.(chip.key);
                      onSelectFilter?.(chip.key);
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                    }}
                    style={[
                      styles.optionRow,
                      isSelected &&
                        (isLightMode
                          ? styles.optionSelectedCyanLight
                          : styles.optionSelectedCyanDark),
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.optionText,
                        {
                          color: isSelected
                            ? cyanInk
                            : themeColors.textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: isSelected ? '900' : '700',
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {rowLabel}
                    </Text>
                    <Feather
                      name={isSelected ? 'check-circle' : 'circle'}
                      size={14}
                      color={isSelected ? cyanInk : themeColors.textMuted}
                    />
                  </KineticPhysicsPressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}

        {openMenu === 'sort' && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.dropdownSheet,
              isLightMode ? styles.dropdownSortLight : styles.dropdownSortDark,
              sortGlassStyle,
            ]}
          >
            <ScrollView
              nestedScrollEnabled
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ maxHeight: 215 }}
            >
              {effectiveSorts.map((opt) => {
                const isSelected = opt.key === currentSortOption.key;
                return (
                  <KineticPhysicsPressable
                    key={opt.key}
                    preset="tactileChip"
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Selection');
                      onSelectSort?.(opt.key);
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                    }}
                    style={[
                      styles.optionRow,
                      isSelected &&
                        (isLightMode
                          ? styles.optionSelectedPurpleLight
                          : styles.optionSelectedPurpleDark),
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.optionText,
                        {
                          color: isSelected
                            ? purpleInk
                            : themeColors.textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: isSelected ? '900' : '700',
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {opt.label}
                    </Text>
                    <Feather
                      name={isSelected ? 'check-circle' : 'circle'}
                      size={14}
                      color={isSelected ? purpleInk : themeColors.textMuted}
                    />
                  </KineticPhysicsPressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const baseStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: { marginBottom: 12, gap: 8 },
  searchContainer: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', minHeight: 44, borderRadius: 16, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 4, gap: 8,
    borderWidth: 1.2, borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderBottomWidth: 2.8, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowRadius: 10, elevation: 0,
  },

    borderRadius: 11, borderWidth: 1.2, borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderBottomWidth: 4.2, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowRadius: 7, elevation: 0,
  },
  filterBtnDark: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12)', borderColor: COLORS.cyan, borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomColor: '#006B78', shadowColor: COLORS.cyan, shadowOpacity: 0.3, elevation: 0 },
  filterBtnLight: { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4', shadowColor: '#00B8D4', shadowOpacity: 0.2, elevation: 6 },

  sortBtnLight: { backgroundColor: '#F3E8FF', borderColor: '#9333EA', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED', shadowColor: '#7C3AED', shadowOpacity: 0.2, elevation: 6 },

    // === src/components/shared/KineticModalHeader3D.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import React, { memo, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  PanResponder,
  Platform,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

const fireHeaderHaptic = (mode: 'Light' | 'Selection'): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  if (mode === 'Selection') {
    Haptics.selectionAsync().catch(() => {});
  } else {
    Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light).catch(() => {});
  }
};

export const KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS: ViewStyle = {
  marginTop: 58,
  height: '92%',
  maxHeight: '92%',
};

export interface KineticSwipeCloseHeaderProps {
  onClose?: (() => void) | null;
  labelEs?: string;
  labelEn?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  style?: ViewStyle;
}

export const KineticSwipeCloseHeader = memo(
  ({
    onClose,
    labelEs = 'DESLIZA PARA CERRAR',
    labelEn = 'SWIPE TO CLOSE',
    accentColor,
    style,
  }: KineticSwipeCloseHeaderProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const touchStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; closed: boolean }>({
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      closed: false,
    });

    const fireClose = () => {
      if (!onClose || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      touchStartRef.current.closed = true;
      fireHeaderHaptic('Light');
      onClose();
      setTimeout(() => {
        touchStartRef.current.closed = false;
      }, 280);
    };

    const panResponder = useMemo(
      () =>
        PanResponder.create({
          onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_evt, gs) =>
            Math.abs(gs.dy) > 10 && Math.abs(gs.dy) > Math.abs(gs.dx),
          onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
            if (gs.dy > 42 || (gs.dy > 24 && gs.vy > 0.45)) {
              fireClose();
            }
          },
        }),
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      [onClose]
    );

    const handleTouchStart = (e: any) => {
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      touchStartRef.current = {
        x: Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0),
        y: Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0),
        closed: false,
      };
    };

    const handleTouchMove = (e: any) => {
      if (!touchStartRef.current.y || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const curY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const curX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = curY - touchStartRef.current.y;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(curX - touchStartRef.current.x);
      if (deltaY > 42 && deltaY > deltaX * 1.1) {
        touchStartRef.current.y = 0;
        fireClose();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = (e: any) => {
      if (!touchStartRef.current.y || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.changedTouches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const endY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const endX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = endY - touchStartRef.current.y;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(endX - touchStartRef.current.x);
      touchStartRef.current.y = 0;
      if (deltaY > 42 && deltaY > deltaX * 1.1) {
        fireClose();
      }
    };

    const inkColor = accentColor || (isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan);
    const glassPillStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, false, 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode]
    );

    return (
      <View
        style={[styles.headerZone, style]}
        onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
        onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
        {...panResponder.panHandlers}
      >
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.84}
          onPress={() => {
            if (!onClose) return;
            fireHeaderHaptic('Selection');
            onClose();
          }}
          style={[
            styles.pill3D,
            isLightMode ? styles.pillLight : styles.pillDark,
            glassPillStyle,
            { elevation: 0 },
            Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null,
          ]}
        >
          <View style={[styles.dragBar, { backgroundColor: inkColor }]} />
          <View style={styles.labelRow}>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={12} color={inkColor} />
            <Text style={[styles.pillText, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0' }]}>
              {tx(labelEs, labelEn)}
            </Text>
            <Feather name="x" size={11} color={isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8'} />
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  headerZone: {
    width: '100%',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    paddingTop: 2,
    marginBottom: 14,
  },
  pill3D: {
    minWidth: 186,
    paddingHorizontal: 18,
    paddingTop: 6,
    paddingBottom: 7,
    borderRadius: 999,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 3,
    borderWidth: 1.2,
    borderTopWidth: 1.8,
    borderBottomWidth: 2.8,
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 0,

    // === src/components/shared/KineticThemeLanguageControl.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import type { KineticLanguage, KineticThemeMode } from '../../constants/kineticTranslations';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

export interface KineticThemeLanguageControlProps {
  compact?: boolean;
  onPreferenceChanged?: (toastMessage: string) => void;
}

export const KineticThemeLanguageControl = memo(
  ({ compact = false, onPreferenceChanged }: KineticThemeLanguageControlProps) => {
    const {
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      t,
      tx,
    } = useKineticPreferences();
    const tlStyles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseTlStyles, resolvedTheme, ['pillBtnActiveCyan']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );

    const handleSelectTheme = (nextMode: KineticThemeMode) => {
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setThemeMode(nextMode);
      if (onPreferenceChanged) {
        const label =
          nextMode === 'light'
            ? tx('✓ Modo Claro activado', '✓ Light Mode enabled')
            : tx('✓ Modo Oscuro activado', '✓ Dark Mode enabled');
        onPreferenceChanged(label);
      }
    };

    const handleSelectLanguage = (nextLang: KineticLanguage) => {
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setLanguage(nextLang);
      if (onPreferenceChanged) {
        onPreferenceChanged(
          nextLang === 'en' ? '✓ Language switched to English' : '✓ Idioma cambiado a Español'
        );
      }
    };

    const themeOptions: { mode: KineticThemeMode; emoji: string; fullLabel: string; shortLabel: string }[] = [
      {
        mode: 'dark',
        emoji: '🌙',
        fullLabel: t('settings.theme_dark'),
        shortLabel: t('settings.theme_dark_short'),
      },
      {
        mode: 'light',
        emoji: '☀️',
        fullLabel: t('settings.theme_light'),
        shortLabel: t('settings.theme_light_short'),
      },
    ];

    const languageOptions: { lang: KineticLanguage; emoji: string; label: string }[] = [
      { lang: 'es', emoji: '🇲🇽', label: language === 'en' ? 'Spanish (ES)' : 'Español (ES)' },
      { lang: 'en', emoji: '🇺🇸', label: 'English (EN)' },
    ];

    const cardSurfaceStyle = {
      backgroundColor: themeColors.surface,
      borderColor: themeColors.cardBorder,
      borderTopColor: themeColors.cardBorderTop,
      borderBottomColor: themeColors.cardBorderBottom,
    };

    const glassTrackStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(themeColors.isLight, false, 'cyan'),
      [themeColors.isLight]
    );

    const inactivePillStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(themeColors.isLight, false, 'neutral'),
      [themeColors.isLight]
    );

    const activeCyanPillStyle = themeColors.isLight
      ? {
          backgroundColor: '#0284C7',
          borderColor: '#38BDF8',
          borderTopColor: '#E0F2FE',
          borderBottomColor: '#0369A1',
          shadowColor: '#0284C7',
          shadowOpacity: 0.25,
          elevation: 0,
        }
      : {
          ...tlStyles.pillBtnActiveCyan,
          elevation: 0,
        };
    const activeCyanTextColor = themeColors.isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : '#050505';
    const activeCyanDataSet: any = themeColors.isLight
      ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } }
      : { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

    if (compact) {
      return (
        <View style={[tlStyles.compactCard3D, cardSurfaceStyle]}>
          <View style={tlStyles.compactHeaderRow}>
            <View style={tlStyles.compactIconCircle}>
              <Feather name="sun" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={[tlStyles.compactTitle, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                {t('vault.lang_appearance_title')}
              </Text>
              <Text style={[tlStyles.compactSub, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
                {tx(
                  'Modo Oscuro o Claro • Español / Inglés',
                  'Dark or Light theme • Spanish / English'
                )}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle]}>
            {themeOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = resolvedTheme === opt.mode;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.mode}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.pillBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectTheme(opt.mode)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.pillBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.shortLabel}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle, { marginTop: 8 }]}>
            {languageOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = language === opt.lang;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.lang}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.pillBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectLanguage(opt.lang)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.pillBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      );
    }

    return (
      <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <Text style={[tlStyles.sectionHeader, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
          {t('settings.lang_appearance_header')}
        </Text>
        <View style={[tlStyles.fullCard3D, cardSurfaceStyle]}>
          <View style={tlStyles.subHeaderRow}>
            <Text style={[tlStyles.subLabel, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
              {t('settings.appearance_label')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[tlStyles.resolvedMicroBadge, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {resolvedTheme === 'light' ? tx('☀️ Claro', '☀️ Light') : tx('🌙 Oscuro', '🌙 Dark')}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle, { marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 14 }]}>
            {themeOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = resolvedTheme === opt.mode;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.mode}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.halfBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectTheme(opt.mode)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.fullBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.fullLabel}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <Text style={[tlStyles.subLabel, { color: themeColors.cyanText, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
            {tx('IDIOMA', 'LANGUAGE')}
          </Text>
          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle]}>
            {languageOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = language === opt.lang;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.lang}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.halfBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectLanguage(opt.lang)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.fullBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const baseTlStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  sectionHeader: { fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 8 },

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../../assets/logo.png');
const HUB_MEDIA_LOCK = [
  'walletHero', 'walletHeroDim', 'walletLogoBox', 'walletDiscTag', 'walletTitle', 'walletClub',
];

export const KineticUnifiedControlHub = ({
  onOpenBilling,
  onOpenFiscal,
  onOpenLegal,
  onOpenConcierge,
  onOpenSupport,
  isB2B = false,
}: {
  onOpenBilling?: () => void;
  onOpenFiscal?: () => void;
  onOpenLegal?: () => void;
  onOpenConcierge?: () => void;
  onOpenSupport?: () => void;
  isB2B?: boolean;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}) => {
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme, t, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const st = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(hubSt, resolvedTheme, HUB_MEDIA_LOCK), [resolvedTheme]);
  const handleFiscal = onOpenBilling || onOpenFiscal || (() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:open-boveda-billing'));
    }
  });

  const items = [
    { icon: 'file-text' as const, color: themeColors.cyanText, title: isB2B ? t('vault.tax_billing_b2b') : t('vault.tax_billing_b2c'), onPress: handleFiscal },
    { icon: 'shield' as const, color: themeColors.purpleText, title: t('vault.legal_waiver'), onPress: onOpenLegal },
    { icon: 'cpu' as const, color: themeColors.cyanText, title: tx('Concierge IA 24/7', '24/7 AI Concierge'), onPress: onOpenConcierge },
    { icon: 'headphones' as const, color: themeColors.green, title: t('vault.talk_human'), onPress: onOpenSupport },
  ];

  return (
    <View style={[st.hubBox, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
      {items.map((it, idx) => (
        <TouchableOpacity key={idx} style={[st.hubRow, themeColors.isLight && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }, idx === items.length - 1 && { borderBottomWidth: 0 }]} activeOpacity={0.82} onPress={it.onPress}>
          <View style={[st.hubIconCircle, { borderColor: it.color }, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC' }]}>
            <Feather name={it.icon} size={14} color={it.color} />
          </View>
          <Text style={[st.hubRowTitle, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{it.title}</Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color={themeColors.textMuted} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
};

export interface KineticBoardingPassWalletItem {
  id?: string | number;
  categoria?: string;
  disciplina?: string;
  servicio?: string;
  titulo?: string;
  nombre_servicio?: string;
  negocio_nombre?: string;
  sede?: string;
  avatar_club?: string;
  avatar_url?: string;
}

export const KineticBoardingPassWalletCard = ({
  pass, selectedPass, qrSecondsLeft = 60, secondsLeft, escrowKc, puertaKc, children,
}: {
  pass?: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem | null; selectedPass?: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem | null; qrSecondsLeft?: number; secondsLeft?: number; escrowKc?: number; puertaKc?: number; children?: React.ReactNode; [key: string]: unknown;
}) => {
  const { tx, td, tDisc, themeColors, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
  const st = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(hubSt, resolvedTheme, HUB_MEDIA_LOCK), [resolvedTheme]);
  const item: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem = pass || selectedPass || {};
  const rawSec = Number(secondsLeft ?? qrSecondsLeft);
  const secs = Number.isFinite(rawSec) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(60, rawSec)) : 60;
  const pct = Math.max(2, Math.min(100, (secs / 60) * 100));
  const barColor = secs <= 10 ? '#FF3B30' : secs <= 20 ? '#FFB800' : themeColors.isLight ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF';
  const disc = String(item?.categoria || item?.disciplina || item?.servicio || 'Fuerza');
  const rawTitle = String(item?.servicio || item?.titulo || item?.nombre_servicio || '');
  const title = rawTitle ? td(rawTitle) : tx('Pase Activo Kinetic', 'Active Kinetic Pass');
  const club = String(item?.negocio_nombre || item?.sede || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official'));
  const coverUri = resolveCategoryImage(disc, title);
  const logoUri = item?.avatar_club || item?.avatar_url;
  const hasLogo = Boolean(logoUri && String(logoUri).length > 5);
  const coverSource = useMemo(() => ({ uri: coverUri }), [coverUri]);
  const logoSource = useMemo(() => (hasLogo ? { uri: String(logoUri) } : null), [hasLogo, logoUri]);

  return (
    <View style={st.walletCard}>
      <View style={st.walletHero} {...({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as Record<string, unknown>)}>
        <Image source={coverSource} recyclingKey={coverUri} cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} style={st.walletHeroImg} contentFit="cover" />
        <View style={st.walletHeroDim} />
        <View style={st.walletHeroRow}>
          <View style={st.walletLogoBox}>
            {logoSource ? (
              <Image source={logoSource} recyclingKey={String(logoUri)} cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} contentFit="cover" />
            ) : (
              <Image source={KINETIC_LOGO} transition={0} style={{ width: 30, height: 30 }} contentFit="contain" />
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={st.walletDiscTag}>{tDisc(disc).toUpperCase()}</Text>
            <Text style={st.walletTitle} numberOfLines={1}>{title}</Text>
            <Text style={st.walletClub} numberOfLines={1}>{club}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
      {children}
      <View style={[st.timerTrack, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderColor: '#7DD3FC' }]}>
        <View style={[st.timerFill, { width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: barColor }]} />
      </View>
      <Text style={[st.timerCaption, themeColors.isLight && { color: '#475569' }]}>
        {tx(`Rotación TOTP 60s en ${secs}s`, `60s TOTP rotation in ${secs}s`)}
        {typeof escrowKc === 'number' && typeof puertaKc === 'number'
          ? tx(` • Custodia: ${escrowKc} KC / Puerta: ${puertaKc} KC`, ` • Escrow: ${escrowKc} KC / Front Desk: ${puertaKc} KC`)
          : ''}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
};

const hubSt = StyleSheet.create({
  hubBox: { backgroundColor: '#090D16', borderRadius: 18, borderWidth: 1.2, borderLeftWidth: 1.2, borderRightWidth: 1.2, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.34)', borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderTopColor: 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.5)', borderBottomWidth: 4.5, borderBottomColor: '#03060B', overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: 16, shadowColor: COLORS.cyan, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 }, shadowOpacity: 0.36, shadowRadius: 12, elevation: 10 },
