const STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES = new Set([1507459749, 1800830082, 79832761, 2447318640, 2016519120]);
function hasStealthRivalToken(q: string): boolean {
  return q.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).some((tok) => {
    if (!tok) return false;
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < tok.length; i += 1) { h = Math.imul(h ^ tok.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0; }
    return STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES.has(h);
  });
}

export function resolveKineticConciergeReply(rawInput: string, lang: KineticLang): { text: string; ctaRole?: 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista' } {
  const q = String(rawInput || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const en = lang === 'en';
  const wantsClub = /\b(club|gym|gimnasio|estudio|studio|sede|cancha|venue|partner|socio|b2b)\b/.test(q);
  const wantsSpec = /\b(especialista|consultorio|fisio|fisioterapia|recovery|specialist|clinic)\b/.test(q);
  const roleHint: 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista' = wantsSpec ? 'especialista' : wantsClub ? 'club' : 'atleta';

  if (hasStealthRivalToken(q) || /\b(precio|precios|costo|costos|cuanto|cuesta|mensualidad|tarifa|comision|porcentaje|split|divide|pago|pagos|moneda|coin|competencia|rival|alternativa|membresia|plan|vs|versus|price|pricing|cost|fee|monthly|commission|percent|how much|membership)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: roleHint,
      text: en
        ? 'Exclusive conditions, membership details and opening perks are shared privately once your invitation is activated. Join the priority list and we will send your private access directly.'
        : 'Las condiciones exclusivas y beneficios de apertura se comparten de forma privada al activar tu invitación. Solicita tu lugar en la lista prioritaria para recibir los detalles al momento de tu ola.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(donde|ciudad|ciudades|ubicacion|zona|cobertura|cabo|san lucas|san jose|where|city|cities|location|coverage)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: 'atleta',
      text: en
        ? 'Initial coverage launches across Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, while the ecosystem is engineered to scale rapidly into new cities by curated invitation.'
        : 'La cobertura inicial inicia entre Cabo San Lucas y San José del Cabo, con una arquitectura diseñada para expandirse progresivamente a nuevas ciudades.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(3d|espacio|lugar|estacion|cama|reformer|bici|bicicleta|camilla|fila|filas|mapa|spot|station|bed|bike|court|line|queue)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Before leaving home, open the 3D spatial view of each venue to select your exact bike, Pilates reformer, training rack, padel court or recovery bed. Walk straight in with zero queues.'
        : 'Antes de salir, entras al mapa espacial en 3D de la sede y eliges tu bicicleta, cama de Pilates, estación, cancha o camilla exacta. Llegas directo a entrenar sin filas.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(nivel|pilar|pilares|fuerza|zen|resistencia|agilidad|racha|rachas|cofre|cofres|premio|premios|trofeo|level|pillar|strength|endurance|agility|streak|chest|reward|trophy)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Every real session boosts Strength, Zen, Endurance and Agility. Keeping active streaks unlocks interactive reward chests and trophies tied directly to your real consistency.'
        : 'Cada entrenamiento real impulsa tus cuatro pilares —Fuerza, Zen, Resistencia y Agilidad—. Al sostener rachas activas desbloqueas cofres con premios y trofeos ligados a tu constancia.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(comunidad|historia|historias|equipo|equipos|amigo|social|community|story|stories|squad|team)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Connect with real athletes nearby, organize training squads for courts or studio classes, and share live moments through 24-hour venue stories.'
        : 'Conecta con atletas reales, arma equipos para canchas o sesiones grupales y comparte tus logros en vivo mediante historias efímeras de 24h desde cada sede.',
    };
  }
  if (wantsClub || wantsSpec) {
    return {
      ctaRole: roleHint,
      text: en
        ? 'Kinetic empowers clubs, studios, courts and specialists with smart off-peak and peak occupancy, verified bookings and zero friction at reception. Leave your details to evaluate your founding venue spot.'
        : 'Kinetic conecta clubes, estudios, canchas y especialistas con ocupación inteligente en todo horario y agenda verificada. Registra tu sede en el formulario para evaluar tu ingreso fundador.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(app|ios|android|iphone|web|dispositivo|celular|device|mobile|download)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Kinetic runs seamlessly across iOS, Android and modern mobile web browsers, keeping your passes, 3D reservations and athletic progress in real-time sync.'
        : 'Kinetic opera en iOS, Android y web móvil manteniendo tus reservas 3D, accesos y progreso atlético sincronizados al instante.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(privacidad|dato|datos|seguridad|privacy|data|security)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Your pre-registration information is used solely to coordinate your priority invitation under KineticApp S.A.S. strict data-protection controls.'
        : 'Tus datos de pre-registro se resguardan bajo control estricto de KineticApp S.A.S. únicamente para coordinar tu invitación y avisos de apertura.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(invitacion|acceso|registro|espera|lista|invite|invitation|access|waitlist|join)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: 'atleta',
      text: en
        ? 'Access rolls out in controlled waves. Leave your name, email and 10-digit WhatsApp in the invitation card so we can notify you as soon as your wave opens.'
        : 'La apertura avanza por oleadas controladas. Deja tu nombre, correo y WhatsApp de 10 dígitos en la tarjeta de invitación para avisarte en cuanto se abra tu acceso.',
    };
  }
  return {
    ctaRole: 'atleta',
    text: en
      ? 'Kinetic unites over 230 fitness, court and recovery disciplines on a single digital pass — with 3D spot selection before leaving home, four living progression pillars, reward chests and community.'
      : 'Kinetic reúne más de 230 disciplinas de fitness, deporte, canchas y recuperación bajo un solo pase digital: reserva exacta en 3D, cuatro pilares de evolución, cofres con premios y comunidad real.',
  };
}

    import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Animated, Easing, Platform, RefreshControl, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS, RADIUS, SPACING } from '../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme, getLastSyncedKineticTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { getOptimizedImageUrl } from '../utils/supabaseImage';

export {
  IKineticStoryOwner,
  IKineticStorySlide,
  KineticStoriesModal,
  STORIES_STORAGE_KEY,
  checkHasActiveCustomStory,
} from './shared/KineticStoriesModal';

const GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI =
  'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534438327276-14e5300c3a48?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80';

let _sharedSkeletonPulse: Animated.Value | null = null;
let _sharedSkeletonLoop: Animated.CompositeAnimation | null = null;
let _sharedSkeletonRefCount = 0;

function acquireSharedSkeletonPulse(): Animated.Value {
  if (!_sharedSkeletonPulse) {
    _sharedSkeletonPulse = new Animated.Value(0.48);
  }
  _sharedSkeletonRefCount += 1;
  if (_sharedSkeletonRefCount === 1) {
    _sharedSkeletonLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(_sharedSkeletonPulse, {
          toValue: 0.78,
          duration: 850,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
        }),
        Animated.timing(_sharedSkeletonPulse, {
          toValue: 0.48,
          duration: 850,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
        }),
      ]),
    );
    _sharedSkeletonLoop.start();
  }
  return _sharedSkeletonPulse;
}

function releaseSharedSkeletonPulse(): void {
  _sharedSkeletonRefCount = Math.max(0, _sharedSkeletonRefCount - 1);
  if (_sharedSkeletonRefCount === 0 && _sharedSkeletonLoop) {
    try {
      _sharedSkeletonLoop.stop();
    } catch {}
    _sharedSkeletonLoop = null;
  }
}

export const triggerHaptic = (type: any = 'Light') => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  try {
    if (type === 'Light') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);
    else if (type === 'Medium') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium);
    else if (type === 'Heavy') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy);
    else if (type === 'Selection') Haptics.selectionAsync();
    else if (type === 'Success') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
    else if (type === 'Warning') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Warning);
    else if (type === 'Error') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Error);
  } catch {}
};

export const triggerArcadeHaptic = (
  preset: 'checkIn' | 'levelUp' | 'reward' | 'unlock' | 'shield' = 'checkIn',
) => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  try {
    if (preset === 'levelUp' || preset === 'unlock') {
      Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
      setTimeout(() => Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy), 130);
    } else if (preset === 'reward' || preset === 'shield') {
      Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium);
      setTimeout(() => Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success), 110);
    } else {
      Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
    }
  } catch {}
};

export const SkeletonPulse = React.memo(({ style, hasCachedData, isLightMode: isLightModeProp }: { style?: any; hasCachedData?: boolean; isLightMode?: boolean }) => {
  if (hasCachedData) return null;
  const isLightMode = typeof isLightModeProp === 'boolean' ? isLightModeProp : getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light';
  const pulseRef = useRef<Animated.Value | null>(null);
  if (!pulseRef.current) {
    pulseRef.current = acquireSharedSkeletonPulse();
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      releaseSharedSkeletonPulse();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        baseStyles.skeletonBaseBox,
        isLightMode
          ? { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1' }
          : { backgroundColor: '#0D121B', borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)', borderTopColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)', borderBottomColor: '#05070C' },
        style,
        { opacity: pulseRef.current },
      ]}
      collapsable={false}
    />
  );
});

export const KineticLoader = React.memo(
  ({ size = 28, color = COLORS.cyan }: { size?: number; color?: string }) => {
    const isLightMode = getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light';
    const effectiveColor = isLightMode && String(color).toUpperCase() === '#00F0FF' ? '#0284C7' : color;
    const rotateAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
      if (size <= 18) return;
      const rotateLoop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.timing(rotateAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 1050, easing: Easing.linear, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      );
      rotateLoop.start();
      return () => {
        rotateLoop.stop();
      };
    }, [rotateAnim, size]);

    if (size <= 18) return <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={effectiveColor} />;
    const hexClean = String(effectiveColor || '#00F0FF').replace('#', '%23');
    const boltSvgDataUri = `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="${hexClean}"><path d="M13 2L3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z"/></svg>`;
    const spin = rotateAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: ['0deg', '360deg'] });

    return (
      <View style={{ justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', width: size + 16, height: size + 16 }}>
        <Animated.View
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', width: size + 12, height: size + 12, borderRadius: (size + 12) / 2,
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.12)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14)',
            borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.35)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)',
            borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF',
            transform: [{ rotate: spin }],
          }}
        />
        <Image source={{ uri: boltSvgDataUri }} style={{ width: size, height: size }} contentFit="contain" cachePolicy="memory-disk" priority="low" />
      </View>
    );
  },
);

const _cachedSmartImageUris = new Set<string>();

export const SmartImage = React.memo(
  ({
    source,
    uri,
    fallbackUri,
    style,
    contentFit = 'cover',
    contentPosition = 'center',
    fallbackCategory = 'Fuerza',
    transition = 0,
    priority = 'low',
  }: any) => {
    const numericSource = typeof source === 'number' ? source : null;
    const rawUri =
      typeof source === 'string'
        ? source.trim()
        : source?.uri
        ? String(source.uri).trim()
        : uri
        ? String(uri).trim()
        : '';
    const safeFallbackUri = fallbackUri ? String(fallbackUri).trim() : '';

    const [errorStage, setErrorStage] = useState(0);
    const hasError = errorStage > 0;
    const [isDecoded, setIsDecoded] = useState<boolean>(
      () => numericSource !== null || Boolean(rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri))
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setErrorStage(0);
      setIsDecoded(numericSource !== null || Boolean(rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri)));
    }, [rawUri, fallbackCategory, numericSource]);

    const optimizedRawUri = useMemo(() => {
      if (!rawUri || rawUri.length < 5) return rawUri;
      return getOptimizedImageUrl(rawUri, {
        quality: 80,
        format: 'webp',
        resize: contentFit === 'contain' ? 'contain' : 'cover',
      });
    }, [rawUri, contentFit]);

    const resolvedSource = useMemo(() => {
      if (errorStage >= 2) return { uri: GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
      if (hasError) {
        const tier1 = safeFallbackUri.length > 4 ? safeFallbackUri : resolveCategoryImage(fallbackCategory);
        return { uri: tier1 || GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
      }
      if (numericSource !== null) return numericSource;
      if (optimizedRawUri.length > 4) return { uri: optimizedRawUri };
      return { uri: resolveCategoryImage(fallbackCategory) || GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
    }, [hasError, errorStage, optimizedRawUri, fallbackCategory, safeFallbackUri, numericSource]);

    const effectiveTransition = rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri) ? 0 : transition;
    const resolvedPriority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' =
      priority === 'high' ? 'high' : priority === 'medium' || priority === 'normal' ? 'normal' : 'low';

    return (
      <View style={[{ overflow: 'hidden' }, style]} pointerEvents="none" collapsable={false}>
        {!isDecoded && (
          <SkeletonPulse style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 }} />
        )}
        <Image
          source={resolvedSource}
          recyclingKey={rawUri || String(numericSource ?? fallbackCategory)}
          style={baseStyles.fullImageFill}
          contentFit={contentFit}
          contentPosition={contentPosition}
          transition={effectiveTransition}
          cachePolicy="memory-disk"
          priority={resolvedPriority}
          onLoad={() => {
            if (rawUri) _cachedSmartImageUris.add(rawUri);
            setIsDecoded(true);
          }}
          onLoadEnd={() => setIsDecoded(true)}
          onError={() => {
            if (errorStage >= 1) setIsDecoded(true);
            setErrorStage((prev) => Math.min(2, prev + 1));
          }}
        />
      </View>
    );
  },
  (prev, next) => {
    const prevRaw = typeof prev.source === 'string' ? prev.source : prev.source?.uri || prev.uri || '';
    const nextRaw = typeof next.source === 'string' ? next.source : next.source?.uri || next.uri || '';
    const prevNum = typeof prev.source === 'number' ? prev.source : null;
    const nextNum = typeof next.source === 'number' ? next.source : null;
    return (
      prevRaw === nextRaw &&
      prevNum === nextNum &&
      prev.priority === next.priority &&
      prev.fallbackUri === next.fallbackUri &&
      prev.fallbackCategory === next.fallbackCategory &&
      prev.contentFit === next.contentFit &&
      prev.contentPosition === next.contentPosition &&
      prev.style === next.style
    );
  },
);

export const GpuProgressBar = ({
  progress = 0,
  color = COLORS.cyan,
  height = 7,
  backgroundColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
  isLightMode: isLightModeProp,
}: {
  progress: number;
  color?: string;
  height?: number;
  duration?: number;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  isLightMode?: boolean;
}) => {
  const isLightMode = typeof isLightModeProp === 'boolean' ? isLightModeProp : getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light';
  const clamped = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(progress) || 0));
  const isDefaultTrack = backgroundColor === 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' || backgroundColor === 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)';
  const resolvedTrack = isLightMode && isDefaultTrack ? '#E2E8F0' : backgroundColor;
  const normFill = String(color || '').toUpperCase();
  const resolvedFill = isLightMode
    ? normFill === '#00F0FF' || normFill === '#00E5FF'
      ? '#0284C7'
      : normFill === '#00FF66'
      ? '#059669'
      : normFill === '#FFCC00' || normFill === '#FFD700'
      ? '#D97706'
      : normFill === '#E0AAFF'
      ? '#7C3AED'
      : color
    : color;

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height,
        backgroundColor: resolvedTrack,
        borderRadius: height / 2,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        borderWidth: isLightMode && isDefaultTrack ? 0.8 : 0,
        borderColor: '#CBD5E1',
      }}
    >
      <View style={{ width: `${clamped}%`, height: '100%', backgroundColor: resolvedFill, borderRadius: height / 2 }} />
    </View>
  );
};

export const PulseBadge = React.memo(({ color = COLORS.cyan, size = 8 }: { color?: string; size?: number }) => {
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  useEffect(() => {
    const loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1.35, duration: 650, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 650, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      ]),
    );
    loop.start();
    return () => loop.stop();
  }, [scaleAnim]);

  return <Animated.View style={{ width: size, height: size, borderRadius: size / 2, backgroundColor: color, transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }] }} />;
});

export const AttentionShakeView = React.memo(
  ({ active = true, children, style }: { active?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode; style?: any }) => {
    const shakeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!active) {
        shakeAnim.setValue(0);
        return;
      }
      const loop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.delay(1800),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 0, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        ]),
      );
      loop.start();
      return () => loop.stop();
    }, [active, shakeAnim]);

    const rotate = shakeAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [-1, 1], outputRange: ['-3.5deg', '3.5deg'] });
    return <Animated.View style={[style, active && { transform: [{ rotate }] }]}>{children}</Animated.View>;
  },
);

  return { borderBottomWidth: 3.5, borderTopWidth: 1.8, transform: [{ translateY: 0 }] };
};

    // === src/components/web/KineticWebLanding.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { type Href, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Image, Linking, Modal, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  KINETIC_CAROUSEL_ITEMS,
  KINETIC_CONCIERGE_CHIPS,
  KINETIC_HERO_SCENES,
  KINETIC_QUICK_ICONS,
  KINETIC_SCROLL_CARDS,
  KINETIC_STEALTH_FAQS,
  resolveKineticConciergeReply,
  type KineticLang,
} from '../shared/kineticWebLandingStealthData';
import { styles } from './KineticWebLanding.styles';

export { KINETIC_REVEAL_DROPS } from '../shared/kineticWebLandingStealthData';

export function isKineticWebLandingHost(): boolean {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return false;
  const hostname = String(window.location.hostname || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const search = String(window.location.search || '');
  if (search.includes('landing=1')) return true;
  return hostname === 'kineticapp.com.mx' || hostname === 'www.kineticapp.com.mx';
}

interface SheetDetail { titleBright: string; titleTitanium: string; accent: string; bullets: string[]; }
type RoleChoice = 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista';
interface ChatBubble { id: string; from: 'ai' | 'user'; text: string; ctaRole?: RoleChoice; }
const KINETIC_MARK_SOURCE = require('../../../assets/logo.png');
const ICON_MAP: Record<string, keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap> = {
  radar: 'radio', space3d: 'box', evolution: 'zap', community: 'users', venues: 'map-pin',
};

export function KineticWebLanding() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<KineticLang>('es');
  const [sceneIdx, setSceneIdx] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<RoleChoice>('atleta');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [whatsapp, setWhatsapp] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [openAcc, setOpenAcc] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<SheetDetail | null>(null);
  const [conciergeOpen, setConciergeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState('');
  const [chatLog, setChatLog] = useState<ChatBubble[]>([]);
  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView | null>(null);
  const touchXRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const cooldownUntilRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || paused) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (mountedRef.current) setSceneIdx((prev) => (prev + 1) % KINETIC_HERO_SCENES.length);
    }, 5200);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [paused]);

  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    const querySuffix = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location ? String(window.location.search || '') : '';
    return (
      <View style={styles.root}>
        {React.createElement('iframe' as any, {
          src: `/landing.html${querySuffix}`,
          title: 'KINETIC — Fitness, Deporte & Wellness',
          style: { border: 'none', width: '100%', height: '100%', backgroundColor: '#050505', display: 'block' },
        })}
      </View>
    );
  }

  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  const scene = KINETIC_HERO_SCENES[sceneIdx] || KINETIC_HERO_SCENES[0];
  const roleLabel =
    role === 'club' ? 'Club / Estudio B2B' : role === 'especialista' ? 'Especialista / Consultorio B2B' : 'Atleta Acceso Prioritario';
  const namePlaceholder = role === 'club'
    ? (isEn ? 'Club or studio name' : 'Nombre del club o estudio')
    : role === 'especialista'
      ? (isEn ? 'Specialist or clinic name' : 'Nombre del especialista o consultorio')
      : (isEn ? 'Your full name' : 'Tu nombre completo');

  const handleConciergeAsk = (rawPrompt: string) => {
    const cleanQ = rawPrompt.trim();
    if (!cleanQ) return;
    const reply = resolveKineticConciergeReply(cleanQ, lang);
    setChatLog((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id: `u_${Date.now()}`, from: 'user', text: cleanQ },
      { id: `a_${Date.now() + 1}`, from: 'ai', text: reply.text, ctaRole: reply.ctaRole },
    ]);
    setChatInput('');
  };

  const openConcierge = () => {
    if (chatLog.length === 0) {
      setChatLog([{
        id: 'welcome',
        from: 'ai',
        text: isEn
          ? 'Welcome to Kinetic Concierge 24/7. Ask me about disciplines, 3D spot selection, levels & reward chests, or founding venues.'
          : 'Bienvenido al Concierge 24/7 de Kinetic. Pregúntame sobre disciplinas, selección 3D, niveles y cofres o cómo sumar tu sede.',
      }]);
    }
    setConciergeOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current) return;
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    if (nowMs < cooldownUntilRef.current) {
      setErrorMsg(isEn ? 'Please wait a few seconds before submitting again.' : 'Espera unos segundos antes de volver a enviar.');
      return;
    }
    const cleanName = name.trim();
    const cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const digits = whatsapp.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanName.length < 2) {
      setErrorMsg(isEn ? 'Enter your full name or venue name.' : 'Ingresa tu nombre o el nombre de tu sede.');
      return;
    }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      setErrorMsg(isEn ? 'Enter a valid email address.' : 'Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.');
      return;
    }
    if (digits.length < 10 || digits.length > 15) {
      setErrorMsg(isEn ? 'Enter a valid 10-digit WhatsApp number.' : 'Ingresa un WhatsApp válido de 10 dígitos.');
      return;
    }
    busyRef.current = true;
    cooldownUntilRef.current = nowMs + 10_000;
    setBusy(true);
    setErrorMsg('');
    const zoneVal = 'Acceso Prioritario Web';
    const discVal = 'Acceso Anticipado Web';
    try {
      const r1 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
        { nombre: cleanName, email: cleanEmail, whatsapp: digits, perfil_interes: roleLabel, zona: zoneVal, disciplina_favorita: discVal, origen: 'kineticapp.com.mx' },
      ]);
      if (r1.error) {
        const r2 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
          { nombre: cleanName, email: cleanEmail, telefono: digits, tipo_perfil: roleLabel, ciudad_zona: zoneVal, disciplina_interes: discVal, origen: 'kineticapp.com.mx' },
        ]);
        if (r2.error && !String(r2.error.code || '').includes('23505')) throw r2.error;
      }
      if (mountedRef.current) setSuccess(true);
    } catch {
      if (mountedRef.current) setErrorMsg(isEn ? 'Could not register right now. Try again.' : 'No pudimos registrar ahora. Intenta de nuevo.');
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.root}>
      <ScrollView ref={scrollRef} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContainer}>
        <View style={styles.navbar}>
          <View style={styles.brandRow}>
            <View style={styles.brandMarkWrap}>
              <Image source={KINETIC_MARK_SOURCE} style={styles.brandMarkImg} resizeMode="cover" />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.brandTitle}>KINETIC</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.navActionsRow}>
            <Pressable style={styles.langToggleBtn} onPress={() => setLang(isEn ? 'es' : 'en')}>
              <Text style={styles.langToggleTxt}>ES | EN</Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable style={styles.btnVipNav} onPress={() => scrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true })}>
              <Text style={styles.btnVipNavText}>{isEn ? 'Early Access' : 'Acceso Anticipado'}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.sectionWrap}>
          <View
            style={styles.heroCard}
            onTouchStart={(e) => { touchXRef.current = e.nativeEvent.pageX; }}
            onTouchEnd={(e) => {
              if (touchXRef.current === null) return;
              const dx = e.nativeEvent.pageX - touchXRef.current;
              touchXRef.current = null;
              if (Math.abs(dx) >= 36) {
                setSceneIdx((prev) => (prev + (dx < 0 ? 1 : KINETIC_HERO_SCENES.length - 1)) % KINETIC_HERO_SCENES.length);
              }
            }}
          >
            <Text style={styles.heroTitleBright}>
              {scene.titleBright[lang]}{' '}
              <Text style={styles.heroTitleTitanium}>{scene.titleTitanium[lang]}</Text>
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.heroSubtitle}>{scene.subtitle[lang]}</Text>
            <View style={styles.heroCtaRow}>
              <Pressable style={styles.btnCtaCyan} onPress={() => { setRole('atleta'); scrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true }); }}>
                <Text style={styles.btnCtaCyanText}>{isEn ? "I'm an Athlete" : 'Soy Atleta'}</Text>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable style={styles.btnCtaPurple} onPress={() => { setRole('club'); scrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true }); }}>
                <Text style={styles.btnCtaPurpleText}>{isEn ? 'I Own a Club or Clinic' : 'Tengo un Club o Consultorio'}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.sceneDotsRow}>
              <View style={styles.dotsGroup}>
                {KINETIC_HERO_SCENES.map((sc, i) => (
                  <Pressable key={sc.id} onPress={() => setSceneIdx(i)} style={[styles.dotPill, i === sceneIdx && styles.dotPillActive]} />
                ))}
              </View>
              <Pressable style={styles.langToggleBtn} onPress={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}>
                <Text style={styles.langToggleTxt}>{paused ? '▶' : '⏸'}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.quickIconsRow}>
            {KINETIC_QUICK_ICONS.map((ic) => (
              <Pressable
                key={ic.id}
                style={styles.quickIconItem}
                onPress={() => setSheet({ titleBright: ic.titleBright[lang], titleTitanium: ic.titleTitanium[lang], accent: ic.accent, bullets: ic.bullets[lang] })}
              >
                <Feather name={ICON_MAP[ic.id] || 'circle'} size={18} color={ic.accent} />
                <Text style={styles.quickIconLabel}>{ic.label[lang]}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>

          {KINETIC_SCROLL_CARDS.map((card) => (
            <View key={card.id} style={styles.sculptureCard}>
              <Text style={{ color: card.accent, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 1.4 }}>{card.animType.toUpperCase()}</Text>
              <View style={styles.sculptureHeaderRow}>
                <Text style={styles.sculptureTitle}>
                  {card.titleBright[lang]} <Text style={styles.heroTitleTitanium}>{card.titleTitanium[lang]}</Text>
                </Text>
                <Pressable
                  style={styles.plusBtn}
                  onPress={() => setSheet({ titleBright: card.titleBright[lang], titleTitanium: card.titleTitanium[lang], accent: card.accent, bullets: card.bullets[lang] })}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.plusBtnText}>+</Text>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            </View>
          ))}

          <ScrollView horizontal pagingEnabled showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>
            {KINETIC_CAROUSEL_ITEMS.map((item) => (
              <View key={item.id} style={styles.carouselCard}>
                <Image source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }} style={styles.carouselImage} />
                <View style={styles.carouselFooter}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800', flex: 1 }}>
                    {item.titleBright[lang]} <Text style={styles.heroTitleTitanium}>{item.titleTitanium[lang]}</Text>
                  </Text>
                  <Pressable
                    style={styles.plusBtn}
                    onPress={() => setSheet({ titleBright: item.titleBright[lang], titleTitanium: item.titleTitanium[lang], accent: item.accent, bullets: item.bullets[lang] })}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.plusBtnText}>+</Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>

          <View style={styles.waitlistCard}>
            <Text style={styles.heroTitleBright}>
              {isEn ? 'Request' : 'Solicitar'} <Text style={styles.heroTitleTitanium}>{isEn ? 'early access.' : 'invitación.'}</Text>
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: '#8E9BB0', fontSize: 14, marginTop: 6 }}>
              {isEn ? 'Priority access by invitation.' : 'Acceso prioritario por invitación.'}
            </Text>
            <View style={styles.roleTabsRow}>
              {(['atleta', 'club', 'especialista'] as const).map((r) => (
                <Pressable key={r} style={[styles.roleChip, role === r && styles.roleChipActive]} onPress={() => setRole(r)}>
                  <Text style={[styles.roleChipText, role === r && styles.roleChipTextActive]}>
                    {r === 'atleta' ? (isEn ? 'Athlete' : 'Atleta') : r === 'club' ? 'Club' : isEn ? 'Specialist' : 'Especialista'}
                  </Text>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>
            <TextInput style={styles.inputField} placeholder={namePlaceholder} placeholderTextColor="#64748B" value={name} onChangeText={setName} />
            <TextInput style={styles.inputField} placeholder={isEn ? 'Email address' : 'Correo electrónico'} placeholderTextColor="#64748B" value={email} onChangeText={setEmail} keyboardType="email-address" autoCapitalize="none" />
            <TextInput style={styles.inputField} placeholder={isEn ? 'WhatsApp (10 digits)' : 'WhatsApp (10 dígitos)'} placeholderTextColor="#64748B" value={whatsapp} onChangeText={setWhatsapp} keyboardType="phone-pad" />
            {Boolean(errorMsg) && <Text style={{ color: '#FF3B30', fontSize: 12.5, marginBottom: 10 }}>{errorMsg}</Text>}
            {success ? (
              <Pressable onPress={() => Linking.openURL('https://www.instagram.com/kinetic.mex')}>
                <Text style={{ color: '#00FF66', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                  {isEn ? 'Invitation queued. Follow clues on @kinetic.mex →' : 'Invitación registrada. Sigue las pistas en @kinetic.mex →'}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            ) : (
              <Pressable style={[styles.btnCtaCyan, busy && { opacity: 0.6 }]} disabled={busy} onPress={handleSubmit}>
                <Text style={styles.btnCtaCyanText}>{busy ? '...' : isEn ? 'Request Invitation' : 'Solicitar Invitación'}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={{ marginTop: 28 }}>
            {KINETIC_STEALTH_FAQS.map((fq) => (
              <View key={fq.id} style={styles.accordionRow}>
                <Pressable style={styles.accordionTrigger} onPress={() => setOpenAcc(openAcc === fq.id ? null : fq.id)}>
                  <Text style={styles.accordionTitle}>{fq.question[lang]}</Text>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#8E9BB0', fontSize: 16 }}>⌄</Text>
                </Pressable>
                {openAcc === fq.id && <Text style={{ color: '#8E9BB0', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 19 }}>{fq.answer[lang]}</Text>}
              </View>
            ))}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 18, marginTop: 18 }}>
              <Pressable onPress={() => router.push('/privacidad' as Href)}><Text style={{ color: '#00F0FF', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '700' }}>{isEn ? 'Privacy' : 'Privacidad'}</Text></Pressable>
              <Pressable onPress={() => router.push('/terminos' as Href)}><Text style={{ color: '#00F0FF', fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: '700' }}>{isEn ? 'Terms' : 'Términos'}</Text></Pressable>
            </View>
            <Text style={{ color: '#64748B', fontSize: 12, marginTop: 14 }}>© 2026 KineticApp S.A.S. • México.</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      <Pressable style={styles.conciergeFab} onPress={openConcierge}>
        <Text style={styles.conciergeFabTxt}>✦ {isEn ? '24/7 Concierge' : 'Concierge 24/7'}</Text>
      </Pressable>

      <Modal visible={conciergeOpen} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setConciergeOpen(false)}>
        <Pressable style={styles.modalOverlay} onPress={() => setConciergeOpen(false)}>
          <Pressable style={styles.modalSheet} onPress={() => {}}>
            <Text style={{ color: '#00F0FF', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 1.4 }}>CONCIERGE 24/7</Text>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, marginTop: 10 }}>
              {KINETIC_CONCIERGE_CHIPS.map((ch) => (
                <Pressable key={ch.id} style={styles.langToggleBtn} onPress={() => handleConciergeAsk(ch.query[lang])}>
                  <Text style={styles.langToggleTxt}>{ch.label[lang]}</Text>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>
            <ScrollView style={styles.chatScroll}>
              {chatLog.map((b) => (
                <View key={b.id} style={b.from === 'user' ? styles.bubbleUser : styles.bubbleAi}>
                  <Text style={styles.bubbleTxt}>{b.text}</Text>
                  {b.ctaRole && (
                    <Pressable
                      style={[styles.btnCtaCyan, { marginTop: 8, paddingVertical: 8 }]}
                      onPress={() => { setRole(b.ctaRole!); setConciergeOpen(false); scrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true }); }}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.btnCtaCyanText}>{isEn ? 'Request Invitation' : 'Solicitar Invitación'}</Text>
                    </Pressable>
                  )}
                </View>
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
            <View style={styles.chatInputRow}>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.chatInput}
                placeholder={isEn ? 'Ask anything...' : 'Escribe tu pregunta...'}
                placeholderTextColor="#64748B"
                value={chatInput}
                onChangeText={setChatInput}
                onSubmitEditing={() => handleConciergeAsk(chatInput)}
              />
              <Pressable style={styles.chatSendBtn} onPress={() => handleConciergeAsk(chatInput)}>
                <Text style={styles.btnCtaCyanText}>↑</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={Boolean(sheet)} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setSheet(null)}>
        <Pressable style={styles.modalOverlay} onPress={() => setSheet(null)}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <Text style={styles.heroTitleBright}>{sheet?.titleBright} <Text style={styles.heroTitleTitanium}>{sheet?.titleTitanium}</Text></Text>
            {sheet?.bullets.map((b, idx) => (
              <Text key={idx} style={{ color: '#CBD5E1', fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 20, marginTop: 10 }}>• {b}</Text>
            ))}
            <Pressable style={[styles.btnCtaCyan, { marginTop: 20 }]} onPress={() => setSheet(null)}>
              <Text style={styles.btnCtaCyanText}>{isEn ? 'Close' : 'Cerrar'}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

export default KineticWebLanding;

export const CABO_CLUBS_AND_BOUTIQUE: IKineticAffiliateCatalogItem[] = [

    // === src/constants/challengesCatalog.ts === //
import { ITrofeo } from '../types';

export type ChallengeDifficultyTier = 'facil' | 'intermedio' | 'avanzado' | 'pro' | 'leyenda';

export const CHALLENGE_DIFFICULTY_TIERS = [
  { key: 'facil', label: 'FÁCIL (50)' },
  { key: 'intermedio', label: 'INTERMEDIO (50)' },
  { key: 'avanzado', label: 'AVANZADO (50)' },
  { key: 'pro', label: 'PRO (50)' },
  { key: 'leyenda', label: 'LEYENDA (50)' },
];

export const SEASON_01_PRESTIGE_TIERS = [
  { level: 1, title: 'Iniciado del Radar', requiredXp: 250 },
  { level: 2, title: 'Atleta de Impacto', requiredXp: 750 },
  { level: 3, title: 'Vanguardia del Mes', requiredXp: 1400 },
  { level: 4, title: 'Élite del Corredor', requiredXp: 2000 },
  { level: 5, title: 'Leyenda Mensual', requiredXp: 2500 },
];

const build250Challenges = (): ITrofeo[] => {
  const tiers = [
    { key: 'facil', label: 'FÁCIL', xpBase: 20, sessionMult: 1 },
    { key: 'intermedio', label: 'INTERMEDIO', xpBase: 55, sessionMult: 3 },
    { key: 'avanzado', label: 'AVANZADO', xpBase: 115, sessionMult: 7 },
    { key: 'pro', label: 'PRO', xpBase: 220, sessionMult: 14 },
    { key: 'leyenda', label: 'LEYENDA', xpBase: 400, sessionMult: 25 },
  ] as const;

  const starterChallenges = [
    {
      titulo: 'Identidad Activa en Kinetic',
      desc: 'Activa tu cuenta y explora el directorio de marcas en la red.',
      req: 'Perfil Activo',
      meta: 1,
      tipo: 'habito_app',
      familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'user-check',
      xp: 20,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Primer Día de Racha en App',
      desc: 'Abre el panel de Racha Semanal y registra tu primer día de actividad.',

    },
    {
      titulo: 'Primer Check-in QR Activo',
      desc: 'Completa tu primera sesión validada con pase QR de acceso en recepción.',
      req: '1 Sesión QR',
      meta: 1,
      tipo: 'sesiones',
      familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'check-circle',
      xp: 30,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Explorador de Radar',
      desc: 'Visita tu primer club o especialista afiliado en la red.',
      req: '1 Sede Visitada',
      meta: 1,
      tipo: 'clubes_visitados',
      familia: 'clubes',
      icon: 'map-pin',
      xp: 35,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Espíritu de Equipo',
      desc: 'Únete o funda tu primer equipo en KinetiClub.',
      req: '1 Equipo Activo',
      meta: 1,
      tipo: 'equipo',
      familia: 'clubes',
      icon: 'users',
      xp: 15,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Constancia de 2 Días',
      desc: 'Mantén una racha activa de 2 días consecutivos.',
      req: 'Racha 2 Días',
      meta: 2,
      tipo: 'racha',
      familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'trending-up',
      xp: 20,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Doble Check-in QR',
      desc: 'Completa 2 entrenamientos validados con Pase QR.',
      req: '2 Sesiones QR',
      meta: 2,
      tipo: 'sesiones',
      familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'activity',
      xp: 35,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Dúo de Disciplinas',
      desc: 'Experimenta 2 disciplinas deportivas distintas en el ecosistema.',
      req: '2 Disciplinas',
      meta: 2,
      tipo: 'disciplinas',
      familia: 'experto',
      icon: 'compass',
      xp: 30,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Ruta de 2 Sedes',
      desc: 'Entrena en 2 clubes o estudios diferentes de la red.',
      req: '2 Sedes Distintas',
      meta: 2,
      tipo: 'clubes_visitados',
      familia: 'clubes',
      icon: 'navigation',
      xp: 35,
    },
    {
      titulo: 'Tríada de Inicio (3 Días)',
      desc: 'Mantén una racha de 3 días en la plataforma Kinetic.',
      req: 'Racha 3 Días',
      meta: 3,
      tipo: 'racha',
      familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'award',
      xp: 15,
    },
  ];

  const list: any[] = [];
  let globalNum = 0;
  const discList = [
    'CrossFit',
    'Pádel',
    'Boxeo',
    'Pilates',
    'Surf',
    'Fuerza',
    'Cold Plunge',
    'Yoga',
  ];

  tiers.forEach((tierCfg, tierIdx) => {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
      globalNum += 1;
      const id = `reto_${globalNum}`;

      if (tierCfg.key === 'facil' && i <= 10) {
        const st = starterChallenges[i - 1];
        list.push({
          id,
          orden: globalNum,
          division: tierCfg.key,
          divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} #${globalNum}`,
          titulo: st.titulo,
          desc: st.desc,
          requisitoCorto: st.req,
          meta: st.meta,
          tipo: st.tipo as any,
          familia: st.familia as any,
          icon: st.icon,
          recompensaXp: st.xp,
          recompensaKc: 0,
        });
        continue;
      }

      const mod = i % 4;
      if (mod === 1) {
        const metaSesiones = Math.max(
          2,
          Math.round((i * 0.5 + tierIdx * 8) * tierCfg.sessionMult * 0.35)
        );
        list.push({
          id,
          orden: globalNum,
          division: tierCfg.key,
          divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} • SESIONES`,
          titulo: `Potencia QR • Nivel ${globalNum}`,
          desc: `Completa ${metaSesiones} sesiones validadas con pase QR de acceso en la red.`,
          requisitoCorto: `${metaSesiones} Sesiones QR`,
          meta: metaSesiones,
          tipo: 'sesiones',
          familia: 'sesiones',
          icon: 'zap',
          recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + (i % 5) * 5,
          recompensaKc: 0,
        });
      } else if (mod === 2) {
        const metaRacha = Math.max(3, i + tierIdx * 10);
        list.push({
          id,
          orden: globalNum,
          division: tierCfg.key,
          divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} • RACHA`,
          titulo: `Racha de Hierro ${metaRacha}D`,
          desc: `Mantén tu escudo activo durante ${metaRacha} días consecutivos.`,
          requisitoCorto: `Racha ${metaRacha} Días`,
          meta: metaRacha,
          tipo: 'racha',
          familia: 'sesiones',
          icon: 'shield',
          recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 10,
          recompensaKc: 0,
        });
      } else if (mod === 3) {
        const metaClubes = Math.min(22, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(i / 6) + tierIdx * 3));
        list.push({
          id,
          orden: globalNum,
          division: tierCfg.key,
          divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} • CLUBES`,
          titulo: `Conquistador de Sedes #${globalNum}`,
          desc: `Reserva y entrena en ${metaClubes} sedes afiliadas distintas.`,
          requisitoCorto: `${metaClubes} Sedes Distintas`,
          meta: metaClubes,
          tipo: 'clubes_visitados',
          familia: 'clubes',
          icon: 'map-pin',
          recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 15,
          recompensaKc: 0,
        });
      } else {
        const dName = discList[i % discList.length];
        const metaDisc = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(i / 8) + tierIdx * 2);
        list.push({
          id,
          orden: globalNum,
          division: tierCfg.key,
          divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} • ${dName.toUpperCase()}`,
          titulo: `Especialista en ${dName} #${globalNum}`,
          desc: `Completa ${metaDisc} sesiones certificadas de ${dName} en clubes de la red.`,
          requisitoCorto: `${metaDisc} en ${dName}`,
          meta: metaDisc,
          tipo: 'disciplina_especifica',
          familia: 'experto',
          disciplinaClave: dName,
          icon: 'award',
          recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 20,
          recompensaKc: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  });

  return list as ITrofeo[];
};

export const KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES: ITrofeo[] = build250Challenges();

const stripAccentsLower = (val: string): string =>
  val
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim();

const NORMALIZED_AMENITY_LOOKUP: Map<string, string> = (() => {
  const m = new Map<string, string>();
  Object.entries(AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP).forEach(([es, en]) => {
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(es), en);
  });
  Object.entries(AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP).forEach(([id, entry]) => {
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(id), entry.titleEn);
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(id.replace(/_/g, ' ')), entry.titleEn);
  });
  return m;
})();

export const translateAmenityLabelEn = (raw?: string | null): string | null => {
  const clean = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  if (AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP[clean]) return AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP[clean];
  const hit = NORMALIZED_AMENITY_LOOKUP.get(stripAccentsLower(clean));
  if (hit) return hit;

  if (clean.includes(' / ')) {
    const parts = clean.split(' / ').map((p) => p.trim());
    const mapped = parts.map((p) => translateAmenityLabelEn(p));
    if (mapped.some(Boolean)) {
      return mapped.map((mVal, idx) => mVal || parts[idx]).join(' / ');
    }
  }
  if (/\s+y\s+/i.test(clean)) {
    const parts = clean.split(/\s+y\s+/i).map((p) => p.trim());
    const mapped = parts.map((p) => translateAmenityLabelEn(p));
    if (mapped.every(Boolean)) {
      return mapped.join(' & ');
    }
  }
  if (/[_-]/.test(clean)) {
    return clean
      .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, (ch) => ch.toUpperCase());
  }
  return null;
};

    // === src/context/AuthContext.tsx === //

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { router as globalRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Linking, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { CATEGORY_IMAGES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit, isExplicitKineticSignOut, isRealSupabaseJwt, markExplicitKineticSignOut,
  persistKineticSessionSnapshot, purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly, readPersistedKineticSessionSync,
  reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession, resetExplicitKineticSignOut, synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import {
  areProfilesEquivalent, areSessionsEquivalent, areUsersEquivalent, handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens,
} from '../services/kineticSessionReconciler';
import {
  doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, getMfaSecuritySnapshot, isPendingMfaGateActive, setPendingMfaGateActive,
} from '../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge, setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
} from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from '../services/kineticVaultCrypto';

interface AuthContextType {
  user: any | null;
  session: any | null;
  profile: any | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshProfile: () => Promise<void>;
  activateResilientSession: (nextUser: any, nextProfile: any, nextSession?: any) => void;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({
  user: null, session: null, profile: null, isLoading: true, loading: true,
  refreshProfile: async () => {}, activateResilientSession: () => {}, signOut: async () => {},
});

const COLD_START_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS = 2200;
const BG_AUTH_RACE_MS = 3500;

const withTimeout = <T,>(promise: PromiseLike<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> =>
  new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('KINETIC_BG_AUTH_TIMEOUT')), ms);
    Promise.resolve(promise).then((v) => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(v); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(t); reject(e); });
  });

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  // Hidratación síncrona 0ms en Web antes de cualquier evaluación de rutas o safetyTimer
  const [initialHydrated] = useState(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return null;
    const snap = readPersistedKineticSessionSync();
    return snap && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(snap.session) ? snap : null;
  });
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any | null>(() => initialHydrated?.user ?? null);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<any | null>(() => initialHydrated?.session ?? null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any | null>(() => initialHydrated?.profile ?? null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !Boolean(initialHydrated?.user));

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const hasHydratedInitialRef = useRef<boolean>(Boolean(initialHydrated?.user));
  const fetchingUserIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const fetchReqIdRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const signOutSeqRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const userRef = useRef<any | null>(initialHydrated?.user ?? null);
  const profileRef = useRef<any | null>(initialHydrated?.profile ?? null);
  const sessionRef = useRef<any | null>(initialHydrated?.session ?? null);

  const finishInitialHydration = useCallback(() => {
    hasHydratedInitialRef.current = true;
    setIsLoading((prev) => (prev ? false : prev));
  }, []);

  const commitUserIfChanged = useCallback((nextUser: any | null) => {
    userRef.current = nextUser;
    setUser((prev: any) => (areUsersEquivalent(prev, nextUser) ? prev : nextUser));
  }, []);

  const commitSessionIfChanged = useCallback((nextSession: any | null) => {
    sessionRef.current = nextSession;
    setSession((prev: any) => (areSessionsEquivalent(prev, nextSession) ? prev : nextSession));
  }, []);

  const commitProfileIfChanged = useCallback((nextProfile: any | null) => {
    profileRef.current = nextProfile;
    setProfile((prev: any) => (areProfilesEquivalent(prev, nextProfile) ? prev : nextProfile));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    userRef.current = user;
    profileRef.current = profile;
    sessionRef.current = session;
    if (user?.id && !isExplicitKineticSignOut() && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(session)) {
      const safeProf = !profile || !profile.id || String(profile.id) === String(user.id) ? profile : null;
      const safeSess = !session || !session.user?.id || String(session.user.id) === String(user.id) ? session : null;
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(user, safeProf, safeSess);
    }
  }, [user, profile, session]);

  const activateResilientSession = useCallback(
    (nextUser: any, nextProfile: any, nextSession?: any) => {
      if (!nextUser?.id || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(nextSession)) return;
      const sameOwnerSess = sessionRef.current && String(sessionRef.current.user?.id || '') === String(nextUser.id) && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionRef.current) ? sessionRef.current : null;
      const effectiveSession = nextSession || sameOwnerSess || (isKineticDevRuntime() ? { access_token: `kinetic-resilient-${nextUser.id}`, token_type: 'bearer', user: nextUser } : null);
      if (!isKineticDevRuntime() && !isRealSupabaseJwt(effectiveSession?.access_token)) return;
      resetExplicitKineticSignOut(); clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
      const sameOwnerProf = profileRef.current && String(profileRef.current.id || '') === String(nextUser.id) ? profileRef.current : null;
      const mergedProfile = synthesizeProfileFromUser(nextUser, nextProfile || sameOwnerProf);
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(nextUser, mergedProfile, effectiveSession);
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        commitSessionIfChanged(effectiveSession);
        commitUserIfChanged(nextUser);
        commitProfileIfChanged(mergedProfile);
        finishInitialHydration();
      }
    },
    [commitProfileIfChanged, commitSessionIfChanged, commitUserIfChanged, finishInitialHydration]
  );

  const fetchUserProfile = useCallback(async (currentUser: any) => {
    const targetUid = String(currentUser?.id || '');
    if (!targetUid || fetchingUserIdRef.current === targetUid) return;
    fetchingUserIdRef.current = targetUid;
    const reqId = ++fetchReqIdRef.current;
    const isStale = () =>
      !isMountedRef.current ||
      isExplicitKineticSignOut() ||
      reqId !== fetchReqIdRef.current ||
      !userRef.current?.id ||
      String(userRef.current.id) !== targetUid;
    const ownerSess = () => (sessionRef.current && String(sessionRef.current.user?.id || '') === targetUid && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionRef.current) ? sessionRef.current : null);
    const ownerProf = () => (profileRef.current && String(profileRef.current.id || '') === targetUid ? profileRef.current : null);

    try {
      const { data, error } = await withTimeout(
        supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle(),
        BG_AUTH_RACE_MS
      );

      if (isStale()) return;

      const meta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
      const isGoogleProvider =
        currentUser.app_metadata?.provider === 'google' ||
        (Array.isArray(currentUser.app_metadata?.providers) &&
          currentUser.app_metadata.providers.includes('google'));
      const googleRealName = String(meta.nombre || meta.full_name || meta.name || '').trim();
      const googleAvatar = meta.avatar_url || meta.picture || null;
      const hasGhostName = !data?.nombre || /^atleta\s*\d*$/i.test(String(data.nombre).trim());

      if (!error && data && !(isGoogleProvider && hasGhostName && googleRealName)) {
        const emailLower = String(currentUser.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const isMasterAdmin =
          Boolean(currentUser.email_confirmed_at) &&
          (emailLower === 'administrador@kinetic.com.mx' || emailLower === 'administrador@kinetic.com');
        let finalProfile = isMasterAdmin && data.rol !== 'admin' ? { ...data, rol: 'admin', nivel: data.nivel || 'Black' } : data;
        if (!data.avatar_url && googleAvatar) {
          supabase.from('perfiles').update({ avatar_url: googleAvatar }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(() => {}, () => {});
          finalProfile = { ...finalProfile, avatar_url: googleAvatar };
        }
        commitProfileIfChanged(finalProfile);
        persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, finalProfile, ownerSess());
        return;
      } else if (isGoogleProvider && currentUser.email) {
        const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
        const finalName = googleRealName || currentUser.email.split('@')[0] || 'Kinetic Athlete';
        if (data) {
          const nextAvatar = data.avatar_url || googleAvatar;
          await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ nombre: finalName, avatar_url: nextAvatar }).eq('id', currentUser.id);
          if (!isStale()) {
            const resolved = { ...data, nombre: finalName, avatar_url: nextAvatar };
            commitProfileIfChanged(resolved);
            persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, resolved, ownerSess());
          }
          return;
        }
        const googlePayload = {
          id: currentUser.id, nombre: finalName, email: currentUser.email.toLowerCase(), avatar_url: googleAvatar,
          rol: 'atleta', nivel: 'Acceso Base', kc_membresia: 0, kc_topup: 0, fecha_activacion_membresia: nowIso,
          perdones_mensuales_usados: 0, mes_perdones_control: nowIso.slice(0, 7), waiver_firmado: true, waiver_version: 'v2.5', waiver_fecha: nowIso,
        };
        const { data: upserted } = await supabase.from('perfiles').upsert(googlePayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true }).select('*').maybeSingle();
        if (!isStale()) {
          const resolved = upserted || googlePayload;
          commitProfileIfChanged(resolved);
          persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, resolved, ownerSess());
        }
        return;
      }

      if (error) {
        const persisted = readPersistedKineticSessionSync();
        const samePersistedProf = persisted && String(persisted.user?.id || '') === targetUid && String(persisted.profile?.id || targetUid) === targetUid ? persisted.profile : null;
        const fallbackProf = ownerProf() || samePersistedProf || synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null);
        if (!ownerProf()) commitProfileIfChanged(fallbackProf);
        persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, ownerProf() || fallbackProf, ownerSess());
        return;
      }

      const existingOwner = ownerProf();
      const baseProfilePayload = existingOwner
        ? synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, existingOwner)
        : { ...synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null), kc_membresia: 0, kc_topup: 0 };

      if (!data) {
        const { data: createdRow, error: createErr } = await withTimeout(
          supabase.from('perfiles').upsert(baseProfilePayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true }).select('*').maybeSingle(),
          BG_AUTH_RACE_MS
        );
        if (isStale()) return;
        if (!createErr && createdRow) {
          commitProfileIfChanged(createdRow);
          persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, createdRow, ownerSess());
          return;
        }
        const { data: minimalRow } = await withTimeout(
          supabase.from('perfiles').upsert(
            {
              id: currentUser.id, email: baseProfilePayload.email || null, nombre: baseProfilePayload.nombre,
              avatar_url: baseProfilePayload.avatar_url, telefono: baseProfilePayload.telefono,
              rol: baseProfilePayload.rol || 'atleta', nivel: baseProfilePayload.nivel || 'Acceso Base',
              kc_membresia: 0, kc_topup: 0, waiver_firmado: true,
            },
            { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true }
          ).select('*').maybeSingle(),
          BG_AUTH_RACE_MS
        );
        if (isStale()) return;
        const resolved = minimalRow || ownerProf() || baseProfilePayload;
        commitProfileIfChanged(resolved);
        persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, resolved, ownerSess());
        return;
      }

      if (!ownerProf()) commitProfileIfChanged(baseProfilePayload);
    } catch {
      if (!isStale() && currentUser?.id && !ownerProf()) {
        commitProfileIfChanged(synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null));
      }
    } finally {
      if (fetchingUserIdRef.current === targetUid) fetchingUserIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [commitProfileIfChanged]);

  const refreshProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;
    const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
    try {
      const targetUser = userRef.current;
      if (targetUser?.id) {
        await fetchUserProfile(targetUser);
        return;
      }
      const {
        data: { session: activeSession },
      } = await withTimeout(supabase.auth.getSession(), BG_AUTH_RACE_MS);
      if (
        !isMountedRef.current ||
        signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart ||
        isExplicitKineticSignOut() ||
        isPendingMfaGateActive() ||
        doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(activeSession)
      ) {
        return;
      }
      if (activeSession?.user?.id) {
        commitUserIfChanged(activeSession.user);
        await fetchUserProfile(activeSession.user);
      }
    } catch {
      // Silencioso: prohibido expulsar al usuario si falla el refresh
    }
  }, [commitUserIfChanged, fetchUserProfile]);

  // Cierre de sesión explícito, atómico e instantáneo (limpia refs y estado en 0ms antes de navegar a /login)
  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    markExplicitKineticSignOut();
    signOutSeqRef.current += 1;
    fetchReqIdRef.current += 1;
    fetchingUserIdRef.current = null;
    setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
    userRef.current = null;
    profileRef.current = null;
    sessionRef.current = null;
    if (isMountedRef.current) {
      setUser(null);
      setSession(null);
      setProfile(null);
    }
    try {
      globalRouter.replace('/login');
    } catch {
      // Silencioso si el navegador aún no está montado
    }
    void clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit();
    void supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;

    const safetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        finishInitialHydration();
      }
    }, COLD_START_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS);

    const verifyAndHydrateRealSession = async () => {
      if (isPendingMfaGateActive() || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
      const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
      try {
        const res = await reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession(supabase, BG_AUTH_RACE_MS);
        if (!isMountedRef.current || isPendingMfaGateActive() || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
        if (res.status === 'valid' && res.user?.id && !isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
          const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot();
          if (!isMountedRef.current || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
          const needsMfa = doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(res.session) || mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge;
          if (mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) {
            await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {}); await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
            commitSessionIfChanged(null); commitUserIfChanged(null); commitProfileIfChanged(null);
            return;
          }
          if (needsMfa) {
            const factorId = mfaSnap.verifiedFactors?.[0]?.id;
            commitSessionIfChanged(null); commitUserIfChanged(null); commitProfileIfChanged(null);
            await purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly().catch(() => {});
            if (factorId) {
              setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
              setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({ required: true, email: String(res.user.email || ''), factorId: String(factorId), reason: 'aal2_required' });
              globalRouter.replace('/login?mfa=1' as any);
            } else {
              await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {}); await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
            }
            return;
          }
          commitSessionIfChanged(res.session);
          commitUserIfChanged(res.user);
          await fetchUserProfile(res.user);
        } else if (res.status === 'cleared' || res.status === 'empty' || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
          commitSessionIfChanged(null);
          commitUserIfChanged(null);
          commitProfileIfChanged(null);
        }
      } catch {} finally {
        clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
        if (isMountedRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
      }
    };

    verifyAndHydrateRealSession();

    let lastFocusVerifyTs = 0;
    const handleWebFocusGuard = () => {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastFocusVerifyTs < 2500) return;
      lastFocusVerifyTs = now;
      if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;
      if (userRef.current?.id && isRealSupabaseJwt(sessionRef.current?.access_token)) {
        const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
        void reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession(supabase, BG_AUTH_RACE_MS)
          .then((res) => {
            if (!isMountedRef.current || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
            if (res.status === 'valid' && res.session && String(res.user?.id || '') === String(userRef.current?.id || '')) {
              sessionRef.current = res.session;
              commitSessionIfChanged(res.session);
              persistKineticSessionSnapshot(res.user, profileRef.current, res.session);
            } else if (res.status === 'cleared') {
              commitSessionIfChanged(null);
              commitUserIfChanged(null);
              commitProfileIfChanged(null);
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {});
        return;
      }
      void verifyAndHydrateRealSession();
    };
    const handleWebVisibilityGuard = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        handleWebFocusGuard();
      }
    };
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.addEventListener('focus', handleWebFocusGuard);
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWebVisibilityGuard);
    }

    const prefetchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const urls = Object.values(CATEGORY_IMAGES || {}).slice(0, 10);
        if (urls.length > 0) Image.prefetch(urls).catch(() => {});
      } catch {}
    }, 300);

    let urlSub: { remove: () => void } | null = null;
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
      Linking.getInitialURL().then((url) => handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens(supabase, url)).catch(() => {});
      urlSub = Linking.addEventListener('url', (ev) => { void handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens(supabase, ev.url); });
    }

    const { data: authListener } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(async (event, newSession) => {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
      const nextUser = newSession?.user ?? null;
      if (
        event === 'SIGNED_OUT' ||
        !nextUser ||
        !isRealSupabaseJwt(newSession?.access_token) ||
        (isExplicitKineticSignOut() && event !== 'SIGNED_IN')
      ) {
        if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || event === 'SIGNED_OUT') {
          setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
          commitSessionIfChanged(null);
          commitUserIfChanged(null);
          commitProfileIfChanged(null);
        }
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot();
      if (!isMountedRef.current || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || (isExplicitKineticSignOut() && event !== 'SIGNED_IN')) {
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      if ((mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) || isPendingMfaGateActive() || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession) || mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge) {
        commitSessionIfChanged(null); commitUserIfChanged(null); commitProfileIfChanged(null);
        if (mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {}); await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        } else if (mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession)) {
          await purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly().catch(() => {});
          if (!isPendingMfaGateActive() && mfaSnap.verifiedFactors?.[0]?.id) {
            setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
            setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({ required: true, email: String(nextUser.email || ''), factorId: String(mfaSnap.verifiedFactors[0].id), reason: 'aal2_required' });
            globalRouter.replace('/login?mfa=1' as any);
          }
        }
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
      const prevUserId = userRef.current?.id;
      const isAccountSwitch = Boolean(prevUserId && String(prevUserId) !== String(nextUser.id));
      if (isAccountSwitch) commitProfileIfChanged(null);
      commitSessionIfChanged(newSession);
      commitUserIfChanged(nextUser);
      if (event !== 'TOKEN_REFRESHED' || !profileRef.current || isAccountSwitch) {
        await fetchUserProfile(nextUser);
      }
      if (isMountedRef.current && !hasHydratedInitialRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
    });

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
      clearTimeout(prefetchTimer);
      urlSub?.remove();
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWebFocusGuard);
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWebVisibilityGuard);
      }
      authListener?.subscription?.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [commitProfileIfChanged, commitSessionIfChanged, commitUserIfChanged, fetchUserProfile, finishInitialHydration]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<AuthContextType>(
    () => ({
      user,
      session,
      profile,
      isLoading,
      loading: isLoading,
      refreshProfile,
      activateResilientSession,
      signOut,
    }),
    [user, session, profile, isLoading, refreshProfile, activateResilientSession, signOut]
  );

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Appearance, Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS,
  type KineticLanguage,
  type KineticResolvedTheme,
  type KineticThemeMode,
} from '../constants/kineticTranslations';
import {
  DARK_M3_TOKENS,
  LIGHT_M3_TOKENS,
  syncOmniSurfaceEngine,
  type KineticM3SurfaceTokens,
} from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import {
  formatActiveEventsCount,
  formatDistanceLabel,
  formatKineticDate,
  formatKineticDateTime,
  setActiveKineticLanguage,
  translateChallenge,
  translateDiscipline,
  translateDynamicContent,
  translateRarity,
} from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

export const KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_user_theme_pref';
export const KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_language_v25';

const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window === 'undefined' ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect;

// Persistencia silenciosa en segundo plano: nunca bloquea el hilo de UI durante el cambio de tema/idioma.
const persistPreferenceSilently = (key: string, value: string) => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.localStorage?.setItem(key, value);
      } catch {}
    }
    AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value).catch(() => {});
  }, 0);
};
