export interface KineticPreferencesContextValue {
  themeMode: KineticThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: KineticThemeMode) => void;
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  isPreferencesHydrated: boolean;
  language: KineticLanguage;
  setLanguage: (lang: KineticLanguage) => void;
  themeColors: KineticThemeColors;
  m3Tokens: KineticM3SurfaceTokens;
  t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => string;
  tx: (esText: string, enText: string) => string;
  td: (text?: string | null) => string;
  tDisc: (cat?: string | null) => string;
  tChallenge: <T extends Record<string, any>>(ch: T) => T;
  tRarity: (rarity?: string | null) => string;
  fmtDate: (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string;
  fmtDateTime: (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string;
  fmtDist: (km: number | string | null | undefined, fromYou?: boolean) => string;
  fmtEventsCount: (count: number) => string;
}

const KineticPreferencesContext = createContext<KineticPreferencesContextValue>({
  themeMode: 'dark',
  setThemeMode: () => {},
  resolvedTheme: 'dark',
  isLightMode: false,
  isPreferencesHydrated: true,
  language: 'es',
  setLanguage: () => {},
  themeColors: DARK_THEME_COLORS,
  m3Tokens: DARK_M3_TOKENS,
  t: (key, fallback) => fallback || KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS.es[key] || key,
  tx: (esText) => esText,
  td: (text) => String(text ?? ''),
  tDisc: (cat) => String(cat ?? ''),
  tChallenge: (ch) => ch,
  tRarity: (r) => String(r ?? ''),
  fmtDate: (iso, opts) => formatKineticDate(iso, 'es', opts),
  fmtDateTime: (iso, opts) => formatKineticDateTime(iso, 'es', opts),
  fmtDist: (km, fromYou) => formatDistanceLabel(km, 'es', fromYou),
  fmtEventsCount: (count) => formatActiveEventsCount(count, 'es'),
});

export const readInitialWebPreferencesSync = (): {
  themeMode: KineticThemeMode;
  language: KineticLanguage;
  deviceScheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
} => {
  const resolveDeviceScheme = (): KineticResolvedTheme => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.matchMedia === 'function') {
      return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark';
    }
    return Appearance?.getColorScheme?.() === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  };
  let themeMode: KineticThemeMode = 'dark';
  let language: KineticLanguage = 'es';
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const savedTheme = window.localStorage?.getItem(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (savedTheme === 'light' || savedTheme === 'dark' || savedTheme === 'system') {
        themeMode = savedTheme;
      }
      const savedLang = window.localStorage?.getItem(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (savedLang === 'es' || savedLang === 'en') {
        language = savedLang;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  const deviceScheme = resolveDeviceScheme();
  const resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme =
    themeMode === 'system' ? deviceScheme : themeMode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  return { themeMode, language, deviceScheme, resolvedTheme };
};

export const KineticPreferencesProvider = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  const [initialWebPrefs] = useState(readInitialWebPreferencesSync);
  const [themeMode, setThemeModeState] = useState<KineticThemeMode>(() => initialWebPrefs.themeMode);
  const [deviceScheme, setDeviceScheme] = useState<KineticResolvedTheme>(() => initialWebPrefs.deviceScheme);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<KineticLanguage>(() => {
    setActiveKineticLanguage(initialWebPrefs.language);
    return initialWebPrefs.language;
  });
  const [isPreferencesHydrated, setIsPreferencesHydrated] = useState<boolean>(() => Platform.OS === 'web');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
      const sub = Appearance?.addChangeListener?.(({ colorScheme }) => {
        setDeviceScheme(colorScheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
      });
      return () => sub?.remove?.();
    }
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)');
    const onChange = () => setDeviceScheme(mq.matches ? 'light' : 'dark');
    mq.addEventListener?.('change', onChange);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener?.('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => null),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => null),
    ])
      .then(([savedTheme, savedLang]) => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (savedTheme === 'light' || savedTheme === 'dark' || savedTheme === 'system') {
          setThemeModeState((prev) => (prev === savedTheme ? prev : savedTheme));
        } else {
          setThemeModeState('dark');
          persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY, 'dark');
        }
        if (savedLang === 'es' || savedLang === 'en') {
          setActiveKineticLanguage(savedLang);
          setLanguageState((prev) => (prev === savedLang ? prev : savedLang));
        } else {
          setActiveKineticLanguage('es');
          setLanguageState('es');
          persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, 'es');
        }
        setIsPreferencesHydrated(true);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setIsPreferencesHydrated(true);
      });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme =
    themeMode === 'system' ? deviceScheme : themeMode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';

  // Sincronía de superficie DOM/nativa DESPUÉS del commit y ANTES del pintado (sin frame intermedio con
  // atributos de tema adelantados al árbol React). Jamás remonta el árbol: solo propagación reactiva.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    setActiveKineticLanguage(language);
    syncOmniSurfaceEngine(resolvedTheme, language);
  }, [resolvedTheme, language]);

  const setThemeMode = useCallback((mode: KineticThemeMode) => {
    const nextMode: KineticThemeMode =
      mode === 'system' ? 'system' : mode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    setThemeModeState((prev) => (prev === nextMode ? prev : nextMode));
    persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
  }, []);

  const setLanguage = useCallback((lang: KineticLanguage) => {
    const nextLang: KineticLanguage = lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
    setActiveKineticLanguage(nextLang);
    setLanguageState((prev) => (prev === nextLang ? prev : nextLang));
    persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, nextLang);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: string, fallback?: string): string =>
      KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS[language]?.[key] ?? KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS.es[key] ?? fallback ?? key,
    [language]
  );

  const tx = useCallback((esText: string, enText: string): string => (language === 'en' ? enText : esText), [language]);
  const td = useCallback((text?: string | null): string => translateDynamicContent(text, language), [language]);
  const tDisc = useCallback((cat?: string | null): string => translateDiscipline(cat, language), [language]);
  const tChallenge = useCallback(<T extends Record<string, any>>(ch: T): T => translateChallenge(ch, language), [language]);
  const tRarity = useCallback((rarity?: string | null): string => translateRarity(rarity, language), [language]);
  const fmtDate = useCallback(
    (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
      formatKineticDate(isoOrDate, language, options),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtDateTime = useCallback(
    (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
      formatKineticDateTime(isoOrDate, language, options),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtDist = useCallback(
    (km: number | string | null | undefined, fromYou?: boolean) => formatDistanceLabel(km, language, fromYou),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtEventsCount = useCallback((count: number) => formatActiveEventsCount(count, language), [language]);

  const isLightMode = resolvedTheme === 'light';
  const themeColors = isLightMode ? LIGHT_THEME_COLORS : DARK_THEME_COLORS;
  const m3Tokens = isLightMode ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS : DARK_M3_TOKENS;

  const value = useMemo<KineticPreferencesContextValue>(
    () => ({
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      isLightMode,
      isPreferencesHydrated,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      m3Tokens,
      t,
      tx,
      td,
      tDisc,
      tChallenge,
      tRarity,
      fmtDate,
      fmtDateTime,
      fmtDist,
      fmtEventsCount,
    }),
    [
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      isLightMode,
      isPreferencesHydrated,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      m3Tokens,
      t,
      tx,
      td,
      tDisc,
      tChallenge,
      tRarity,
      fmtDate,
      fmtDateTime,
      fmtDist,
      fmtEventsCount,
    ]
  );

  return <KineticPreferencesContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</KineticPreferencesContext.Provider>;
};

export const useKineticPreferences = () => useContext(KineticPreferencesContext);

export const useKineticTheme = () => {
  const prefs = useKineticPreferences();
  return {
    theme: prefs.resolvedTheme,
    themeMode: prefs.themeMode,
    setThemeMode: prefs.setThemeMode,
    isLight: prefs.isLightMode,
    isLightMode: prefs.isLightMode,
    colors: prefs.themeColors,
    themeColors: prefs.themeColors,
    m3: prefs.m3Tokens,
    m3Tokens: prefs.m3Tokens,
  };
};

export const useKineticI18n = () => {
  const prefs = useKineticPreferences();
  return {
    language: prefs.language,
    setLanguage: prefs.setLanguage,
    t: prefs.t,
    tx: prefs.tx,
    td: prefs.td,
    tDisc: prefs.tDisc,
    tChallenge: prefs.tChallenge,
    tRarity: prefs.tRarity,
    fmtDate: prefs.fmtDate,
    fmtDateTime: prefs.fmtDateTime,
    fmtDist: prefs.fmtDist,
    fmtEventsCount: prefs.fmtEventsCount,
  };
};

export const ThemeContext = KineticPreferencesContext;
export const I18nContext = KineticPreferencesContext;

// Kinetic OS v2.5 — Hook Unificado de Checkout y Procesamiento Atómico Stripe
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { CheckoutItemPayload, stripeService } from '../services/stripeService';
import { getNativeStripeSdk } from '../services/nativeStripeBridge';
import { assertValidKcMultipleOfTen } from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from '../services/kineticVaultCrypto';

export type CheckoutStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'initializing'
  | 'processing'
  | 'succeeded'
  | 'canceled'
  | 'failed';

export interface CheckoutError {
  code:
    | 'CANCELED'
    | 'CARD_DECLINED'
    | 'NETWORK_ERROR'
    | 'INVALID_SESSION'
    | 'SERVER_ERROR';
  message: string;
}

export interface UseCheckoutOptions {
  onSuccess?: (item: CheckoutItemPayload, paymentId: string) => void;
  onError?: (error: CheckoutError) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

export function useCheckout(options: UseCheckoutOptions = {}) {
  const { user, refreshProfile } = useAuth();
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<CheckoutStatus>('idle');
  const [error, setError] = useState<CheckoutError | null>(null);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<CheckoutItemPayload | null>(null);
  const isExecutingRef = useRef(false);

  const resetCheckout = useCallback(() => {
    isExecutingRef.current = false;
    setStatus('idle');
    setError(null);
    setActiveItem(null);
  }, []);

  const startCheckout = useCallback(
    async (item: CheckoutItemPayload): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (isExecutingRef.current) return false;
      isExecutingRef.current = true;
      setError(null);
      setActiveItem(item);
      setStatus('initializing');
      triggerHaptic('Medium');

      try {
        const userId = item.userId || user?.id;
        if (!userId) {
          const err: CheckoutError = {
            code: 'INVALID_SESSION',
            message: tx(
              'Sesión no válida. Inicia sesión para continuar.',
              'Invalid session. Please log in to continue.'
            ),
          };
          setError(err);
          setStatus('failed');
          options.onError?.(err);
          return false;
        }

        if (Number(item?.kcOtorgados) > 0) {
          assertValidKcMultipleOfTen(Number(item.kcOtorgados), 'Checkout');
        }
        setStatus('processing');
        let confirmedPaymentId = `knt_pay_${Date.now()}`;

        // 1. Cobro real con Stripe Live (cero fallback de saldo en cliente si falla pasarela)
        if (stripeService.isLiveModeEnabled()) {
          if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
            const stripeSdk = getNativeStripeSdk();
            if (!stripeSdk?.initPaymentSheet || !stripeSdk?.presentPaymentSheet) {
              throw new Error(
                tx(
                  'El módulo nativo de pagos seguros Stripe no está disponible.',
                  'Native Stripe secure payments module is unavailable.'
                )
              );
            }

            const paymentIntentData = await stripeService.createPaymentIntent(item);
            const clientSecret =
              paymentIntentData?.clientSecret || paymentIntentData?.client_secret;
            if (!clientSecret) {
              throw new Error(
                tx(
                  'No se pudo inicializar la autorización bancaria con Stripe.',
                  'Could not initialize bank authorization with Stripe.'
                )
              );
            }

            const initRes = await stripeSdk.initPaymentSheet({
              paymentIntentClientSecret: clientSecret,
              merchantDisplayName: 'KineticApp S.A.S.',
              applePay: { merchantCountryCode: 'MX' },
              googlePay: { merchantCountryCode: 'MX', testEnv: false },
              style: 'alwaysDark',
            });

            if (initRes.error) {
              throw new Error(initRes.error.message);
            }

            const presentRes = await stripeSdk.presentPaymentSheet();
            if (presentRes.error) {
              if (
                presentRes.error.code === 'Canceled' ||
                presentRes.error.message?.toLowerCase().includes('cancel')
              ) {
                const cancelErr: CheckoutError = {
                  code: 'CANCELED',
                  message: tx('Operación cancelada por el usuario.', 'Operation canceled by user.'),
                };
                setError(cancelErr);
                setStatus('canceled');
                options.onCancel?.();
                return false;
              }

              const cardErr: CheckoutError = {
                code: 'CARD_DECLINED',
                message:
                  presentRes.error.message ||
                  tx('Tarjeta rechazada por el banco emisor.', 'Card declined by issuing bank.'),
              };
              setError(cardErr);
              setStatus('failed');
              triggerHaptic('Error');
              options.onError?.(cardErr);
              return false;
            }

            confirmedPaymentId = paymentIntentData?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
          } else {
            const paymentIntentData: any = await stripeService.createPaymentIntent(item);
            if (paymentIntentData?.status !== 'succeeded') {
              throw new Error(
                tx(
                  'La autorización de pago Web con Stripe no fue confirmada.',
                  'Stripe Web payment authorization was not confirmed.'
                )
              );
            }
            confirmedPaymentId = paymentIntentData?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
          }
        } else {
          // 2. Modo Pre-Stripe Sandbox en servidor o simulación local (__DEV__)
          if (!isKineticDevRuntime()) {
            const rawSlug = String(item.planId || item.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
            const sandboxSlug =
              item.tipo === 'topup' && !/^topup_\d+$/.test(rawSlug) && Number(item.kcOtorgados) > 0
                ? `topup_${Math.round(Number(item.kcOtorgados))}`
                : rawSlug;
            const { data: sandboxData, error: sandboxErr } = await supabase.rpc(
              'procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox',
              { p_plan_id: sandboxSlug, p_tipo: item.tipo }
            );
            if (sandboxErr) {
              const errMsg = String(sandboxErr.message || '');
              if (errMsg.includes('SANDBOX_DESHABILITADO')) {
                throw new Error(
                  tx('Pasarela Stripe Live requerida en producción.', 'Stripe Live gateway required in production.')
                );
              }
              throw new Error(
                errMsg || tx('No se pudo procesar el pago Pre-Stripe.', 'Could not process Pre-Stripe payment.')
              );
            }
            confirmedPaymentId = `sandbox_${String((sandboxData as any)?.plan_id || Date.now())}`;
          } else {
            const simIntent = await stripeService.createPaymentIntent(item);
            confirmedPaymentId = simIntent?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
            await stripeService.registrarTransaccionEnBoveda(
              { ...item, userId },
              confirmedPaymentId
            );
          }
        }

        await refreshProfile?.();
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        setStatus('succeeded');
        options.onSuccess?.(item, confirmedPaymentId);
        return true;
      } catch (err: any) {
        const errorObj: CheckoutError = {
          code: 'SERVER_ERROR',
          message:
            err?.message ||
            tx(
              'No se pudo completar el cobro. Intenta nuevamente.',
              'Payment could not be completed. Please try again.'
            ),
        };
        setError(errorObj);
        setStatus('failed');
        triggerHaptic('Error');
        options.onError?.(errorObj);
        return false;
      } finally {
        isExecutingRef.current = false;
      }
    },
    [user?.id, refreshProfile, options, tx]
  );

  return {
    status,
    isProcessing: status === 'initializing' || status === 'processing',
    isSuccess: status === 'succeeded',
    error,
    activeItem,
    startCheckout,
    resetCheckout,
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AppState, Keyboard, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { resolveRoleDestination } from '../services/kineticTabRoleGuard';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
} from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import {
  PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY,
  ensureFirstTimeProfile,
  isKineticDevRuntime,
  mapSupabaseAuthError,
} from '../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import { runWebGoogleGisSignIn } from '../services/kineticGoogleGisWebRunner';
import {
  KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK,
  beginNativeOidcFlow,
  buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl,
  clearPendingOidcChallenge,
  consumeCapturedNativeOidcUrl,
  endNativeOidcFlow,
  generateOidcNonceAndState,
  isNativeOidcFlowInFlight,
  persistPendingOidcChallenge,
  verifyAndExchangeNativeGoogleOidcUrl,
} from '../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import {
  isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl,
  scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation,
} from '../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';

try { WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession(); } catch {}
import {
  doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, getMfaSecuritySnapshot, setPendingMfaGateActive, verifyAndActivateTotpFactor,
} from '../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail, clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit, isEgressOrTransientAuthError, readEncryptedPersistedAccountSession, synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

const tr = (es: string, en: string) => (getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? en : es);

const SIGN_IN_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 9000;
const PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;
const MFA_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;

const raceWithAuthTimeout = <T,>(promise: PromiseLike<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> =>
  new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('KINETIC_AUTH_TIMEOUT')), ms);
    Promise.resolve(promise).then((v) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(v); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(e); });
  });

export { PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY, mapSupabaseAuthError };

const resolveAuthTarget = (user: any, profile: any, _mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b') =>
  resolveRoleDestination(user, profile);

export interface IPendingMfaChallenge {
  factorId: string; friendlyName: string; email: string; mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b'; user: any;
}

export function useKineticAuth(
  triggerHaptic?: (type: string) => void,
  showTacticalAlert?: (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void
) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const emailSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const lastSignInAttemptRef = useRef(0);
  const ssoSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const mfaBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const localGateRef = useRef(false);
  const pendingMfaActiveRef = useRef(false);
  const oauthPendingRef = useRef(false);
  const oauthPopupCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const unlockDebounceTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const [isEmailSigningIn, setIsEmailSigningIn] = useState(false);
  const [isTransitioningAfterLogin, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin] = useState(false);
  const [isSsoLoading, setIsSsoLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pendingMfaChallenge, setPendingMfaChallenge] = useState<IPendingMfaChallenge | null>(null);
  const [isVerifyingMfa, setIsVerifyingMfa] = useState(false);
  const [mfaErrorMsg, setMfaErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const setGate = useCallback((active: boolean) => {
    localGateRef.current = active;
    setPendingMfaGateActive(active);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    const syncGlobalMfa = async (st: ReturnType<typeof getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge>) => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || !st?.required || !st.factorId) return;
      const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser().catch(() => ({ data: { user: null } }));
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      const storedMode = ((await AsyncStorage.getItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => null)) === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c') as 'b2c' | 'b2b';
      pendingMfaActiveRef.current = true;
      setGate(true);
      setPendingMfaChallenge({
        factorId: st.factorId, friendlyName: 'Kinetic Authenticator',
        email: st.email || String(data?.user?.email || ''), mode: storedMode, user: data?.user || null,
      });
    };
    const gCur = getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
    if (gCur.required && gCur.factorId) void syncGlobalMfa(gCur);
    const unsubGlobalMfa = subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge((st) => { void syncGlobalMfa(st); });

    const unlockOAuth = (immediate = false) => {
      if (!oauthPendingRef.current || oauthPopupCleanupRef.current !== null || isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) return;
      if (unlockDebounceTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(unlockDebounceTimerRef.current);
      const finalizeUnlock = () => {
        unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = null;
        if (!oauthPendingRef.current || oauthPopupCleanupRef.current !== null || isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) return;
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        ssoSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setIsSsoLoading(false);
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        }
      };
      if (immediate) finalizeUnlock();
      else unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(finalizeUnlock, 450);
    };
    const appSub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (s) => { if (s === 'active') unlockOAuth(false); });
    const onWebPageShow = () => {
      if (mountedRef.current && !oauthPopupCleanupRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
      unlockOAuth(true);
    };
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.addEventListener('pageshow', onWebPageShow);
    }

    if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
      WebBrowser.warmUpAsync?.().catch(() => {});
    }

    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      if (unlockDebounceTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(unlockDebounceTimerRef.current);
        unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      oauthPopupCleanupRef.current?.();
      oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
      if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
        WebBrowser.coolDownAsync?.().catch(() => {});
      }
      unsubGlobalMfa(); appSub.remove();
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.removeEventListener('pageshow', onWebPageShow);
      }
      const hadPending = pendingMfaActiveRef.current;
      if (localGateRef.current || hadPending) {
        localGateRef.current = false; pendingMfaActiveRef.current = false; setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      }
      if (hadPending) {
        if (!getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required) {
          clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
          void supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
          void clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    };
  }, [setGate]);

  const evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed = useCallback(
    async (signedUser: any, sessionObj: any, emailLabel: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b'): Promise<'clear' | 'mfa_required'> => {
      const mfaSnap = await raceWithAuthTimeout(getMfaSecuritySnapshot(), MFA_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(() => null);
      const tokenRequiresMfa = doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionObj);
      if ((!mfaSnap || mfaSnap.checkFailed) && (tokenRequiresMfa || !isKineticDevRuntime())) {
        setGate(false); clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        throw new Error('MFA_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE');
      }
      const needsMfa = Boolean(mfaSnap?.requiresMfaChallenge || tokenRequiresMfa);
      if (!needsMfa) return 'clear';
      const verifiedFactor = mfaSnap?.verifiedFactors?.[0] || (Array.isArray(signedUser?.factors) ? signedUser.factors.find((f: any) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp')) : null);
      if (!verifiedFactor?.id) {
        setGate(false); clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        throw new Error('MFA_FACTOR_RESOLUTION_FAILED');
      }
      pendingMfaActiveRef.current = true;
      setGate(true);
      setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({ required: true, email: emailLabel, factorId: String(verifiedFactor.id), reason: 'aal2_required' });
      if (mountedRef.current) {
        setMfaErrorMsg(null);
        setPendingMfaChallenge({ factorId: String(verifiedFactor.id), friendlyName: String(verifiedFactor.friendly_name || 'Kinetic Authenticator'), email: emailLabel, mode, user: signedUser });
      }
      triggerHaptic?.('Selection');
      return 'mfa_required';
    },
    [setGate, triggerHaptic]
  );

  const handleSignIn = useCallback(
    async (emailRaw: string, passwordRaw: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean | 'mfa_required'> => {
      if (emailSubmittingRef.current) return false;
      const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
      const cleanPassword = String(passwordRaw || '').trim().slice(0, 128);
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanPassword) {
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        showTacticalAlert?.(tr('CAMPOS REQUERIDOS', 'REQUIRED FIELDS'), tr('Ingresa tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña para continuar.', 'Enter your email address and password to continue.'), 'error');
        return false;
      }
      const nowMs = Date.now();
      if (nowMs - lastSignInAttemptRef.current < 1500) return false;
      lastSignInAttemptRef.current = nowMs;
      Keyboard.dismiss();
      emailSubmittingRef.current = true;
      setIsEmailSigningIn(true);
      setGate(true);
      triggerHaptic?.('Light');
      try {
        const { data, error } = await raceWithAuthTimeout(
          supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: cleanEmail, password: cleanPassword }),
          SIGN_IN_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS
        );
        if (error) throw error;
        const signedUser = data?.user;
        if (!signedUser) throw new Error('KINETIC_AUTH_TIMEOUT');
        const isConfirmed = Boolean((signedUser as any).email_confirmed_at || (signedUser as any).confirmed_at || (signedUser as any).phone_confirmed_at);
        if (!isKineticDevRuntime() && !isConfirmed && !cleanEmail.endsWith('@phone.kineticapp.mx')) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
          throw new Error('Email not confirmed');
        }

        const mfaStatus = await evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed(signedUser, data?.session, cleanEmail, mode);
        if (mfaStatus === 'mfa_required') {
          if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
          return 'mfa_required';
        }

        setGate(false);
        let profileData: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
        try {
          profileData = await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(signedUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS);
        } catch {
          profileData = synthesizeProfileFromUser(signedUser, null, mode);
        }
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
        activateResilientSession(signedUser, profileData, data?.session ?? null);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(signedUser, profileData, mode));
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        setGate(false);
        if (isKineticDevRuntime() && isEgressOrTransientAuthError(err)) {
          const fallbackSession = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(cleanEmail, mode);
          if (fallbackSession && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(fallbackSession.session)) {
            if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
            activateResilientSession(fallbackSession.user, fallbackSession.profile, fallbackSession.session);
            triggerHaptic?.('Success');
            router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(fallbackSession.user, fallbackSession.profile, mode));
            return true;
          }
        }
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        showTacticalAlert?.(tr('ACCESO DENEGADO', 'ACCESS DENIED'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg), 'error');

      } finally {
        emailSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsEmailSigningIn(false);

    },
    [router, activateResilientSession, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed]
  );

  const verifyPendingMfaLogin = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!pendingMfaChallenge || mfaBusyRef.current) return false;

        const upgradedSession = await verifyAndActivateTotpFactor(pendingMfaChallenge.factorId, rawCode);

        const activeUser = upgradedSession.user || pendingMfaChallenge.user;

        try {
          profileData = await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(activeUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS);
        } catch {
          const cachedFallback = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(pendingMfaChallenge.email, pendingMfaChallenge.mode);
          profileData = synthesizeProfileFromUser(activeUser, cachedFallback?.profile || null, pendingMfaChallenge.mode);
        }
        const targetMode = pendingMfaChallenge.mode;
        AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setPendingMfaChallenge(null);
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
        }
        activateResilientSession(activeUser, profileData, upgradedSession);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(activeUser, profileData, targetMode));
        return true;
      } catch {
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
          setMfaErrorMsg(tr('Código 2FA inválido o expirado. Verifica los 6 dígitos en tu app autenticadora.', 'Invalid or expired 2FA code. Check the 6 digits in your authenticator app.'));
        }

      }
    },
    [pendingMfaChallenge, activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, setGate]

    if (mfaBusyRef.current) return;
    pendingMfaActiveRef.current = false; setGate(false); clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
    AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
    if (mountedRef.current) { setPendingMfaChallenge(null); setMfaErrorMsg(null); }

  }, [triggerHaptic, setGate]);

  const handleGoogleSignIn = useCallback(
    async (mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean> => {

      ssoSubmittingRef.current = true;

        const finishOAuthLogin = async (signedUser: any, activeSess: any) => {
          if (!mountedRef.current) return false;
          setGate(true);
          const mfaStatus = await evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed(signedUser, activeSess, String(signedUser.email || ''), mode);
          if (mfaStatus === 'mfa_required') return true;

          const profileData = await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(signedUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(() =>
            synthesizeProfileFromUser(signedUser)
          );
          if (!mountedRef.current) return false;
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
          activateResilientSession(signedUser, profileData, activeSess);

          router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(signedUser, profileData, mode));
          return true;
        };

        if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
          const webRes = await runWebGoogleGisSignIn(mode, {
            onBeforeTokenExchange: () => { if (mountedRef.current) setGate(true); },
            registerCleanup: (fn) => { oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = fn; },
          });
          oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
          scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
          if (webRes.status !== 'success' || !mountedRef.current) return false;
          return await finishOAuthLogin(webRes.user, webRes.session);

        const challenge = generateOidcNonceAndState('native', mode);
        await persistPendingOidcChallenge({ ...challenge, mode, createdAtMs: Date.now() });
        nativeFlowId = beginNativeOidcFlow();
        const bridgeUrl = buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl({ mode, nonceHash: challenge.nonceHash, state: challenge.state });
        const authSession = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(
          bridgeUrl,
          KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK,
          { showInRecents: false, createTask: false }
        );
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        const callbackUrl = authSession.type === 'success' && authSession.url ? authSession.url : consumeCapturedNativeOidcUrl();
        if (
          callbackUrl &&
          callbackUrl.startsWith(KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK) &&

          setGate(true);

        }
        return false;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (!pendingMfaActiveRef.current) setGate(false);
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          showTacticalAlert?.(tr('CONEXIÓN CON GOOGLE', 'GOOGLE SIGN-IN'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg), 'error');
        }
        return false;
      } finally {
        if (nativeFlowId !== undefined) endNativeOidcFlow(nativeFlowId);
        void clearPendingOidcChallenge();
        oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
        if (!pendingMfaActiveRef.current) {
          setGate(false);
          AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
        }
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        ssoSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsSsoLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [router, activateResilientSession, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed]
  );

  const handleGoogleInAppLogin = useCallback(
    async (emailGoogle: string, fullName?: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!isKineticDevRuntime()) return false;
      const cleanEmail = emailGoogle.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) return false;
      const fallbackSession = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(cleanEmail).catch(() => null);
      if (!fallbackSession?.user || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(fallbackSession?.session)) return false;
      if (fallbackSession.profile && fullName) fallbackSession.profile.nombre = fullName;
      if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
      activateResilientSession(fallbackSession.user, fallbackSession.profile, null);
      triggerHaptic?.('Success');
      router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(fallbackSession.user, fallbackSession.profile, mode));
      return true;
    },
    [activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic]
  );

  const handleBiometricSessionRestore = useCallback(
    async (emailRaw: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean> => {
      const cached = await readEncryptedPersistedAccountSession(emailRaw);
      if (!cached?.user?.id || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(cached.session)) return false;
      const accessTok = String((cached.session as any)?.access_token || '');
      const refreshTok = String((cached.session as any)?.refresh_token || '');
      if (!accessTok || !refreshTok || accessTok.startsWith('kinetic-')) return false;
      setGate(true);
      try {
        const { data: setRes, error: setErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({ access_token: accessTok, refresh_token: refreshTok });
        if (setErr || !setRes?.session || !setRes?.user) {
          setGate(false); await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {}); return false;
        }
        const mfaStatus = await evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed(setRes.user, setRes.session, String(setRes.user.email || emailRaw), mode);
        if (mfaStatus === 'mfa_required') return true;
        setGate(false);
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
        activateResilientSession(setRes.user, cached.profile, setRes.session);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(setRes.user, cached.profile, mode));
        return true;
      } catch {
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        if (!pendingMfaActiveRef.current) setGate(false);
        return false;
      }
    },
    [activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed]
  );

  return {
    isLoading: isEmailSigningIn || isSsoLoading || isTransitioningAfterLogin,
    isEmailSigningIn,
    isTransitioningAfterLogin,
    isSsoLoading,
    pendingMfaChallenge,
    isVerifyingMfa,
    mfaErrorMsg,
    verifyPendingMfaLogin,
    cancelPendingMfaLogin,
    handleSignIn,
    handleBiometricSessionRestore,
    handleGoogleSignIn,
    handleGoogleInAppLogin,
    mapSupabaseAuthError,
  };
}

    import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { AppState, Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  KINETIC_PERSISTED_SESSION_KEY,
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  persistKineticSessionSnapshot,
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut,
} from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import {
  extractJwtClaimsSafe,
  getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
} from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';

export { KINETIC_PERSISTED_SESSION_KEY };

const assertNoSecretInPublicEnv = (val) => {
  const v = String(val || '').trim();
  if (/^(sk_live_|sk_test_|rk_live_|rk_test_|whsec_)/i.test(v) || v.includes('"service_role"')) {
    throw new Error('FATAL_SECURITY_GUARD: Llave secreta detectada en variable EXPO_PUBLIC_*.');
  }
};

assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY);

// Inyección segura mediante variables de entorno nativas de Expo (Cero exposición de llaves en consola)
const supabaseUrl = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || '').trim();
const supabaseAnonKey = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || '').trim();

const mirrorAuthTokenToPersistedSession = (key, value) => {
  if (!key || typeof value !== 'string' || !/^sb-.*-auth-token$/.test(String(key))) return;
  try {
    if (getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
    const sessionObj = parsed?.currentSession || parsed;
    if (sessionObj?.user?.id) {
      const claims = extractJwtClaimsSafe(sessionObj?.access_token);
      const factors = Array.isArray(sessionObj?.user?.factors) ? sessionObj.user.factors : [];
      const hasVerifiedTotp = factors.some((f) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp'));
      if (hasVerifiedTotp && String(claims?.aal || 'aal1').toLowerCase() !== 'aal2') return;
      resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(sessionObj.user, null, sessionObj);
    }
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }
};

// Adaptador optimizado y seguro tanto para SSR, entornos Web puros y App Móvil (Zero-Logout on Update)
const customStorage = {
  getItem: async (key) => {
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
        try {
          return typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof localStorage.getItem === 'function'
            ? localStorage.getItem(key)
            : null;
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      }
      return await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },
  setItem: async (key, value) => {
    try {
      mirrorAuthTokenToPersistedSession(key, value);
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        try {
          if (
            typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof localStorage.setItem === 'function'
          ) {
            localStorage.setItem(key, value);
          }
        } catch {}
        return;
      }
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch {
      // Silencioso: jamás exponer payloads de sesión/JWT en logs de consola
    }
  },
  removeItem: async (key) => {
    try {
      // Blindaje Zero-Logout: no borrar tokens salvo signOut explícito o cancelación de reto MFA pendiente
      if (!isExplicitKineticSignOut() && !getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required && /^sb-.*-auth-token$/.test(String(key || ''))) {
        return;
      }
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        try {
          if (
            typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof localStorage.removeItem === 'function'
          ) {
            localStorage.removeItem(key);
          }
        } catch {}
        return;
      }
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch {
      // Silencioso
    }
  },
};

// Circuit Breaker Anti-Egress y Resiliencia ante HTTP 402 (Payment Required / Quota Exceeded)
let _isQuotaExceeded = false;
let _lastQuotaErrorTs = 0;
const QUOTA_COOLDOWN_MS = 60000;

export const isSupabaseQuotaExceeded = () => {
  if (_isQuotaExceeded && Date.now() - _lastQuotaErrorTs > QUOTA_COOLDOWN_MS) {
    _isQuotaExceeded = false;
  }
  return _isQuotaExceeded;
};

export const setSupabaseQuotaExceeded = (state = true) => {
  _isQuotaExceeded = Boolean(state);
  if (state) _lastQuotaErrorTs = Date.now();
};

export const isSupabaseQuotaOr402Error = (errOrRes) => {
  if (!errOrRes) return false;
  const status = Number(errOrRes?.status || errOrRes?.statusCode || 0);
  if (status === 402) return true;
  const code = String(errOrRes?.code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'PGRST_QUOTA_402' || code === '402') return true;
  const msg = String(errOrRes?.message || errOrRes?.details || errOrRes || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    msg.includes('payment required') ||
    msg.includes('quota exceeded') ||
    msg.includes('egress quota') ||
    msg.includes('exceeded the quota')
  );
};

// Fetch con timeout defensivo (10s) y Circuit Breaker ante HTTP 402 / throttling de Egress
const kineticResilientFetch = async (input, init) => {
  const method = String(init?.method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
  const isReadMethod = method === 'GET' || method === 'HEAD';

  if (isReadMethod && isSupabaseQuotaExceeded()) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        message: 'Payment Required: quota exceeded (circuit breaker active)',
        code: 'PGRST_QUOTA_402',
        details: null,
        hint: null,
      }),
      { status: 402, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    );
  }

  const canAbort = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' && !init?.signal;
  const controller = canAbort ? new AbortController() : null;
  const timeoutId = controller ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000) : null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(input, {
      ...(init || {}),
      ...(controller ? { signal: controller.signal } : {}),
    });
    if (res.status === 402 || isSupabaseQuotaOr402Error({ status: res.status, message: res.statusText })) {
      setSupabaseQuotaExceeded(true);
    }
    return res;
  } finally {
    if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
};

// Inicialización del cliente optimizada para alta concurrencia descentralizada
export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: customStorage,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    flowType: 'pkce',
    detectSessionInUrl: Platform.OS === 'web',
  },
  global: {
    fetch: kineticResilientFetch,
  },
});

// Sincronización de Token con el ciclo de vida nativo (Foreground / Background)
if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
  AppState.addEventListener('change', (state) => {
    if (state === 'active') {
      supabase.auth.startAutoRefresh();
    } else {
      supabase.auth.stopAutoRefresh();
    }
  });
}

    .trim()
    .replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, (ch) => ch.toUpperCase());

const normKey = (s?: string | null): string =>
  String(s || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

export function normalizeClubAmenityIds(rawList?: any): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rawList) || rawList.length === 0) {
    return KINETIC_AMENITIES.slice(0, 6).map((a) => a.id);
  }
  const resolved: string[] = [];
  rawList.forEach((raw) => {
    const clean = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (!clean || clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('__ig:')) return;
    const nk = normKey(clean);
    const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find(
      (a) =>
        a.id === clean ||
        normKey(a.id) === nk ||
        normKey(a.title) === nk ||
        normKey((a as any).titleEn) === nk ||
        (nk.includes('regadera') && a.id === 'regaderas') ||
        (nk.includes('locker') && a.id === 'regaderas') ||
        (nk.includes('estacionamiento') && a.id === 'estacionamiento') ||
        (nk.includes('wifi') && a.id === 'wifi') ||
        ((nk.includes('aire') || nk.includes('climatiza')) && a.id === 'aire_acondicionado') ||
        ((nk.includes('agua') || nk.includes('hidrat')) && a.id === 'hidratacion') ||
        (nk.includes('toalla') && a.id === 'toallas') ||
        ((nk.includes('ice') || nk.includes('recovery') || nk.includes('plunge')) && a.id === 'cold_plunge_recovery') ||
        ((nk.includes('shake') || nk.includes('protein') || nk.includes('smoothie')) && a.id === 'shake_bar') ||
        (nk.includes('valet') && a.id === 'valet_parking') ||
        (nk.includes('pet') && a.id === 'pet_friendly') ||
        ((nk.includes('infrared') || nk.includes('hot')) && a.id === 'hot_studio')
    );
    const finalId = preset ? preset.id : clean;
    if (!resolved.includes(finalId)) resolved.push(finalId);
  });
  return resolved.length > 0 ? resolved : KINETIC_AMENITIES.slice(0, 6).map((a) => a.id);
}

export function localizeSingleAmenity(rawAm: any, language: string): any {
  if (!rawAm) return rawAm;
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const nkId = normKey(rawAm.id);
  const nkTitle = normKey(rawAm.title);
  const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find((a) => a.id === rawAm.id || normKey(a.title) === nkTitle);
  if (preset) {
    return {
      ...preset,
      ...rawAm,
      icon: rawAm.icon && rawAm.icon !== 'check-circle' ? rawAm.icon : preset.icon,
      title: isEn ? ((preset as any).titleEn || rawAm.titleEn || preset.title) : preset.title,
      desc: isEn ? ((preset as any).descEn || rawAm.descEn || preset.desc) : preset.desc,
    };
  }
  const dictHit =
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkId] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkId.replace(/_/g, ' ')] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkTitle] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkTitle.replace(/_/g, ' ')];
  if (dictHit) {
    const resolvedTier = dictHit.tier || rawAm.tier || 'estandar';
    return {
      ...rawAm,
      icon: dictHit.icon || rawAm.icon || 'check-circle',
      tier: resolvedTier,
      color: resolvedTier === 'vip' ? '#9D4EDD' : rawAm.color || '#00F0FF',
      title: isEn
        ? dictHit.titleEn
        : dictHit.titleEs || formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.title || rawAm.id),
      desc: isEn
        ? dictHit.descEn
        : dictHit.descEs || rawAm.desc || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
    };
  }
  const cleanFallbackTitle = formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.title || rawAm.id);
  if (!isEn) {
    const hasUnderscoreOrRaw = /[_-]/.test(String(rawAm.title || '')) || String(rawAm.title || '') === String(rawAm.title || '').toLowerCase();
    return {
      ...rawAm,
      title: hasUnderscoreOrRaw ? cleanFallbackTitle : rawAm.title,
      desc: rawAm.desc || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
    };
  }
  const fallback = translateAmenity({ ...rawAm, title: cleanFallbackTitle }, 'en');
  return {
    ...fallback,
    title: formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.titleEn || fallback.title || translateDynamicContent(cleanFallbackTitle, 'en')),
    desc: rawAm.descEn || fallback.desc || 'Verified facility available at this Kinetic venue.',
  };
}

export function resolveLocalizedClubAmenities(selectedIds: string[], language: string): any[] {
  const normalized = normalizeClubAmenityIds(selectedIds);
  const items = normalized.map((idOrLabel) => {
    const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find((a) => a.id === idOrLabel);
    if (preset) return preset;
    const nk = normKey(idOrLabel);
    const dictHit = CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nk] || CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nk.replace(/_/g, ' ')];
    const tier = dictHit?.tier || 'estandar';
    return {
      id: idOrLabel,
      title: dictHit?.titleEs || formatAmenityTitleCase(idOrLabel),
      titleEn: dictHit?.titleEn || formatAmenityTitleCase(translateDynamicContent(formatAmenityTitleCase(idOrLabel), 'en')),
      desc: dictHit?.descEs || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
      descEn: dictHit?.descEn || 'Verified facility available at this Kinetic venue.',
      icon: dictHit?.icon || 'check-circle',
      tier,
      color: tier === 'vip' ? '#9D4EDD' : '#00F0FF',
    };
  });
  return items.map((am) => localizeSingleAmenity(am, language));
}

export function localizeClubSchedule(rawHorarios?: string | null, language: string = 'es'): string {
  const base = String(rawHorarios || '').trim().replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1');
  if (!base) {
    return language === 'en' ? 'Monday to Friday • 06:00 to 22:00' : 'Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 22:00';
  }
  const out = translateOperatingHours(base, language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es');
  if (language !== 'en') return out;
  return out
    .replace(/\bCerrado\b/gi, 'Closed')
    .replace(/\bAbierto 24\s*h(?:oras|rs)?\b/gi, 'Open 24h')
    .replace(/\bPrevia Cita\b/gi, 'By Appointment')
    .replace(/\bCita Previa\b/gi, 'By Appointment')
    .replace(/\bLun\b/gi, 'Mon')
    .replace(/\bMar\b/gi, 'Tue')
    .replace(/\bMi[ée]\b/gi, 'Wed')
    .replace(/\bJue\b/gi, 'Thu')
    .replace(/\bVie\b/gi, 'Fri')
    .replace(/\bS[áa]b\b/gi, 'Sat')
    .replace(/\bDom\b/gi, 'Sun');
}

export async function fetchRealClubReviewsFromSupabase(
  clubId?: string | null,
  clubName?: string | null
): Promise<IRealClubReview[]> {
  const cleanName = String(clubName || '').trim();
  const cleanId = String(clubId || '').trim();
  const out: IRealClubReview[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  try {
    if (cleanName) {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('reservas')
        .select('id, servicio_nombre, nombre_servicio, calificacion_estrellas, comentario_resena, created_at')
        .ilike('negocio_nombre', cleanName)
        .not('calificacion_estrellas', 'is', null)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(20);
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        data.forEach((r: any) => {
          const stars = Number(r?.calificacion_estrellas || 0);
          if (stars >= 1 && stars <= 5) {
            const rid = `res_${r.id}`;
            if (!seen.has(rid)) {
              seen.add(rid);
              out.push({
                id: rid,
                author: 'Atleta Verificado QR',
                stars,
                comment: String(r?.comentario_resena || '').trim(),
                serviceName: String(r?.nombre_servicio || r?.servicio_nombre || '').trim(),
                dateIso: r?.created_at ? String(r.created_at) : undefined,
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  if (UUID_RE.test(cleanId)) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('afiliados').select('comentarios').eq('id', cleanId).maybeSingle();
      if (Array.isArray(data?.comentarios)) {
        data.comentarios.forEach((c: any, idx: number) => {
          const stars = Number(c?.estrellas ?? c?.stars ?? c?.calificacion ?? 0);
          const txt = String(c?.comentario ?? c?.comment ?? c?.texto ?? '').trim();
          if (stars >= 1 && stars <= 5 && (txt.length > 0 || c?.id)) {
            const cid = `com_${c?.id || idx}`;
            if (!seen.has(cid)) {
              seen.add(cid);
              out.push({
                id: cid,
                author: String(c?.autor || c?.author || 'Atleta Verificado').trim(),
                stars,
                comment: txt,
                dateIso: c?.created_at || c?.fecha || undefined,
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return out;
}

import {
  KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES,
  cleanLocationDisplay,
  resolveCategoryImage,
  resolveDisciplineGalleryFallbacks,
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState,
} from '../constants/exploreData';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  persistClubAuditRatingToStorage,
  saveClubExtCache,
} from '../utils/clubLocalOverridesHelper';
import { setSyncClubMediaMemory } from '../utils/exploreEnrichmentHelpers';
import {
  emitKineticRadarUpdated,
  extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords,
} from '../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import {
  isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl,
  readMediaUriAsUint8Array,
  validateSafeStorageImagePayload,
} from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

export {
  fetchRealClubReviewsFromSupabase,
  localizeClubSchedule,
  localizeSingleAmenity,
  normalizeClubAmenityIds,
  resolveLocalizedClubAmenities,
} from './clubAmenitiesAndReviewsHelper';
export type { IRealClubReview } from './clubAmenitiesAndReviewsHelper';

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

const normKey = (s?: string | null): string =>
  String(s || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

const keepOnlyVerifiedHttps = (u?: unknown): string | null => {
  const s = String(u || '').trim();
  return isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(s) ? s : null;
};

export async function uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(uri?: string | null, clubKey = 'club', slot = 'img'): Promise<string | null> {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  if (isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(clean)) return clean;
  if (/^http:\/\//i.test(clean)) return null;
  try {
    const safeKey = normKey(clubKey).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').slice(0, 28) || 'club';
    const bytes = await readMediaUriAsUint8Array(clean);
    const check = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes, uriOrName: clean });
    if (!check.ok || !bytes) return null;
    const path = `clubs/${safeKey}_${slot}_${Date.now()}.${check.ext || 'jpg'}`;
    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('avatars')
      .upload(path, bytes, { contentType: check.contentType || 'image/jpeg', cacheControl: '604800', upsert: true });
    if (error) return null;
    const { data } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
    const pub = String(data?.publicUrl || '').trim();
    return isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(pub) ? pub : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate: any, targetName: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const rawId = String(affiliate?.id || '').trim();
  if (UUID_RE.test(rawId)) return rawId;
  const namesToTry = Array.from(
    new Set([String(affiliate?.nombre || '').trim(), String(targetName || '').trim()].filter(Boolean))
  );
  for (const nm of namesToTry) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('afiliados').select('id').ilike('nombre', nm).limit(1);
      if (Array.isArray(data) && data[0]?.id && UUID_RE.test(String(data[0].id))) {
        return String(data[0].id);
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

export async function persistClubSheetAsAdmin(affiliate: any, updatedFields: Record<string, any>): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
  const clubKey = String(affiliate?.id || updatedFields.nombre || affiliate?.nombre || 'club');
  const [resolvedAvatar, resolvedPortada] = await Promise.all([
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.avatar_url, clubKey, 'avatar'),
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.portada_url, clubKey, 'cover'),
  ]);
  const rawGal = Array.isArray(updatedFields.galeria) ? updatedFields.galeria.slice(0, 4) : [];
  const positionalGaleria = await Promise.all(
    [0, 1, 2, 3].map(async (idx) => {
      const g = String(rawGal[idx] || '').trim();
      if (!g || g.length <= 5) return '';
      return (await uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(g, clubKey, `gal${idx}`)) || '';
    })
  );
  const resolvedGaleria = positionalGaleria.some(Boolean) ? positionalGaleria : [];

  const finalFields: Record<string, any> = {
    ...updatedFields,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.avatar_url),
    portada_url: resolvedPortada ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.portada_url),
    galeria: resolvedGaleria,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const parsedGeo = extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords(String(finalFields.ubicacion || ''));
  const lat = parsedGeo.lat ?? affiliate?.latitud ?? affiliate?.latitude ?? null;
  const lng = parsedGeo.lng ?? affiliate?.longitud ?? affiliate?.longitude ?? null;
  if (typeof lat === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lat)) finalFields.latitud = lat;
  if (typeof lng === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lng)) finalFields.longitud = lng;

  const scores = Array.isArray(finalFields.audit_scores) ? finalFields.audit_scores : null;
  const ratingFallback = Number(finalFields.rating) > 0 ? Number(finalFields.rating) : null;
  const isSpec = Boolean(affiliate?.es_especialista);

  const tier1Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    categoria: affiliate?.categoria || (isSpec ? 'Especialista' : 'Club'),
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    horarios: finalFields.horarios,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    amenidades: finalFields.amenidades,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    galeria: finalFields.galeria,
  };
  if (typeof lat === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lat)) tier1Payload.latitud = lat;
  if (typeof lng === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lng)) tier1Payload.longitud = lng;
  if (scores && scores.length >= 4) {
    tier1Payload.rating_limpieza = scores[2] ?? scores[0] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_seguridad = scores[3] ?? scores[1] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_equipo = scores[1] ?? scores[2] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_atencion = scores[4] ?? scores[3] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_comunidad = scores[0] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
  } else if (ratingFallback) {
    tier1Payload.rating_limpieza = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_seguridad = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_equipo = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_atencion = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_comunidad = ratingFallback;
  }
  if (finalFields.audit_checklists) tier1Payload.audit_checklists = finalFields.audit_checklists;

  const tier2Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    horarios: finalFields.horarios,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    amenidades: finalFields.amenidades,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
  };

  const tier3Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
  };

  const existingUuid = await resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate, finalFields.nombre);
  if (existingUuid) {
    finalFields.id = existingUuid;
    const r1 = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier1Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
    if (r1.error) {
      const r2 = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier2Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      if (r2.error) await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier3Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
    }
  } else {
    const insPayload = { ...tier1Payload, estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo' };
    let createdId: string | null = null;
    const i1 = await supabase.from('afiliados').insert([insPayload]).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (!i1.error && i1.data?.id) {
      createdId = String(i1.data.id);
    } else {
      const i2 = await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .insert([{ ...tier2Payload, estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo' }])
        .select('id')
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!i2.error && i2.data?.id) createdId = String(i2.data.id);
      else {
        const i3 = await supabase.from('afiliados').insert([tier3Payload]).select('id').maybeSingle();
        if (!i3.error && i3.data?.id) createdId = String(i3.data.id);
      }
    }
    if (createdId) finalFields.id = createdId;
  }

  const finalIdKey = String(finalFields.id || clubKey);
  setSyncClubMediaMemory([finalIdKey, clubKey, affiliate?.id, affiliate?.nombre, finalFields.nombre], {
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    galeria: finalFields.galeria,
  });
  await saveClubExtCache(finalIdKey, finalFields, finalFields.nombre);
  if (clubKey !== finalIdKey) await saveClubExtCache(clubKey, finalFields, affiliate?.nombre);
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState({ ...affiliate, ...finalFields });

  const oldNameNorm = normKey(affiliate?.nombre);
  const newNameNorm = normKey(finalFields.nombre);
  (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).forEach((st: any) => {
    const stNorm = normKey(st?.nombre);
    if ((oldNameNorm && stNorm === oldNameNorm) || (newNameNorm && stNorm === newNameNorm)) {
      Object.assign(st, finalFields);
    }
  });

  const { exploreService } = await import('./exploreService');
  exploreService.clearRadarCache();
  emitKineticRadarUpdated();
  return finalFields;
}

export async function submitClubChangesForAdminReview(
  affiliate: any,
  updatedFields: Record<string, any>,
  user: any
): Promise<void> {
  const clubKey = String(affiliate?.id || affiliate?.nombre || 'club_b2b');
  const [resolvedAvatar, resolvedPortada] = await Promise.all([
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.avatar_url, clubKey, 'b2b_avatar'),
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.portada_url, clubKey, 'b2b_cover'),
  ]);
  const rawGal = Array.isArray(updatedFields.galeria) ? updatedFields.galeria.slice(0, 4) : [];
  const positionalGaleria = await Promise.all(
    [0, 1, 2, 3].map(async (idx) => {
      const g = String(rawGal[idx] || '').trim();
      if (!g || g.length <= 5) return '';
      return (await uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(g, clubKey, `b2b_gal${idx}`)) || '';
    })
  );
  const resolvedGaleria = positionalGaleria.some(Boolean) ? positionalGaleria : [];

  setSyncClubMediaMemory([clubKey, affiliate?.id, affiliate?.nombre, updatedFields.nombre], {
    portada_url: resolvedPortada ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.portada_url),
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.avatar_url),

  });

  const b2bDiffPayload = {

    horarios: updatedFields.horarios,

    descripcion: updatedFields.descripcion,
    amenidades: updatedFields.amenidades,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.avatar_url),

    galeria: resolvedGaleria,

  const summaryLabel = `Socio B2B • Solicitud Edición Ficha (${updatedFields.disciplina || 'Club'} • ${updatedFields.horarios || 'Horario actualizado'})`;
  const emailVal = String(user?.email || affiliate?.email_contacto || '').trim();
  const phoneVal = String(updatedFields.whatsapp || affiliate?.whatsapp || '').trim();
  const venueName = String(updatedFields.nombre || affiliate?.nombre || 'Sede B2B').trim();
  const zoneVal = String(updatedFields.ubicacion || affiliate?.ubicacion || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.').trim();
  const discVal = String(updatedFields.disciplina || affiliate?.disciplina || 'Fuerza').trim();

  const w1 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
    {
      nombre: venueName,
      email: emailVal,
      whatsapp: phoneVal,
      perfil_interes: summaryLabel,
      zona: zoneVal,
      disciplina_favorita: discVal,
      origen: 'App B2B • Moderación Ficha',
      estado: 'pendiente',
      cambios_pendientes_b2b: b2bDiffPayload,
    },
  ]);

  if (w1.error) {
    const w2 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
      {
        nombre: venueName,
        email: emailVal,
        whatsapp: phoneVal,
        perfil_interes: summaryLabel,
        zona: zoneVal,
        disciplina_favorita: discVal,
        origen: 'App B2B • Moderación Ficha',
        estado: 'pendiente',
      },
    ]);
    if (w2.error) {
      await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
        {
          nombre: venueName,
          email: emailVal,
          telefono: phoneVal,
          tipo_perfil: summaryLabel,
          ciudad_zona: zoneVal,
          disciplina_interes: discVal,
          origen: 'App B2B • Moderación Ficha',
        },
      ]);
    }
  }

  const existingUuid = await resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate, affiliate?.nombre || venueName);
  if (existingUuid) {
    await supabase
      .from('afiliados')
      .update({ cambios_pendientes_b2b: b2bDiffPayload })
      .eq('id', existingUuid)
      .then(() => {}, () => {});
  }
}

export async function persistClubAuditAndChecklists(
  affiliate: any,
  clubId: string,
  clubName: string,
  cleanRating: number,
  cleanScores: number[] | null,
  checklists: Record<string, boolean> | null,
  isAdminUser: boolean
): Promise<void> {
  await persistClubAuditRatingToStorage(affiliate, clubId, clubName, cleanRating, cleanScores);
  if (checklists) {
    await saveClubExtCache(clubId, { audit_checklists: checklists }, clubName);
  }
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState({
    ...affiliate,
    rating: cleanRating,
    calificacion: cleanRating,
    audit_scores: cleanScores,
    audit_checklists: checklists || affiliate?.audit_checklists || null,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  if (isAdminUser) {
    const existingUuid = await resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate, clubName);
    const fiveRubrosPayload: Record<string, any> =
      cleanScores && cleanScores.length >= 4
        ? {
            rating_limpieza: cleanScores[2] ?? cleanScores[0] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_seguridad: cleanScores[3] ?? cleanScores[1] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_equipo: cleanScores[1] ?? cleanScores[2] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_atencion: cleanScores[4] ?? cleanScores[3] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_comunidad: cleanScores[0] ?? cleanRating,
          }
        : {
            rating_limpieza: cleanRating,
            rating_seguridad: cleanRating,
            rating_equipo: cleanRating,
            rating_atencion: cleanRating,
            rating_comunidad: cleanRating,
          };
    const fullAuditPayload: Record<string, any> = {
      ...fiveRubrosPayload,
      ...(checklists ? { audit_checklists: checklists } : {}),
    };

    if (existingUuid) {
      affiliate.id = existingUuid;
      const { error } = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(fullAuditPayload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      if (error) {
        await supabase.from('afiliados').update(fiveRubrosPayload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      }
    } else if (clubName) {
      const ins = await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .insert([
          {
            nombre: clubName,
            disciplina: affiliate?.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
            ubicacion: affiliate?.ubicacion || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.',
            ...fiveRubrosPayload,
            estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo',
          },
        ])
        .select('id')
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!ins.error && ins.data?.id) affiliate.id = String(ins.data.id);
    }
    const { exploreService } = await import('./exploreService');
    exploreService.clearRadarCache();
    emitKineticRadarUpdated();
  }
}

export async function crearNuevoAfiliadoDesdeModal(editData: any, selectedAmenityIds: string[] = []): Promise<any> {
  const { crearNuevoAfiliado } = await import('./adminService');
  return crearNuevoAfiliado({
    ...editData,
    nombre: String(editData?.nombre || '').trim(),
    amenidades: selectedAmenityIds,
    activo: editData?.activo ?? true,
  });
}

const ADMIN_EMAILS = ['administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com'];

export function resolveClubOwnerPermissions(hasValidJwt: boolean, user: any, profile: any, activeClub: any) {
  if (!hasValidJwt) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: false };
  const email = String(user?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const rol = String(profile?.rol || profile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const isAdmin = ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(email) || rol === 'admin' || rol === 'fundador';
  if (isAdmin) return { isAdmin: true, isOwnerOfThisClub: true };
  if (!user?.id || !activeClub) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: false };
  if (activeClub.propietario_id && String(activeClub.propietario_id) === String(user.id)) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: true };
  const myName = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cName = String(activeClub.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: Boolean(myName && cName && myName === cName) };
}

export function resolveClubCarouselMedia(disciplina: string, nombreSede: string, activeClub: any, editData: any) {
  const clubFallbackUri = resolveCategoryImage(disciplina, activeClub?.categoria || nombreSede);
  const discFallbacks = resolveDisciplineGalleryFallbacks(disciplina, activeClub?.categoria || nombreSede);
  const rawCover = editData?.portada_url || activeClub?.portada_url;
  const coverImageUri = rawCover && String(rawCover).trim().length > 5 ? rawCover : clubFallbackUri;
  const rawGal = Array.isArray(editData?.galeria) ? editData.galeria : Array.isArray(activeClub?.galeria) ? activeClub.galeria : [];
  const galSlots = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((idx) => {
    const u = String(rawGal[idx] || '').trim();
    return u.length > 5 && !u.startsWith('data:image/nonexistent') ? u : discFallbacks[idx] || clubFallbackUri;
  });
  const l = String(nombreSede).trim().toLowerCase();
  const isOfficialKineticBrand = l === 'kinetic oficial' || l === 'kinetic sports club';
  const rawAv = editData?.avatar_url || activeClub?.avatar_url;
  const logoSquareUri = rawAv && String(rawAv).trim().length > 5 ? rawAv : isOfficialKineticBrand ? null : coverImageUri;
  return { clubFallbackUri, allCarouselImages: [coverImageUri, ...galSlots], logoSquareUri };
}

export function buildClubSharePayload(p: { nombreSede: string; disciplina: string; ubicacion?: string; rating: number; language: string; discLoc: string }) {
  const isEn = p.language === 'en';
  const cleanLoc = cleanLocationDisplay(p.ubicacion, isEn ? 'Verified Location' : 'Ubicación Verificada');
  const url = `https://kineticapp.com.mx/?sede=${encodeURIComponent(String(p.nombreSede).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-'))}`;
  const title = isEn ? `${p.nombreSede} on Kinetic` : `${p.nombreSede} en Kinetic`;
  const webText = isEn
    ? `⚡ Train at ${p.nombreSede} (${p.discLoc} • ★ ${p.rating.toFixed(1)}) via Kinetic.\n📍 ${cleanLoc}`
    : `⚡ Entrena en ${p.nombreSede} (${p.discLoc} • ★ ${p.rating.toFixed(1)}) vía Kinetic.\n📍 ${cleanLoc}`;
  return { title, url, webText, message: `${webText}\n📲 ${url}` };
}

import { normalizeOrbitalYawDeg } from './kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';
import {
  type IProjectedPolygon,
  type IRawPolyFace,
  type IVec3,
  projectPerspectivePoint,
  rotX,
  rotY,
  shadeAndSortFaces,
} from './kinetic3DManifoldMeshBuilder';

export interface IChaliceManifoldParams {
  yawDeg: number;
  pitchDeg: number;
  tierMain: string;
  tierBevel: string;
  tierDark: string;
  tierWing: string;
  unlocked: boolean;
  size?: number;
}

export interface IChaliceManifoldResult {
  polys: IProjectedPolygon[];
  frontScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  backScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  pedestalRingRx: number;
  pedestalRingRy: number;
}

const PEDESTAL_LATHE: [number, number][] = [
  [44, 0], [44, 24.8], [39.5, 24.8], [36, 18.8], [32, 18.8], [29, 14], [25, 14], [25, 0],
];

const CHALICE_LATHE: { y: number; r: number; inner?: boolean }[] = [
  { y: 25.2, r: 0 }, { y: 25.2, r: 8.4 }, { y: 20, r: 5.4 }, { y: 15, r: 7.9 }, { y: 10.5, r: 4.9 },
  { y: 6.5, r: 7.3 }, { y: 1.5, r: 15 }, { y: -7.5, r: 21.4 }, { y: -17, r: 23.6 }, { y: -22.2, r: 24.8 },
  { y: -24.4, r: 24.8 }, { y: -24.4, r: 21.6, inner: true }, { y: -21.8, r: 19.6, inner: true },
  { y: -12, r: 16.8, inner: true }, { y: -3, r: 10.0, inner: true }, { y: -0.4, r: 0, inner: true },
];

export function buildVolumetricChaliceManifold(params: IChaliceManifoldParams): IChaliceManifoldResult {
  const yawRad = (normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(params.yawDeg) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const safePitch = Math.max(-28, Math.min(18, Number.isFinite(params.pitchDeg) ? params.pitchDeg : -13));
  const pitchRad = (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180;
  const camF = 248;
  const cx = 60;
  const cy = 62;
  const xf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => rotX(rotY(v, yawRad), pitchRad);

  const rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[] = [];
  const pushLathe = (prof: { y: number; r: number; inner?: boolean }[], segs: number, phaseOffset: number, isPedestal: boolean) => {
    const rings: IVec3[][] = prof.map((pt) =>
      Array.from({ length: segs }, (_, i) => {
        const phi = phaseOffset + (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
        return xf({ x: pt.r * Math.cos(phi), y: pt.y, z: pt.r * Math.sin(phi) });
      })
    );
    for (let k = 0; k < prof.length - 1; k++) {
      const r0 = prof[k].r, r1 = prof[k + 1].r;
      const isInner = Boolean(prof[k].inner || prof[k + 1].inner);
      const baseHex = isPedestal ? params.tierDark : params.tierMain;
      const specWeight = isInner ? 0.14 : params.unlocked ? 0.62 : 0.22;
      const ambientMin = isInner ? 0.08 : 0.22;
      for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
        const ni = (i + 1) % segs;
        if (r0 === 0 && r1 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k + 1][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
        else if (r1 === 0 && r0 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
        else if (r0 > 0 || r1 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k][ni], rings[k + 1][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
      }
    }
  };

  pushLathe(PEDESTAL_LATHE.map(([y, r]) => ({ y, r })), 8, Math.PI / 8, true);
  pushLathe(CHALICE_LATHE, 22, 0, false);

  const spine = [
    { x: 18.5, y: -17 }, { x: 30.5, y: -18 }, { x: 36.5, y: -10.5 }, { x: 32.5, y: -1.5 }, { x: 23.5, y: 3.5 }, { x: 13.5, y: 3 },
  ];
  [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
    const tubeRings: IVec3[][] = spine.map((pt, idx) => {
      const next = spine[Math.min(spine.length - 1, idx + 1)];
      const prev = spine[Math.max(0, idx - 1)];
      const tx = (next.x - prev.x) * side, ty = next.y - prev.y;
      const tLen = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
      const nx = -ty / tLen, ny = tx / tLen;
      const rad = idx === 2 ? 2.6 : 2.1;
      return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, j) => {
        const ang = (j / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        return xf({ x: pt.x * side + nx * Math.cos(ang) * rad, y: pt.y + ny * Math.cos(ang) * rad, z: Math.sin(ang) * rad });
      });
    });
    for (let k = 0; k < tubeRings.length - 1; k++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
        const nj = (j + 1) % 6;
        const pts = side > 0
          ? [tubeRings[k][j], tubeRings[k][nj], tubeRings[k + 1][nj], tubeRings[k + 1][j]]
          : [tubeRings[k][nj], tubeRings[k][j], tubeRings[k + 1][j], tubeRings[k + 1][nj]];
        rawFaces.push({ pts, baseHex: params.tierWing, specWeight: params.unlocked ? 0.58 : 0.2 });
      }
    }
  });

  const polys = shadeAndSortFaces(rawFaces, camF, cx, cy, params.tierBevel, params.tierDark, 1.08, 1.2);
  const f3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -9, z: 22.8 });
  const b3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -9, z: -22.8 });
  const fP = projectPerspectivePoint(f3, camF, cx, cy);
  const bP = projectPerspectivePoint(b3, camF, cx, cy);
  const pitchCos = Math.max(0.28, Math.abs(Math.sin(pitchRad)) + 0.32);
  return {
    polys,
    frontScreen: { x: fP.x, y: fP.y, z: f3.z },
    backScreen: { x: bP.x, y: bP.y, z: b3.z },
    pedestalRingRx: 33.5,
    pedestalRingRy: Number((10.5 * pitchCos).toFixed(1)),
  };
}
