import { CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG, normalizeOrbitalYawDeg } from './kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';

export interface IVec3 {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}

export interface IProjectedPolygon {
  points: string;
  fill: string;
  stroke: string;
  zSort: number;
  tag?: 'tympanum' | 'hull' | 'emblem';
}

export interface IProjectedSegment {
  x1: number;
  y1: number;
  x2: number;
  y2: number;
  zSort: number;
  width: number;
}

export interface IChestManifoldParams {
  yawDeg: number;
  pitchDeg: number;
  hingeAngleDeg: number;
  chargeStep: number;
  rarityStep: number;
  isOpened: boolean;
  trimMain: string;
  trimBevel: string;
  trimDark: string;
  coreGlow: string;
  keyLightBoost?: number;
  rimLightBoost?: number;
}

export interface IChestManifoldResult {
  polys: IProjectedPolygon[];
  cracks3D: IProjectedSegment[];
  coreCenterScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  ejectedEmblemPos: { x: number; y: number; rotDeg: number; scale: number; visible: boolean };
  hingeAngleDeg: number;
  closedLateralTympanumFaces: number;
}

export {
  buildVolumetricChaliceManifold,
  type IChaliceManifoldParams,
  type IChaliceManifoldResult,
} from './kinetic3DChaliceMeshBuilder';

export type RevealBeatPhase = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

export interface I5BeatRevealState {
  beat: RevealBeatPhase;
  pedestalGlow01: number;
  rimBoost: number;
  keyLightBoost: number;
  targetHingeDeg: number;
  ejectProgress01: number;
  turntableHoldActive: boolean;
}

export interface IRawPolyFace {
  pts: IVec3[];
  baseHex: string;
  specWeight: number;
  emissive?: boolean;
  ambientMin?: number;
  strokeHex?: string;
  tag?: 'tympanum' | 'hull' | 'emblem';
}

const clamp01 = (v: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0));

const parseHex = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  const clean = String(hex || '#00F0FF').replace('#', '');
  const full = clean.length === 3 ? clean.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('') : clean.padEnd(6, '0');
  return [parseInt(full.slice(0, 2), 16) || 0, parseInt(full.slice(2, 4), 16) || 0, parseInt(full.slice(4, 6), 16) || 0];
};

const mixHex = (a: string, b: string, tRaw: number): string => {
  const t = clamp01(tRaw);
  const [r1, g1, b1] = parseHex(a);
  const [r2, g2, b2] = parseHex(b);
  return `#${Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export const rotX = (v: IVec3, rad: number): IVec3 => {
  const c = Math.cos(rad);
  const s = Math.sin(rad);
  return { x: v.x, y: v.y * c - v.z * s, z: v.y * s + v.z * c };
};

export const rotY = (v: IVec3, rad: number): IVec3 => {
  const c = Math.cos(rad);
  const s = Math.sin(rad);
  return { x: v.x * c + v.z * s, y: v.y, z: -v.x * s + v.z * c };
};

const sub3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): IVec3 => ({ x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y, z: a.z - b.z });
const dot3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): number => a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
const cross3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): IVec3 => ({
  x: a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
  y: a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
  z: a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x,
});
const norm3 = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => {
  const l = Math.hypot(v.x, v.y, v.z);
  return l > 1e-6 ? { x: v.x / l, y: v.y / l, z: v.z / l } : { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 };
};

function addClosedBox(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  x0: number,
  x1: number,
  y0: number,
  y1: number,
  z0: number,
  z1: number,
  baseHex: string,
  specWeight: number,
  xf?: (v: IVec3) => IVec3,
  ambientMin?: number
): void {
  const fn = xf || ((v: IVec3) => v);
  const v000 = fn({ x: x0, y: y0, z: z0 }), v100 = fn({ x: x1, y: y0, z: z0 });
  const v110 = fn({ x: x1, y: y1, z: z0 }), v010 = fn({ x: x0, y: y1, z: z0 });
  const v001 = fn({ x: x0, y: y0, z: z1 }), v101 = fn({ x: x1, y: y0, z: z1 });
  const v111 = fn({ x: x1, y: y1, z: z1 }), v011 = fn({ x: x0, y: y1, z: z1 });
  faces.push({ pts: [v001, v101, v111, v011], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
  faces.push({ pts: [v100, v000, v010, v110], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
  faces.push({ pts: [v101, v100, v110, v111], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
  faces.push({ pts: [v000, v001, v011, v010], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
  faces.push({ pts: [v000, v100, v101, v001], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
  faces.push({ pts: [v011, v111, v110, v010], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
}

export function projectPerspectivePoint(v: IVec3, camF: number, cx: number, cy: number): { x: number; y: number; s: number } {
  const denom = Math.max(45, camF - v.z);
  const s = camF / denom;
  return { x: cx + v.x * s, y: cy + v.y * s, s };
}

export function shadeAndSortFaces(
  rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[],
  camF: number,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  bevelHex: string,
  darkFloorHex: string,
  keyBoost = 1,
  rimBoost = 1
): IProjectedPolygon[] {
  const keyDir = norm3({ x: -0.44, y: -0.72, z: 0.68 });
  const fillDir = norm3({ x: 0.65, y: 0.15, z: 0.55 });
  const halfVec = norm3({ x: keyDir.x, y: keyDir.y, z: keyDir.z + 1 });
  const out: IProjectedPolygon[] = [];

  for (const face of rawFaces) {
    if (!face.pts || face.pts.length < 3) continue;
    const rawCross = cross3(sub3(face.pts[1], face.pts[0]), sub3(face.pts[2], face.pts[0]));
    const crossLen = Math.hypot(rawCross.x, rawCross.y, rawCross.z);
    if (crossLen < 1e-4) continue;
    const normal = { x: rawCross.x / crossLen, y: rawCross.y / crossLen, z: rawCross.z / crossLen };

    const centroid = face.pts.reduce(
      (acc, pt) => ({ x: acc.x + pt.x, y: acc.y + pt.y, z: acc.z + pt.z }),
      { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }
    );
    const nPts = face.pts.length;
    centroid.x /= nPts;
    centroid.y /= nPts;
    centroid.z /= nPts;

    const toCamera = norm3({ x: -centroid.x, y: -centroid.y, z: camF - centroid.z });
    if (dot3(normal, toCamera) <= -0.02) continue;

    const ptsProj = face.pts.map((pt) => projectPerspectivePoint(pt, camF, cx, cy));
    if (ptsProj.some((p) => !Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.y))) continue;
    const points = ptsProj.map((p) => `${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');

    const keyDiff = Math.max(0, dot3(normal, keyDir)) * keyBoost;
    const fillDiff = Math.max(0, dot3(normal, fillDir)) * 0.24;
    const spec = Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot3(normal, halfVec)), 22) * face.specWeight * keyBoost;
    const rim = Math.pow(1 - Math.max(0, dot3(normal, toCamera)), 2.4) * 0.34 * rimBoost;
    const lum = clamp01((face.ambientMin ?? 0.2) + keyDiff * 0.52 + fillDiff + spec * 0.45 + rim);

    let fill = face.baseHex;
    if (!face.emissive) {
      fill = lum < 0.5 ? mixHex(darkFloorHex, face.baseHex, lum / 0.5) : mixHex(face.baseHex, bevelHex, (lum - 0.5) * 0.92);
    }
    const zSort = centroid.z + normal.z * 1.15;
    out.push({ points, fill, stroke: face.strokeHex || fill, zSort, ...(face.tag ? { tag: face.tag } : {}) });
  }

  out.sort((a, b) => a.zSort - b.zSort);
  return out;
}

export function compute5BeatRevealStage(progress01: number, isOpened: boolean): I5BeatRevealState {
  const p = clamp01(progress01);
  if (!isOpened) {
    return {
      beat: 1,
      pedestalGlow01: clamp01(0.35 + p * 0.65),
      rimBoost: 1,
      keyLightBoost: 1,
      targetHingeDeg: 0,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: true,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.18) {
    return {
      beat: 1,
      pedestalGlow01: clamp01(p / 0.18),
      rimBoost: 0.9,
      keyLightBoost: 0.9,
      targetHingeDeg: 0,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.36) {
    const local = (p - 0.18) / 0.18;
    return {
      beat: 2,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1 + local * 0.75,
      keyLightBoost: 0.95,
      targetHingeDeg: local * 8,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.58) {
    const local = (p - 0.36) / 0.22;
    return {
      beat: 3,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1.55 - local * 0.2,
      keyLightBoost: 1.1 + local * 0.55,
      targetHingeDeg: 8 + local * 38,
      ejectProgress01: local * 0.15,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.82) {
    const local = (p - 0.58) / 0.24;
    return {
      beat: 4,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1.35,
      keyLightBoost: 1.45,
      targetHingeDeg: 46 + local * (CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG - 46),
      ejectProgress01: clamp01(0.15 + local * 0.85),
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    beat: 5,
    pedestalGlow01: 0.9,
    rimBoost: 1.15,
    keyLightBoost: 1.15,
    targetHingeDeg: CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG,
    ejectProgress01: 1,
    turntableHoldActive: true,
  };
}

export function buildArticulatedChestManifold(params: IChestManifoldParams): IChestManifoldResult {
  const safeYaw = normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(params.yawDeg);
  const safePitch = Math.max(-34, Math.min(12, Number.isFinite(params.pitchDeg) ? params.pitchDeg : -18));
  const yawRad = (safeYaw * Math.PI) / 180;
  const pitchRad = (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180;
  const safeHinge = Math.max(0, Math.min(CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG, Number.isFinite(params.hingeAngleDeg) ? params.hingeAngleDeg : 0));
  const lidRad = (safeHinge * Math.PI) / 180;
  const camF = 316;
  const cx = 128;
  const cy = 114;

  const worldXf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => rotX(rotY(v, yawRad), pitchRad);
  const lidHingeXf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => {
    const shifted = { x: v.x, y: v.y + 8, z: v.z + 35 };
    const pitched = rotX(shifted, lidRad);
    return { x: pitched.x, y: pitched.y - 8, z: pitched.z - 35 };
  };

  const hullDark = '#0F1B33';
  const hullMid = '#1D335B';
  const innerDark = '#090E1B';
  const cavityFloorHex = params.isOpened ? '#F59E0B' : '#121927';
  const rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[] = [];

  // Base cerrada watertight (wallThickness = 8): 4 muros externos+internos + piso exterior/interior + labio superior
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -54, 54, 34, 42, -38, 38, params.trimDark, 0.55);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, 14, 35, -35, 35, hullDark, 0.35);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, -8, 15, 27, 35, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, -8, 15, -35, -27, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, -43, -8, 15, -27, 27, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, 43, 51, -8, 15, -27, 27, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -43, 43, 12.2, 14.5, -27, 27, cavityFloorHex, params.isOpened ? 0.85 : 0.2, undefined, params.isOpened ? 0.58 : 0.14);

  // Cinchos perimetrales extruidos + asas laterales en relieve
  [-29, 29].forEach((bx) => {
    addClosedBox(rawFaces, bx - 6, bx + 6, -8.4, 36.2, 33.2, 37.6, params.trimMain, 0.78);
    addClosedBox(rawFaces, bx - 6, bx + 6, -8.4, 36.2, -37.6, -33.2, params.trimMain, 0.78);
  });
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, 50.6, 54.4, -2, 24, -18, 18, params.trimDark, 0.52);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -54.4, -50.6, -2, 24, -18, 18, params.trimDark, 0.52);

  // Escudo de cerradura 3D + Emblema de Rayo Kinetic extruido en geometria 3D real (z=45..47.4)
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -13, 13, -10, 18, 35, 42, '#0A101E', 0.52);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -10.5, 10.5, -7.5, 15.5, 41.6, 44.8, params.trimMain, 0.86);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -5.5, 5.5, -3.5, 11.5, 44.5, 46.2, params.trimDark, 0.7);
  const boltUpper: IVec3[] = [
    { x: 1.6, y: -2.2, z: 47.0 },
    { x: 4.0, y: -2.2, z: 47.0 },
    { x: -0.2, y: 4.0, z: 47.0 },
    { x: -3.2, y: 4.0, z: 47.0 },
  ];
  const boltLower: IVec3[] = [
    { x: 0.0, y: 3.4, z: 47.0 },
    { x: 3.4, y: 3.4, z: 47.0 },
    { x: -1.4, y: 10.4, z: 47.0 },
    { x: -1.0, y: 4.4, z: 47.0 },
  ];
  const boltHex = params.isOpened || params.chargeStep >= 1 ? '#FFFBEB' : params.trimBevel;
  rawFaces.push({ pts: boltUpper, baseHex: boltHex, specWeight: 1, emissive: true });
  rawFaces.push({ pts: boltLower, baseHex: boltHex, specWeight: 1, emissive: true });

  // Tapa abovedada cerrada con arco exterior, arco concavo interior y timpanos laterales cerrados
  const archSteps = 14;
  const outerArch: { z: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const innerArch: { z: number; y: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= archSteps; i++) {
    const theta = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / archSteps) * Math.PI;
    outerArch.push({ z: 36 * Math.sin(theta), y: -8 - 32.5 * Math.cos(theta) });
    innerArch.push({ z: 29 * Math.sin(theta), y: -8 - 25.5 * Math.cos(theta) });
  }
  const xL = -52.5;
  const xR = 52.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < archSteps; i++) {
    const o0 = outerArch[i], o1 = outerArch[i + 1];
    const in0 = innerArch[i], in1 = innerArch[i + 1];
    rawFaces.push({
      pts: [
        lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o0.y, z: o0.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: o0.y, z: o0.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: o1.y, z: o1.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o1.y, z: o1.z }),
      ],
      baseHex: i === 0 || i === archSteps - 1 ? params.trimDark : hullMid,
      specWeight: 0.58,
    });
    rawFaces.push({
      pts: [
        lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: in0.y, z: in0.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: in0.y, z: in0.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: in1.y, z: in1.z }),
        lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: in1.y, z: in1.z }),
      ],
      baseHex: innerDark,
      specWeight: 0.2,
      ambientMin: 0.14,
    });
  }
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, xL, xR, -12.8, -8, 29, 36.2, params.trimDark, 0.72, lidHingeXf);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, xL, xR, -12.8, -8, -36.2, -29, params.trimDark, 0.72, lidHingeXf);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, xL, -45.8, -12.8, -8, -29, 29, params.trimDark, 0.72, lidHingeXf);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, 45.8, xR, -12.8, -8, -29, 29, params.trimDark, 0.72, lidHingeXf);

  // Timpanos laterales cerrados solidos (fan semicircular desde {y:-8,z:0}, cero huecos en 0..360)
  let closedLateralTympanumFaces = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < archSteps; i++) {
    const o0 = outerArch[i], o1 = outerArch[i + 1];
    const in0 = innerArch[i], in1 = innerArch[i + 1];
    rawFaces.push(
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: o1.y, z: o1.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: xR, y: o0.y, z: o0.z })], baseHex: params.trimDark, specWeight: 0.48, tag: 'tympanum' },
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o0.y, z: o0.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o1.y, z: o1.z })], baseHex: params.trimDark, specWeight: 0.48, tag: 'tympanum' },
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: in0.y, z: in0.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: in1.y, z: in1.z })], baseHex: innerDark, specWeight: 0.22, ambientMin: 0.16, tag: 'tympanum' },
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: in1.y, z: in1.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: in0.y, z: in0.z })], baseHex: innerDark, specWeight: 0.22, ambientMin: 0.16, tag: 'tympanum' }
    );
    closedLateralTympanumFaces += 4;
  }

  [-29, 29].forEach((bx) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < archSteps; i++) {
      const p0 = outerArch[i], p1 = outerArch[i + 1];
      rawFaces.push({
        pts: [
          lidHingeXf({ x: bx - 6, y: p0.y - 1.5, z: p0.z * 1.03 }),
          lidHingeXf({ x: bx + 6, y: p0.y - 1.5, z: p0.z * 1.03 }),
          lidHingeXf({ x: bx + 6, y: p1.y - 1.5, z: p1.z * 1.03 }),
          lidHingeXf({ x: bx - 6, y: p1.y - 1.5, z: p1.z * 1.03 }),
        ],
        baseHex: params.trimMain,
        specWeight: 0.86,
      });
    }
  });

  const worldFaces = rawFaces.map((f) => ({ ...f, pts: f.pts.map(worldXf) }));
  const polys = shadeAndSortFaces(
    worldFaces,
    camF,
    cx,
    cy,
    params.trimBevel,
    '#04070F',
    params.keyLightBoost ?? 1,
    params.rimLightBoost ?? 1
  );

  // Grietas de sobrecarga proyectadas en 3D real sobre caras frontales del cofre
  const cracks3D: IProjectedSegment[] = [];
  if (!params.isOpened && params.chargeStep >= 1) {
    const segs3D: [IVec3, IVec3][] = [
      [{ x: -34, y: -4, z: 35.6 }, { x: -16, y: 4, z: 35.6 }],
      [{ x: -16, y: 4, z: 35.6 }, { x: -8, y: -1, z: 35.6 }],
      ...(params.chargeStep >= 2
        ? [
            [{ x: 14, y: 2, z: 35.6 }, { x: 32, y: 10, z: 35.6 }] as [IVec3, IVec3],
            [{ x: -20, y: 12, z: 35.6 }, { x: -4, y: 22, z: 35.6 }] as [IVec3, IVec3],
          ]
        : []),
      ...(params.chargeStep >= 3
        ? [
            [{ x: 18, y: -22, z: 32.5 }, { x: 38, y: -12, z: 35.2 }] as [IVec3, IVec3],
            [{ x: -42, y: -16, z: 33.8 }, { x: -18, y: -26, z: 29.8 }] as [IVec3, IVec3],
          ]
        : []),
    ];
    for (const [a0, b0] of segs3D) {
      const a = worldXf(a0), b = worldXf(b0);
      if (a.z < -8 && b.z < -8) continue;
      const pA = projectPerspectivePoint(a, camF, cx, cy);
      const pB = projectPerspectivePoint(b, camF, cx, cy);
      cracks3D.push({ x1: pA.x, y1: pA.y, x2: pB.x, y2: pB.y, zSort: (a.z + b.z) * 0.5, width: params.rarityStep >= 3 ? 2.5 : 1.9 });
    }
  }

  const core3D = worldXf({ x: 0, y: 4, z: 0 });
  const coreScreen = projectPerspectivePoint(core3D, camF, cx, cy);
  const openRatio = clamp01(safeHinge / CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG);
  const ejectOrigin = worldXf({ x: 0, y: 10 - openRatio * 54, z: 0 });
  const ejectP = projectPerspectivePoint(ejectOrigin, camF, cx, cy);

  return {
    polys,
    cracks3D,
    coreCenterScreen: { x: coreScreen.x, y: coreScreen.y, z: core3D.z },
    ejectedEmblemPos: {
      x: ejectP.x,
      y: ejectP.y,
      rotDeg: Number(((1 - openRatio) * -140 + (safeYaw % 40) * 0.2).toFixed(1)),
      scale: Number((0.45 + openRatio * 0.55).toFixed(3)),
      visible: params.isOpened && openRatio > 0.25,
    },
    hingeAngleDeg: safeHinge,
    closedLateralTympanumFaces,
  };
}

    // === src/services/kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics.ts === //

export interface IOrbitalSample {
  dx: number;
  dy: number;
  t: number;
}

export interface IOrbitalTurntableState {
  yawDeg: number;
  pitchDeg: number;
  omegaYaw: number;
  omegaPitch: number;
}

export interface IOrbitalStepOptions {
  turntableHold?: boolean;
  turntableSpeedDegPerSec?: number;
  restPitchDeg?: number;
  minPitchDeg?: number;
  maxPitchDeg?: number;
  dampYawPerSec?: number;
  dampPitchPerSec?: number;
  pitchReturnStiffness?: number;
}

export interface IHingeSpringState {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDeg: number;
}

export interface IHopSquashInput {
  hopHeightPx: number;
  velY: number;
  squashY: number;
  squashVel: number;
}

export interface IHopSquashResult extends IHopSquashInput {
  scaleX: number;
  scaleY: number;
  scaleZ: number;
  shadowScale: number;
  shadowOpacity: number;
  didImpactFloor: boolean;
}

export interface IDeepZParallaxInput {
  tiltX: number;
  tiltY: number;
  maxOffsetPx?: number;
}

export interface IDeepZParallaxResult {
  bgShiftX: number;
  bgShiftY: number;
  midShiftX: number;
  midShiftY: number;
  fgShiftX: number;
  fgShiftY: number;
  specularShiftPct: number;
}

export const TURNTABLE_HOLD_DEG_PER_SEC = 14;
export const CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG = 108;

const finiteOr = (val: unknown, fallback: number): number => {
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
};

const clampNum = (val: number, min: number, max: number): number =>
  Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Number.isFinite(val) ? val : min));

export function normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(rawYawDeg: number): number {
  const clean = finiteOr(rawYawDeg, 0);
  const mod = ((clean % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return mod === 360 ? 0 : mod;
}

export function clampPhysicsDtMs(rawDtMs: number): number {
  const clean = finiteOr(rawDtMs, 16);
  return clampNum(clean, 4, 64);
}

export function computeSlidingWindowOrbitalVelocity(
  samples: ReadonlyArray<IOrbitalSample>,
  nowMs: number,
  windowMs = 70
): { omegaYaw: number; omegaPitch: number } {
  const safeNow = finiteOr(nowMs, 0);
  const safeWin = Math.max(16, Math.min(250, finiteOr(windowMs, 70)));
  const recent = (Array.isArray(samples) ? samples : []).filter(
    (s) => s && Number.isFinite(s.t) && Number.isFinite(s.dx) && Number.isFinite(s.dy) && s.t >= safeNow - safeWin && s.t <= safeNow + 8
  );
  if (recent.length < 2) return { omegaYaw: 0, omegaPitch: 0 };
  const first = recent[0];
  const last = recent[recent.length - 1];
  const dtSec = Math.max(0.012, (last.t - first.t) / 1000);
  const omegaYaw = clampNum(((last.dx - first.dx) * 0.92) / dtSec, -2400, 2400);
  const omegaPitch = clampNum(((last.dy - first.dy) * 0.28) / dtSec, -720, 720);
  return { omegaYaw, omegaPitch };
}

export function stepOrbitalTurntablePhysics(
  state: IOrbitalTurntableState,
  dtMs: number,
  opts?: IOrbitalStepOptions
): IOrbitalTurntableState {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const minPitch = finiteOr(opts?.minPitchDeg, -34);
  const maxPitch = finiteOr(opts?.maxPitchDeg, 12);
  const restPitch = clampNum(finiteOr(opts?.restPitchDeg, -18), minPitch, maxPitch);
  const dampYaw = Math.max(0.1, finiteOr(opts?.dampYawPerSec, 3.1));
  const dampPitch = Math.max(0.2, finiteOr(opts?.dampPitchPerSec, 6.2));
  const returnK = Math.max(0, finiteOr(opts?.pitchReturnStiffness, 12));
  const turntableHold = opts?.turntableHold !== false;
  const targetHoldSpeed = finiteOr(opts?.turntableSpeedDegPerSec, TURNTABLE_HOLD_DEG_PER_SEC);

  let omegaYaw = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaYaw, 0), -2600, 2600);
  let omegaPitch = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaPitch, 0), -900, 900);
  let yawDeg = finiteOr(state?.yawDeg, 332);
  let pitchDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.pitchDeg, restPitch), minPitch, maxPitch);

  omegaYaw *= Math.exp(-dampYaw * dt);
  if (turntableHold && Math.abs(omegaYaw) < 18) {
    const blend = Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    const desiredSign = omegaYaw < -2 ? -1 : 1;
    const targetVel = desiredSign * Math.abs(targetHoldSpeed);
    omegaYaw = omegaYaw + (targetVel - omegaYaw) * blend;
  } else if (!turntableHold && Math.abs(omegaYaw) < 1.5) {
    omegaYaw = 0;
  }

  const pitchAccel = (restPitch - pitchDeg) * returnK;
  omegaPitch = (omegaPitch + pitchAccel * dt) * Math.exp(-dampPitch * dt);
  if (Math.abs(omegaPitch) < 0.25 && Math.abs(restPitch - pitchDeg) < 0.08) {
    omegaPitch = 0;
    pitchDeg = restPitch;
  } else {
    pitchDeg = clampNum(pitchDeg + omegaPitch * dt, minPitch, maxPitch);
    if (pitchDeg === minPitch || pitchDeg === maxPitch) omegaPitch *= -0.35;
  }

  yawDeg = normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(yawDeg + omegaYaw * dt);
  return { yawDeg, pitchDeg, omegaYaw, omegaPitch };
}

export function stepArticulatedHingeSpring(
  state: IHingeSpringState,
  targetDeg: number,
  dtMs: number
): IHingeSpringState {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const safeTarget = clampNum(finiteOr(targetDeg, 0), 0, CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG);
  let angleDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.angleDeg, 0), 0, CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG);
  let omegaDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaDeg, 0), -1800, 1800);

  const subSteps = 2;
  const subDt = dt / subSteps;
  const stiffness = 190;
  const damping = 14.5;

  for (let i = 0; i < subSteps; i++) {
    const force = (safeTarget - angleDeg) * stiffness - omegaDeg * damping;
    omegaDeg = clampNum(omegaDeg + force * subDt, -1800, 1800);
    angleDeg += omegaDeg * subDt;
    if (angleDeg < 0) {
      angleDeg = 0;
      if (omegaDeg < 0) omegaDeg = 0;
    } else if (angleDeg > CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG) {
      angleDeg = CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG;
      if (omegaDeg > 0) omegaDeg = 0;
    }
  }

  if (Math.abs(safeTarget - angleDeg) < 0.05 && Math.abs(omegaDeg) < 0.4) {
    angleDeg = safeTarget;
    omegaDeg = 0;
  }
  return { angleDeg, omegaDeg };
}

export function computeVolumePreservingScale(squashYInput: number): {
  scaleX: number;
  scaleY: number;
  scaleZ: number;
} {
  const scaleY = clampNum(finiteOr(squashYInput, 1), 0.82, 1.18);
  const invSqrt = 1 / Math.sqrt(scaleY);
  return { scaleX: invSqrt, scaleY, scaleZ: invSqrt };
}

export function stepBallisticHopAndSquash(
  state: IHopSquashInput,
  dtMs: number
): IHopSquashResult {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const gravityPxPerSec2 = 980;
  let hopHeightPx = Math.max(0, clampNum(finiteOr(state?.hopHeightPx, 0), 0, 96));
  let velY = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.velY, 0), -900, 900);
  let squashY = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.squashY, 1), 0.82, 1.18);
  let squashVel = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.squashVel, 0), -20, 20);
  let didImpactFloor = false;

  if (hopHeightPx > 0 || velY > 0) {
    velY -= gravityPxPerSec2 * dt;
    hopHeightPx += velY * dt;
    if (hopHeightPx <= 0) {
      hopHeightPx = 0;
      didImpactFloor = Math.abs(velY) > 45;
      if (didImpactFloor) {
        squashVel -= clampNum(Math.abs(velY) * 0.012, 0.5, 4.2);
      }
      velY = 0;
    } else if (hopHeightPx > 96) {
      hopHeightPx = 96;
      if (velY > 0) velY = 0;
    }
  }

  const squashAccel = (1 - squashY) * 240 - squashVel * 15;
  squashVel = clampNum(squashVel + squashAccel * dt, -20, 20);
  squashY = clampNum(squashY + squashVel * dt, 0.82, 1.18);
  if (Math.abs(1 - squashY) < 0.002 && Math.abs(squashVel) < 0.02) {
    squashY = 1;
    squashVel = 0;
  }

  const { scaleX, scaleY, scaleZ } = computeVolumePreservingScale(squashY);
  const shadowScale = clampNum(1 / (1 + hopHeightPx * 0.016), 0.38, 1);
  const shadowOpacity = clampNum(0.62 / (1 + hopHeightPx * 0.028), 0.14, 0.62);

  return {
    hopHeightPx,
    velY,
    squashY,
    squashVel,
    scaleX,
    scaleY,
    scaleZ,
    shadowScale,
    shadowOpacity,
    didImpactFloor,
  };
}

export function computeDeepZParallaxLayers(input: IDeepZParallaxInput): IDeepZParallaxResult {
  const maxPx = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.maxOffsetPx, 7), 1, 16);
  const nx = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.tiltX, 0), -1, 1);
  const ny = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.tiltY, 0), -1, 1);
  const clampOff = (v: number) => clampNum(Number(clampNum(v, -maxPx, maxPx).toFixed(2)), -maxPx, maxPx) || 0;
  return {
    bgShiftX: clampOff(-nx * maxPx * 0.45),
    bgShiftY: clampOff(-ny * maxPx * 0.45),
    midShiftX: clampOff(nx * maxPx * 0.72),
    midShiftY: clampOff(ny * maxPx * 0.72),
    fgShiftX: clampOff(nx * maxPx),
    fgShiftY: clampOff(ny * maxPx),
    specularShiftPct: Number(clampNum(50 + nx * 38, 12, 88).toFixed(2)),
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { PermissionsAndroid, Platform } from 'react-native';

export const ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_android_notif_prompted_v1';

let _promptInFlightOrDone = false;
let _activePromptPromise: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

/**
 * Solicita de forma contextual e idempotente el permiso POST_NOTIFICATIONS en Android 13+ (API 33+).
 * Comparte una promesa singleton para evitar cuadros simultáneos al dispararse desde layout y modal.
 */
export const requestContextualAndroidNotificationsOnce = (): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return Promise.resolve(false);
  const apiLevel = Number(Platform.Version);
  if (!Number.isFinite(apiLevel) || apiLevel < 33) return Promise.resolve(false);
  if (_activePromptPromise) return _activePromptPromise;

  const perm =
    (PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS as any)?.POST_NOTIFICATIONS ||
    'android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS';

  const task = (async () => {
    try {
      const alreadyGranted = await PermissionsAndroid.check(perm);
      if (alreadyGranted) {
        _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
        AsyncStorage.setItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY, '1').catch(() => {});
        return true;
      }
      if (_promptInFlightOrDone) return false;
      const promptedFlag = await AsyncStorage.getItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (promptedFlag === '1') {
        _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
        return false;
      }
      _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY, '1').catch(() => {});
      const status = await PermissionsAndroid.request(perm);
      return status === PermissionsAndroid.RESULTS.GRANTED;
    } catch {
      return false;
    } finally {
      _activePromptPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  _activePromptPromise = task;
  return task;
};

export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS = new Set<string>([
  'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
  'administrador@kinetic.com',
  'kinetic@kinetic.com',
  'admin@kinetic.com',
]);

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const GENERIC_NAMES = new Set<string>([
  '',
  'atleta',
  'athlete',
  'atletakinetic',
  'kineticathlete',
  'miembrokinetic',
  'kineticmember',
  'usuario',
  'user',
  'anon',
  'me',
  'kineticoficial',
  'kineticofficial',
  'terminalglobalkinetic',
]);
const RESERVED_ADMIN_SLUGS = new Set<string>([
  'kineticoficial',
  'kineticofficial',
  'terminalglobalkinetic',
]);
const RESERVED_ROLES = new Set<string>(['admin', 'fundador', 'ceo']);

const normText = (v?: unknown): string =>
  String(v ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

const normIdentitySlug = (v?: unknown): string => normText(v).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');

export function isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(row: any): boolean {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return true;
  if (row.desactivado === true || normText(row.estado_cuenta) === 'desactivado') return true;
  const nameLow = normText(row.nombre);
  if (
    nameLow === 'usuario desactivado' ||
    nameLow === 'deactivated user' ||
    nameLow.includes('usuario desactivado')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  const emailLow = String(row.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (
    emailLow.startsWith('anonimo_') ||
    emailLow.startsWith('anonymous_') ||
    emailLow.startsWith('deleted_')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function isMasterAdminProfileRecord(row: any): boolean {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return false;
  const idLow = String(row.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailLow = String(row.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (idLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID) return true;
  return !idLow && KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLow);
}

const hasRichAvatar = (r: any): boolean => {
  const av = String(r?.avatar_url ?? r?.avatar ?? '').trim();
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(av) || av.startsWith('data:image/');
};

const getXpValue = (r: any): number => {
  const n = Number(r?.xpTotal ?? r?.xp_total ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, n) : 0;
};

const getStreakValue = (r: any): number => {
  const n = Number(r?.racha ?? r?.racha_dias ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, n) : 0;
};

function compareAthleteRichness(a: any, b: any, cleanCurrentUid: string): number {
  const aMaster = String(a?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
  const bMaster = String(b?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
  if (aMaster !== bMaster) return aMaster ? -1 : 1;

  const aMasterEmail = KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(String(a?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
  const bMasterEmail = KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(String(b?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
  if (aMasterEmail !== bMasterEmail) return aMasterEmail ? -1 : 1;

  const aMe = Boolean(cleanCurrentUid && String(a?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanCurrentUid);
  const bMe = Boolean(cleanCurrentUid && String(b?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanCurrentUid);
  if (aMe !== bMe) return aMe ? -1 : 1;

  const aUuid = UUID_RE.test(String(a?.id ?? '').trim());
  const bUuid = UUID_RE.test(String(b?.id ?? '').trim());
  if (aUuid !== bUuid) return aUuid ? -1 : 1;

  const xpDiff = getXpValue(b) - getXpValue(a);
  if (xpDiff !== 0) return xpDiff;

  const aAv = hasRichAvatar(a);
  const bAv = hasRichAvatar(b);
  if (aAv !== bAv) return aAv ? -1 : 1;

  const stDiff = getStreakValue(b) - getStreakValue(a);
  if (stDiff !== 0) return stDiff;

  const aEm = Boolean(String(a?.email ?? '').trim());
  const bEm = Boolean(String(b?.email ?? '').trim());
  if (aEm !== bEm) return aEm ? -1 : 1;

  return String(a?.id ?? '').localeCompare(String(b?.id ?? ''));
}

/**
 * Deduplicación pura, determinista e idempotente para Ranking y Directorio KinetiClub.
 * - Excluye cuentas dadas de baja (`Usuario Desactivado`, `anonimo_*`).
 * - Normaliza cualquier cuenta maestra admin como `Kinetic Oficial`.
 * - Consolida duplicados por `id`, `email` normalizado y huella de identidad preservando la fila más rica.
 */
function deduplicateSinglePass<T extends Record<string, any>>(
  valid: T[],
  cleanCurrentUid: string
): T[] {
  const n = valid.length;
  if (n === 0) return [];

  const parent = new Int32Array(n);
  const compUuid: string[] = new Array(n);
  const compEmail: string[] = new Array(n);
  const compAdmin: boolean[] = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    parent[i] = i;
    const r: any = valid[i];
    const idLow = String(r.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    compUuid[i] = UUID_RE.test(idLow) ? idLow : '';
    compEmail[i] = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    compAdmin[i] = isMasterAdminProfileRecord(r);
  }
  const find = (x: number): number => {
    let cur = x;
    while (parent[cur] !== cur) {
      parent[cur] = parent[parent[cur]];
      cur = parent[cur];
    }
    return cur;
  };
  const unite = (a: number, b: number, allowDistinctIdentity: boolean): void => {
    const ra = find(a);
    const rb = find(b);
    if (ra === rb) return;
    if (
      (compAdmin[ra] || compAdmin[rb]) &&
      (compAdmin[ra] !== compAdmin[rb] ||
        (compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb] && compUuid[ra] !== compUuid[rb]))
    ) {
      return;
    }
    if (!allowDistinctIdentity) {
      if (compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb] && compUuid[ra] !== compUuid[rb]) return;
      if (compEmail[ra] && compEmail[rb] && compEmail[ra] !== compEmail[rb]) return;
    }
    parent[rb] = ra;
    if (!compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb]) compUuid[ra] = compUuid[rb];
    if (!compEmail[ra] && compEmail[rb]) compEmail[ra] = compEmail[rb];
    if (compAdmin[rb]) compAdmin[ra] = true;
  };

  const hardBuckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const bindHard = (key: string, idx: number): void => {
    if (!key) return;
    const list = hardBuckets.get(key);
    if (!list) hardBuckets.set(key, [idx]);
    else {
      for (const prev of list) unite(prev, idx, true);
      list.push(idx);
    }
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const r: any = valid[i];
    const idLow = String(r.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailLow = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (idLow) bindHard(`id:${idLow}`, i);
    if (emailLow) bindHard(`em:${emailLow}`, i);
    if (compAdmin[i]) bindHard('admin:kinetic_oficial', i);
  }

  const softBuckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const bindSoft = (key: string, idx: number): void => {
    if (!key) return;
    const list = softBuckets.get(key);
    if (!list) softBuckets.set(key, [idx]);
    else {
      for (const prev of list) unite(prev, idx, false);
      list.push(idx);
    }
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (compAdmin[i]) continue;
    const r: any = valid[i];
    const emailLow = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const nameSlug = normIdentitySlug(r.nombre);
    if (GENERIC_NAMES.has(nameSlug) || nameSlug.length < 4) continue;
    const avatarUrl = hasRichAvatar(r) ? String(r.avatar_url ?? r.avatar ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    if (avatarUrl) bindSoft(`av_nm:${avatarUrl}|${nameSlug.slice(0, 10)}`, i);
    const tokens = normText(r.nombre).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (tokens.length >= 2) bindSoft(`fullname:${tokens.join('_')}`, i);
    const emailLocal = emailLow.includes('@') ? normIdentitySlug(emailLow.split('@')[0]) : '';
    if (emailLocal && emailLocal.length >= 4 && emailLocal === nameSlug) bindSoft(`handle:${emailLocal}`, i);
  }

  const groups = new Map<number, T[]>();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const root = find(i);
    const bucket = groups.get(root);
    if (bucket) bucket.push(valid[i]);
    else groups.set(root, [valid[i]]);
  }

  const consolidated: T[] = [];
  groups.forEach((bucket) => {
    if (bucket.length === 1) {
      consolidated.push(bucket[0]);
      return;
    }
    const sorted = [...bucket].sort((a, b) => compareAthleteRichness(a, b, cleanCurrentUid));
    const winner: any = { ...sorted[0] };
    for (let k = 1; k < sorted.length; k++) {
      const alt: any = sorted[k];
      if (GENERIC_NAMES.has(normIdentitySlug(winner.nombre)) && !GENERIC_NAMES.has(normIdentitySlug(alt.nombre))) {
        winner.nombre = alt.nombre;
      }
      if (!hasRichAvatar(winner) && hasRichAvatar(alt)) {
        if (alt.avatar_url) winner.avatar_url = alt.avatar_url;
        else if (alt.avatar) winner.avatar = alt.avatar;
      }
      if (!String(winner.email ?? '').trim() && String(alt.email ?? '').trim()) winner.email = alt.email;
      const maxStreak = Math.max(getStreakValue(winner), getStreakValue(alt));
      if ('racha_dias' in winner && maxStreak > (Number(winner.racha_dias) || 0)) winner.racha_dias = maxStreak;
      if ('racha' in winner && maxStreak > (Number(winner.racha) || 0)) winner.racha = maxStreak;
      const maxXp = Math.max(getXpValue(winner), getXpValue(alt));
      if ('xp_total' in winner && maxXp > (Number(winner.xp_total) || 0)) winner.xp_total = maxXp;
      if ('xpTotal' in winner && maxXp > (Number(winner.xpTotal) || 0)) winner.xpTotal = maxXp;
    }
    if (isMasterAdminProfileRecord(winner)) winner.nombre = 'Kinetic Oficial';
    consolidated.push(winner as T);
  });
  return consolidated;
}

export function deduplicateCanonicalAthletes<T extends Record<string, any>>(
  rows: T[],
  currentUserId?: string | null
): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return [];
  const cleanCurrentUid = String(currentUserId ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();

  const seenRawIds = new Set<string>();
  const rawEmailById = new Map<string, string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const cid = String(rows[i]?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cid) continue;
    seenRawIds.add(cid);
    const cem = String(rows[i]?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const neutralizedCem =
      cid !== KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID && KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(cem) ? '' : cem;
    const effectiveCem = neutralizedCem ? `em:${neutralizedCem}` : '__empty__';
    if (!rawEmailById.has(cid)) rawEmailById.set(cid, effectiveCem);
    else if (rawEmailById.get(cid) !== effectiveCem) rawEmailById.set(cid, '__conflict__');
  }

  let anonSeq = 0;
  let emailSeq = 0;
  const synthEmailIds = new Map<string, string>();
  const valid: T[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const raw = rows[i];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(raw)) continue;
    const isAdmin = isMasterAdminProfileRecord(raw);
    const cleanId = String(raw.id ?? '').trim();
    const cleanIdLow = cleanId.toLowerCase();
    const rawEmail = String(raw.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isForeignMasterEmail =
      Boolean(cleanId) &&
      cleanIdLow !== KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID &&
      KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(rawEmail);
    const isNonMasterEmailOnMaster =
      cleanIdLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID &&
      Boolean(rawEmail) &&
      !KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(rawEmail);
    const cleanEmail = isForeignMasterEmail || isNonMasterEmailOnMaster ? '' : rawEmail;
    const normName = normIdentitySlug(raw.nombre);
    if (!cleanId && !cleanEmail && !normName && !isAdmin) continue;

    const normalized: any = { ...raw };
    if (isForeignMasterEmail || isNonMasterEmailOnMaster) normalized.email = '';
    if (isAdmin) {
      normalized.nombre = 'Kinetic Oficial';
    } else {
      if (RESERVED_ADMIN_SLUGS.has(normName)) normalized.nombre = 'Atleta Kinetic';
      if (RESERVED_ROLES.has(normText(raw.rol)) && 'rol' in normalized) {
        normalized.rol = 'atleta';
      }
      if (RESERVED_ROLES.has(normText(raw.tipo_cuenta)) && 'tipo_cuenta' in normalized) {
        normalized.tipo_cuenta = 'atleta';
      }
    }
    if (!cleanId) {
      if (isAdmin) {
        normalized.id = KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
      } else if (cleanEmail) {
        const emailTag = `em:${cleanEmail}`;
        let chosen = synthEmailIds.get(cleanEmail);
        if (!chosen) {
          const base = `ath_em_${cleanEmail}`;
          if (!seenRawIds.has(base) || rawEmailById.get(base) === emailTag) {
            chosen = base;
          } else {
            chosen = `ath_em_${emailSeq}_${cleanEmail}`;
            while (seenRawIds.has(chosen) && rawEmailById.get(chosen) !== emailTag) {
              emailSeq += 1;
              chosen = `ath_em_${emailSeq}_${cleanEmail}`;
            }
            emailSeq += 1;
          }
          seenRawIds.add(chosen);
          rawEmailById.set(chosen, emailTag);
          synthEmailIds.set(cleanEmail, chosen);
        }
        normalized.id = chosen;
      } else {
        let candidate = `ath_anon_${anonSeq}_${normName || 'u'}`;
        while (seenRawIds.has(candidate)) {
          anonSeq += 1;
          candidate = `ath_anon_${anonSeq}_${normName || 'u'}`;
        }
        anonSeq += 1;
        seenRawIds.add(candidate);
        normalized.id = candidate;
      }
    }
    valid.push(normalized as T);
  }

  let cur = deduplicateSinglePass(valid, cleanCurrentUid);
  let curJson = JSON.stringify(cur);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
    const next = deduplicateSinglePass(cur, cleanCurrentUid);
    const nextJson = JSON.stringify(next);
    if (next.length === cur.length && nextJson === curJson) break;
    cur = next;
    curJson = nextJson;
  }
  return cur;
}

export function isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(
  athlete: any,
  myUserId?: string | null,
  myEmail?: string | null,
  myName?: string | null,
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string>
): boolean {
  if (!athlete || isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(athlete)) return true;
  const aId = String(athlete.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanMyId = String(myUserId ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanMyId && aId && aId === cleanMyId) return true;
  if (aId && blockedIdsSet?.has(aId)) return true;

  const aEmail = String(athlete.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanMyEmail = String(myEmail ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanMyEmail && aEmail && aEmail === cleanMyEmail) return true;

  const aNameSlug = normIdentitySlug(athlete.nombre);
  const myNameSlug = normIdentitySlug(myName);
  if (myNameSlug && !GENERIC_NAMES.has(myNameSlug) && aNameSlug === myNameSlug) return true;
  return false;
}

export const normalizeKineticPhone = (phoneRaw: string, defaultDialCode = '+52') => {
  const trimmed = String(phoneRaw || '').trim();
  const hasPlus = trimmed.startsWith('+');
  const allDigits = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (allDigits.length < 10 || allDigits.length > 15) {
    return { isValid: false, e164: '', digits10: allDigits.slice(-10), variants: [] as string[] };
  }
  const digits10 = allDigits.slice(-10);
  const dialDigits = defaultDialCode.replace(/\D/g, '') || '52';
  const e164 = hasPlus
    ? `+${allDigits}`
    : allDigits.length === 10
    ? `+${dialDigits}${digits10}`
    : `+${allDigits}`;
  const variants = Array.from(new Set([e164, digits10, e164.replace('+', ''), `52${digits10}`]));
  return { isValid: digits10.length === 10, e164, digits10, variants };
};

export const mapSupabaseAuthError = (rawMessage?: string, isEnInput?: boolean): string => {
  let cleanRaw = String(rawMessage || '').trim();
  if (cleanRaw.startsWith('{') && cleanRaw.endsWith('}')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanRaw) as Record<string, unknown>;
      cleanRaw = String(parsed.msg || parsed.error_description || parsed.message || parsed.error_code || cleanRaw);
    } catch {}
  }
  const msg = cleanRaw.toLowerCase();
  const isEn = typeof isEnInput === 'boolean' ? isEnInput : getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';

  if (
    msg.includes('unsupported provider') ||
    msg.includes('provider is not enabled') ||
    msg.includes('oauth') && msg.includes('disabled')
  ) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Google Sign-In is currently being enabled on the server. Please use your email and password in the meantime.'
      : 'El acceso directo con Google está en activación en el servidor. Usa tu correo y contraseña mientras concluye.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('kinetic_auth_timeout') || msg.includes('kinetic_bg_auth_timeout') || msg.includes('timed out') || msg.includes('timeout')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Server verification took too long. Please check your connection and try again.'
      : 'La verificación con el servidor tardó demasiado. Verifica tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('invalid login credentials') || msg.includes('user not found') || msg.includes('invalid_credentials')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Incorrect email or password. Please verify your login credentials.'
      : 'Correo o contraseña incorrectos. Verifica tus credenciales de acceso.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('user already registered') || msg.includes('already exists') || msg.includes('already been registered')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'This email address already has a registered Kinetic account.'
      : 'Este correo electrónico ya tiene una cuenta registrada en Kinetic.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('email_confirmation_required') || msg.includes('email not confirmed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Confirm your email via the link sent to your inbox before entering Kinetic.'
      : 'Confirma tu correo electrónico mediante el enlace enviado a tu bandeja antes de ingresar a Kinetic.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('password should be at least')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Password must contain at least 6 characters.'
      : 'La contraseña debe contener al menos 6 caracteres.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('invalid format') || msg.includes('unable to validate email')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Invalid email address format.'
      : 'El formato del correo electrónico no es válido.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('over_email_send_rate_limit') || msg.includes('rate limit') || msg.includes('too many requests') || msg.includes('for security purposes') || msg.includes('429')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Too many consecutive attempts. Please wait a minute and try signing in again.'
      : 'Demasiados intentos seguidos. Espera un momento e intenta iniciar sesión de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('oidc_challenge_expired') || msg.includes('oidc_callback_invalid') || msg.includes('oidc_token_invalid') || msg.includes('oidc_session_empty')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Google verification expired or failed validation. Please try signing in again.'
      : 'La verificación con Google expiró o no pudo validarse. Inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('google_gis_') || msg.includes('secure_crypto_unavailable')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Could not start Google Sign-In in this browser. Check your connection or allow popups.'
      : 'No se pudo iniciar Google Sign-In en este navegador. Verifica tu conexión o habilita ventanas emergentes.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('mfa_verification_unavailable') || msg.includes('mfa_factor_resolution_failed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Two-factor (2FA) verification could not be confirmed. Try again.'
      : 'No fue posible verificar la autenticación de dos pasos (2FA). Inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('network request failed') || msg.includes('failed to fetch') || msg.includes('load failed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Unstable internet connection. Check your signal and try again.'
      : 'Sin conexión estable a internet. Verifica tu señal e inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (cleanRaw.startsWith('{')) {
    return isEn ? 'Could not complete authentication request.' : 'No se pudo completar la solicitud de autenticación.';
  }
  return cleanRaw || (isEn ? 'Could not connect to the authentication vault.' : 'No se pudo establecer conexión con la bóveda de autenticación.');
};

const OAUTH_JWT_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+$/;

const hasOAuthUrlError = (callbackUrl: string): boolean => {
  const q = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const h = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  for (const part of [q, h]) {
    if (!part) continue;
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(part);
      if (p.get('error') || p.get('error_description')) return true;
    } catch {}
  }
  return false;
};

export const extractOAuthTokensFromUrl = (callbackUrl: string) => {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string' || !callbackUrl.trim() || hasOAuthUrlError(callbackUrl)) return null;
  const hashPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] : '';
  const queryPart = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const params = new URLSearchParams(hashPart || queryPart);
  const accessToken = String(params.get('access_token') || '').trim();
  const refreshToken = String(params.get('refresh_token') || '').trim();
  return OAUTH_JWT_RE.test(accessToken) && refreshToken.length >= 10
    ? { accessToken, refreshToken }
    : null;
};

const FORBIDDEN_OAUTH_CODES = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export const extractOAuthCodeFromUrl = (callbackUrl: string): string | null => {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string' || !callbackUrl.trim() || hasOAuthUrlError(callbackUrl)) return null;
  const queryPart = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const hashPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  for (const rawPart of [queryPart, hashPart]) {
    if (!rawPart) continue;
    try {
      const code = String(new URLSearchParams(rawPart).get('code') || '').trim();
      if (
        code.length >= 6 &&
        code.length <= 512 &&
        !/\s/.test(code) &&
        !FORBIDDEN_OAUTH_CODES.has(code.toLowerCase())
      ) {
        return code;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
};

export async function completeNativeOAuthSessionFromUrl(callbackUrl: string) {
  if (!isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(callbackUrl)) return null;
  if (callbackUrl.includes('id_token=')) {
    const challenge = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
    if (!challenge) return null;
    const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(callbackUrl, {
      expectedState: challenge.state,
      expectedNonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
    });
    if (!extracted) return null;
    return exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(extracted.idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
  }
  const oauthCode = extractOAuthCodeFromUrl(callbackUrl);
  if (oauthCode) {
    return supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(oauthCode);
  }
  const tokens = extractOAuthTokensFromUrl(callbackUrl);
  if (tokens) {
    const rawPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : callbackUrl.split('?')[1] || '';
    const linkType = String(new URLSearchParams(rawPart).get('type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!new Set(['signup', 'recovery', 'invite', 'magiclink', 'email_change']).has(linkType)) return null;
    return supabase.auth.setSession({
      access_token: tokens.accessToken,
      refresh_token: tokens.refreshToken,
    });
  }
  return null;
}

export async function ensureFirstTimeProfile(
  signedUser: { id: string; email?: string | null; phone?: string | null; user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> },
  options?: { linkedName?: string | null; linkedAvatar?: string | null; linkedRole?: string | null; linkedNivel?: string | null; phoneE164?: string | null }
) {
  const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', signedUser.id).maybeSingle();
  if (existing) {
    if (options?.phoneE164 && !existing.telefono) {
      await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ telefono: options.phoneE164 }).eq('id', signedUser.id);
      return { ...existing, telefono: options.phoneE164 };
    }
    return existing;
  }

  const meta = signedUser.user_metadata || {};
  const emailStr = String(signedUser.email || '').trim();
  const isPhoneSynthetic = emailStr.endsWith('@phone.kineticapp.mx');
  const resolvedPhone =
    options?.phoneE164 ||
    (typeof signedUser.phone === 'string' && signedUser.phone.trim()) ||
    (typeof meta.telefono === 'string' && meta.telefono.trim()) ||
    null;

  const isMasterAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(emailStr.toLowerCase());
  const resolvedName = isMasterAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : String(
        options?.linkedName ||
          meta.full_name ||
          meta.name ||
          meta.nombre ||
          meta.nombre_negocio ||
          (!isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr.split('@')[0] : '') ||
          (resolvedPhone ? `Atleta ${resolvedPhone.slice(-4)}` : 'Atleta Kinetic')
      ).trim().slice(0, 80);

  const resolvedAvatar =
    options?.linkedAvatar ||
    (typeof meta.avatar_url === 'string' && meta.avatar_url.trim()) ||
    (typeof meta.picture === 'string' && meta.picture.trim()) ||
    null;

  const resolvedRole = isMasterAdmin ? 'admin' : 'atleta';
  const resolvedNivel = isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Acceso Base';
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  const fullPayload = {
    id: signedUser.id,
    nombre: resolvedName,
    email: !isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr : null,
    telefono: resolvedPhone,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar,
    rol: resolvedRole,
    tipo_cuenta: resolvedRole,
    nivel: resolvedNivel,
    kc_membresia: 0,
    kc_topup: 0,
    racha_dias: 0,
    xp_total: 0,
    radar_publico: true,
    waiver_firmado: true,
    waiver_fecha: nowIso,
    fecha_activacion_membresia: nowIso,
    perdones_mensuales_usados: 0,
    mes_perdones_control: nowIso.slice(0, 7),
  };

  const minPayload = {
    id: signedUser.id,
    email: !isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr : null,
    nombre: resolvedName,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar,
    telefono: resolvedPhone,
    rol: resolvedRole,
    nivel: resolvedNivel,
    kc_membresia: 0,
    kc_topup: 0,
    waiver_firmado: true,
  };

  try {
    const { data: createdFull, error: fullErr } = await supabase
      .from('perfiles')
      .upsert(fullPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
      .select('*')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!fullErr && createdFull) return createdFull;

    const { data: createdMin } = await supabase
      .from('perfiles')
      .upsert(minPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
      .select('*')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (createdMin) return createdMin;

    const { data: fetchedAfter } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', signedUser.id).maybeSingle();
    return fetchedAfter || minPayload;
  } catch {
    return minPayload;
  }
}

const POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export const sanitizeSavedAccount = (raw: unknown, fallbackRole: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): SafeSavedAccountMeta | null => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const cleanEmail = String(obj.email || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@') || POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanEmail)) return null;
  const isAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(cleanEmail);
  const rol: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = isAdmin || obj.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : fallbackRole;
  const nombre = isAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : typeof obj.nombre === 'string' && obj.nombre.trim()
    ? obj.nombre.trim().slice(0, 60)
    : cleanEmail.split('@')[0];
  return { email: cleanEmail, nombre, rol };
};

export const deduplicateSavedAccountsMap = (
  rawMap: Record<string, unknown>,
  fallbackRole: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'
): Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> => {
  const deduped: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};
  if (!rawMap || typeof rawMap !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rawMap)) return deduped;

  for (const [keyHint, val] of Object.entries(rawMap)) {
    const cleanKeyHint = String(keyHint || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanKeyHint)) continue;
    const candidate = typeof val === 'object' && val !== null && !Array.isArray(val)
      ? (val as Record<string, unknown>)
      : { email: keyHint };
    const cleanEmail = String(candidate.email || keyHint || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
    if (!cleanEmail.includes('@') || POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanEmail) || LEGACY_PURGED_DEMO_EMAILS.has(cleanEmail)) {
      continue;
    }
    const cleanMeta = sanitizeSavedAccount({ ...candidate, email: cleanEmail }, fallbackRole);
    if (!cleanMeta) continue;
    const prev = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(deduped, cleanEmail) ? deduped[cleanEmail] : undefined;
    if (!prev) {
      deduped[cleanEmail] = cleanMeta;
      continue;
    }
    const emailLocal = cleanEmail.split('@')[0];
    const nextNombre =
      cleanMeta.nombre && cleanMeta.nombre !== emailLocal
        ? cleanMeta.nombre
        : prev.nombre || cleanMeta.nombre || emailLocal;
    deduped[cleanEmail] = {
      email: cleanEmail,
      nombre: nextNombre,
      rol: prev.rol === 'b2b' || cleanMeta.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
    };
  }
  return deduped;
};

export async function loadSanitizedLoginAccounts() {
  const [rawPref, rawPrefLegacy, rawB2C, rawB2B, rawMap, rawV2, rawRealV3] = await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.getItem(BIOMETRIC_LOGIN_ENABLED_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_biometric_enabled_v1'),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(LEGACY_KEY_B2C),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(LEGACY_KEY_B2B),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(LEGACY_MAP_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(LEGACY_V2_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY),
  ]);
  const effectiveBioRaw = rawPref ?? rawPrefLegacy;
  const bioEnabled = effectiveBioRaw === null ? true : effectiveBioRaw === 'true';
  let sanitizedMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};

  const mergeBatch = (batch: Record<string, unknown>, roleHint: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c') => {
    sanitizedMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap({ ...sanitizedMap, ...deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(batch, roleHint) }, roleHint);
  };

  try {
    const realV3Obj = rawRealV3 ? JSON.parse(rawRealV3) : null;
    if (realV3Obj && typeof realV3Obj === 'object') {
      mergeBatch(realV3Obj, 'b2c');
    }
  } catch {}

  const hadLegacyKeys = Boolean(rawB2C || rawB2B || rawMap || rawV2);
  if (hadLegacyKeys) {
    for (const [rawStr, roleHint] of [[rawV2, 'b2c'], [rawMap, 'b2c']] as const) {
      if (!rawStr) continue;
      try {
        const obj = JSON.parse(rawStr);
        if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') mergeBatch(obj, roleHint);
      } catch {}
    }
    for (const [rawCred, roleHint] of [[rawB2C, 'b2c'], [rawB2B, 'b2b']] as const) {
      if (!rawCred) continue;
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawCred) as Record<string, unknown>;
        const rawMail = String(parsed?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (rawMail) mergeBatch({ [rawMail]: parsed }, roleHint);
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  if (hadLegacyKeys || rawRealV3 === null) {
    await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.setItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY, JSON.stringify(sanitizedMap)),
      purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys(),
    ]).catch(() => {});
  } else {
    void purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys();
  }

  const accountsList = Object.values(sanitizedMap);
  const safeB2C = accountsList.find((a) => a.rol === 'b2c') || null;
  const safeB2B = accountsList.find((a) => a.rol === 'b2b') || null;

  return { bioEnabled, safeB2C, safeB2B, sanitizedMap, accountsList };
}

export async function saveSanitizedLoginAccount(
  cleanEmail: string,
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  currentMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>,
  displayName?: string
) {
  const normEmail = String(cleanEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  const normalizedCurrent = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(currentMap, mode);
  const isAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(normEmail);
  const isB2B = isAdmin || mode === 'b2b';
  const resolvedNombre = isAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : String(displayName || normalizedCurrent[normEmail]?.nombre || normEmail.split('@')[0]).trim().slice(0, 80);
  const safeMeta: SafeSavedAccountMeta = {
    email: normEmail,
    nombre: resolvedNombre,
    rol: isB2B ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
  };
  const nextMap = normEmail ? deduplicateSavedAccountsMap({ ...normalizedCurrent, [normEmail]: safeMeta }, mode) : normalizedCurrent;
  await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.setItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextMap)),
    purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys(),
  ]);
  return { isB2B, safeMeta, nextMap };
}

export async function removeSanitizedLoginAccount(
  emailToRemove: string,
  currentMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>
): Promise<Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>> {
  const norm = String(emailToRemove || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nextMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(currentMap);
  delete nextMap[norm];
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextMap));
  } catch {}
  return nextMap;
}

import { getMaxForgivenessForLevel } from '../constants/memberships';

export type CancellationWindowType =
  | 'zero_kc_or_admin'
  | 'grace_5m_or_72h'
  | 'vip_forgiveness_72h_4h'
  | 'late_no_forgiveness_72h_4h'
  | 'under_4h_strict_retention';

export interface ICancellationWindowInput {
  hoursUntilEvent: number;
  minutesSinceCreated?: number;
  vipLevel?: string | null;
  usedForgivenessCount?: number;
  isAdminUser?: boolean;
  isZeroKcPass?: boolean;
  montoEscrow?: number;
  isEn?: boolean;
}

export interface ICancellationWindowPolicy {
  shouldRefund: boolean;
  usedVipForgiveness: boolean;
  remainingForgiveness: number;
  maxForgiveness: number;
  windowType: CancellationWindowType;
  isUnder4hWindow: boolean;
  actionButtonLabel: string;
  windowMessage: string;
  resultMessage: string;
}

export const buildQrCancelCtaLabel = ({
  escrowKc,
  isFullRefund,
  isAdminPass = false,
  isEn = false,
  fallbackLabel,
}: {
  escrowKc: number;
  isFullRefund: boolean;
  isAdminPass?: boolean;
  isEn?: boolean;
  fallbackLabel?: string;
}): string => {
  const safeEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(escrowKc) || 0));
  if (isAdminPass || safeEscrow <= 0) {
    return isEn ? 'RELEASE / REMOVE PASS (0 KC)' : 'LIBERAR / ELIMINAR PASE (0 KC)';
  }
  if (isFullRefund) {
    return isEn
      ? `CANCEL & REFUND MY ${safeEscrow} KC (100% ESCROW)`
      : `CANCELAR Y REEMBOLSAR MIS ${safeEscrow} KC (100% APARTADO)`;
  }
  return (
    fallbackLabel ||
    (isEn ? 'CANCEL & RELEASE SPOT (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR Y LIBERAR CUPO (40% RETENIDO)')
  );
};

export const evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy = (
  input: ICancellationWindowInput
): ICancellationWindowPolicy => {
  const {
    hoursUntilEvent,
    minutesSinceCreated = 999,
    vipLevel,
    usedForgivenessCount = 0,
    isAdminUser = false,
    isZeroKcPass = false,
    montoEscrow = 0,
    isEn = false,
  } = input;

  const safeHours = Number.isFinite(hoursUntilEvent) ? hoursUntilEvent : 999;
  const safeMinSince = Number.isFinite(minutesSinceCreated) ? minutesSinceCreated : 999;
  const safeUsed = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(usedForgivenessCount) || 0));
  const safeEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(montoEscrow) || 0));
  const maxForgiveness = getMaxForgivenessForLevel(vipLevel);
  const remainingBefore = Math.max(0, maxForgiveness - safeUsed);
  const isWithin5mGrace = safeMinSince >= 0 && safeMinSince <= 5;

  if (isZeroKcPass || isAdminUser) {
    return {
      shouldRefund: true,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'zero_kc_or_admin',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'RELEASE / REMOVE PASS (0 KC)' : 'LIBERAR / ELIMINAR PASE (0 KC)',
      windowMessage: isEn
        ? '0 KC courtesy pass can be released immediately at no charge.'
        : 'Este pase 0 KC puede liberarse sin costo ni penalización.',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? 'The 0 KC reservation was released cleanly.'
        : 'La reserva 0 KC fue liberada correctamente.',
    };
  }

  if (isWithin5mGrace || safeHours >= 72) {
    return {
      shouldRefund: true,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'grace_5m_or_72h',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL & REFUND 40%' : 'CANCELAR Y REEMBOLSAR 40%',
      windowMessage: isWithin5mGrace
        ? isEn
          ? 'Within 5-min grace period: 100% of your 40% Escrow is refunded.'
          : 'Dentro de tolerancia (<=5 min): reembolso del 100% de tu 40% Escrow.'
        : isEn
          ? 'Early cancellation (>=72h): 100% of your 40% Escrow is refunded.'
          : 'Cancelación anticipada (>=72h): reembolso del 100% de tu 40% Escrow.',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? `${safeEscrow} KC refunded to your Vault (100% Escrow guarantee returned).`
        : `${safeEscrow} KC reembolsados íntegros a tu Bóveda (100% del Apartado 40%).`,
    };
  }

  if (safeHours >= 4 && safeHours < 72) {
    if (remainingBefore > 0) {
      const remainingAfter = remainingBefore - 1;
      return {
        shouldRefund: true,
        usedVipForgiveness: true,
        remainingForgiveness: remainingAfter,
        maxForgiveness,
        windowType: 'vip_forgiveness_72h_4h',
        isUnder4hWindow: false,
        actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL WITH VIP FORGIVENESS (100%)' : 'CANCELAR CON PERDÓN VIP (100%)',
        windowMessage: isEn
          ? `Window 72h–4h: Your VIP Forgiveness applies (${remainingBefore}/${maxForgiveness} left) for a 100% refund.`
          : `Ventana 72h–4h: Se aplicará 1 Perdón VIP (${remainingBefore}/${maxForgiveness} disponibles) con reembolso del 100%.`,
        resultMessage: isEn
          ? `VIP Forgiveness applied! ${safeEscrow} KC refunded 100% (${remainingAfter} left this month).`
          : `¡Perdón VIP aplicado! ${safeEscrow} KC devueltos al 100% (${remainingAfter} perdones restantes este mes).`,
      };
    }

    return {
      shouldRefund: false,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: 0,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'late_no_forgiveness_72h_4h',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL SESSION (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR SESIÓN (RETENCIÓN 40%)',
      windowMessage: isEn
        ? 'Window 72h–4h with 0 monthly VIP Forgiveness left: the 40% Escrow is retained (60% door fee waived).'
        : 'Ventana 72h–4h con 0 Perdones VIP disponibles este mes: se retiene el 40% Escrow (sin cargo del 60% en puerta).',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? `Session cancelled. With 0 monthly VIP Forgiveness left in the 72h–4h window, the ${safeEscrow} KC (40% Escrow) is retained.`
        : `Sesión cancelada. Sin Perdones VIP disponibles en la ventana 72h–4h, los ${safeEscrow} KC (40% Escrow) quedan retenidos.`,
    };
  }

  return {
    shouldRefund: false,
    usedVipForgiveness: false,
    remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
    maxForgiveness,
    windowType: 'under_4h_strict_retention',
    isUnder4hWindow: true,
    actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL SESSION (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR SESIÓN (RETENCIÓN 40%)',
    windowMessage: isEn
      ? `Less than 4h before class (<4h): The 40% Escrow (${safeEscrow} KC) is retained for the studio/coach (60% door fee is never charged).`
      : `A menos de 4h de iniciar (<4h): Tu 40% Escrow (${safeEscrow} KC) queda retenido a favor de la sede y coach (el 60% restante nunca se cobra).`,
    resultMessage: isEn
      ? `Session cancelled inside <4h window. The ${safeEscrow} KC (40% Escrow) was retained to protect the studio; the remaining 60% was not charged.`
      : `Sesión cancelada con menos de 4h (<4h). El 40% Escrow (${safeEscrow} KC) fue retenido en garantía de la sede; el 60% restante nunca se cobra.`,
  };
};

  'ubicacion verificada', 'ubicación verificada', 'por definir', 'online', 'sin direccion', 'sin dirección', 'mexico', 'méxico',
]);

const normalizeAddressText = (raw?: string | null): string =>
  String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

function normalizeCanonicalValue(val: unknown): unknown {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  if (typeof val === 'number') return Number.isFinite(val) ? (Object.is(val, -0) ? 0 : val) : 0;
  if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val;
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return val.map((item) => normalizeCanonicalValue(item));
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [key, entryVal] of Object.entries(val as Record<string, unknown>).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
      if (entryVal !== undefined) out[key] = normalizeCanonicalValue(entryVal);
    }
    return out;
  }
  return String(val);
}

export function buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task: FinOpsAiTask, payload: unknown, version = 'v1'): string {
  const cleanVersion = String(version || 'v1').trim() || 'v1';
  return JSON.stringify({ task, version: cleanVersion, payload: normalizeCanonicalValue(payload ?? {}) });
}

export function computeCanonicalFinOpsCacheKey(task: FinOpsAiTask, payload: unknown, version = 'v1'): string {
  const cleanVersion = String(version || 'v1').trim() || 'v1';
  return `${task}:${cleanVersion}:${sha256HexSync(buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task, payload, cleanVersion))}`;
}

export function quantizeServicePriceToTenKc(rawKc: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(rawKc);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(Math.min(num, 10_000_000) / 10) * 10);
}

export function clampB2BServiceCapacity(raw: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Math.round(num))) : 10;
}

export function clampB2BServiceDurationMinutes(raw: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(240, Math.max(15, Math.round(num))) : 60;
}

export function validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(base64Input: unknown, mimeType?: unknown): IBase64ImageValidationResult {
  const raw = typeof base64Input === 'string' ? base64Input.trim() : '';
  if (!raw) return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'empty_payload' };
  const isDataUri = /^data:/i.test(raw);
  const declaredMime = typeof mimeType === 'string' ? mimeType.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const b64Body = isDataUri ? raw.slice(raw.indexOf(',') + 1) : raw;
  if (b64Body.length > 5_592_416 && b64Body.replace(/[\r\n\t ]+/g, '').length > 5_592_412) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES + 1, reason: 'file_too_large' };
  }
  const bytes = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(raw);
  if (!bytes) return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'invalid_base64' };
  const safeCheck = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({
    bytes,
    uriOrName: isDataUri ? raw : undefined,
    declaredMime: declaredMime || undefined,
    maxBytes: MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES,
  });
  if (!safeCheck.ok || !safeCheck.contentType) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: safeCheck.byteLength, reason: safeCheck.reason || 'invalid_image' };
  }
  return { ok: true, mimeType: safeCheck.contentType, byteLength: safeCheck.byteLength, cleanBase64: encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes) };
}

export function shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver(input: IWriteOnceGeoCheckInput): boolean {
  const normUbicacion = normalizeAddressText(input.ubicacion);
  if (normUbicacion.length < 5 || GENERIC_GEO_LABELS.has(normUbicacion)) return false;
  const hasPlaceId = Boolean(String(input.existingPlaceId || '').trim());
  const hasVerifiedAt = Boolean(String(input.existingGeoVerifiedAt || '').trim());
  if (hasPlaceId && hasVerifiedAt) {
    const normPrev = normalizeAddressText(input.prevUbicacion);
    if (!normPrev || normPrev === normUbicacion) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function parseStrictCoord(val: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof val === 'boolean' || val === null || val === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '') return null;
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

export function isValidGeoCoordPair(lat: unknown, lng: unknown): boolean {
  const nLat = parseStrictCoord(lat);
  const nLng = parseStrictCoord(lng);
  return nLat !== null && nLng !== null && nLat >= -90 && nLat <= 90 && nLng >= -180 && nLng <= 180 && !(nLat === 0 && nLng === 0);
}

export function isMissingColumnPostgrestError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const msg = String((err as { message?: string } | null)?.message || err || '');
  return /Could not find the '[^']+' column|column "[^"]+" of relation/i.test(msg);
}

export function buildExternalMapsNavigationUrl(input: IExternalMapsUrlInput): string | null {
  const lat = parseStrictCoord(input.latitude);
  const lng = parseStrictCoord(input.longitude);
  const hasCoords = isValidGeoCoordPair(lat, lng);
  const cleanLabel = String(input.label || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 180);
  const cleanPlaceId = String(input.placeId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 120);
  if (!hasCoords && !cleanLabel) return null;

  let rawUrl = '';
  if (input.provider === 'waze') {
    rawUrl = hasCoords
      ? `https://waze.com/ul?ll=${(lat as number).toFixed(6)},${(lng as number).toFixed(6)}&navigate=yes`
      : `https://waze.com/ul?q=${encodeURIComponent(cleanLabel)}&navigate=yes`;
  } else {
    const queryTarget = hasCoords ? `${(lat as number).toFixed(6)},${(lng as number).toFixed(6)}` : cleanLabel;
    rawUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(queryTarget)}`;
    if (cleanPlaceId) rawUrl += `&query_place_id=${encodeURIComponent(cleanPlaceId)}`;
  }
  const sanitized = sanitizeExternalLinkUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!sanitized) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(sanitized);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return null;
    if (parsed.hostname !== 'www.google.com' && parsed.hostname !== 'waze.com') return null;
    return sanitized;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function invokeEdgeJson<TData>(fnName: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<TData>> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(fnName, { body });
    if (error || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
      return { ok: false, cached: false, error: error?.message || 'EDGE_INVOKE_UNAVAILABLE' };
    }
    const payload = data as Partial<ICloudAiResponse<TData>>;
    return {
      ok: Boolean(payload.ok),
      cached: Boolean(payload.cached),
      cache_key: payload.cache_key ?? null,
      data: payload.data,
      quota: payload.quota,
      error: payload.error,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return { ok: false, cached: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'EDGE_NETWORK_ERROR' };
  }
}

export async function digitizeB2BScheduleCloud(input: IDigitizeB2BScheduleInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<IDigitizeB2BScheduleData>> {
  const scheduleText = String(input.scheduleText || '').trim();
  let safeImg: IBase64ImageValidationResult | null = null;
  if (input.imageBase64) {
    safeImg = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(input.imageBase64, input.imageMimeType);
    if (!safeImg.ok || !safeImg.cleanBase64 || !safeImg.mimeType) {
      return { ok: false, cached: false, error: safeImg.reason || 'INVALID_OR_UNSAFE_IMAGE' };
    }
  }
  if (!scheduleText && !safeImg) return { ok: false, cached: false, error: 'EMPTY_DIGITIZER_INPUT' };
  const resp = await invokeEdgeJson<IDigitizeB2BScheduleData>('kinetic-ai-engine', {
    task: 'b2b_digitizer',
    scheduleText,
    clubName: String(input.clubName || '').trim(),
    ...(safeImg ? { imageBase64: safeImg.cleanBase64, imageMimeType: safeImg.mimeType } : {}),
  });
  if (!resp.ok || !resp.data) return resp;
  return {
    ...resp,
    data: {
      ...resp.data,
      servicios: (Array.isArray(resp.data.servicios) ? resp.data.servicios : []).map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        precio_kc: quantizeServicePriceToTenKc(s.precio_kc),
        cupo_maximo: clampB2BServiceCapacity(s.cupo_maximo),
        duracion_minutos: clampB2BServiceDurationMinutes(s.duracion_minutos),
      })),
    },
  };
}

export async function requestKineticCoachMatchCloud(input: ICoachMatchInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<ICoachMatchData>> {
  return invokeEdgeJson<ICoachMatchData>('kinetic-ai-engine', {

    disciplina: String(input.disciplina || '').trim(),
    atributo_rpg: input.atributo_rpg,
    objetivo: String(input.objetivo || '').trim(),
    nivel: String(input.nivel || '').trim(),
