  });
}

export async function seedKineticExerciseCatalogCloud(input: ICatalogSeederInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<{ inserted_or_updated: number }>> {
  return invokeEdgeJson<{ inserted_or_updated: number }>('kinetic-ai-engine', {
    task: 'catalog_seeder',
    count: Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(input.count) || 5))),
    disciplina: String(input.disciplina || '').trim(),
  });
}

export async function resolveWriteOnceGeoCloud(ubicacion: string): Promise<IResolvedGeoResult | null> {
  if (!shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion })) return null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('kinetic-geo-resolver', { body: { address: ubicacion.trim() } });
    if (error || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return null;
    const raw = data as Partial<IResolvedGeoResult & { ok?: boolean }>;
    const lat = parseStrictCoord(raw.latitude);
    const lng = parseStrictCoord(raw.longitude);
    if (!raw.ok || typeof raw.place_id !== 'string' || !raw.place_id.trim() || !isValidGeoCoordPair(lat, lng)) return null;
    return {
      latitude: lat as number,
      longitude: lng as number,
      place_id: raw.place_id.trim(),
      formatted_address: typeof raw.formatted_address === 'string' && raw.formatted_address.trim() ? raw.formatted_address.trim() : ubicacion.trim(),
      cached: Boolean(raw.cached),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch(opts: {
  table: 'afiliados' | 'servicios'; lookupCol: 'id' | 'propietario_id' | ''; lookupVal: string;
  ubicacion: string; existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null;
  prevUbicacion?: string | null; includeCoords: boolean;
}): Promise<IAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const normUbicacion = normalizeAddressText(opts.ubicacion);
  if (!normUbicacion) return {};
  let { existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt, prevUbicacion } = opts;
  if ((!existingPlaceId || !existingGeoVerifiedAt || !prevUbicacion) && opts.lookupCol && opts.lookupVal) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from(opts.table).select('ubicacion, place_id, geo_verified_at').eq(opts.lookupCol, opts.lookupVal).limit(1).maybeSingle();
      if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
        const row = data as Record<string, unknown>;
        if (!existingPlaceId && typeof row.place_id === 'string') existingPlaceId = row.place_id;
        if (!existingGeoVerifiedAt && typeof row.geo_verified_at === 'string') existingGeoVerifiedAt = row.geo_verified_at;
        if (!prevUbicacion && typeof row.ubicacion === 'string') prevUbicacion = row.ubicacion;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  const hadVerifiedGeo = Boolean(String(existingPlaceId || '').trim() || String(existingGeoVerifiedAt || '').trim());
  const normPrev = normalizeAddressText(prevUbicacion);
  const addressChanged = Boolean(normPrev && normPrev !== normUbicacion);
  if (!shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: opts.ubicacion, existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt, prevUbicacion })) {
    const becameInvalidOrGeneric = !shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: opts.ubicacion });
    return becameInvalidOrGeneric && hadVerifiedGeo && addressChanged ? { place_id: null, formatted_address: null, geo_verified_at: null } : {};
  }
  const geo = await resolveWriteOnceGeoCloud(opts.ubicacion);
  if (!geo) return hadVerifiedGeo && (!normPrev || addressChanged) ? { place_id: null, formatted_address: null, geo_verified_at: null } : {};
  const basePatch: IServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch = { place_id: geo.place_id, formatted_address: geo.formatted_address, geo_verified_at: new Date().toISOString() };
  return opts.includeCoords ? { ...basePatch, latitud: geo.latitude, longitud: geo.longitude } : basePatch;
}

export async function resolveAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch(params: {
  affiliateId?: string | null; ownerUserId?: string | null; ubicacion: string;
  existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null; prevUbicacion?: string | null;
}): Promise<IAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const affId = String(params.affiliateId || '').trim();
  const ownerId = String(params.ownerUserId || '').trim();
  const lookupCol = UUID_STRICT_RE.test(affId) ? 'id' : UUID_STRICT_RE.test(ownerId) ? 'propietario_id' : '';
  const lookupVal = lookupCol === 'id' ? affId : lookupCol === 'propietario_id' ? ownerId : '';
  return resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch({
    table: 'afiliados', lookupCol, lookupVal, ubicacion: params.ubicacion,
    existingPlaceId: params.existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt: params.existingGeoVerifiedAt,
    prevUbicacion: params.prevUbicacion, includeCoords: true,
  });
}

export async function resolveServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch(params: {
  serviceId?: string | null; ubicacion: string; existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null; prevUbicacion?: string | null;
}): Promise<IServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const sid = String(params.serviceId || '').trim();
  const lookupCol = UUID_STRICT_RE.test(sid) ? 'id' : '';
  return resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch({
    table: 'servicios', lookupCol, lookupVal: lookupCol ? sid : '', ubicacion: params.ubicacion,
    existingPlaceId: params.existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt: params.existingGeoVerifiedAt,
    prevUbicacion: params.prevUbicacion, includeCoords: false,
  });
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

  IDirectMessageItem, IDirectMessageThread, areDmTimestampsClose, buildDeterministicDmCode, canInitiateOrHydrateDm,

  isMasterAdminChatIdentity, isStrictDmParticipant, isUuid, matchesUserIdentity,

} from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';

  CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS, DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY, DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX,

} from './kineticDmMemoryStore';

export {
  buildDeterministicDmCode, canInitiateOrHydrateDm, DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY, DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY,
  DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX, extractPeerUuidFromDmCode, filterAntiZombieDmThreads, getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot,

  resolvePeerUuidForThread, resolveStrictDmUserId, setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
};
export type { IDirectMessageItem, IDirectMessageThread };

const STORY_BASE64_PREFIX_FILTER = '__KINETIC_STORY_V25__%';
let _dmSyncInflight: Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> | null = null;

async function hydrateMissingDmPeerProfiles(byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>, effectiveUid: string): Promise<void> {
  const missingUuids = new Set<string>();
  byCode.forEach((t) => {
    [{ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName, av: t.requesterAvatar }, { id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName, av: t.targetAvatar }].forEach((s) => {
      const cId = String(s.id || '').trim();
      if (isUuid(cId) && cId.toLowerCase() !== effectiveUid.toLowerCase() && !isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: cId, name: s.name }) && (isGenericPlaceholderName(s.name) || !s.av)) {
        missingUuids.add(cId);
      }
    });
  });
  if (missingUuids.size === 0) return;
  const idsArr = Array.from(missingUuids);
  const profileById = new Map<string, { nombre?: string; avatar_url?: string | null; rol?: string; email?: string }>();
  try {
    const pubRes = await supabase.from('perfiles_publicos').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel').in('id', idsArr);
    (pubRes.data || []).forEach((r: any) => { if (r?.id) profileById.set(String(r.id).toLowerCase(), r); });
  } catch {}
  const stillMissing = idsArr.filter((id) => { const f = profileById.get(id.toLowerCase()); return !f || isGenericPlaceholderName(f.nombre); });
  if (stillMissing.length > 0) {
    try {
      const privRes = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, rol').in('id', stillMissing);
      (privRes.data || []).forEach((r: any) => { if (r?.id) { const k = String(r.id).toLowerCase(); profileById.set(k, { ...profileById.get(k), ...r }); } });
    } catch {}
  }
  byCode.forEach((t) => {
    const reqP = profileById.get(String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase());
    if (reqP || isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName })) {
      t.requesterName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.requesterId, name: reqP?.nombre || t.requesterName, email: reqP?.email, rol: reqP?.rol, fallback: t.requesterName });
      if (!t.requesterAvatar && reqP?.avatar_url) t.requesterAvatar = reqP.avatar_url;
    }
    const tgtP = profileById.get(String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase());
    if (tgtP || isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName })) {
      t.targetName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.targetId, name: tgtP?.nombre || t.targetName, email: tgtP?.email, rol: tgtP?.rol, fallback: t.targetName });
      if (!t.targetAvatar && tgtP?.avatar_url) t.targetAvatar = tgtP.avatar_url;
    }
    t.messages.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.senderId === t.requesterId && !isGenericPlaceholderName(t.requesterName)) m.senderName = t.requesterName;
      else if (m.senderId === t.targetId && !isGenericPlaceholderName(t.targetName)) m.senderName = t.targetName;
    });
  });
}

export async function syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(
  myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null
): Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> {
  const effectiveUid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  if (!effectiveUid) return [];

  const identityKey = `${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`;
  const cacheState = getDmCacheSnapshotState();
  if (cacheState.val && cacheState.key === identityKey && Date.now() - cacheState.ts < CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cacheState.val;
  }
  if (_dmSyncInflight && cacheState.key === identityKey) return _dmSyncInflight;
  setDmCacheIdentityKey(identityKey);

  _dmSyncInflight = (async () => {
    try {
      await hydrateUgcModerationState(effectiveUid, false).catch(() => {});
      const [deletedMap, localThreads] = await Promise.all([loadDeletedDmMap(effectiveUid), loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, myUserName)]);
      const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
      localThreads.forEach((t) => { mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t); });

      try {
        const safeNameToken = !isGenericPlaceholderName(myUserName) ? normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName).slice(0, 14).toUpperCase() : '';
        const teamOrClauses = [`creador_id.eq.${effectiveUid}`, `nombre.ilike.%${effectiveUid}%`, `codigo_invitacion.ilike.%${effectiveUid}%`];
        if (safeNameToken.length >= 3) teamOrClauses.push(`codigo_invitacion.ilike.DM-%${safeNameToken}%`);

        const [dmTeamsRes, directMsgsRes] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id, nombre, disciplina, codigo_invitacion, creador_id, creador_nombre, created_at')
            .ilike('codigo_invitacion', 'DM-%').or(teamOrClauses.join(',')).limit(40),
          isUuid(effectiveUid)
            ? supabase.from('mensajes_directos').select('id, sender_id, recipient_id, mensaje, created_at')
                .or(`sender_id.eq.${effectiveUid},recipient_id.eq.${effectiveUid}`).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(60)
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as any[] }),
        ]);

        const dmTeams: any[] = Array.isArray(dmTeamsRes.data) ? dmTeamsRes.data : [];
        const dmTeamIdToCanonical = new Map<string, string>();
        dmTeams.forEach((row) => {
          const rawCode = String(row.codigo_invitacion || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          if (!rawCode.startsWith('DM-')) return;
          let meta: any = {};
          try { if (String(row.nombre || '').startsWith('{')) meta = JSON.parse(row.nombre); } catch {}
          const reqId = String(meta.reqId || row.creador_id || '').trim();
          const reqName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: reqId, name: meta.reqName || row.creador_nombre, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          const tgtId = String(meta.tgtId || '').trim();
          const tgtName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: tgtId, name: meta.tgtName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          if (!isStrictDmParticipant(effectiveUid, myUserName, reqId, reqName, tgtId, tgtName)) return;
          const merged = mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, {
            threadId: rawCode, dmCode: rawCode, dbTeamId: String(row.id), legacyCodes: [rawCode],
            requesterId: reqId, requesterName: reqName, requesterAvatar: meta.reqAv || null,
            targetId: tgtId, targetName: tgtName, targetAvatar: meta.tgtAv || null,
            status: meta.st === 'accepted' ? 'accepted' : 'pending', updatedAt: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString(), messages: [],
          });
          dmTeamIdToCanonical.set(String(row.id), merged.dmCode);
        });

        const dmTeamIds = Array.from(dmTeamIdToCanonical.keys());
        if (dmTeamIds.length > 0) {
          const { data: dmMsgs } = await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').select('*')
            .in('equipo_id', dmTeamIds).not('mensaje', 'ilike', STORY_BASE64_PREFIX_FILTER).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(40);
          if (Array.isArray(dmMsgs)) {
            [...dmMsgs].reverse().forEach((m: any) => {
              const code = dmTeamIdToCanonical.get(String(m.equipo_id));
              const thread = code ? byCode.get(code) : null;
              if (!thread) return;
              const mCreated = String(m.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
              const mTxt = String(m.mensaje || '').trim();
              if (!mTxt) return;
              const mSender = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: m.usuario_id, name: m.usuario_nombre, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
              if (matchesUserIdentity(m.usuario_id, mSender, thread.targetId, thread.targetName)) thread.status = 'accepted';
              thread.updatedAt = mCreated;
              const dup = thread.messages.some((ex) => ex.id === String(m.id) || (normalizeChatIdentity(ex.senderName) === normalizeChatIdentity(mSender) && String(ex.text).trim() === mTxt && String(ex.createdAt || '').slice(0, 16) === mCreated.slice(0, 16)));
              if (!dup) thread.messages.push({ id: String(m.id), senderId: String(m.usuario_id || ''), senderName: mSender, text: mTxt, createdAt: mCreated });
            });
          }
        }

        if (Array.isArray(directMsgsRes.data) && directMsgsRes.data.length > 0) {
          const myDisplay = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: effectiveUid, name: myUserName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          [...directMsgsRes.data].reverse().forEach((dm: any) => {
            const sId = String(dm.sender_id || '').trim();
            const rId = String(dm.recipient_id || '').trim();
            const txt = String(dm.mensaje || '').trim();
            if (!txt || !canInitiateOrHydrateDm(sId, rId, effectiveUid)) return;
            const sName = sId.toLowerCase() === effectiveUid.toLowerCase() ? myDisplay : resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: sId, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
            const rName = rId.toLowerCase() === effectiveUid.toLowerCase() ? myDisplay : resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: rId, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
            const createdTs = String(dm.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
            const thread = mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, {
              threadId: buildDeterministicDmCode(sId, sName, rId, rName), dmCode: buildDeterministicDmCode(sId, sName, rId, rName),
              requesterId: sId, requesterName: sName, requesterAvatar: null, targetId: rId, targetName: rName, targetAvatar: null,
              status: 'pending', updatedAt: createdTs, messages: [],
            });
            if (sId.toLowerCase() === String(thread.targetId || '').toLowerCase()) thread.status = 'accepted';
            thread.updatedAt = createdTs;
            const senderDisplay = sId.toLowerCase() === String(thread.requesterId || '').toLowerCase() ? thread.requesterName : thread.targetName;
            const dup = thread.messages.some((ex) => ex.id === String(dm.id) || (ex.senderId === sId && String(ex.text).trim() === txt && areDmTimestampsClose(ex.createdAt, createdTs)));
            if (!dup) thread.messages.push({ id: String(dm.id), senderId: sId, senderName: senderDisplay, text: txt, createdAt: createdTs });
          });
        }
        await hydrateMissingDmPeerProfiles(byCode, effectiveUid);
      } catch {}

      const strictResult = filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, effectiveUid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(strictResult)).catch(() => {});
      setDmThreadsCache(identityKey, strictResult);
      return strictResult;
    } finally {
      _dmSyncInflight = null;
    }
  })();
  return _dmSyncInflight;
}

export async function sendCloudDirectMessage(params: {
  senderId: string; senderName: string; senderAvatar?: string | null;
  targetId: string; targetName: string; targetAvatar?: string | null; text: string;
  existingThread?: IDirectMessageThread | null;
}): Promise<{ thread: IDirectMessageThread; isNewRequest: boolean }> {
  const effectiveUid = (await resolveStrictDmUserId(params.senderId)) || String(params.senderId || '').trim();
  const cleanTargetId = String(params.targetId || '').trim();
  if (!canInitiateOrHydrateDm(effectiveUid, cleanTargetId, effectiveUid, params.senderName, params.targetName)) {
    throw new Error('SELF_DM_FORBIDDEN: No puedes iniciar un chat 1 a 1 contigo mismo.');
  }
  if (isUserBlockedUgc(cleanTargetId)) throw new Error('BLOCKED_DM_FORBIDDEN: Usuario bloqueado.');

  const resolvedSenderName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: effectiveUid, name: params.senderName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
  const resolvedTargetName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: cleanTargetId, name: params.targetName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
  const diskThreads = await loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName);
  const memThreads = getDmCacheSnapshotState().val || [];
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  [...diskThreads, ...memThreads, ...(params.existingThread ? [params.existingThread] : [])].forEach((t) => {
    if (t) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
  });

  const dmCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, cleanTargetId, resolvedTargetName);
  const targetLow = cleanTargetId.toLowerCase();
  const meLow = effectiveUid.toLowerCase();
  let existing = byCode.get(dmCode.toUpperCase()) || Array.from(byCode.values()).find((t) => {
    if (t.dmCode.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase() || t.threadId.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase()) return true;
    if (Array.isArray(t.legacyCodes) && t.legacyCodes.some((c) => c.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase())) return true;
    if (isUuid(meLow) && isUuid(targetLow)) {
      const r = String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
      const g = String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase();
      return (r === meLow && g === targetLow) || (r === targetLow && g === meLow);
    }
    return false;
  });

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const msgObj: IDirectMessageItem = {
    id: `dm_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    senderId: effectiveUid, senderName: resolvedSenderName, senderAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null,
    text: String(params.text || td('¡Hola! Entrenemos en equipo en Kinetic ⚡', "Hey! Let's train together on Kinetic ⚡")).trim(),
    createdAt: nowIso,
  };

  let isNewRequest = false;
  if (!existing) {
    isNewRequest = true;
    existing = {
      threadId: dmCode, dmCode, requesterId: msgObj.senderId, requesterName: resolvedSenderName, requesterAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null,
      targetId: cleanTargetId || resolvedTargetName, targetName: resolvedTargetName, targetAvatar: params.targetAvatar || null,
      status: 'pending', updatedAt: nowIso, messages: [msgObj],
    };
  } else {
    const prevKey = existing.dmCode;
    existing.dmCode = dmCode; existing.threadId = dmCode; existing.updatedAt = nowIso;
    if (!isGenericPlaceholderName(resolvedTargetName)) {
      if (matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.requesterId, existing.requesterName)) existing.targetName = resolvedTargetName;
      else existing.requesterName = resolvedTargetName;
    }
    const hasTwoWayReplies = existing.messages.some((m) => String(m.senderId || '').toLowerCase() !== meLow);
    if (existing.status === 'accepted' || hasTwoWayReplies || matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.targetId, existing.targetName)) {
      existing.status = 'accepted';
    }
    existing.messages = [...existing.messages, msgObj];
    if (prevKey && prevKey !== dmCode) byCode.delete(prevKey);
  }
  byCode.set(dmCode, existing);
  const consolidated = Array.from(byCode.values()).sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(consolidated)).catch(() => {});
  setDmThreadsCache(`${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(resolvedSenderName)}`, consolidated);
  await markDmSeenCountInStorage(effectiveUid, existing);

  const peerUid = matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.requesterId, existing.requesterName) ? existing.targetId : existing.requesterId;
  try {
    if (isUuid(effectiveUid) && isUuid(peerUid) && effectiveUid.toLowerCase() !== peerUid.toLowerCase()) {
      await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('mensajes_directos').insert([{ sender_id: effectiveUid, recipient_id: peerUid, mensaje: msgObj.text }]),
        supabase.from('mensajes_directos').update({ leido: true }).eq('recipient_id', effectiveUid).eq('sender_id', peerUid).eq('leido', false),
      ]);
    }
  } catch {}
  try {
    const safeReqAv = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(existing.requesterAvatar) ? existing.requesterAvatar : null;
    const safeTgtAv = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(existing.targetAvatar) ? existing.targetAvatar : null;
    const metaJson = JSON.stringify({ reqId: existing.requesterId, reqName: existing.requesterName, reqAv: safeReqAv, tgtId: existing.targetId, tgtName: existing.targetName, tgtAv: safeTgtAv, st: existing.status });
    let dbTeamId = existing.dbTeamId;
    if (!dbTeamId) {
      const codesToFind = Array.from(new Set([dmCode, ...(existing.legacyCodes || [])]));
      const { data: foundRows } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id').in('codigo_invitacion', codesToFind).limit(1);
      if (Array.isArray(foundRows) && foundRows[0]?.id) {
        dbTeamId = String(foundRows[0].id);
        await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').update({ nombre: metaJson, codigo_invitacion: dmCode }).eq('id', dbTeamId);
      } else {
        const insertPayload: any = { nombre: metaJson, disciplina: 'DM_1A1', codigo_invitacion: dmCode, cupo_maximo: 2, creador_nombre: existing.requesterName };
        if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) insertPayload.creador_id = effectiveUid;
        const { data: created } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').insert([insertPayload]).select('id').single();
        if (created?.id) dbTeamId = String(created.id);
      }
    } else if (existing.status === 'accepted') {
      await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').update({ nombre: metaJson, codigo_invitacion: dmCode }).eq('id', dbTeamId);
    }
    if (dbTeamId) {
      existing.dbTeamId = dbTeamId;
      const msgRow: any = { equipo_id: dbTeamId, usuario_nombre: msgObj.senderName, mensaje: msgObj.text };
      if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) msgRow.usuario_id = effectiveUid;
      await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([msgRow]);
    }
  } catch {}
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return { thread: existing, isNewRequest };
}

export async function acceptCloudDirectMessage(
  dmCodeOrThreadId: string,
  myUserId?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null,
  threadSnapshot?: IDirectMessageThread | null
): Promise<IDirectMessageThread | null> {
  const effectiveUid = (await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId)) || String(myUserId || '').trim();
  const diskThreads = await loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, myUserName);
  const memThreads = getDmCacheSnapshotState().val || [];
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  [...diskThreads, ...memThreads, ...(threadSnapshot ? [threadSnapshot] : [])].forEach((t) => {
    if (t) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
  });

  const targetCodeUp = String(dmCodeOrThreadId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const targetPeer = extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(targetCodeUp, effectiveUid).toLowerCase();
  let found = byCode.get(targetCodeUp) || Array.from(byCode.values()).find((t) =>
    t.dmCode.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp ||
    t.threadId.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp ||
    (Array.isArray(t.legacyCodes) && t.legacyCodes.some((c) => c.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp)) ||
    (targetPeer && resolvePeerUuidForThread(t, effectiveUid, myUserName) === targetPeer)
  ) || null;

  const code = found?.dmCode || targetCodeUp;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  if (found) {
    found.status = 'accepted';
    found.updatedAt = nowIso;
    byCode.set(found.dmCode, found);
    if (effectiveUid) {
      const nextList = Array.from(byCode.values()).sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(nextList)).catch(() => {});
      setDmThreadsCache(`${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`, nextList);
      await markDmSeenCountInStorage(effectiveUid, found);
    }
  }
  try {
    if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) {
      const peerUid = found ? resolvePeerUuidForThread(found, effectiveUid, myUserName) : targetPeer;
      if (isUuid(peerUid)) {
        await supabase.from('mensajes_directos').update({ leido: true }).eq('recipient_id', effectiveUid).eq('sender_id', peerUid);
      }
      const codesToFind = Array.from(new Set([code, ...(found?.legacyCodes || [])]));
      const { data: rows } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id, nombre').in('codigo_invitacion', codesToFind).limit(1);
      if (Array.isArray(rows) && rows[0]?.id) {
        let meta: any = {};
        try { if (String(rows[0].nombre || '').startsWith('{')) meta = JSON.parse(rows[0].nombre); } catch {}
        if (!meta.reqId && found) {
          meta = { reqId: found.requesterId, reqName: found.requesterName, reqAv: found.requesterAvatar || null, tgtId: found.targetId, tgtName: found.targetName, tgtAv: found.targetAvatar || null };
        }
        if (matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, meta.tgtId, meta.tgtName) || matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, meta.reqId, meta.reqName)) {
          meta.st = 'accepted';
          await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').update({ nombre: JSON.stringify(meta), codigo_invitacion: code }).eq('id', rows[0].id);
        }
      } else if (found) {
        const metaJson = JSON.stringify({
          reqId: found.requesterId, reqName: found.requesterName, reqAv: isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(found.requesterAvatar) ? found.requesterAvatar : null,
          tgtId: found.targetId, tgtName: found.targetName, tgtAv: isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(found.targetAvatar) ? found.targetAvatar : null,
          st: 'accepted',
        });
        await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').insert([{ nombre: metaJson, disciplina: 'DM_1A1', codigo_invitacion: code, cupo_maximo: 2, creador_id: effectiveUid, creador_nombre: found.requesterName }]);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return found;
}

    // === src/services/kineticDmDeterministicHelpers.ts === //
import {
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS,
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID,
} from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';

export { KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS, KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID };

export interface IDirectMessageItem {
  id: string;
  senderId: string;
  senderName: string;
  senderAvatar?: string | null;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface IDirectMessageThread {
  threadId: string;
  dmCode: string;
  dbTeamId?: string;
  legacyCodes?: string[];
  requesterId: string;
  requesterName: string;
  requesterAvatar?: string | null;
  targetId: string;
  targetName: string;
  targetAvatar?: string | null;
  status: 'pending' | 'accepted';
  updatedAt: string;
  messages: IDirectMessageItem[];
}

export const isUuid = (v?: string | null): boolean =>
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(v || '').trim());

export const normalizeChatIdentity = (raw?: string | null): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
    .trim();

export const isGenericPlaceholderName = (raw?: string | null): boolean => {
  const k = normalizeChatIdentity(raw);
  return (
    !k ||
    k === 'atletakinetic' ||
    k === 'kineticathlete' ||
    k === 'administrador' ||
    k === 'admin' ||
    k === 'me' ||
    k === 'anon' ||
    k === 'usuario' ||
    k === 'user'
  );
};

export function isMasterAdminChatIdentity(params: {
  id?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  rol?: string | null;
}): boolean {
  const idLow = String(params.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailLow = String(params.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nameSlug = normalizeChatIdentity(params.name);
  const rolLow = String(params.rol || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    idLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID ||
    KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLow) ||
    nameSlug === 'terminalglobalkinetic' ||
    nameSlug === 'kineticoficial' ||
    nameSlug === 'kineticofficial' ||
    rolLow === 'admin' ||
    rolLow === 'fundador'
  );
}

export function resolveOfficialChatDisplayName(params: {
  id?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  rol?: string | null;
  fallback?: string;
}): string {
  if (isMasterAdminChatIdentity(params)) return 'Kinetic Oficial';
  const cleanName = String(params.name || '').trim();
  if (cleanName && !isGenericPlaceholderName(cleanName)) return cleanName;
  const emailPrefix = String(params.email || '').trim().split('@')[0];
  if (emailPrefix && !isGenericPlaceholderName(emailPrefix)) return emailPrefix;
  return params.fallback || 'Atleta Kinetic';
}

/**
 * Clave determinista canónica inmutable 1-a-1:
 * Cuando ambos participantes tienen UUID válido -> `DM-${sortedUuidA}-${sortedUuidB}` (simétrica e inmutable).
 */
export const buildDeterministicDmCode = (
  uidA?: string | null,
  nameA?: string | null,
  uidB?: string | null,
  nameB?: string | null
): string => {
  const cleanA = String(uidA || '').trim();
  const cleanB = String(uidB || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(cleanA) && isUuid(cleanB)) {
    const sorted = [cleanA.toUpperCase(), cleanB.toUpperCase()].sort();
    return `DM-${sorted[0]}-${sorted[1]}`;
  }
  const keyA = !isGenericPlaceholderName(nameA) ? normalizeChatIdentity(nameA) : normalizeChatIdentity(cleanA) || 'atleta1';
  const keyB = !isGenericPlaceholderName(nameB) ? normalizeChatIdentity(nameB) : normalizeChatIdentity(cleanB) || 'atleta2';
  const pair = [keyA.slice(0, 14), keyB.slice(0, 14)].sort();
  return `DM-${pair[0]}-${pair[1]}`.toUpperCase();
};

export const matchesUserIdentity = (
  myId?: string | null,
  myName?: string | null,
  candidateId?: string | null,
  candidateName?: string | null
): boolean => {
  const cleanMyId = String(myId || '').trim();
  const cleanCandId = String(candidateId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(cleanMyId) && isUuid(cleanCandId)) {
    return cleanMyId.toLowerCase() === cleanCandId.toLowerCase();
  }
  const normMyName = normalizeChatIdentity(myName);
  const normCandName = normalizeChatIdentity(candidateName);
  if (normMyName && normCandName && !isGenericPlaceholderName(myName) && !isGenericPlaceholderName(candidateName)) {
    return normMyName === normCandName;
  }
  return false;
};

export function canInitiateOrHydrateDm(
  requesterId?: string | null,
  targetId?: string | null,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  requesterName?: string | null,
  targetName?: string | null
): boolean {
  const req = String(requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const tgt = String(targetId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const eff = String(effectiveUid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!req && !tgt) return false;
  if (req && tgt && req === tgt) return false;
  if (eff && req === eff && tgt === eff) return false;
  if (
    !isUuid(req) &&
    !isUuid(tgt) &&
    requesterName &&
    targetName &&
    !isGenericPlaceholderName(requesterName) &&
    normalizeChatIdentity(requesterName) === normalizeChatIdentity(targetName)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (eff && matchesUserIdentity(eff, requesterName, req, requesterName) && matchesUserIdentity(eff, requesterName, tgt, targetName)) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export const isStrictDmParticipant = (
  myId?: string | null,
  myName?: string | null,
  reqId?: string | null,
  reqName?: string | null,
  tgtId?: string | null,
  tgtName?: string | null
): boolean => {
  const cleanMyId = String(myId || '').trim();
  if (!isUuid(cleanMyId) && isGenericPlaceholderName(myName)) return false;
  if (!canInitiateOrHydrateDm(reqId, tgtId, cleanMyId, reqName, tgtName)) return false;
  return (
    matchesUserIdentity(cleanMyId, myName, reqId, reqName) ||
    matchesUserIdentity(cleanMyId, myName, tgtId, tgtName)
  );
};

const CANONICAL_DM_UUID_PAIR_RE =
  /^DM-([0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12})-([0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12})$/i;

export function extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(dmCode?: string | null, myUserId?: string | null): string {
  const match = String(dmCode || '').trim().match(CANONICAL_DM_UUID_PAIR_RE);
  if (!match) return '';
  const u1 = match[1].toLowerCase();
  const u2 = match[2].toLowerCase();
  const me = String(myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (me && u1 === me) return u2;
  if (me && u2 === me) return u1;
  return '';
}

export function resolvePeerUuidForThread(
  thread: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName'>,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null
): string {
  const amReq = matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, thread.requesterId, thread.requesterName);
  const candidate = String(amReq ? thread.targetId : thread.requesterId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(candidate)) return candidate.toLowerCase();
  return extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(thread.dmCode, effectiveUid);
}

export function resolveEffectiveDeletedAtMs(
  thread: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'threadId' | 'legacyCodes' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName'>,
  deletedMap: Record<string, string>,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null
): number | null {
  if (!deletedMap || typeof deletedMap !== 'object') return null;
  const candidateKeys = new Set<string>();
  const code = String(thread.dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const tid = String(thread.threadId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (code) candidateKeys.add(code);
  if (tid) candidateKeys.add(tid);
  if (Array.isArray(thread.legacyCodes)) {
    thread.legacyCodes.forEach((lc) => {
      if (lc) candidateKeys.add(String(lc).trim().toUpperCase());
    });
  }
  const canonical = buildDeterministicDmCode(thread.requesterId, thread.requesterName, thread.targetId, thread.targetName).toUpperCase();
  if (canonical) candidateKeys.add(canonical);

  const peerUuid = resolvePeerUuidForThread(thread, effectiveUid, myUserName);
  if (peerUuid) candidateKeys.add(`PEER:${peerUuid.toUpperCase()}`);

  const upperDeleted = new Map<string, string>();
  Object.entries(deletedMap).forEach(([dk, dv]) => {
    if (dk && dv) upperDeleted.set(String(dk).trim().toUpperCase(), String(dv));
  });

  let maxDeletedMs: number | null = null;
  candidateKeys.forEach((k) => {
    const rawIso = upperDeleted.get(k.toUpperCase());
    if (!rawIso) return;
    const parsed = Date.parse(rawIso);
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && (maxDeletedMs === null || parsed > maxDeletedMs)) {
      maxDeletedMs = parsed;
    }
  });
  return maxDeletedMs;
}

/**
 * Filtro puro Anti-Zombis + Anti-AutoChat + Bloqueos UGC:
 * Descarta mensajes con `Date.parse(m.createdAt) <= Date.parse(deletedAt)`.
 * Si tras el filtrado estricto no queda ningún mensaje nuevo (`> deletedAt`), el hilo NO existe ni resucita.
 */
export function filterAntiZombieDmThreads(
  threads: IDirectMessageThread[],
  deletedMap: Record<string, string>,
  effectiveUid: string,
  myUserName?: string | null,
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string>
): IDirectMessageThread[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(threads) || !effectiveUid) return [];
  const out: IDirectMessageThread[] = [];

  for (const t of threads) {
    if (!t || !isStrictDmParticipant(effectiveUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
      continue;
    }
    const peerUuid = resolvePeerUuidForThread(t, effectiveUid, myUserName);
    if (peerUuid && blockedIdsSet?.has(peerUuid.toLowerCase())) continue;

    const deletedAtMs = resolveEffectiveDeletedAtMs(t, deletedMap, effectiveUid, myUserName);
    const rawMsgs = Array.isArray(t.messages) ? t.messages : [];
    if (rawMsgs.length === 0) continue;

    let survivingMsgs = rawMsgs;
    if (deletedAtMs !== null) {
      survivingMsgs = rawMsgs.filter((m) => {
        const mMs = Date.parse(String(m?.createdAt || ''));
        return Number.isFinite(mMs) && mMs > deletedAtMs;
      });
      if (survivingMsgs.length === 0) continue;
    }

    const sortedMsgs = [...survivingMsgs].sort((a, b) =>
      String(a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(String(b.createdAt || ''))
    );
    const latestTs = sortedMsgs.length > 0 ? sortedMsgs[sortedMsgs.length - 1].createdAt : t.updatedAt;
    const canonicalCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName);

    out.push({
      ...t,
      dmCode: canonicalCode,
      threadId: canonicalCode,
      requesterName: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName }),
      targetName: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName }),
      updatedAt: latestTs || new Date().toISOString(),
      messages: sortedMsgs,
    });
  }

  return out.sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
}

export function areDmTimestampsClose(isoA?: string | null, isoB?: string | null, windowMs = 15_000): boolean {
  const sA = String(isoA || ''), sB = String(isoB || '');
  const tA = Date.parse(sA), tB = Date.parse(sB);
  if (Number.isFinite(tA) && Number.isFinite(tB)) return Math.abs(tA - tB) < windowMs;
  return Boolean(sA && sA.slice(0, 16) === sB.slice(0, 16));
}

export function mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(
  byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>,
  incoming: IDirectMessageThread,
  fallbackLabel = 'Atleta Kinetic'
): IDirectMessageThread {
  const canonical = buildDeterministicDmCode(
    incoming.requesterId, incoming.requesterName, incoming.targetId, incoming.targetName
  ).toUpperCase();
  const rawCode = String(incoming.dmCode || incoming.threadId || canonical).trim().toUpperCase();

  let existing = byCode.get(canonical);
  if (!existing && isUuid(incoming.requesterId) && isUuid(incoming.targetId)) {
    const reqLow = incoming.requesterId.toLowerCase();
    const tgtLow = incoming.targetId.toLowerCase();
    existing = Array.from(byCode.values()).find((cand) => {
      const cReq = String(cand.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
      const cTgt = String(cand.targetId || '').toLowerCase();
      return (cReq === reqLow && cTgt === tgtLow) || (cReq === tgtLow && cTgt === reqLow);
    });
    if (existing && existing.dmCode !== canonical) byCode.delete(existing.dmCode);
  }

  const pickName = (a?: string | null, b?: string | null, uid?: string | null): string => {
    const rA = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: uid, name: a, fallback: '' });
    if (rA === 'Kinetic Oficial') return rA;
    const rB = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: uid, name: b, fallback: '' });
    if (rB === 'Kinetic Oficial') return rB;
    if (rA && !isGenericPlaceholderName(rA)) return rA;
    if (rB && !isGenericPlaceholderName(rB)) return rB;
    return rA || rB || fallbackLabel;
  };

  if (!existing) {
    const legacy = rawCode && rawCode !== canonical ? [rawCode] : [];
    const created: IDirectMessageThread = {
      ...incoming,
      threadId: canonical,
      dmCode: canonical,
      legacyCodes: Array.from(new Set([...(incoming.legacyCodes || []), ...legacy])),
      requesterName: pickName(incoming.requesterName, '', incoming.requesterId),
      targetName: pickName(incoming.targetName, '', incoming.targetId),
      messages: [...(incoming.messages || [])],
    };
    byCode.set(canonical, created);
    return created;
  }

  const sameDir = String(existing.requesterId || '').toLowerCase() === String(incoming.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
  existing.requesterName = pickName(existing.requesterName, sameDir ? incoming.requesterName : incoming.targetName, existing.requesterId);
  existing.targetName = pickName(existing.targetName, sameDir ? incoming.targetName : incoming.requesterName, existing.targetId);
  existing.requesterAvatar = existing.requesterAvatar || (sameDir ? incoming.requesterAvatar : incoming.targetAvatar) || null;
  existing.targetAvatar = existing.targetAvatar || (sameDir ? incoming.targetAvatar : incoming.requesterAvatar) || null;
  if (incoming.dbTeamId && !existing.dbTeamId) existing.dbTeamId = incoming.dbTeamId;
  if (incoming.status === 'accepted') existing.status = 'accepted';
  if (String(incoming.updatedAt || '') > String(existing.updatedAt || '')) existing.updatedAt = incoming.updatedAt;

  const extraLegacy = new Set<string>(existing.legacyCodes || []);
  if (rawCode && rawCode !== canonical) extraLegacy.add(rawCode);
  (incoming.legacyCodes || []).forEach((lc) => { if (lc && lc !== canonical) extraLegacy.add(lc); });
  existing.legacyCodes = Array.from(extraLegacy);

  (incoming.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
    const mTxt = String(m?.text || '').trim();
    if (!mTxt) return;
    const dup = existing!.messages.some(
      (ex) =>
        ex.id === m.id ||
        ((ex.senderId && m.senderId ? ex.senderId === m.senderId : normalizeChatIdentity(ex.senderName) === normalizeChatIdentity(m.senderName)) &&
          String(ex.text).trim() === mTxt &&
          areDmTimestampsClose(ex.createdAt, m.createdAt))
    );
    if (!dup) existing!.messages.push(m);
  });

  byCode.set(canonical, existing);
  return existing;
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  IDirectMessageThread, filterAntiZombieDmThreads, extractPeerUuidFromDmCode,
  isStrictDmParticipant, isUuid, mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap, normalizeChatIdentity,
} from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import { td } from './kineticlubHelpers';
import { emitSquadsDataChanged } from './kineticlubSquadsDeterministicEngine';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';

export const DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_direct_messages_v25';
export const DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_deleted_dms_v25';
export const SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_shared_squad_msgs_v3';
export const DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_msg_seen_counts_v265_';
export const CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS = 2000;

export async function markDmSeenCountInStorage(
  uid?: string | null,
  dmThread?: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName' | 'messages'> | null
): Promise<void> {
  const cleanUid = String(uid || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid || !dmThread?.dmCode) return;
  const total = Array.isArray(dmThread.messages) ? dmThread.messages.length : 0;
  const myLow = cleanUid.toLowerCase();
  const reqLow = String(dmThread.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const peerRaw = reqLow === myLow ? dmThread.targetId : dmThread.requesterId;
  const peerLow = String(peerRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const rowKey = isUuid(peerLow) ? `dm:peer:${peerLow}` : `dm:${String(dmThread.dmCode).toLowerCase()}`;
  const key = `${DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanUid}`;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    const safePrev = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    if (safePrev[rowKey] === total && safePrev[dmThread.dmCode] === total) return;
    const next = { ...safePrev, [rowKey]: total, [dmThread.dmCode]: total };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(next));
    emitSquadsDataChanged();
  } catch {}
}

let _dmSyncCacheKey = '';
let _dmSyncCacheTs = 0;
let _dmSyncCacheVal: IDirectMessageThread[] | null = null;
let _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot: Record<string, any[]> = {};

export function getDmCacheSnapshotState(): { key: string; ts: number; val: IDirectMessageThread[] | null } {
  return { key: _dmSyncCacheKey, ts: _dmSyncCacheTs, val: _dmSyncCacheVal };
}

export function setDmCacheIdentityKey(key: string): void {
  _dmSyncCacheKey = key;
}

export function setDmThreadsCache(identityKey: string, threads: IDirectMessageThread[]): void {
  _dmSyncCacheKey = identityKey;
  _dmSyncCacheVal = Array.isArray(threads) ? threads : [];
  _dmSyncCacheTs = Date.now();
}

export function invalidateDirectMessagesCache(): void {
  _dmSyncCacheTs = 0;
  _dmSyncCacheVal = null;
}

export const getScopedDmStorageKey = (uid?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return isUuid(clean) ? `${DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY}_${clean}` : DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY;
};

function readWebLocalStorageJson<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
    }
  } catch {}
  return fallback;
}

export function getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null): IDirectMessageThread[] {
  const cleanUid = String(myUserId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid) {
    _dmSyncCacheVal = null;
    _dmSyncCacheKey = '';
    return [];
  }
  if (_dmSyncCacheVal && _dmSyncCacheVal.length > 0) {
    const blocked = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
    const prefix = `${cleanUid}|`;
    if (_dmSyncCacheKey.startsWith(prefix)) return _dmSyncCacheVal;
    return _dmSyncCacheVal.filter((t) =>
      isStrictDmParticipant(cleanUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName) &&
      !blocked.has(String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase()) &&
      !blocked.has(String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase())
    );
  }
  const rawList = readWebLocalStorageJson<IDirectMessageThread[]>(
    getScopedDmStorageKey(cleanUid),
    readWebLocalStorageJson<IDirectMessageThread[]>(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, [])
  );
  if (!Array.isArray(rawList) || rawList.length === 0) return [];
  const delKey = isUuid(cleanUid) ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${cleanUid.toLowerCase()}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY;
  const deletedMap = readWebLocalStorageJson<Record<string, string>>(delKey, {});
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  rawList.forEach((t) => {
    if (t && isStrictDmParticipant(cleanUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
      mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
    }
  });
  const filtered = filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, cleanUid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
  if (filtered.length > 0) {
    _dmSyncCacheKey = `${cleanUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`;
    _dmSyncCacheVal = filtered;
  }
  return filtered;
}

export function getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(): Record<string, any[]> {
  if (Object.keys(_squadRoomsMemorySnapshot).length > 0) return _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot;
  const localMap = readWebLocalStorageJson<Record<string, any[]>>(SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY, {});
  if (localMap && typeof localMap === 'object' && Object.keys(localMap).length > 0) {
    _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot = localMap;
  }
  return _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot;
}

export function setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(map: Record<string, any[]>): void {
  if (map && typeof map === 'object') {
    _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot = { ...map };
  }
}

export async function resolveStrictDmUserId(explicitUserId?: string | null): Promise<string> {
  const clean = String(explicitUserId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(clean)) return clean;
  try {
    const sUid = String((await supabase.auth.getSession()).data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    if (isUuid(sUid)) return sUid;
  } catch {}
  return '';
}

export async function markDmDeletedLocally(
  dmCode: string,
  myUserId?: string | null,
  deletedAtIso?: string,
  peerUuid?: string | null,
  extraCodes?: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  const code = String(dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const uid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  const ts = deletedAtIso || new Date().toISOString();
  const resolvedPeer = isUuid(peerUuid) ? String(peerUuid).trim().toLowerCase() : extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(code, uid);
  if (!code && !resolvedPeer) return;
  const key = uid ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${uid.toLowerCase()}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    const map: Record<string, string> = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    if (code) map[code] = ts;
    if (resolvedPeer) map[`PEER:${resolvedPeer}`] = ts;
    (extraCodes || []).forEach((c) => {
      const up = String(c || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (up) map[up] = ts;
    });
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(map));
  } catch {}
  invalidateDirectMessagesCache();
}

export async function loadDeletedDmMap(uid?: string | null): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(isUuid(clean) ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${clean}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function loadLocalDmThreads(myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null): Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> {
  try {
    const uid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
    if (!uid) return [];
    const [scopedRaw, legacyRaw, deletedMap] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(uid)),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY),
      loadDeletedDmMap(uid),
    ]);
    const list: IDirectMessageThread[] = scopedRaw ? JSON.parse(scopedRaw) : legacyRaw ? JSON.parse(legacyRaw) : [];
    const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
    const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
    (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).forEach((t) => {
      if (t && isStrictDmParticipant(uid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
        mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
      }
    });
    return filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, uid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

import { getLevelNumericWeight, getMembershipByLevel } from '../constants/memberships';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from './kineticVaultCrypto';

export const KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+$/;

export type ProductionAuthRejectReason =
  | 'ok'
  | 'missing_jwt'
  | 'synthetic_token'
  | 'aal2_required'
  | 'mfa_check_failed'
  | 'unconfirmed_email';

export interface ProductionAuthEvaluationInput {
  token?: unknown;
  aal?: unknown;
  hasVerifiedTotp?: boolean;
  emailConfirmed?: boolean | null;
  mfaCheckFailed?: boolean;
  isDevRuntime?: boolean;
}

export interface ProductionAuthEvaluationResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason: ProductionAuthRejectReason;
}

export interface IPendingMfaChallengeState {
  required: boolean;
  email?: string;
  factorId?: string;
  reason?: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export const isSyntheticOrDemoToken = (token: unknown): boolean => {
  if (typeof token !== 'string') return true;
  const trimmed = token.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return true;
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower.startsWith('kinetic-') ||
    lower.startsWith('demo-') ||
    lower.startsWith('mock-')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return !KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE.test(trimmed);
};

export const isValidRealSupabaseJwt = (token: unknown): boolean => !isSyntheticOrDemoToken(token);

const B2B_UPPER = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
const B2B_LOWER = 'abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
const B2B_DIGITS = '23456789';
const B2B_SYMBOLS = '!@#$%&*+-=?';
const B2B_ALL = `${B2B_UPPER}${B2B_LOWER}${B2B_DIGITS}${B2B_SYMBOLS}`;

const secureRandIndex = (max: number, getRandomValues: (arr: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array): number => {
  const limit = 0x1_0000_0000 - (0x1_0000_0000 % max);
  const buf = new Uint32Array(1);
  let val = 0;
  do {
    getRandomValues(buf);
    val = buf[0] >>> 0;
  } while (val >= limit);
  return val % max;
};

export const generateSecureB2BTempPassword = (length = 16): string => {
  const c = (globalThis as { crypto?: { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array } })?.crypto;
  if (!c?.getRandomValues) {
    throw new Error('SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
  }
  const grv = (arr: Uint32Array) => c.getRandomValues!(arr);
  const targetLen = Math.min(16, Math.max(14, Math.floor(Number(length) || 16)));
  const chars: string[] = [
    B2B_UPPER[secureRandIndex(B2B_UPPER.length, grv)],
    B2B_LOWER[secureRandIndex(B2B_LOWER.length, grv)],
    B2B_DIGITS[secureRandIndex(B2B_DIGITS.length, grv)],
    B2B_SYMBOLS[secureRandIndex(B2B_SYMBOLS.length, grv)],
  ];
  while (chars.length < targetLen) {
    chars.push(B2B_ALL[secureRandIndex(B2B_ALL.length, grv)]);
  }
  for (let i = chars.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
    const j = secureRandIndex(i + 1, grv);
    const tmp = chars[i];
    chars[i] = chars[j];
    chars[j] = tmp;
  }
  return chars.join('');
};

export const extractJwtClaimsSafe = (
  token: unknown,
): { sub?: string; aal?: string; exp?: number; amr?: unknown[]; email?: string } | null => {
  if (isSyntheticOrDemoToken(token)) return null;
  try {
    const parts = String(token).trim().split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts[1]) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padLen = (4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4;
    const padded = b64 + '='.repeat(padLen);
    let jsonStr = '';
    if (typeof atob === 'function') {
      const bin = atob(padded);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      jsonStr = typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined' ? new TextDecoder().decode(bytes) : bin;
    } else {
      const Buf = (globalThis as any)?.Buffer;
      if (!Buf?.from) return null;
      jsonStr = Buf.from(padded, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const evaluateProductionAuthAccess = (
  input: ProductionAuthEvaluationInput,
): ProductionAuthEvaluationResult => {
  const devRuntime = typeof input.isDevRuntime === 'boolean' ? input.isDevRuntime : isKineticDevRuntime();
  const rawToken = typeof input.token === 'string' ? input.token.trim() : '';

  if (!rawToken) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
  }

  const lower = rawToken.toLowerCase();
  const isExplicitSynthetic =
    lower.startsWith('kinetic-') || lower.startsWith('demo-') || lower.startsWith('mock-');
  if (isExplicitSynthetic) {
    if (!devRuntime) return { allowed: false, reason: 'synthetic_token' };
  } else if (!KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE.test(rawToken)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
  }

  const claims = extractJwtClaimsSafe(rawToken);
  if (!devRuntime) {
    const subOk = typeof claims?.sub === 'string' && claims.sub.trim().length > 0;
    const expOk = typeof claims?.exp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(claims.exp) && claims.exp * 1000 > Date.now();
    if (!claims || !subOk || !expOk) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
    }
  }
  if (input.mfaCheckFailed === true) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'mfa_check_failed' };
  }
  const claimAal = typeof claims?.aal === 'string' && claims.aal.trim() ? claims.aal.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
  const inputAal = typeof input.aal === 'string' && input.aal.trim() ? input.aal.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
  const resolvedAal = !devRuntime
    ? (claimAal === 'aal2' && inputAal !== 'aal1' ? 'aal2' : 'aal1')
    : (inputAal || claimAal || 'aal1');
  if (input.hasVerifiedTotp === true && resolvedAal !== 'aal2') {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'aal2_required' };
  }

  if (input.emailConfirmed === false && !devRuntime) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unconfirmed_email' };
  }

  return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
};

export const maskClabeAccount = (rawClabe: unknown): string => {
  const digits = String(rawClabe ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '•••• •••• •••• ••••';
  if (digits.length < 6) return '•'.repeat(Math.max(4, digits.length));
  const tail = digits.slice(-4);
  if (digits.length >= 16) return `•••• •••• •••• ••${tail}`;
  return `•••• •••• ${tail}`;
};

export const isValidKcMultipleOfTen = (amountKc: unknown): boolean => {
  if (typeof amountKc !== 'number') return false;
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountKc) || !Number.isInteger(amountKc)) return false;
  return amountKc >= 10 && amountKc <= 1_000_000 && amountKc % 10 === 0;
};

export const assertValidKcMultipleOfTen = (amountKc: unknown, contextLabel = 'KC'): number => {
  const num = Number(amountKc);
  if (!isValidKcMultipleOfTen(num)) {
    throw new Error(`[${contextLabel}] Monto invalido: solo multiplos exactos de 10 KC permitidos.`);
  }
  return num;
};

let _pendingMfaChallenge: IPendingMfaChallengeState = { required: false, updatedAt: 0 };
const _mfaListeners = new Set<(state: IPendingMfaChallengeState) => void>();

const emitMfaChallenge = (): void => {
  _mfaListeners.forEach((listener) => {
    try {
      listener(_pendingMfaChallenge);
    } catch {}
  });
};

export const getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (): IPendingMfaChallengeState => _pendingMfaChallenge;

export const setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (
  patch: Omit<IPendingMfaChallengeState, 'updatedAt'>,
): void => {
  _pendingMfaChallenge = { ...patch, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  emitMfaChallenge();
};

export const clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (): void => {
  if (!_pendingMfaChallenge.required) return;
  _pendingMfaChallenge = { required: false, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  emitMfaChallenge();
};

export const subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (
  listener: (state: IPendingMfaChallengeState) => void,
): (() => void) => {
  _mfaListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    _mfaListeners.delete(listener);
  };
};

export const CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID: Record<string, number> = {
  topup_50: 50,
  topup_100: 100,
  topup_250: 250,
  topup_500: 500,
  topup_1000: 1000,
};

export const resolveCanonicalCheckoutPlan = (input: {
  tipo: 'membresia' | 'topup';
  planId?: string | null;
  targetLevel?: string | null;
  currentLevel?: string | null;
}): {
  canonicalPlanId: string;
  canonicalLevel: string | null;
  kcOtorgados: number;
  precioMxn: number;
  isDowngrade: boolean;
} => {
  if (input.tipo === 'topup') {
    const rawId = String(input.planId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pkgKc = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, rawId)
      ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[rawId]
      : Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, `topup_${rawId}`)
      ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[`topup_${rawId}`]
      : 0;
    if (!pkgKc || typeof pkgKc !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(pkgKc)) {
      throw new Error('Paquete Top-Up no reconocido en catálogo oficial.');
    }
    const isVip = getLevelNumericWeight(input.currentLevel) >= 1;
    return {
      canonicalPlanId: `topup_${pkgKc}`,
      canonicalLevel: null,
      kcOtorgados: pkgKc,
      precioMxn: isVip ? pkgKc : Math.round(pkgKc * 1.2),
      isDowngrade: false,
    };
  }
  const targetPlan = getMembershipByLevel(input.targetLevel || input.planId);
  const nextW = getLevelNumericWeight(targetPlan.nivel);
  if (nextW < 1) {
    return { canonicalPlanId: 'free', canonicalLevel: 'Acceso Base', kcOtorgados: 0, precioMxn: 0, isDowngrade: true };
  }
  const curW = getLevelNumericWeight(input.currentLevel);
  if (nextW < curW) {
    return { canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id, canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel, kcOtorgados: 0, precioMxn: 0, isDowngrade: true };
  }
  if (curW >= 1 && nextW > curW) {
    const curPlan = getMembershipByLevel(input.currentLevel);
    return {
      canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id,
      canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel,
      kcOtorgados: Math.max(0, targetPlan.kc_otorgados - curPlan.kc_otorgados),
      precioMxn: Math.max(0, targetPlan.precio_mensual_mxn - curPlan.precio_mensual_mxn),
      isDowngrade: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id,
    canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel,
    kcOtorgados: targetPlan.kc_otorgados,
    precioMxn: targetPlan.precio_mensual_mxn,
    isDowngrade: false,
  };
};

import { getMembershipByLevel } from '../constants/memberships';

const FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MINUTES = 180;
const FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MS = FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

export interface IResolveFlashVipDiscountParams {
  event: any;
  vipLevel?: string | null;
  kcMembresia?: number | null;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  nowMs?: number;
  isEn?: boolean;
}

export interface IFlashVipDiscountPricing {
  basePriceKc: number;
  discountedTotalKc: number;
  escrow40: number;
  puerta60: number;
  discountPct: number;
  savingsKc: number;
  hasFlashDiscount: boolean;
  isFlashWindow: boolean;
  showFlashPromoBadge: boolean;
  resolvedVipLevel: string;
  flashBadgeText: string | null;
  minutesToStart: number | null;
}

const normalizeVipTierName = (rawLevel?: string | null, kcMembresia?: number | null): string => {
  const clean = String(rawLevel || '').trim();
  const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || lower === 'acceso base' || lower === 'base access' || lower === 'free' || lower === 'ninguno') {
    const memKc = Number(kcMembresia) || 0;
    if (memKc >= 3600) return 'Platinum';
    if (memKc >= 2500) return 'Gold';
    if (memKc >= 1500) return 'Silver';
    if (memKc >= 600) return 'Bronze';
    return 'Acceso Base';
  }
  if (lower.startsWith('top-up') || lower.startsWith('topup')) {
    const memKc = Number(kcMembresia) || 0;
    if (memKc >= 3600) return 'Platinum';
    if (memKc >= 2500) return 'Gold';
    if (memKc >= 1500) return 'Silver';
    if (memKc >= 600) return 'Bronze';
    return 'Acceso Base';
  }
  if (lower.includes('platinum') || lower.includes('platino') || lower.includes('leyenda') || lower.includes('black')) {
    return 'Platinum';
  }
  if (lower.includes('gold') || lower.includes('oro')) return 'Gold';
  if (lower.includes('silver') || lower.includes('plata')) return 'Silver';
  if (lower.includes('bronze') || lower.includes('bronce')) return 'Bronze';
  return 'Acceso Base';
};

const parseEventStartTimestampMs = (ev: any): number | null => {
  if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') return null;
  if (typeof ev.nextTimestamp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(ev.nextTimestamp) && ev.nextTimestamp > 0) {
    return ev.nextTimestamp;
  }
  const rawDate = String(
    ev.fecha_clase || ev.fecha_seleccionada || ev.fecha_proyectada || ev.fecha || ''
  )
    .split('T')[0]
    .trim();
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(rawDate)) return null;
  const [y, m, d] = rawDate.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!y || !m || !d) return null;

  const rawHora = String(ev.hora_inicio || ev.hora || '').trim();
  const match = rawHora.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/i);
  if (!match) return null;
  let hh = parseInt(match[1], 10);
  const mm = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(match[2], 10) || 0));
  const ampm = (match[4] || '').toLowerCase();
  if (ampm.startsWith('p') && hh < 12) hh += 12;
  if (ampm.startsWith('a') && hh === 12) hh = 0;
  hh = Math.max(0, Math.min(23, hh));

  const ts = new Date(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, 0, 0).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(ts) ? ts : null;
};

export const resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing = ({
  event,
  vipLevel,
  kcMembresia,
  isAdmin = false,
  nowMs,
  isEn = false,
}: IResolveFlashVipDiscountParams): IFlashVipDiscountPricing => {
  const safeNowMs = typeof nowMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
  const rawBase =
    event?.precio_base_kc ??
    event?.precio_kc ??
    event?.precio ??
    event?.costo_total ??
    event?.precioBaseKc ??
    0;
  const basePriceKc = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(rawBase) || 0));

  const startMs = parseEventStartTimestampMs(event);
  const diffMs = startMs !== null ? startMs - safeNowMs : null;
  const within3hWindow = diffMs !== null && diffMs > 0 && diffMs <= FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MS;
  const minutesToStart = diffMs !== null ? Math.round(diffMs / 60_000) : null;

  const explicitFlash = Boolean(
    event?.es_venta_flash ||
      event?.isFlashSale ||
      event?.isFlashUrgent3h ||
      event?.atributos?.es_venta_flash
  );
  const isFlashWindow = explicitFlash || within3hWindow;

  const resolvedVipLevel = normalizeVipTierName(vipLevel, kcMembresia);
  const membership = getMembershipByLevel(resolvedVipLevel);
  const tierPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(20, Number(membership?.descuento_flash) || 0));

  const rawAttrPct = Number(
    event?.atributos?.descuento_flash_pct ?? event?.descuento_flash_pct ?? 0
  );
  const attrPct = Number.isFinite(rawAttrPct) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(40, Math.round(rawAttrPct))) : 0;

  const eligibleVipPct = tierPct > 0 ? Math.max(tierPct, attrPct) : 0;
  const discountPct = !isAdmin && isFlashWindow && basePriceKc > 0 ? eligibleVipPct : 0;

  const discountedTotalKc = isAdmin
    ? 0
    : Math.max(0, Math.round(basePriceKc * (1 - discountPct / 100)));
  const escrow40 =
    isAdmin || discountedTotalKc === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(discountedTotalKc * 0.4);
  const puerta60 =
    isAdmin || discountedTotalKc === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(0, discountedTotalKc - escrow40);

  const savingsKc = isAdmin ? 0 : Math.max(0, basePriceKc - discountedTotalKc);
  const hasFlashDiscount = Boolean(!isAdmin && isFlashWindow && discountPct > 0 && savingsKc > 0);
  const showFlashPromoBadge = Boolean(isFlashWindow && basePriceKc > 0);

  const flashBadgeText = !showFlashPromoBadge
    ? null
    : isAdmin || discountPct <= 0
      ? isEn
        ? 'FLASH UP TO -20% VIP'
        : 'FLASH HASTA -20% VIP'
      : `FLASH -${discountPct}% ${resolvedVipLevel.toUpperCase()}`;

  return {
    basePriceKc,
    discountedTotalKc,
    escrow40,
    puerta60,
    discountPct,
    savingsKc,
    hasFlashDiscount,
    isFlashWindow,
    showFlashPromoBadge,
    resolvedVipLevel,
    flashBadgeText,
    minutesToStart,
  };
};

import type { Session, User } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import {
  KINETIC_CANONICAL_ORIGIN,
  exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase,
  generateOidcNonceAndState,
  resolveGoogleWebClientId,
  validateGoogleIdTokenClaims,
} from './kineticGoogleOidcService';

export interface IGoogleGisIdApi {
  initialize: (cfg: {
    client_id: string;
    nonce: string;
    ux_mode: 'popup' | 'redirect';
    auto_select?: boolean;
    context?: string;
    use_fedcm_for_prompt?: boolean;
    itp_support?: boolean;
    callback: (resp: { credential?: string }) => void | Promise<void>;
  }) => void;
  renderButton: (
    parent: HTMLElement,
    opts: { theme?: string; size?: string; shape?: string; text?: string; width?: number; locale?: string }
  ) => void;
  prompt: () => void;
  cancel?: () => void;
}
type GoogleWindowRef = Window & { google?: { accounts?: { id?: IGoogleGisIdApi } } };

const GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID = 'kinetic-google-gis-sdk';
const GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_SRC = 'https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client';

export async function loadGoogleIdentityServicesSdk(): Promise<IGoogleGisIdApi> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    throw new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_WEB_ONLY');
  }
  const win = window as GoogleWindowRef;
  if (win.google?.accounts?.id) return win.google.accounts.id;
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const existing = document.getElementById(GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID) as HTMLScriptElement | null;
    if (existing && existing.dataset.kineticGisState !== 'loading') {
      existing.remove();
    }
    const targetScript =
      (document.getElementById(GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID) as HTMLScriptElement | null) || document.createElement('script');
    const cleanupListeners = () => {
      targetScript.removeEventListener('load', onDone);
      targetScript.removeEventListener('error', onFail);
    };
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'error';
      targetScript.remove();
      reject(new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_TIMEOUT'));
    }, 10_000);
    const onDone = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'ready';
      resolve();
    };
    const onFail = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'error';
      targetScript.remove();
      reject(new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_LOAD_FAILED'));
    };
    if (targetScript.parentNode) {
      targetScript.addEventListener('load', onDone, { once: true });
      targetScript.addEventListener('error', onFail, { once: true });
      return;
    }
    targetScript.id = GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID;
    targetScript.src = GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_SRC;
    targetScript.async = true;
    targetScript.defer = true;
    targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'loading';
    targetScript.addEventListener('load', onDone, { once: true });
    targetScript.addEventListener('error', onFail, { once: true });
    document.head.appendChild(targetScript);
  });
  const loaded = (window as GoogleWindowRef).google?.accounts?.id;
  if (!loaded) throw new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_UNAVAILABLE');
  return loaded;
}

export async function mountKineticGoogleGisWidget(params: {
  container: HTMLElement;
  nonceHash: string;
  onCredential: (idToken: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onError: (err: Error) => void;
  locale?: string;
  isAborted?: () => boolean;
}): Promise<() => void> {
  const gisId = await loadGoogleIdentityServicesSdk();
  if (params.isAborted?.()) return () => {};
  const clientId = resolveGoogleWebClientId();
  let consumed = false;
  gisId.initialize({
    client_id: clientId,
    nonce: params.nonceHash,
    ux_mode: 'popup',
    auto_select: false,
    context: 'signin',
    use_fedcm_for_prompt: true,
    itp_support: true,
    callback: async (resp: { credential?: string }) => {
      if (consumed || params.isAborted?.()) return;
      consumed = true;
      const idToken = String(resp?.credential || '').trim();
      const claims = validateGoogleIdTokenClaims(idToken, {
        expectedNonceHash: params.nonceHash,
        expectedClientId: clientId,
      });
      if (!claims.ok) {
        params.onError(new Error('OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID'));
        return;
      }
      await params.onCredential(idToken);
    },
  });
  if (params.isAborted?.()) return () => {};
  gisId.renderButton(params.container, {
    theme: 'filled_black',
    size: 'large',
    shape: 'pill',
    text: 'continue_with',
    width: 280,
    locale: params.locale || 'es',
  });
  try {
    if (!params.isAborted?.()) gisId.prompt();
  } catch {}
  return () => {
    consumed = true;
    try { gisId.cancel?.(); } catch {}
  };
}

export async function runWebGoogleGisSignIn(
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  options?: {
    onBeforeTokenExchange?: () => void;
    registerCleanup?: (cleanupFn: (() => void) | null) => void;
  }
): Promise<{ status: 'success'; user: User; session: Session } | { status: 'cancelled' }> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    throw new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_WEB_ONLY');
  }
  if (String(window.location.hostname || '').toLowerCase() === 'www.kineticapp.com.mx') {
    window.location.replace(`${KINETIC_CANONICAL_ORIGIN}/login`);
    return { status: 'cancelled' };
  }
  const isEn = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';
  const challenge = generateOidcNonceAndState('web', mode);

  return new Promise<{ status: 'success'; user: User; session: Session } | { status: 'cancelled' }>((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    let aborted = false;
    let cancelGis: () => void = () => {};
    document.getElementById('kinetic-google-gis-overlay')?.remove();

    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'kinetic-google-gis-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText =
      'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999999;background:rgba(5,5,5,0.82);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;';

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText =
      'width:100%;max-width:360px;background:#090C12;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.45);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);color:#FFFFFF;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;text-align:center;';

    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.textContent = isEn ? 'Continue with Google' : 'Continuar con Google';
    title.style.cssText = 'font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.3px;margin-bottom:6px;';

    const subtitle = document.createElement('div');
    subtitle.textContent = 'Kinetic • kineticapp.com.mx';
    subtitle.style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:#94A3B8;margin-bottom:18px;';

    const btnHost = document.createElement('div');
    btnHost.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;margin-bottom:16px;';

    const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
    cancelBtn.type = 'button';
    cancelBtn.textContent = isEn ? 'Cancel' : 'Cancelar';
    cancelBtn.style.cssText =
      'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);color:#CBD5E1;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;';

    const cleanup = () => {
      aborted = true;
      options?.registerCleanup?.(null);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      clearTimeout(maxTimer);
      cancelGis();
      overlay.remove();
    };
    const onCancel = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      resolve({ status: 'cancelled' });
    };
    options?.registerCleanup?.(onCancel);
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); };
    const maxTimer = setTimeout(onCancel, 180_000);
    cancelBtn.onclick = onCancel;
    overlay.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) onCancel(); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);

    card.append(title, subtitle, btnHost, cancelBtn);
    overlay.appendChild(card);
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    mountKineticGoogleGisWidget({
      container: btnHost,
      nonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      locale: isEn ? 'en' : 'es',
      isAborted: () => aborted || settled,
      onError: (err) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        reject(err);
      },
      onCredential: async (idToken) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        try {
          options?.onBeforeTokenExchange?.();
          const { data, error } = await exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
          if (error) { reject(error); return; }
          if (!data?.user || !data?.session) { reject(new Error('OIDC_SESSION_EMPTY')); return; }
          resolve({ status: 'success', user: data.user, session: data.session });
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      },
    })
      .then((dispose) => {
        if (aborted || settled) { dispose(); return; }
        cancelGis = dispose;
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        reject(err);
      });
  });
}
