import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import Constants from 'expo-constants';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { sha256HexSync } from './terminalSpeiAndStudioService';

const DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID =
  '702074850389-v61e4bbha3nc7m0cch2si5panjnqt7r1.apps.googleusercontent.com';
export const KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID = 'com.kineticapp.mx';
export const KINETIC_CANONICAL_ORIGIN = 'https://kineticapp.com.mx';
export const KINETIC_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI = 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth';
export const KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK = 'kinetic://login';
export const PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_KEY = '@kinetic_pending_oidc_challenge_v1';

const PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const OIDC_STATE_RE = /^knt1\.(web|native)\.(b2c|b2b)\.([0-9a-f]{32})$/;
const SHA256_HEX_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const JWT_3_PARTS_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}$/;
const POISONED_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
const GOOGLE_ISSUERS = new Set(['https://accounts.google.com', 'accounts.google.com']);

let _nativeOidcFlowSeq = 0;
let _activeNativeOidcFlowId: number | null = null;
let _capturedNativeOidcUrl: string | null = null;
let _challengeLock: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

const withChallengeLock = <T,>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
  const next = _challengeLock.then(fn, fn);
  _challengeLock = next.then(() => undefined, () => undefined);
  return next;
};

export const beginNativeOidcFlow = (): number => {
  _nativeOidcFlowSeq += 1;
  _activeNativeOidcFlowId = _nativeOidcFlowSeq;
  _capturedNativeOidcUrl = null;
  return _activeNativeOidcFlowId;
};
export const endNativeOidcFlow = (flowId?: number): void => {
  if (flowId === undefined || _activeNativeOidcFlowId === flowId) {
    _activeNativeOidcFlowId = null;
  }
};
export const setNativeOidcFlowInFlight = (active: boolean): void => {
  if (active) beginNativeOidcFlow();
  else endNativeOidcFlow();
};
export const isNativeOidcFlowInFlight = (): boolean => _activeNativeOidcFlowId !== null;
export const recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl = (url: string): void => {
  if (_activeNativeOidcFlowId !== null && typeof url === 'string' && url.includes('id_token=')) {
    _capturedNativeOidcUrl = url.trim();
  }
};
export const consumeCapturedNativeOidcUrl = (): string | null => {
  const out = _capturedNativeOidcUrl;
  _capturedNativeOidcUrl = null;
  return out;
};

export interface PendingOidcChallenge {
  rawNonce: string;
  nonceHash: string;
  state: string;
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  createdAtMs: number;
}

export interface ParsedKineticOidcState {
  valid: boolean;
  platform: 'web' | 'native';
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  csrf: string;
}

export interface ExtractedGoogleIdToken {
  idToken: string;
  state: string;
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  nonce: string | null;
}

export function resolveGoogleWebClientId(): string {
  const rawEnv = process?.env?.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;
  const fromEnv = typeof rawEnv === 'string' ? rawEnv.trim() : '';
  const extraRaw = (Constants?.expoConfig?.extra as { googleWebClientId?: unknown } | undefined)?.googleWebClientId;
  const fromExtra = typeof extraRaw === 'string' ? extraRaw.trim() : '';
  const candidate = fromEnv || fromExtra || DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;
  if (
    !/^[0-9]{6,}-[a-z0-9_-]+\.apps\.googleusercontent\.com$/i.test(candidate) ||
    /secret|gocsp|supabase\.co|\s/i.test(candidate)
  ) {
    return DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;
  }
  return candidate;
}

export const KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID = resolveGoogleWebClientId();

export function sha256HexOidc(input: string): string {
  return sha256HexSync(String(input ?? '')).toLowerCase();
}

const randomHexBytes = (byteCount: number): string => {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteCount);
  const gCrypto = (globalThis as { crypto?: { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint8Array) => Uint8Array } })?.crypto;
  if (!gCrypto || typeof gCrypto.getRandomValues !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
  }
  gCrypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  return Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
};

export function generateOidcNonceAndState(
  platform: 'web' | 'native',
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'
): { rawNonce: string; nonceHash: string; state: string } {
  const safePlatform: 'web' | 'native' = platform === 'native' ? 'native' : 'web';
  const safeMode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c';
  const rawNonce = randomHexBytes(24);
  const nonceHash = sha256HexOidc(rawNonce);
  const csrf = randomHexBytes(16);
  return { rawNonce, nonceHash, state: `knt1.${safePlatform}.${safeMode}.${csrf}` };
}

export function parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(
  rawState: unknown,
  expectedState?: string | null
): ParsedKineticOidcState | null {
  if (typeof rawState !== 'string') return null;
  const clean = rawState.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 96 || POISONED_KEYS.has(clean.toLowerCase())) return null;
  const match = OIDC_STATE_RE.exec(clean);
  if (!match) return null;
  if (expectedState != null && clean !== String(expectedState).trim()) return null;
  return { valid: true, platform: match[1] as 'web' | 'native', mode: match[2] as 'b2c' | 'b2b', csrf: match[3] };
}

export function isAllowedCanonicalOidcRedirectUri(candidate: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof candidate !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = candidate.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 512 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s]/.test(clean) || clean.includes('..')) return false;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    return (
      parsed.protocol === 'https:' &&
      parsed.hostname.toLowerCase() === 'kineticapp.com.mx' &&
      !parsed.username &&
      !parsed.password
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl(params: {
  clientId?: string;
  redirectUri?: string;
  nonceHash: string;
  state: string;
}): string {
  const clientId = String(params?.clientId || KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID).trim();
  const redirectUri = String(params?.redirectUri || KINETIC_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI).trim();
  const nonceHash = String(params?.nonceHash || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(params?.state);
  if (!/^[0-9]{6,}-[a-z0-9_-]+\.apps\.googleusercontent\.com$/i.test(clientId) || /supabase\.co/i.test(clientId)) {
    throw new Error('OIDC_CLIENT_ID_INVALID');
  }
  if (!isAllowedCanonicalOidcRedirectUri(redirectUri)) {
    throw new Error('OIDC_REDIRECT_URI_FORBIDDEN');
  }
  if (!SHA256_HEX_RE.test(nonceHash)) {
    throw new Error('OIDC_NONCE_INVALID');
  }
  if (!parsedState) {
    throw new Error('OIDC_STATE_INVALID');
  }
  const url = new URL('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth');
  url.searchParams.set('client_id', clientId);
  url.searchParams.set('redirect_uri', redirectUri);
  url.searchParams.set('response_type', 'id_token');
  url.searchParams.set('scope', 'openid email profile');
  url.searchParams.set('prompt', 'select_account');
  url.searchParams.set('nonce', nonceHash);
  url.searchParams.set('state', String(params.state).trim());
  return url.toString();
}

export function buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl(params: {
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  nonceHash: string;
  state: string;
}): string {
  const safeMode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = params?.mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c';
  const nonceHash = String(params?.nonceHash || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(params?.state);
  if (!SHA256_HEX_RE.test(nonceHash) || !parsedState || parsedState.platform !== 'native') {
    throw new Error('OIDC_BRIDGE_PARAMS_INVALID');
  }
  const url = new URL(KINETIC_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI);
  url.searchParams.set('platform', 'native');
  url.searchParams.set('mode', safeMode);
  url.searchParams.set('nonce', nonceHash);
  url.searchParams.set('state', String(params.state).trim());
  return url.toString();
}

const B64_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

const decodeBase64BytesPure = (b64: string): Uint8Array | null => {
  const clean = b64.replace(/=+$/, '');
  if (clean.length % 4 === 1) return null;
  const out = new Uint8Array(Math.floor((clean.length * 3) / 4));
  let ptr = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 4) {
    const c0 = B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i]);
    const c1 = B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 1]);
    const c2 = i + 2 < clean.length ? B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 2]) : 0;
    const c3 = i + 3 < clean.length ? B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 3]) : 0;
    if (c0 < 0 || c1 < 0 || c2 < 0 || c3 < 0) return null;
    const n = (c0 << 18) | (c1 << 12) | (c2 << 6) | c3;
    out[ptr++] = (n >>> 16) & 0xff;
    if (i + 2 < clean.length) out[ptr++] = (n >>> 8) & 0xff;
    if (i + 3 < clean.length) out[ptr++] = n & 0xff;
  }
  return out;
};

const decodeBase64UrlJsonSafe = (segment: string): Record<string, unknown> | null => {
  if (!segment || typeof segment !== 'string' || segment.length > 4096) return null;
  try {
    const normalized = segment.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padLen = (4 - (normalized.length % 4)) % 4;
    const bytes = decodeBase64BytesPure(normalized + '='.repeat(padLen));
    if (!bytes) return null;
    const decoded =
      typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined'
        ? new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)
        : decodeURIComponent(escape(Array.from(bytes, (b) => String.fromCharCode(b)).join('')));
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return null;
    for (const key of Object.keys(parsed)) {
      if (POISONED_KEYS.has(key)) return null;
    }
    return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export function validateGoogleIdTokenClaims(
  idToken: unknown,
  options?: { expectedNonceHash?: string | null; expectedClientId?: string | null; nowSec?: number }
): { ok: boolean; nonce: string | null } {
  if (typeof idToken !== 'string') return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const clean = idToken.trim();
  if (!JWT_3_PARTS_RE.test(clean) || clean.length > 8192) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const parts = clean.split('.');
  const header = decodeBase64UrlJsonSafe(parts[0]);
  const payload = decodeBase64UrlJsonSafe(parts[1]);
  if (!header || !payload) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const iss = String(payload.iss || '').trim();
  if (!GOOGLE_ISSUERS.has(iss)) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const exp = Number(payload.exp);
  const nowSec = Number.isFinite(options?.nowSec) ? Number(options?.nowSec) : Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (!Number.isFinite(exp) || exp <= nowSec - 30) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const expectedAud = String(options?.expectedClientId || KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID).trim();
  if (!expectedAud) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const audMatches = Array.isArray(payload.aud)
    ? payload.aud.includes(expectedAud)
    : String(payload.aud || '').trim() === expectedAud;
  if (!audMatches) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const tokenNonce = typeof payload.nonce === 'string' ? payload.nonce.trim() : null;
  const expectedNonce = String(options?.expectedNonceHash || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!expectedNonce || !tokenNonce || tokenNonce !== expectedNonce) {
    return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  }
  return { ok: true, nonce: tokenNonce };
}

const isAllowedOidcCallbackTarget = (candidateUrl: string): boolean => {
  const clean = candidateUrl.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 8192 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s]/.test(clean) || clean.startsWith('//') || clean.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    const authority = clean.slice('kinetic://'.length).split(/[/?#]/)[0] || '';
    return !authority.includes('@') && /^kinetic:\/\/(?:login|oauth|auth\/callback)(?:[/?#].*)?$/i.test(clean);
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    return (
      parsed.protocol === 'https:' &&
      parsed.hostname.toLowerCase() === 'kineticapp.com.mx' &&
      !parsed.username &&
      !parsed.password
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export function extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(
  callbackUrl: unknown,
  options?: { expectedState?: string | null; expectedNonceHash?: string | null; expectedClientId?: string | null; nowSec?: number }
): ExtractedGoogleIdToken | null {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const cleanUrl = callbackUrl.trim();
  if (!isAllowedOidcCallbackTarget(cleanUrl)) return null;
  const qPart = cleanUrl.includes('?') ? cleanUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const hPart = cleanUrl.includes('#') ? cleanUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  let idToken = '';
  let rawState: string | null = null;
  for (const part of [hPart, qPart]) {
    if (!part) continue;
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(part);
      if (p.get('error') || p.get('error_description')) return null;
      if (!idToken && p.get('id_token')) idToken = String(p.get('id_token') || '').trim();
      if (!rawState && p.get('state')) rawState = String(p.get('state') || '').trim();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  if (!idToken || !rawState) return null;
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(rawState, options?.expectedState);
  if (!parsedState) return null;
  const claims = validateGoogleIdTokenClaims(idToken, {
    expectedNonceHash: options?.expectedNonceHash,
    expectedClientId: options?.expectedClientId,
    nowSec: options?.nowSec,
  });
  if (!claims.ok) return null;
  return { idToken, state: rawState, mode: parsedState.mode, nonce: claims.nonce };
}

export function buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink(idToken: string, state: string): string {
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(state);
  if (!parsedState || parsedState.platform !== 'native') {
    throw new Error('OIDC_NATIVE_STATE_INVALID');
  }
  if (typeof idToken !== 'string' || !JWT_3_PARTS_RE.test(idToken.trim()) || idToken.length > 8192) {
    throw new Error('OIDC_NATIVE_TOKEN_INVALID');
  }
  return `${KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK}#id_token=${encodeURIComponent(idToken.trim())}&state=${encodeURIComponent(state.trim())}`;
}

export async function persistPendingOidcChallenge(challenge: PendingOidcChallenge): Promise<void> {
  await withChallengeLock(() => AsyncStorage.setItem(PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(challenge)));
}

export async function clearPendingOidcChallenge(): Promise<void> {
  await withChallengeLock(() => AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_KEY).catch(() => {}));
}

export async function consumePendingOidcChallenge(): Promise<PendingOidcChallenge | null> {
  return withChallengeLock(async () => {
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_KEY);
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_KEY).catch(() => {});
      if (!raw) return null;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PendingOidcChallenge>;
      if (
        !parsed ||
        typeof parsed.rawNonce !== 'string' ||
        typeof parsed.nonceHash !== 'string' ||
        typeof parsed.state !== 'string' ||
        typeof parsed.createdAtMs !== 'number'
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      if (Date.now() - parsed.createdAtMs > PENDING_OIDC_CHALLENGE_TTL_MS) return null;
      if (sha256HexOidc(parsed.rawNonce) !== parsed.nonceHash.toLowerCase()) return null;
      const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(parsed.state);
      if (!parsedState) return null;
      return {
        rawNonce: parsed.rawNonce,
        nonceHash: parsed.nonceHash.toLowerCase(),
        state: parsed.state,
        mode: parsedState.mode,
        createdAtMs: parsed.createdAtMs,
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });
}

export async function exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(idToken: string, rawNonce: string) {
  return supabase.auth.signInWithIdToken({
    provider: 'google',
    token: String(idToken || '').trim(),
    nonce: String(rawNonce || '').trim(),
  });
}

export async function verifyAndExchangeNativeGoogleOidcUrl(callbackUrl: string) {
  const consumed = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
  if (!consumed) throw new Error('OIDC_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED');
  const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(callbackUrl, {
    expectedState: consumed.state,
    expectedNonceHash: consumed.nonceHash,
    expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
  });
  if (!extracted) throw new Error('OIDC_CALLBACK_INVALID');
  const authRes = await exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(extracted.idToken, consumed.rawNonce);
  if (authRes.error) throw authRes.error;
  return authRes;
}

import type { IPdfInvoiceConfig } from './kineticPdfEngine';

const rgbToCss = (rgb: [number, number, number]): string => {
  const r = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[0]) || 0)) * 255);
  const g = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[1]) || 0)) * 255);
  const b = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[2]) || 0)) * 255);
  return `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
};

export const buildNativeKineticPdfHtml = (config: IPdfInvoiceConfig): string => {
  const kpisHtml = (config.kpis || [])
    .map(
      (k) => `
      <div class="kpi-card" style="border-top: 3px solid ${rgbToCss(k.accentRgb)};">
        <div class="kpi-lbl">${escapeHtmlSafe(k.label)}</div>
        <div class="kpi-val" style="color: ${rgbToCss(k.accentRgb)};">${escapeHtmlSafe(k.value)}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">${escapeHtmlSafe(k.sub)}</div>
      </div>`
    )
    .join('');

  const headers = config.tableHeaders && config.tableHeaders.length === 8
    ? config.tableHeaders
    : ['#', 'AFILIADO / DISCIPLINA', 'ESTATUS FISCAL / CLABE', 'OPERACIÓN', 'BRUTO 100%', 'KINETIC 20%', 'RET. SAT', 'NETO SPEI'];

  const rowsHtml = (config.tableRows || [])
    .map(
      (r) => `
      <tr class="${r.hasPositivePayout ? 'row-pay' : ''}">
        <td class="mono muted">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.idx)}</td>
        <td>
          <div class="cell-main">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.afiliado)}</div>
          <div class="cell-sub">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.disciplina)}</div>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div class="cell-main">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.rfcStatus)}</div>
          <div class="cell-sub mono">CLABE: ${escapeHtmlSafe(r.clabe)}</div>
        </td>
        <td>${escapeHtmlSafe(r.operacion)}</td>
        <td class="num">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.bruto)}</td>
        <td class="num purple">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.kinetic20)}</td>
        <td class="num red">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.retSat)}</td>
        <td class="num ${r.hasPositivePayout ? 'green bold' : 'muted'}">${escapeHtmlSafe(r.netoSpei)}</td>
      </tr>`
    )
    .join('');

  const tableSectionHtml =
    rowsHtml.length > 0
      ? `
      <div class="section-title">${escapeHtmlSafe(config.tableSectionTitle || 'DESGLOSE CONTABLE Y BANCARIO (1 KC = $1.00 MXN)')}</div>
      <table>
        <thead><tr>${headers.map((h) => `<th>${escapeHtmlSafe(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead>

          </div>`
          )

    )
    .join('');

  const footerLines = (config.footerLegal || [])
    .map((ln, idx) => `<div class="${idx === 0 ? 'foot-emisor' : 'foot-note'}">${escapeHtmlSafe(ln)}</div>`)
    .join('');

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { isMasterPass0Kc } from './adminB2BCutEngine';

const ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES = new Set(['activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada']);
const DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES = 45;
export const NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES = 180;

let _lastSilentReconcileAtMs = 0;

export const isPassExpiredWithoutCheckIn = (
  reserva: any,
  matchedSrv?: any,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES
): boolean => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return false;
  if (reserva.qr_usado_at || reserva.checked_in_at) return false;
  const st = String(reserva.estado || 'activa').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES.has(st)) return false;
  const safeGrace = Math.min(1440, Math.max(30, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES)));
  const rawHora = String(
    reserva.hora_inicio || reserva.hora || matchedSrv?.hora_inicio || '08:00'
  ).trim();
  const candidates = [
    reserva.fecha_clase,
    reserva.fecha_programada,
    matchedSrv?.fecha,
    reserva.fecha_hora,
    reserva.fecha,
    reserva.created_at,
  ];
  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const raw = String(cand || '').trim();
    if (!raw) continue;
    const synthetic = {
      fecha_hora: raw,
      fecha_clase: raw,
      hora_inicio: rawHora,
    };
    const deadlineMs = parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs(synthetic, safeGrace);
    if (deadlineMs !== null && Number.isFinite(deadlineMs)) {
      return nowMs >= deadlineMs;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

export const reconcileExpiredNoShowPassesSilent = async (force = false): Promise<void> => {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!force && now - _lastSilentReconcileAtMs < 45_000) return;
  _lastSilentReconcileAtMs = now;
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('reconciliar_reservas_expiradas_noshow');
    if (error) {
      await supabase.rpc('ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40', {
        p_reserva_id: null,
        p_minutos_gracia: NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES,
      });
    }
  } catch {}
};

export interface INoShowSummary {
  eligibleIds: string[];
  eligibleCount: number;
  totalEscrow40Kc: number;
  venueNet80Mxn: number;
  kineticFee20Mxn: number;
}

export const parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs = (
  reserva: any,
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): number | null => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return null;
  const safeGraceMin = Math.min(1440, Math.max(5, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES)));
  const graceMs = safeGraceMin * 60_000;

  const rawHora = String(reserva.hora_inicio || reserva.hora || '').trim();
  const horaMatch = rawHora.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  const hh = horaMatch ? Math.min(23, Math.max(0, Number(horaMatch[1]))) : 23;
  const mm = horaMatch ? Math.min(59, Math.max(0, Number(horaMatch[2]))) : 59;

  const candidates = [reserva.fecha_hora, reserva.fecha_clase, reserva.fecha];
  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const raw = String(cand || '').trim();
    if (!raw) continue;
    const dayMatch = raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|[T\s](.+))?/);
    if (dayMatch) {
      const timePart = (dayMatch[4] || '').trim();
      const isDateOrMidnight =
        !timePart || /^00:00(?::00(?:\.\d+)?)?(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?$/i.test(timePart);
      if (isDateOrMidnight) {
        const y = Number(dayMatch[1]);
        const m = Number(dayMatch[2]) - 1;
        const d = Number(dayMatch[3]);
        const dt = new Date(y, m, d, hh, mm, 0, 0);
        if (!Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) {
          return dt.getTime() + graceMs;
        }
        continue;
      }
    }
    const parsed = Date.parse(raw);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
      return parsed + graceMs;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

export const isReservationEligibleForNoShow40 = (
  reserva: any,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): boolean => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return false;
  if (!reserva.id) return false;
  const st = String(reserva.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES.has(st)) return false;
  if (isMasterPass0Kc(reserva)) return false;
  const escrowKc = Number(reserva.monto_escrow) || 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(escrowKc) || escrowKc <= 0) return false;
  const deadlineMs = parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs(reserva, graceMinutes);
  if (deadlineMs === null || !Number.isFinite(deadlineMs)) return false;
  return nowMs >= deadlineMs;
};

export const summarizePendingNoShowContracts = (
  reservas: any[] = [],
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): INoShowSummary => {
  const eligibleIds: string[] = [];
  let totalCents = 0;

  for (const r of reservas || []) {
    if (!isReservationEligibleForNoShow40(r, nowMs, graceMinutes)) continue;
    const idStr = String(r.id || '').trim();
    if (!idStr) continue;
    eligibleIds.push(idStr);
    const escrow = Math.max(0, Number(r.monto_escrow) || 0);
    totalCents += Math.round(escrow * 100);
  }

  const feeCents = Math.round(totalCents * 0.2);
  const netCents = totalCents - feeCents;

  return {
    eligibleIds,
    eligibleCount: eligibleIds.length,
    totalEscrow40Kc: totalCents / 100,
    venueNet80Mxn: netCents / 100,
    kineticFee20Mxn: feeCents / 100,
  };
};

export const formatNoShowSweepResultMessage = (
  res: { procesadas: number; escrow_retenido_kc: number },
  isEn: boolean
): string =>
  res.procesadas > 0
    ? isEn
      ? `Settled ${res.procesadas} expired bookings keeping ${res.escrow_retenido_kc} KC (80% venue / 20% Kinetic) without charging the 60% door balance.`
      : `Se liquidaron ${res.procesadas} reservas vencidas reteniendo ${res.escrow_retenido_kc} KC (80% sede / 20% Kinetic) sin cobrar el 60% de puerta.`
    : isEn
      ? 'No eligible expired bookings (>45 min grace) were ready to settle in this sweep.'
      : 'No hubo reservas elegibles vencidas (>45 min de gracia) para liquidar en este corte.';

export const computeOptimisticNoShowState = (
  reservasActivas: any[] = [],
  prevKpis: any = {},
  targetReservaId?: string | null,
  sweepResult?: { procesadas?: number; escrow_retenido_kc?: number } | null,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): { nextReservasActivas: any[]; nextKpis: any } => {
  const cleanId = String(targetReservaId || '').trim();
  const procesadas = Number(sweepResult?.procesadas) || 0;
  if (procesadas <= 0) {
    return { nextReservasActivas: reservasActivas, nextKpis: prevKpis };
  }
  const removedIds = new Set<string>();
  let removedEscrow = 0;
  const nextReservasActivas = (reservasActivas || []).filter((r: any) => {
    const rid = String(r?.id || '').trim();
    const shouldDrop = cleanId ? rid === cleanId : isReservationEligibleForNoShow40(r, nowMs, graceMinutes);
    if (shouldDrop) {
      if (rid) removedIds.add(rid);
      removedEscrow += Math.max(0, Number(r?.monto_escrow) || 0);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  const capturedKc = Math.max(removedEscrow, Number(sweepResult?.escrow_retenido_kc) || 0);
  const nextEscrowTotal = Math.max(0, (Number(prevKpis?.escrowTotal) || 0) - capturedKc);
  const nextLiquidity = (Number(prevKpis?.liquidezTotalCapturada) || 0) + capturedKc;
  return {
    nextReservasActivas,
    nextKpis: {
      ...prevKpis,
      escrowTotal: nextEscrowTotal,
      liquidezTotalCapturada: nextLiquidity,
      comisionKinetic20: Math.round(nextLiquidity * 0.2),
      reservasActivasCount: nextReservasActivas.length,
    },
  };
};

export const executeNoShow40Sweep = async (
  reservaId?: string | null,
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; procesadas: number; escrow_retenido_kc: number }> => {
  const safeGrace = Math.min(1440, Math.max(5, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES)));
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40', {
    p_reserva_id: reservaId || null,
    p_minutos_gracia: safeGrace,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return {
    ok: Boolean((data as any)?.ok ?? true),
    procesadas: Math.max(0, Number((data as any)?.procesadas) || 0),
    escrow_retenido_kc: Math.max(0, Number((data as any)?.escrow_retenido_kc) || 0),
  };
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Alert } from 'react-native';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { registerOptimisticActivePass, syncActivePassesSnapshot } from './bovedaRealtimeSync';
import { exploreService } from './exploreService';
import { resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing } from './kineticFlashSaleHelper';
import { computeSplitEscrow1NMath, persistSelectedSpotSession, rehydratePersistedSpotForEvent } from './kineticSplitPreBookingStore';
import { createSplitEscrowInvites } from './splitEscrowInvitesService';
import {
  clearSpotLockAndIntent,
  normalizeLocalIsoDate,
  resolveClientPickedSpot,
  SPOT_COLLISION_ERROR_CODE,
} from './spotCollisionService';
import { parseTerminalQrPacket } from './terminalSpeiAndStudioService';

const BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_boveda_res_v2_';
export const BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY = '@kinetic_boveda_passes_cache_v1';
const RADAR_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_radar_snapshot_v2';

const bovedaMemoryStore: Record<string, any[]> = {};
const bovedaLastFetchedStore: Record<string, number> = {};
const bovedaSubscribers = new Map<string, Set<(rows: any[]) => void>>();

const notifyBovedaSubscribers = (uid: string, rows: any[]) => {
  const subs = bovedaSubscribers.get(uid);
  if (!subs) return;
  subs.forEach((cb) => {
    try {
      cb(rows);
    } catch {}
  });
};

export const getBovedaSWRReservas = (uid?: string): any[] | undefined =>
  uid ? bovedaMemoryStore[uid] : undefined;

export const getBovedaSWRLastFetchedAt = (uid?: string): number =>
  (uid && bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid]) || 0;

export const resetBovedaSWRLastFetchedAt = (uid?: string): void => {
  if (uid) bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = 0;
};

export const setBovedaSWRReservas = (uid: string, rows: any[], markFresh = true): void => {
  if (!uid) return;
  const existingOptimistic = (bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || []).filter((r) => r?.isOptimistic);
  const realIds = new Set(rows.map((r) => String(r?.id || '')));
  const realTokens = new Set(rows.map((r) => String(r?.qr_token || '')).filter(Boolean));
  const survivingOptimistic = existingOptimistic.filter(
    (opt) => !realIds.has(String(opt.id)) && (!opt.qr_token || !realTokens.has(String(opt.qr_token)))
  );
  const merged = survivingOptimistic.length > 0 ? [...survivingOptimistic, ...rows] : rows;
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = merged;
  if (markFresh) bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = Date.now();
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, merged);
  AsyncStorage.setItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY, JSON.stringify({ userId: uid, passes: merged, updatedAt: Date.now() })).catch(() => {});
  AsyncStorage.setItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`, JSON.stringify(rows)).catch(() => {});
};

export const subscribeBovedaSWR = (uid: string, cb: (rows: any[]) => void): (() => void) => {
  if (!uid) return () => {};
  let set = bovedaSubscribers.get(uid);
  if (!set) {
    set = new Set();
    bovedaSubscribers.set(uid, set);
  }
  set.add(cb);
  return () => {
    set?.delete(cb);
  };
};

export const hydrateBovedaSWRFromStorage = async (uid: string): Promise<any[] | null> => {
  if (!uid) return null;
  if (bovedaMemoryStore[uid] !== undefined) return bovedaMemoryStore[uid];
  try {
    const rawV1 = await AsyncStorage.getItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY);
    if (rawV1) {
      const parsedV1 = JSON.parse(rawV1);
      const v1Passes =
        parsedV1?.userId === uid && Array.isArray(parsedV1?.passes)
          ? parsedV1.passes
          : Array.isArray(parsedV1)
            ? parsedV1.filter((r: any) => !r?.usuario_id || String(r.usuario_id) === uid)
            : null;
      if (v1Passes && bovedaMemoryStore[uid] === undefined) {
        bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = v1Passes;
        notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, v1Passes);
        return v1Passes;
      }
    }
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed) && bovedaMemoryStore[uid] === undefined) {
      bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = parsed;
      notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, parsed);
      return parsed;
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
};

export const hydrateExploreSWRFromStorage = async (): Promise<{
  afiliados: any[];
  servicios: any[];
} | null> => {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(RADAR_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed?.afiliados) && parsed.afiliados.length > 0) {
      return {
        afiliados: parsed.afiliados,
        servicios: Array.isArray(parsed.servicios) ? parsed.servicios : [],
      };
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
};

export const prependBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, pass: any): void => {
  if (!uid || !pass) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const next = [pass, ...current.filter((r) => r?.id !== pass.id)];
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next);
};

export const commitBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, tempId: string, realRow: any): void => {
  if (!uid) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const next = current.map((r) => {
    if (r?.id !== tempId) return r;
    const resolvedDate = realRow?.fecha_clase ? normalizeLocalIsoDate(realRow.fecha_clase) : r.fecha_clase || r.fecha;
    const resolvedHora = String(realRow?.hora_inicio || realRow?.hora || r.hora_inicio || r.hora || '08:00').substring(0, 5);
    return {
      ...r,
      ...(realRow || {}),
      id: realRow?.id || r.id,
      qr_token: realRow?.qr_token || r.qr_token,
      fecha_clase: resolvedDate,
      fecha: resolvedDate,
      hora: resolvedHora,
      hora_inicio: resolvedHora,
      fecha_programada: `${resolvedDate}T${resolvedHora}:00`,
      spot_number: realRow?.spot_number ?? r.spot_number ?? null,
      isOptimistic: false,
    };
  });
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = Date.now();
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next);
};

export const removeBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, tempId: string): void => {
  if (!uid) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const next = current.filter((r) => r?.id !== tempId);
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next);
};

export interface IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions {
  user: any;
  profile: any;
  ev: any;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  fechaClase?: string | null;
  selectedDate?: string | null;
  selectedSpot?: number | null;
  spot?: number | null;
  activateResilientSession: (user: any, profile: any) => void;
  refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>;
  onOptimisticSeatDelta?: (evId: string, delta: number) => void;
  onInstantBooked?: (esc: number) => void;
  onSilentRevalidate?: () => Promise<any>;
  onRollbackError?: (errMessage: string) => void;
  fallbackTitle?: string;
}

const _inFlightOptimisticBookings = new Set<string>();

export const executeOptimisticEscrowBooking = async ({
  user,
  profile,
  ev,
  isAdmin,
  fechaClase,
  selectedDate,
  selectedSpot,
  spot,
  activateResilientSession,
  refreshProfile,
  onOptimisticSeatDelta,
  onInstantBooked,
  onSilentRevalidate,
  onRollbackError,
  fallbackTitle = 'RESERVA REVERTIDA',
}: IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (!user?.id || !ev) return false;
  const servicioNombre = ev.nombre_servicio || ev.titulo || ev.servicio || 'Experiencia Kinetic';
  const fechaBase = normalizeLocalIsoDate(
    fechaClase || selectedDate || ev.fecha_clase || ev.selectedDate || ev.fecha_proyectada || ev.fecha
  );
  const inFlightKey = `${user.id}::${String(ev.id || servicioNombre)}::${fechaBase}`;
  if (_inFlightOptimisticBookings.has(inFlightKey)) return false;
  _inFlightOptimisticBookings.add(inFlightKey);

  try {
    const fp = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
      event: { ...ev, fecha_clase: fechaBase },
      vipLevel: profile?.nivel,
      kcMembresia: profile?.kc_membresia,
      isAdmin,
    });
    const total = isAdmin ? 0 : fp.discountedTotalKc;
    const splitCount = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Number(ev?.split_count || ev?.splitCount) || 1));
    const splitGuests = Array.isArray(ev?.splitGuests) ? ev.splitGuests : [];
    const splitMath = computeSplitEscrow1NMath(total, splitCount, fp.escrow40, isAdmin);
    const esc = isAdmin ? 0 : splitMath.effectiveEscrowKc;
    const pta = isAdmin ? 0 : splitMath.effectiveDoorKc;
    const isZeroKcPass = isAdmin || total <= 0 || esc <= 0;
    const memActual = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.kc_membresia) || 0);
    const topActual = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.kc_topup) || 0);
    const descMem = isZeroKcPass ? 0 : Math.min(memActual, esc);
    const descTop = isZeroKcPass ? 0 : Math.max(0, esc - descMem);
    const pickedSpot =
      selectedSpot ?? spot ?? ev.selectedSpot ?? ev.spot_number ?? ev.spot ??
      rehydratePersistedSpotForEvent(fechaBase ? `${ev.id}::${fechaBase}` : ev.id, fechaBase ? `${servicioNombre}::${fechaBase}` : servicioNombre) ??
      resolveClientPickedSpot(ev.id, servicioNombre);

    const inserted = await exploreService.procesarReservaEscrow(
      user.id,
      { ...ev, fecha: fechaBase, fecha_clase: fechaBase, selectedDate: fechaBase, spot_number: pickedSpot ?? null },
      esc,
      pta,
      { fechaClase: fechaBase, spotNumber: pickedSpot ?? null, splitCount }
    );

    if (!isZeroKcPass && profile) {
      activateResilientSession(user, {
        ...profile,
        kc_membresia: Math.max(0, memActual - descMem),
        kc_topup: Math.max(0, topActual - descTop),
      });
    }

    const rawNegocioNombre = String(ev.negocio_nombre || ev.club || 'Kinetic Oficial').trim();
    const negocioNombre =
      rawNegocioNombre.toLowerCase() === 'terminal global kinetic' || !rawNegocioNombre
        ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
        : rawNegocioNombre;
    const horaBase = String(ev.hora_inicio || ev.hora || '08:00').substring(0, 5);
    const fechaIso = `${fechaBase}T${horaBase}:00`;
    const insertedObj = inserted && typeof inserted === 'object' ? (inserted as { reserva_id?: unknown; id?: unknown; created_at?: string }) : null;
    const insertedId = String(insertedObj?.reserva_id || insertedObj?.id || '').trim();
    if (!insertedId) {
      throw new Error('No se recibió confirmación válida de reserva desde el servidor.');
    }
    const confirmedPass = {
      id: insertedId,
      ...(insertedObj || {}),
      isOptimistic: false,
      usuario_id: user.id,
      servicio_id: ev.id ?? null,
      negocio_nombre: negocioNombre,
      servicio: servicioNombre,
      nombre_servicio: servicioNombre,
      titulo_clase: servicioNombre,
      categoria: ev.categoria || ev.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
      estado: 'confirmada',
      costo_total: total,
      precio_kc: total,
      monto_escrow: esc,
      monto_puerta: pta,
      saldo_pendiente_mxn: isZeroKcPass ? 0 : pta,
      escrow_membresia: descMem,
      escrow_topup: descTop,
      fecha: fechaBase,
      fecha_clase: fechaBase,
      fecha_hora: fechaIso,
      fecha_programada: fechaIso,
      hora: horaBase,
      hora_inicio: horaBase,
      spot_number: pickedSpot ?? null,
      duracion_minutos: Number(ev.duracion_minutos || ev.duracion_min || 60),
      instructor_nombre: ev.instructor_nombre || ev.coach || 'Coach Oficial Kinetic',
      ubicacion: ev.ubicacion || 'Sede Verificada Kinetic',
      created_at: insertedObj?.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    prependBovedaOptimisticPass(user.id, confirmedPass);
    registerOptimisticActivePass(user.id, ev, fechaBase);
    if (ev.id) onOptimisticSeatDelta?.(String(ev.id), 1);
    persistSelectedSpotSession(ev.id, null, servicioNombre, fechaBase);
    if (splitCount > 1 && splitGuests.length > 0 && insertedId) {
      void createSplitEscrowInvites({
        reservaId: insertedId,
        eventId: ev.id,
        title: servicioNombre,
        anfitrionId: user.id,
        invitados: splitGuests,
        montoKcParte: esc,
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
    triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn');
    onInstantBooked?.(esc);
    await Promise.allSettled([refreshProfile?.(), onSilentRevalidate?.()]);
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const errRec = err && typeof err === 'object' ? (err as { code?: unknown; message?: string }) : null;
    if (errRec?.code === SPOT_COLLISION_ERROR_CODE) {
      clearSpotLockAndIntent(ev.id, servicioNombre);
      persistSelectedSpotSession(ev.id, null, servicioNombre, fechaBase);
    }
    triggerHaptic('Error');
    const msg = errRec?.message || 'Cupo agotado o error en servidor. No se realizó ningún cargo.';
    if (onRollbackError) {
      onRollbackError(msg);
    } else {
      Alert.alert(fallbackTitle, msg);
    }
    return false;
  } finally {
    _inFlightOptimisticBookings.delete(inFlightKey);
  }
};

export const parseAndValidateTerminalQr = (
  raw: string,
  nowSynced: number,
  tr: (es: string, en: string) => string
): string => {
  const trimmedRaw = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!trimmedRaw) {
    throw new Error(tr('Ingresa o escanea una llave QR o folio válido.', 'Enter or scan a valid QR key or folio.'));
  }
  const pkt = parseTerminalQrPacket(trimmedRaw, nowSynced);
  if (pkt.isExpired) {
    throw new Error(
      tr(
        'Llave QR expirada (más de 60s). Pídele al atleta que muestre su Bóveda activa.',
        'Expired QR key (over 60s). Ask the athlete to display their active Vault pass.'
      )
    );
  }
  if (!pkt.ok || !pkt.qrIdentifier) {
    throw new Error(tr('Formato de llave QR inválido o ajeno a Kinetic.', 'Invalid or non-Kinetic QR key format.'));
  }
  return pkt.qrIdentifier;
};

function utf8ToBytes(str: string): Uint8Array {
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') return new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const encoded = unescape(encodeURIComponent(str));
  return Uint8Array.from(encoded, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
}

export function sha256BytesSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const bitLen = data.length * 8;
  const paddedLen = (((data.length + 8) >> 6) + 1) * 64;
  const words = new Int32Array(paddedLen >> 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 1) {
    words[i >> 2] |= (data[i] & 0xff) << (24 - (i % 4) * 8);
  }
  words[data.length >> 2] |= 0x80 << (24 - (data.length % 4) * 8);
  words[words.length - 2] = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  words[words.length - 1] = bitLen >>> 0;

  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const rotr = (n: number, x: number) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const w = new Int32Array(64);
  for (let j = 0; j < words.length; j += 16) {
    let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h] = H;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) {
      w[i] =
        i < 16
          ? words[j + i]
          : ((rotr(17, w[i - 2]) ^ rotr(19, w[i - 2]) ^ (w[i - 2] >>> 10)) +
              w[i - 7] +
              (rotr(7, w[i - 15]) ^ rotr(18, w[i - 15]) ^ (w[i - 15] >>> 3)) +
              w[i - 16]) |
            0;
      const t1 = (h + (rotr(6, e) ^ rotr(11, e) ^ rotr(25, e)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + SHA256_K[i] + w[i]) | 0;
      const t2 = ((rotr(2, a) ^ rotr(13, a) ^ rotr(22, a)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c))) | 0;
      [h, g, f, e, d, c, b, a] = [g, f, e, (d + t1) | 0, c, b, a, (t1 + t2) | 0];
    }
    const vals = [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k += 1) H[k] = (H[k] + vals[k]) | 0;
  }
  const out = new Uint8Array(32);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
    out[i * 4] = (H[i] >>> 24) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 1] = (H[i] >>> 16) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 2] = (H[i] >>> 8) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 3] = H[i] & 0xff;
  }
  return out;
}

export function hmacSha256HexSync(secret: string, message: string): string {
  let keyBytes = utf8ToBytes(secret);
  if (keyBytes.length > 64) keyBytes = sha256BytesSync(keyBytes);
  const block = new Uint8Array(64);
  block.set(keyBytes);

  const msgBytes = utf8ToBytes(message);
  const inner = new Uint8Array(64 + msgBytes.length);
  const outer = new Uint8Array(64 + 32);
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) {
    inner[i] = block[i] ^ 0x36;
    outer[i] = block[i] ^ 0x5c;
  }
  inner.set(msgBytes, 64);
  outer.set(sha256BytesSync(inner), 64);
  return Array.from(sha256BytesSync(outer), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

function timingSafeHexEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length || a.length === 0) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 1) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

export function verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync(input: {
  rawBody: string;
  signatureHeader: string;
  webhookSecret: string;
  nowEpochSec: number;
  toleranceSec?: number;
}): { ok: boolean; reason?: string; timestampSec?: number } {
  const { rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret, nowEpochSec } = input;
  const tol = typeof input.toleranceSec === 'number' && input.toleranceSec > 0 ? input.toleranceSec : 300;
  if (!webhookSecret || !signatureHeader || typeof rawBody !== 'string') return { ok: false, reason: 'missing_inputs' };

  const parts = signatureHeader.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  let timestampSec = -1;
  const v1List: string[] = [];
  for (const part of parts) {
    const eqIdx = part.indexOf('=');
    if (eqIdx <= 0) continue;
    const k = part.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
    const v = part.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (k === 't' && /^\d+$/.test(v)) timestampSec = Number(v);
    if (k === 'v1' && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(v)) v1List.push(v);
  }
  if (timestampSec <= 0 || v1List.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'malformed_signature_header' };
  if (Math.abs(nowEpochSec - timestampSec) > tol) return { ok: false, reason: 'timestamp_outside_tolerance', timestampSec };

  const expected = hmacSha256HexSync(webhookSecret, `${timestampSec}.${rawBody}`);
  const match = v1List.some((sig) => timingSafeHexEqual(sig, expected));
  return match ? { ok: true, timestampSec } : { ok: false, reason: 'signature_mismatch', timestampSec };
}

export function createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor() {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  let totalKcCredited = 0;
  let processedCount = 0;
  return {
    process(eventId: string, kcAmount: number): { status: 'processed' | 'duplicate_ignored' | 'rejected'; totalKcCredited: number; processedCount: number } {
      const cleanId = String(eventId || '').trim();
      if (cleanId.length < 4 || !Number.isSafeInteger(kcAmount) || kcAmount <= 0 || kcAmount % 10 !== 0) {
        return { status: 'rejected', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
      }
      if (seen.has(cleanId)) return { status: 'duplicate_ignored', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
      seen.add(cleanId);
      totalKcCredited += kcAmount;
      processedCount += 1;
      return { status: 'processed', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
    },
  };
}

export function createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter(maxHits: number, windowSeconds: number) {
  const safeMax = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxHits));
  const safeWin = Math.max(1, Math.floor(windowSeconds));
  const windows = new Map<string, { windowStartSec: number; hitCount: number }>();
  return {
    consume(scope: string, actorKey: string, nowSec: number): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterSeconds: number } {
      const key = `${String(scope)}\u0000${String(actorKey)}`;
      const existing = windows.get(key);
      if (!existing || nowSec >= existing.windowStartSec + safeWin) {
        windows.set(key, { windowStartSec: nowSec, hitCount: 1 });
        return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.max(0, safeMax - 1), retryAfterSeconds: 0 };
      }
      if (existing.hitCount < safeMax) {
        existing.hitCount += 1;
        return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.max(0, safeMax - existing.hitCount), retryAfterSeconds: 0 };
      }
      const retry = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(existing.windowStartSec + safeWin - nowSec));
      return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterSeconds: retry };
    },
  };
}

export function createSingleUseQrNonceGuard() {
  const consumedReservas = new Set<string>();
  const consumedStepNonces = new Set<string>();
  return {
    consume(reservaId: string, totpStep: number, qrNonce?: string | null): boolean {
      const cleanRes = String(reservaId || '').trim();
      if (!cleanRes || consumedReservas.has(cleanRes)) return false;
      const cleanNonce = String(qrNonce || '').trim();
      const stepNonceKey = cleanNonce && cleanNonce !== String(totpStep) ? `${totpStep}\u0000${cleanNonce}` : '';
      if (stepNonceKey && consumedStepNonces.has(stepNonceKey)) return false;
      consumedReservas.add(cleanRes);
      if (stepNonceKey) consumedStepNonces.add(stepNonceKey);
      return true;
    },
  };
}

export type ConcurrentSimOp =
  | { kind: 'reserve'; precioKc: number }
  | { kind: 'claim_reward'; retoId: string; kcReward: number }
  | { kind: 'cancel_one' };

export function simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(
  initialCap: number,
  initialMemKc: number,
  initialTopKc: number,
  ops: ConcurrentSimOp[]
) {
  const cap = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialCap));
  let memKc = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialMemKc / 10) * 10);
  let topKc = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialTopKc / 10) * 10);
  let inscritos = 0;
  let acceptedBookings = 0;
  let rejectedCupo = 0;
  let duplicateClaims = 0;
  const claimedRetos = new Set<string>();

  for (const op of ops) {
    if (op.kind === 'reserve') {
      if (inscritos >= cap) { rejectedCupo += 1; continue; }
      const rawPrice = Math.max(0, Math.floor(op.precioKc));
      if (rawPrice % 10 !== 0) continue;
      const escrow = Math.round(rawPrice * 0.4);
      if (memKc + topKc < escrow) continue;
      const useMem = Math.min(memKc, escrow);
      const useTop = escrow - useMem;
      memKc -= useMem;
      topKc -= useTop;
      inscritos += 1;
      acceptedBookings += 1;
    } else if (op.kind === 'claim_reward') {
      const key = String(op.retoId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!key) continue;
      if (claimedRetos.has(key)) { duplicateClaims += 1; continue; }
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(op.kcReward) || op.kcReward < 0 || op.kcReward % 10 !== 0 || op.kcReward > 50) continue;
      claimedRetos.add(key);
      topKc += op.kcReward;
    } else if (op.kind === 'cancel_one' && inscritos > 0) {
      inscritos -= 1;
    }
  }
  return {
    cap,
    inscritos,
    memKc,
    topKc,
    totalKc: memKc + topKc,
    acceptedBookings,
    rejectedCupo,
    duplicateClaims,
    claimedCount: claimedRetos.size,
  };
}

import { Platform, Share } from 'react-native';
import * as Print from 'expo-print';
import * as Sharing from 'expo-sharing';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { buildNativeKineticPdfHtml } from './kineticNativePdfHtmlBuilder';

const toPdfSafeText = (input: any): string =>
  String(input ?? '')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/•/g, '-')
    .replace(/✓/g, 'OK')
    .replace(/⚡/g, '')
    .replace(/★/g, '*')
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7EÁÉÍÓÚáéíóúÑñÜü$%.,:;()/#@+\-_]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

const escapePdfLiteral = (str: string): string =>
  toPdfSafeText(str)
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
    .replace(/\(/g, '\\(')
    .replace(/\)/g, '\\)');

export const escapeHtmlSafe = (val: unknown): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

export const formatMxn = (val: number): string =>
  `$${(Number(val) || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;

export interface IPdfTableRow {
  idx: string;
  afiliado: string;
  disciplina: string;
  rfcStatus: string;
  clabe: string;
  operacion: string;
  bruto: string;
  kinetic20: string;
  retSat: string;
  netoSpei: string;
  hasPositivePayout: boolean;
}

export interface IPdfInvoiceConfig {
  docTitle: string;
  docSubtitle: string;
  folio: string;
  periodoLabel: string;
  emisorInfo: string;
  tableSectionTitle?: string;
  kpis: {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    sub: string;
    accentRgb: [number, number, number];
  }[];
  tableHeaders?: string[];
  tableRows?: IPdfTableRow[];
  detailBlocks?: {
    sectionTitle: string;
    lines: { label: string; value: string; highlight?: boolean }[];
  }[];
  footerLegal: string[];
}

export const buildKineticInvoicePdfBytes = (
  config: IPdfInvoiceConfig
): Uint8Array => {
  const isEn = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';
  const pageWidth = 612;
  const pageHeight = 792;
  const ROWS_PER_PAGE = 18;
  const allRows = config.tableRows || [];
  const totalPages = allRows.length > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(allRows.length / ROWS_PER_PAGE)) : 1;
  const pageStreams: string[] = [];

  for (let p = 0; p < totalPages; p++) {
    const ops: string[] = [];
    const isFirstPage = p === 0;
    const isLastPage = p === totalPages - 1;

    const drawRect = (
      x: number,
      yTop: number,
      w: number,
      h: number,
      fillRgb?: [number, number, number],
      strokeRgb?: [number, number, number],
      lineWidth = 0.8
    ) => {
      const yPdf = pageHeight - yTop - h;
      ops.push('q');
      if (fillRgb) {
        ops.push(`${fillRgb[0].toFixed(3)} ${fillRgb[1].toFixed(3)} ${fillRgb[2].toFixed(3)} rg`);
      }
      if (strokeRgb) {
        ops.push(`${strokeRgb[0].toFixed(3)} ${strokeRgb[1].toFixed(3)} ${strokeRgb[2].toFixed(3)} RG`);
        ops.push(`${lineWidth} w`);
      }
      const mode = fillRgb && strokeRgb ? 'B' : fillRgb ? 'f' : 'S';
      ops.push(`${x.toFixed(1)} ${yPdf.toFixed(1)} ${w.toFixed(1)} ${h.toFixed(1)} re ${mode}`);
      ops.push('Q');
    };

    const drawText = (
      text: string,
      x: number,
      yTop: number,
      size = 9,
      bold = false,
      rgb: [number, number, number] = [0.1, 0.12, 0.16]
    ) => {
      const yPdf = pageHeight - yTop;
      ops.push('BT');
      ops.push(`${bold ? '/F2' : '/F1'} ${size} Tf`);
      ops.push(`${rgb[0].toFixed(3)} ${rgb[1].toFixed(3)} ${rgb[2].toFixed(3)} rg`);
      ops.push(`1 0 0 1 ${x.toFixed(1)} ${yPdf.toFixed(1)} Tm`);
      ops.push(`(${escapePdfLiteral(text)}) Tj`);
      ops.push('ET');
    };

    drawRect(0, 0, pageWidth, pageHeight, [0.97, 0.98, 0.99]);

    let cursorY = 24;
    if (isFirstPage) {
      drawRect(24, 24, pageWidth - 48, 84, [0.04, 0.06, 0.1]);
      drawRect(24, 24, pageWidth - 48, 4, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
      drawRect(38, 36, 70, 18, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
      drawText('KINETIC OS', 45, 48, 9.5, true, [0.02, 0.03, 0.05]);
      drawText(config.docTitle, 116, 49, 13, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      drawText(config.docSubtitle, 38, 70, 8.5, false, [0.68, 0.75, 0.84]);
      drawText(config.emisorInfo, 38, 84, 7.5, false, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
      const pageInfo = totalPages > 1 ? `   |   PÁG 1 / ${totalPages}` : '';
      drawText(`${config.periodoLabel}   |   FOLIO: ${config.folio}${pageInfo}`, 38, 98, 7.8, true, [0.88, 0.92, 0.98]);
      cursorY = 118;

      if (config.kpis && config.kpis.length > 0) {
        const totalW = pageWidth - 48;
        const gap = 8;
        const cardW = (totalW - gap * (config.kpis.length - 1)) / config.kpis.length;
        config.kpis.forEach((kpi, idx) => {
          const cardX = 24 + idx * (cardW + gap);
          drawRect(cardX, cursorY, cardW, 54, [1, 1, 1], [0.84, 0.87, 0.92], 0.8);
          drawRect(cardX, cursorY, cardW, 3.5, kpi.accentRgb);
          drawText(kpi.label, cardX + 8, cursorY + 15, 6.8, true, [0.38, 0.43, 0.52]);
          drawText(kpi.value, cardX + 8, cursorY + 33, 12.5, true, kpi.accentRgb);
          drawText(kpi.sub, cardX + 8, cursorY + 46, 6.5, false, [0.45, 0.5, 0.58]);
        });
        cursorY += 66;
      }
    } else {
      drawRect(24, 24, pageWidth - 48, 38, [0.04, 0.06, 0.1]);
      drawRect(24, 24, pageWidth - 48, 3, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
      drawText(config.docTitle, 36, 40, 10, true, [1, 1, 1]);
      drawText(
        `FOLIO: ${config.folio}   |   ${config.periodoLabel}   |   PÁG ${p + 1} / ${totalPages}`,
        36,
        52,
        7.5,
        false,
        [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]
      );
      cursorY = 72;
    }

    if (allRows.length > 0) {
      const pageRows = allRows.slice(p * ROWS_PER_PAGE, (p + 1) * ROWS_PER_PAGE);
      const sectionHeader =
        config.tableSectionTitle ||
        (isEn
          ? 'ACCOUNTING & BANKING SPEI PAYOUT BREAKDOWN BY AFFILIATE (PARITY 1 KC = $1.00 MXN)'
          : 'DESGLOSE CONTABLE Y BANCARIO DE DISPERSIONES SPEI POR AFILIADO (PARIDAD 1 KC = $1.00 MXN)');
      drawText(sectionHeader, 24, cursorY + 4, 8.2, true, [0.08, 0.1, 0.16]);
      cursorY += 10;

      const tableX = 24;
      const tableW = pageWidth - 48;
      drawRect(tableX, cursorY, tableW, 18, [0.06, 0.08, 0.14]);
      const defaultHeaders = isEn
        ? ['#', 'AFFILIATE / DISCIPLINE', 'TAX STATUS / CLABE', 'ACTIVITY', 'GROSS 100%', 'KINETIC 20%', 'SAT TAX', 'NET SPEI']
        : ['#', 'AFILIADO / DISCIPLINA', 'ESTATUS FISCAL / CLABE', 'OPERACIÓN', 'BRUTO 100%', 'KINETIC 20%', 'RET. SAT', 'NETO SPEI'];
      const hdrs = config.tableHeaders && config.tableHeaders.length === 8 ? config.tableHeaders : defaultHeaders;
      const colXs = [28, 44, 184, 306, 368, 426, 482, 532];
      colXs.forEach((x, idx) => drawText(hdrs[idx] || '', x, cursorY + 12, 6.5, true, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]));
      cursorY += 18;

      const rowH = 20.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < pageRows.length; i++) {
        const r = pageRows[i];
        const bgRgb: [number, number, number] = r.hasPositivePayout
          ? [0.92, 0.99, 0.95]
          : i % 2 === 0
          ? [1, 1, 1]
          : [0.96, 0.97, 0.99];
        drawRect(tableX, cursorY, tableW, rowH, bgRgb, [0.88, 0.9, 0.94], 0.4);
        drawText(r.idx, 28, cursorY + 13, 7, true, [0.35, 0.4, 0.48]);
        drawText(r.afiliado.slice(0, 26), 44, cursorY + 9.5, 7.2, true, [0.08, 0.1, 0.15]);
        drawText(r.disciplina.slice(0, 28), 44, cursorY + 17.5, 6.2, false, [0.42, 0.47, 0.56]);
        drawText(r.rfcStatus.slice(0, 25), 184, cursorY + 9.5, 6.5, true, [0.15, 0.2, 0.28]);
        drawText(`CLABE: ${r.clabe.slice(0, 18)}`, 184, cursorY + 17.5, 6.2, false, [0.42, 0.47, 0.56]);
        drawText(r.operacion.slice(0, 14), 306, cursorY + 13, 6.6, false, [0.2, 0.24, 0.32]);
        drawText(r.bruto, 368, cursorY + 13, 7, true, [0.12, 0.15, 0.22]);
        drawText(r.kinetic20, 426, cursorY + 13, 7, false, [0.48, 0.2, 0.72]);
        drawText(r.retSat, 482, cursorY + 13, 7, false, [0.8, 0.18, 0.18]);
        drawText(
          r.netoSpei,
          532,
          cursorY + 13,
          7.8,
          true,
          r.hasPositivePayout ? [0.0, 0.58, 0.26] : [0.45, 0.5, 0.58]
        );
        cursorY += rowH;
      }
      cursorY += 8;
    }

    if (isLastPage) {
      if (config.detailBlocks && config.detailBlocks.length > 0) {
        config.detailBlocks.forEach((block) => {
          const blockH = 22 + block.lines.length * 18;
          drawRect(24, cursorY, pageWidth - 48, blockH, [1, 1, 1], [0.84, 0.87, 0.92], 0.8);
          drawRect(24, cursorY, pageWidth - 48, 18, [0.06, 0.08, 0.14]);
          drawText(block.sectionTitle, 32, cursorY + 12, 7.5, true, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
          let lineY = cursorY + 31;
          block.lines.forEach((ln) => {
            drawText(ln.label, 34, lineY, 8, false, [0.3, 0.35, 0.44]);
            drawText(ln.value, 320, lineY, 8.5, true, ln.highlight ? [0.0, 0.58, 0.26] : [0.08, 0.1, 0.16]);
            lineY += 18;
          });
          cursorY += blockH + 10;
        });
      }

      const footerY = Math.max(cursorY + 4, pageHeight - 54);
      drawRect(24, footerY, pageWidth - 48, 36, [0.05, 0.07, 0.12]);
      (config.footerLegal || []).slice(0, 3).forEach((line, idx) => {
        drawText(
          line,
          32,
          footerY + 11 + idx * 9,
          6.3,
          idx === 0,
          idx === 0 ? [0.0, 0.94, 1.0] : [0.75, 0.8, 0.88]
        );
      });
    }

    pageStreams.push(ops.join('\n'));
  }

  const kidsStr = pageStreams.map((_, idx) => `${5 + idx * 2} 0 R`).join(' ');
  const objects: string[] = [
    '1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n',
    `2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [${kidsStr}] /Count ${pageStreams.length} >>\nendobj\n`,
    '3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n',
    '4 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n',
  ];

  pageStreams.forEach((stream, idx) => {
    const pageObjId = 5 + idx * 2;
    const streamObjId = 6 + idx * 2;
    objects.push(
      `${pageObjId} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${pageWidth} ${pageHeight}] /Contents ${streamObjId} 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> >> >>\nendobj\n`
    );
    objects.push(
      `${streamObjId} 0 obj\n<< /Length ${stream.length} >>\nstream\n${stream}\nendstream\nendobj\n`
    );
  });

  let pdfStr = '%PDF-1.4\n';
  const offsets: number[] = [0];
  for (const obj of objects) {
    offsets.push(pdfStr.length);
    pdfStr += obj;
  }
  const xrefOffset = pdfStr.length;
  pdfStr += `xref\n0 ${objects.length + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= objects.length; i++) {
    pdfStr += `${String(offsets[i]).padStart(10, '0')} 00000 n \n`;
  }
  pdfStr += `trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xrefOffset}\n%%EOF`;

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(pdfStr.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < pdfStr.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = pdfStr.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
  }
  return bytes;
};

export const uploadAndOpenInvoicePdf = async (
  fileNamePrefix: string,
  config: IPdfInvoiceConfig
): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (
    Platform.OS === 'web' &&
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof document.createElement === 'function'
  ) {
    const pdfBytes = buildKineticInvoicePdfBytes(config);
    const safeName = `${fileNamePrefix}_${Date.now()}.pdf`;
    const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(pdfBytes)], { type: 'application/pdf' });
    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = blobUrl;
    link.download = safeName;
    link.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
    }, 5000);
    return true;
  }

  const html = buildNativeKineticPdfHtml(config);
  const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, width: 612, height: 792 });
  if (!uri) {
    throw new Error('NATIVE_PDF_PRINT_FAILED');
  }

  const canShare = await Sharing.isAvailableAsync().catch(() => false);
  if (canShare) {
    await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
      mimeType: 'application/pdf',
      UTI: 'com.adobe.pdf',
      dialogTitle: config.docTitle,
    });
    return true;
  }

  await Share.share({
    title: config.docTitle,
    url: uri,
    message: `${config.docTitle} (${config.folio})`,
  });
  return true;
};

export const safeOpenOrShareInvoicePdf = async (
  rawPrefix: string,
  config: IPdfInvoiceConfig
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const safePrefix =
    String(rawPrefix || 'Kinetic_OS_Report')
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '_')
      .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'Kinetic_OS_Report';
  try {
    return await uploadAndOpenInvoicePdf(safePrefix, config);
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      const summaryLines = [
        config.docTitle,
        `Folio: ${config.folio}`,
        config.periodoLabel,
        '',
        ...(config.kpis || []).map((k) => `• ${k.label}: ${k.value} (${k.sub})`),
      ].join('\n');
      await Share.share({ title: config.docTitle, message: summaryLines });
      return true;
    } catch {
      throw err;
    }
  }
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { PermissionsAndroid, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export type PushPlatform = 'android' | 'ios' | 'web';

export const PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY = '@kinetic_push_fcm_synced_v1';
const UUID_STRICT_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const FORBIDDEN_TOKEN_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', 'null', 'undefined']);

export function resolveCurrentPushPlatform(): PushPlatform {
  if (Platform.OS === 'ios') return 'ios';
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return 'web';
  return 'android';
}

export function sanitizePushDeviceToken(rawToken: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof rawToken !== 'string') return null;
  const clean = rawToken.trim();
  if (clean.length < 16 || clean.length > 4096) return null;
  if (/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s<>"'`]/.test(clean)) return null;
  if (clean.includes('..') || /^(?:https?|javascript|data):/i.test(clean)) return null;
  if (FORBIDDEN_TOKEN_KEYS.has(clean.toLowerCase())) return null;
  return clean;
}

export function shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce(input: {
  userId?: string | null;
  nextToken?: string | null;
  cachedUserId?: string | null;
  cachedToken?: string | null;
}): boolean {
  const uid = String(input.userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_STRICT_RE.test(uid)) return false;
  const cleanToken = sanitizePushDeviceToken(input.nextToken);
  if (!cleanToken) return false;
  if (String(input.cachedUserId || '').trim() === uid && String(input.cachedToken || '').trim() === cleanToken) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

async function hasSilentPushPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return true;
  const apiLevel = Number(Platform.Version);
  if (!Number.isFinite(apiLevel) || apiLevel < 33) return true;
  try {
    return await PermissionsAndroid.check('android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost(params: {
  userId?: string | null;
  rawToken?: string | null;
  platform?: PushPlatform;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; synced: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  const uid = String(params.userId || '').trim();
  const cleanToken = sanitizePushDeviceToken(params.rawToken);
  if (!UUID_STRICT_RE.test(uid) || !cleanToken) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'permission_or_token_pending' };
  }
  if (!(await hasSilentPushPermission())) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'permission_or_token_pending' };
  }

  let cachedUserId = '';
  let cachedToken = '';
  try {
    const rawSnapshot = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    if (rawSnapshot) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawSnapshot) as { userId?: unknown; token?: unknown };
      cachedUserId = typeof parsed?.userId === 'string' ? parsed.userId : '';
      cachedToken = typeof parsed?.token === 'string' ? parsed.token : '';
    }
  } catch {}

  if (!shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce({ userId: uid, nextToken: cleanToken, cachedUserId, cachedToken })) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'unchanged_write_once' };
  }

  try {
    const platform = params.platform || resolveCurrentPushPlatform();
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('user_push_devices')
      .upsert(
        { user_id: uid, platform, push_token: cleanToken, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,push_token' }
      );
    if (error) return { ok: false, synced: false, reason: 'sync_deferred_offline_or_schema' };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ userId: uid, token: cleanToken })).catch(() => {});
    return { ok: true, synced: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, synced: false, reason: 'sync_deferred_offline' };
  }
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { IEquipoKinetic, IMensajeEquipo } from '../types';
import {

export async function loadLocalDmThreads(
  myUserId?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null
): Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> {
  const effectiveUid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  if (!effectiveUid) return [];

  myUserId?: string | null,

  if (!effectiveUid) return [];

  );
