    // === src/services/kineticSessionReconciler.ts === //
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
  consumePendingOidcChallenge,
  extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl,
  isNativeOidcFlowInFlight,
  recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl,
} from './kineticGoogleOidcService';
import { isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl } from './kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';
import { isValidRealSupabaseJwt } from './kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import {
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit,
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  isRealSupabaseJwt,
  persistKineticSessionSnapshot,
  readPersistedKineticSessionAsync,
  readPersistedKineticSessionSync,
  readSupabaseAuthTokenSyncWeb,
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut,
} from './kineticSessionPersistence';

export const ALLOWED_OAUTH_REDIRECT_PREFIXES = [
  'kinetic://',
  'exp://',
  'https://kineticapp.com.mx',
  'https://www.kineticapp.com.mx',
] as const;

export const isEgressOrTransientAuthError = (err: unknown): boolean => {
  const msg = String((err as { message?: string })?.message || err || '').toLowerCase();
  const status = Number((err as { status?: number })?.status || 0);
  if (msg.includes('invalid login credentials') || msg.includes('email not confirmed')) return false;
  if (status === 429 || status === 408 || status >= 500) return true;
  return [
    'kinetic_auth_timeout',
    'timeout',
    'timed out',
    'abort',
    'failed to fetch',
    'network request failed',
    'load failed',
    'fetch failed',
    'rate limit',
    'too many requests',
    'over_request_rate_limit',
    'egress',
    'exceed',
    '502',
    '503',
    '504',
    '522',
  ].some((tok) => msg.includes(tok));
};

let _reconcileInFlight: Promise<{
  status: 'valid' | 'cleared' | 'empty' | 'transient';
  session: any | null;
  user: any | null;
}> | null = null;

export const reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession = (
  supabaseClient: any,
  timeoutMs = 3500
): Promise<{ status: 'valid' | 'cleared' | 'empty' | 'transient'; session: any | null; user: any | null }> => {
  if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
    return Promise.resolve({ status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null });
  }
  if (_reconcileInFlight) return _reconcileInFlight;

  const task = (async (): Promise<{
    status: 'valid' | 'cleared' | 'empty' | 'transient';
    session: any | null;
    user: any | null;
  }> => {
    const raceAuth = <T,>(p: PromiseLike<T>): Promise<T> =>
      new Promise<T>((res, rej) => {
        const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('KINETIC_AUTH_TIMEOUT')), timeoutMs);
        Promise.resolve(p).then(
          (v) => {
            clearTimeout(t);
            res(v);
          },
          (e) => {
            clearTimeout(t);
            rej(e);
          }
        );
      });

    const persisted = readPersistedKineticSessionSync() || (await readPersistedKineticSessionAsync());
    const sbWeb = Platform.OS === 'web' ? readSupabaseAuthTokenSyncWeb() : null;
    const storedSession = (persisted?.session || sbWeb?.session || null) as Record<string, any> | null;
    const storedRefresh = String(storedSession?.refresh_token || '').trim();
    const storedAccess = String(storedSession?.access_token || '').trim();

    let liveSession: any = null;
    try {
      const getRes: any = await raceAuth<any>(supabaseClient.auth.getSession());
      if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
        return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
      }
      if (getRes?.error && isEgressOrTransientAuthError(getRes.error) && isRealSupabaseJwt(storedAccess)) {
        return { status: 'transient', session: null, user: null };
      }
      liveSession = getRes?.data?.session ?? null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
        return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
      }
      if (!isRealSupabaseJwt(storedAccess) && !storedRefresh && persisted?.user?.id) {
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit();
        return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
      }
      if (isEgressOrTransientAuthError(err)) return { status: 'transient', session: null, user: null };
    }

    if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
      return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
    }

    if (isRealSupabaseJwt(liveSession?.access_token) && liveSession?.user?.id) {
      resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(liveSession.user, persisted?.profile || null, liveSession);
      return { status: 'valid', session: liveSession, user: liveSession.user };
    }

    const refreshCandidate = String(liveSession?.refresh_token || storedRefresh || '').trim();
    if (refreshCandidate) {
      try {
        let recovered: any = null;
        let lastErr: any = null;
        if (isRealSupabaseJwt(storedAccess)) {
          const setRes: any = await raceAuth(
            supabaseClient.auth.setSession({ access_token: storedAccess, refresh_token: refreshCandidate })
          );
          recovered = setRes?.data?.session ?? null;
          if (setRes?.error) lastErr = setRes.error;
        }
        if (!isRealSupabaseJwt(recovered?.access_token)) {
          const refRes: any = await raceAuth(
            supabaseClient.auth.refreshSession({ refresh_token: refreshCandidate })
          );
          recovered = refRes?.data?.session ?? null;
          if (refRes?.error) lastErr = refRes.error;
        }
        if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
          return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
        }
        if (isRealSupabaseJwt(recovered?.access_token) && recovered?.user?.id) {
          resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
          persistKineticSessionSnapshot(recovered.user, persisted?.profile || null, recovered);
          return { status: 'valid', session: recovered, user: recovered.user };
        }
        if (lastErr && isEgressOrTransientAuthError(lastErr) && isRealSupabaseJwt(storedAccess)) {
          return { status: 'transient', session: null, user: null };
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (isEgressOrTransientAuthError(err) && isRealSupabaseJwt(storedAccess)) {
          return { status: 'transient', session: null, user: null };
        }
      }
    }

    if (persisted?.user?.id || liveSession) {
      await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit();
      return { status: 'cleared', session: null, user: null };
    }
    return { status: 'empty', session: null, user: null };
  })();

  _reconcileInFlight = task.finally(() => {
    _reconcileInFlight = null;
  });
  return _reconcileInFlight;
};

const serializeComparableRecord = (obj: any): string => {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return String(obj ?? '');
  const normalized: Record<string, any> = {};
  Object.keys(obj)
    .filter((k) => k !== 'last_sign_in_at' && k !== 'updated_at_local')
    .sort()
    .forEach((k) => {
      normalized[k] = obj[k];
    });
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(normalized);
  } catch {
    return String(obj.id ?? '');
  }
};

export const areUsersEquivalent = (a: any, b: any): boolean =>
  a === b ||
  (Boolean(a && b) &&
    a.id === b.id &&
    a.email === b.email &&
    a.phone === b.phone &&
    a.role === b.role &&
    serializeComparableRecord(a.user_metadata) === serializeComparableRecord(b.user_metadata) &&
    serializeComparableRecord(a.app_metadata) === serializeComparableRecord(b.app_metadata));

// Evita re-renders y re-ruteo cuando solo rota access_token para el mismo user.id
export const areSessionsEquivalent = (a: any, b: any): boolean => {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (!a || !b) return false;
  if (!a.user?.id || !b.user?.id || String(a.user.id) !== String(b.user.id)) return false;
  return isValidRealSupabaseJwt(a.access_token) === isValidRealSupabaseJwt(b.access_token);
};

export const areProfilesEquivalent = (a: any, b: any): boolean =>
  a === b || (Boolean(a && b) && serializeComparableRecord(a) === serializeComparableRecord(b));

export const handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens = async (
  supabaseClient: any,
  incomingUrl?: string | null
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const cleanIncoming = String(incomingUrl || '').trim();
  if (!cleanIncoming) return false;
  const isDevExpUrl = typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__ && /^exp:\/\/(?:localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.|10\.)/i.test(cleanIncoming);
  if (!isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(cleanIncoming) && !isDevExpUrl) return false;
  try {
    if (cleanIncoming.includes('id_token=')) {
      if (isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) {
        recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl(cleanIncoming);
        return false;
      }
      const challenge = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
      if (!challenge) return false;
      const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(cleanIncoming, {
        expectedState: challenge.state,
        expectedNonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
        expectedClientId: KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
      });
      if (!extracted) return false;
      const res = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithIdToken({
        provider: 'google',
        token: extracted.idToken,
        nonce: challenge.rawNonce,
      });
      return Boolean(res?.data?.session?.user);
    }
    if (!cleanIncoming.includes('access_token=')) return false;
    const fragment = cleanIncoming.split('#')[1] || cleanIncoming.split('?')[1] || '';
    const params = new URLSearchParams(fragment);
    const linkType = String(params.get('type') || '').toLowerCase();
    const allowedEmailLinkTypes = new Set(['signup', 'recovery', 'invite', 'magiclink', 'email_change']);
    if (!allowedEmailLinkTypes.has(linkType)) return false;
    const access_token = params.get('access_token');
    const refresh_token = params.get('refresh_token');
    if (isRealSupabaseJwt(access_token) && Boolean(refresh_token)) {
      await supabaseClient.auth.setSession({ access_token: access_token!, refresh_token: refresh_token! });
      return true;
    }
  } catch {}
  return false;
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import { ISplitInviteAthlete } from './splitEscrowInvitesService';
import {
  clearSpotLockAndIntent,
  resolveClientPickedSpot,
  setSpotLock90s,
} from './spotCollisionService';

const SPLIT_PREBOOK_TTL_MS = 20 * 60_000;
const SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS = 20 * 60_000;

export interface IPendingSplitEscrowConfig {
  splitCount: 2 | 3 | 4;
  selectedGuests: ISplitInviteAthlete[];
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface ISplitEscrow1NMath {
  safeSplit: number;
  effectivePriceKc: number;
  perPersonTotalKc: number;
  effectiveEscrowKc: number;
  effectiveDoorKc: number;
}

const _pendingSplitConfigs = new Map<string, IPendingSplitEscrowConfig>();
const _persistedSpotSession = new Map<string, { spot: number; updatedAt: number }>();
const SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_spot_prebook_v1';

const readSyncSpotFromWebStorage = (cleanKeys: string[], now: number): number | null => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.sessionStorage) return null;
  try {
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return null;
    for (const k of cleanKeys) {
      const rec = parsed[k];
      if (rec && now - Number(rec.updatedAt || 0) <= SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS && Number(rec.spot) > 0) {
        return Math.round(Number(rec.spot));
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
};

const flushSpotSessionToDisk = (): void => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const obj: Record<string, { spot: number; updatedAt: number }> = {};
  _persistedSpotSession.forEach((v, k) => {
    if (v && now - v.updatedAt <= SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS && v.spot > 0) obj[k] = v;
  });
  const payload = JSON.stringify(obj);
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.sessionStorage) {
    try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY, payload); } catch {}
  }
  AsyncStorage.setItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY, payload).catch(() => {});
};

void AsyncStorage.getItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY)
  .then((raw) => {
    if (!raw) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return;
    const now = Date.now();
    Object.entries(parsed).forEach(([k, v]: [string, any]) => {
      if (v && now - Number(v.updatedAt || 0) <= SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS && Number(v.spot) > 0 && !_persistedSpotSession.has(k)) {
        _persistedSpotSession.set(k, { spot: Math.round(Number(v.spot)), updatedAt: Number(v.updatedAt) });
      }
    });
  })
  .catch(() => {});

registerSessionCleanupHook(() => {
  _pendingSplitConfigs.clear();
  _persistedSpotSession.clear();
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.sessionStorage) {
    try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY); } catch {}
  }
  AsyncStorage.removeItem(SPOT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => {});
});

const normKeys = (keys: (string | number | undefined | null)[]): string[] =>
  Array.from(new Set(keys.map((k) => String(k ?? '').trim()).filter(Boolean)));

export const computeSplitEscrow1NMath = (
  effectivePriceKc: number,
  splitCount: number,
  baseEscrow40?: number,
  isAdmin = false
): ISplitEscrow1NMath => {
  const rawSplit = Number.isFinite(Number(splitCount)) ? Math.floor(Number(splitCount)) : 1;
  const safeSplit = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, rawSplit));
  const cleanPrice = isAdmin ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(effectivePriceKc) || 0));
  if (isAdmin || cleanPrice <= 0) {
    return {
      safeSplit,
      effectivePriceKc: 0,
      perPersonTotalKc: 0,
      effectiveEscrowKc: 0,
      effectiveDoorKc: 0,
    };
  }
  const fallbackEscrow40 =
    baseEscrow40 !== undefined
      ? Math.min(cleanPrice, Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(baseEscrow40) || 0)))
      : Math.round(cleanPrice * 0.4);
  const perPersonTotalKc = safeSplit > 1 ? Math.round(cleanPrice / safeSplit) : cleanPrice;
  const effectiveEscrowKc =
    safeSplit > 1 ? Math.round((cleanPrice / safeSplit) * 0.4) : fallbackEscrow40;
  const effectiveDoorKc = Math.max(0, perPersonTotalKc - effectiveEscrowKc);
  return {
    safeSplit,
    effectivePriceKc: cleanPrice,
    perPersonTotalKc,
    effectiveEscrowKc,
    effectiveDoorKc,
  };
};

export const getPendingSplitConfig = (
  ...keys: (string | number | undefined | null)[]
): IPendingSplitEscrowConfig | null => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const key of normKeys(keys)) {
    const item = _pendingSplitConfigs.get(key);
    if (!item) continue;
    if (now - item.updatedAt > SPLIT_PREBOOK_TTL_MS) {
      _pendingSplitConfigs.delete(key);
      continue;
    }
    return item;
  }
  return null;
};

export const setPendingSplitConfig = (
  eventKey: string | number | undefined | null,
  cfg: { splitCount: number; selectedGuests: ISplitInviteAthlete[] },
  serviceId?: string | number | null
): IPendingSplitEscrowConfig | null => {
  const keys = normKeys([eventKey, serviceId]);
  if (keys.length === 0) return null;
  const safeSplit: 2 | 3 | 4 =
    cfg.splitCount === 2 ? 2 : cfg.splitCount === 3 ? 3 : 4;
  const entry: IPendingSplitEscrowConfig = {
    splitCount: safeSplit,
    selectedGuests: Array.isArray(cfg.selectedGuests)
      ? cfg.selectedGuests.slice(0, safeSplit - 1)
      : [],
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };
  keys.forEach((k) => _pendingSplitConfigs.set(k, entry));
  return entry;
};

export const clearPendingSplitConfig = (
  ...keys: (string | number | undefined | null)[]
): void => {
  normKeys(keys).forEach((k) => _pendingSplitConfigs.delete(k));
};

export const persistSelectedSpotSession = (
  eventKey: string | number | undefined | null,
  spot: number | null,
  serviceId?: string | number | null,
  dateIso?: string | null
): void => {
  const cleanDate = String(dateIso || '').split('T')[0].trim();
  const baseKeys = normKeys([eventKey, serviceId]);
  const datedKeys = cleanDate ? baseKeys.map((k) => `${k}::${cleanDate}`) : [];
  const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...datedKeys, ...baseKeys]));
  if (allKeys.length === 0) return;
  if (spot == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(spot)) || Number(spot) <= 0) {
    allKeys.forEach((k) => _persistedSpotSession.delete(k));
    clearSpotLockAndIntent(...allKeys);
    flushSpotSessionToDisk();
    return;
  }
  const writeKeys = datedKeys.length > 0 ? Array.from(new Set(datedKeys)) : baseKeys;
  const cleanSpot = Math.round(Number(spot));
  const now = Date.now();
  writeKeys.forEach((k) => {
    _persistedSpotSession.set(k, { spot: cleanSpot, updatedAt: now });
    setSpotLock90s(k, cleanSpot, 180_000);
  });
  flushSpotSessionToDisk();
};

export const rehydratePersistedSpotForEvent = (
  ...keys: (string | number | undefined | null)[]
): number | null => {
  const cleanKeys = normKeys(keys);
  if (cleanKeys.length === 0) return null;
  const now = Date.now();
  let foundSpot: number | null = null;
  for (const k of cleanKeys) {
    const stored = _persistedSpotSession.get(k);
    if (stored && now - stored.updatedAt <= SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS && stored.spot > 0) {
      foundSpot = stored.spot;
      break;
    }
    if (stored && now - stored.updatedAt > SPOT_SESSION_TTL_MS) {
      _persistedSpotSession.delete(k);
    }
  }
  if (foundSpot == null) {
    foundSpot = readSyncSpotFromWebStorage(cleanKeys, now);
  }
  if (foundSpot == null) {
    foundSpot = resolveClientPickedSpot(...cleanKeys);
  }
  if (foundSpot != null && foundSpot > 0) {
    cleanKeys.forEach((k) => {
      _persistedSpotSession.set(k, { spot: foundSpot!, updatedAt: now });
      setSpotLock90s(k, foundSpot, 180_000);
    });
  }
  return foundSpot;
};

export type StudioEquipmentType = 'reformer' | 'bike' | 'barre' | 'bag' | 'court' | 'spot';

export interface IStudioLayoutConfig {
  equipmentType: StudioEquipmentType;
  rows: number;
  cols: number;
  disabledCells: string[];
  totalSpots: number;
}

export const MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS = 50;
export const MAX_STUDIO_GRID_AXIS = 10;

export const clampStudioGridToMaxSpots = (
  rawRows: number,
  rawCols: number,
  rawDisabled: string[],
  equipmentType: StudioEquipmentType
): IStudioLayoutConfig => {
  const rows = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_GRID_AXIS, Math.round(Number(rawRows) || 3)));
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_GRID_AXIS, Math.round(Number(rawCols) || 4)));
  const validDisabled = new Set<string>();
  for (const key of rawDisabled || []) {
    const [r, c] = String(key).split('-').map(Number);
    if (Number.isInteger(r) && Number.isInteger(c) && r >= 0 && r < rows && c >= 0 && c < cols) {
      validDisabled.add(`${r}-${c}`);
    }
  }
  let activeCount = 0;
  const finalDisabled: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const k = `${r}-${c}`;
      if (validDisabled.has(k) || activeCount >= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) finalDisabled.push(k);
      else activeCount++;
    }
  }
  if (activeCount === 0) {
    const idx = finalDisabled.indexOf('0-0');
    if (idx >= 0) finalDisabled.splice(idx, 1);
    activeCount = 1;
  }
  return {
    equipmentType,
    rows,
    cols,
    disabledCells: finalDisabled,
    totalSpots: Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, Math.max(1, activeCount)),
  };
};

export const buildGridForTotalSpots = (
  targetSpots: number,
  equipmentType: StudioEquipmentType
): IStudioLayoutConfig => {
  const safeTotal = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, Math.round(Number(targetSpots) || 12)));
  if (safeTotal === MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) {
    return {
      equipmentType,
      rows: 5,
      cols: 10,
      disabledCells: [],
      totalSpots: MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS,
    };
  }

  let bestRows = 1;
  let bestCols = safeTotal;
  if (safeTotal > 4) {
    let bestScore = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    for (let c = 4; c <= MAX_STUDIO_GRID_AXIS; c++) {
      const r = Math.ceil(safeTotal / c);
      if (r < 1 || r > MAX_STUDIO_GRID_AXIS) continue;
      const wasted = r * c - safeTotal;
      const widePenalty = c > 7 ? 0.35 : 0;
      const shapePenalty = Math.abs(r - c) * 0.04;
      const score = wasted + widePenalty + shapePenalty;
      if (score < bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestRows = r;
        bestCols = c;
      }
    }
  }

  const disabledCells: string[] = [];
  let toDisable = Math.max(0, bestRows * bestCols - safeTotal);
  for (let r = bestRows - 1; r >= 0 && toDisable > 0; r--) {
    for (let c = bestCols - 1; c >= 0 && toDisable > 0; c--) {
      if (c === Math.floor(bestCols / 2) && toDisable > 0) {
        disabledCells.push(`${r}-${c}`);
        toDisable--;
      }
    }
  }
  for (let r = bestRows - 1; r >= 0 && toDisable > 0; r--) {
    for (let c = bestCols - 1; c >= 0 && toDisable > 0; c--) {
      const k = `${r}-${c}`;
      if (!disabledCells.includes(k)) {
        disabledCells.push(k);
        toDisable--;
      }
    }
  }

  return clampStudioGridToMaxSpots(bestRows, bestCols, disabledCells, equipmentType);
};

export const PIN_CAMERA_OFFSET_LAT_RATIO = 0.22;
export const PIN_WEB_PIXEL_OFFSET: [number, number] = [0, -90];

export const computePinCameraFocusOffset = (
  pinLat: number,
  pinLng: number,
  latitudeDelta = 0.0045
) => {
  const safeLat = Number.isFinite(pinLat) ? pinLat : 22.8905;
  const safeLng = Number.isFinite(pinLng) ? pinLng : -109.9167;
  const safeDelta = Math.max(0.0005, Math.min(2.0, Number(latitudeDelta) || 0.0045));
  return {
    latitude: Number((safeLat - safeDelta * PIN_CAMERA_OFFSET_LAT_RATIO).toFixed(6)),
    longitude: safeLng,
    latitudeDelta: safeDelta,
    longitudeDelta: safeDelta,
    webOffset: [...PIN_WEB_PIXEL_OFFSET] as [number, number],
  };
};

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { readCachedRoleSync } from '../utils/kineticRoleCache';
import { isRealSupabaseJwt } from './kineticSessionPersistence';

export const KINETIC_ADMIN_ROLES = ['admin', 'fundador', 'ceo'] as const;
const MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS = new Set([
  'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
  'administrador@kinetic.com',
  'kinetic@kinetic.com',
  'admin@kinetic.com',
]);
export const KINETIC_B2B_ROLES = [
  'socio',
  'club',
  'especialista',
  'afiliado',
  'negocio',
  'estadio',
  'partner b2b',
  'partner_b2b',
  'b2b',
] as const;

const SPECIAL_ROLES: readonly string[] = [...KINETIC_ADMIN_ROLES, ...KINETIC_B2B_ROLES];

const isAdminRoleString = (r: string, emailLower = ''): boolean =>
  r === 'admin' || r === 'fundador' || (r === 'ceo' && MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLower));
export const isB2BRoleString = (r: string): boolean => (KINETIC_B2B_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(r);

export const resolveExplicitProfileRole = (
  profile: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
  emailLower = ''
): string => {
  const r1 = String(profile?.rol || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const r2 = String(profile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (isAdminRoleString(r1, emailLower)) return r1;
  if (isAdminRoleString(r2, emailLower)) return r2;
  if (isB2BRoleString(r1)) return r1;
  if (isB2BRoleString(r2)) return r2;
  return r2 || r1;
};

export const resolveRoleDestination = (
  user: any,
  profile: any,
  accessToken?: string | null
): '/(tabs)/admin' | '/(tabs)/terminal' | '/(tabs)' => {
  if (accessToken !== undefined && !isRealSupabaseJwt(accessToken)) return '/(tabs)';
  const email = String(user?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const dbRole = resolveExplicitProfileRole(profile as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, email);

  if (MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(email) || isAdminRoleString(dbRole, email)) {
    return '/(tabs)/admin';
  }
  if (isB2BRoleString(dbRole)) {
    return '/(tabs)/terminal';
  }
  return '/(tabs)';
};

export const resolveSyncRole = (user: any, profile: any): string | null => {
  if (!user) return null;
  const emailLower = String(user.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLower)) {
    return 'admin';
  }
  const rawRole = resolveExplicitProfileRole(profile as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, emailLower);
  if (rawRole) return rawRole;
  const cached = readCachedRoleSync(user.id);
  return cached && !SPECIAL_ROLES.includes(cached) ? cached : null;
};

export function getKineticHomeRouteForRole(
  rawRole?: string | null,
  rawEmail?: string | null
): '/(tabs)/admin' | '/(tabs)/terminal' | '/(tabs)' {
  const r = String(rawRole || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const emailLower = String(rawEmail || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (r === 'admin' || r === 'fundador' || (r === 'ceo' && (!emailLower || MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLower)))) {
    return '/(tabs)/admin';
  }
  if (isB2BRoleString(r)) {
    return '/(tabs)/terminal';
  }
  return '/(tabs)';
}

export function isPathMatchingRoleRoot(
  rawPath: string,
  isAdminRole: boolean,
  isSocioRole: boolean
): boolean {
  const norm = String(rawPath || '/').replace(/^\/\(tabs\)/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';
  if (isAdminRole) return norm === '/admin';
  if (isSocioRole) return norm === '/terminal';
  return norm === '/' || norm === '/index';
}

export async function fetchFallbackTabRole(userId: string): Promise<string> {
  let detectedRole = '';
  const { data: perfilDB } = await supabase
    .from('perfiles')
    .select('rol, tipo_cuenta')
    .eq('id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (perfilDB) {
    detectedRole = resolveExplicitProfileRole(perfilDB as Record<string, unknown>);
  }

  if (!SPECIAL_ROLES.includes(detectedRole)) {
    const { data: negocio } = await supabase
      .from('afiliados')
      .select('id, categoria')
      .eq('propietario_id', userId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (negocio) {
      detectedRole = String(negocio.categoria || '').toLowerCase().includes('especialista')
        ? 'especialista'
        : 'club';
    }
  }
  return detectedRole || 'cliente';
}

export const TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S = 3200;
export const TROPHY_FRICTION_60HZ = 0.986;
export const TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S = 24;
export const TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG = 3.5;

export interface ITrophySpinPhysicsState {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDegPerSec: number;
  isSpinning: boolean;
}

export interface ITrophySpinStepResult extends ITrophySpinPhysicsState {
  tiltZDeg: number;
  didCrossRevolution: boolean;
  crossedHalfTurns: number;
}

export interface ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom {
  side: 'left' | 'right';
  zDepth: number;
  isFront: boolean;
  pathD: string;
  innerHighlightD: string;
  thicknessRatio: number;
}

export interface ITrophyRevolutionGeometry {
  thetaDeg: number;
  cosTheta: number;
  sinTheta: number;
  absCos: number;
  absSin: number;
  activeFace: 'front' | 'back';
  bowlScaleX: number;
  bowlShiftX: number;
  specularX: number;
  specularWidth: number;
  shadowX: number;
  shadowWidth: number;
  rimRx: number;
  rimRy: number;
  rimDepthOffset: number;
  baseRx: number;
  baseRy: number;
  frontScaleX: number;
  backScaleX: number;
  isFrontVisible: boolean;
  isBackVisible: boolean;
  handlesOrdered: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom[];
}

const normalizeDeg = (angleDeg: number): number => {
  const safe = Number.isFinite(Number(angleDeg)) ? Number(angleDeg) : 0;
  const mod = ((safe % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return mod === 0 ? 0 : mod;
};

export const clampTrophyOmega = (omegaDegPerSec: number): number => {
  const num = Number(omegaDegPerSec);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return 0;
  if (num > TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) return TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  if (num < -TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) return -TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  return num;
};

export const computeDragReleaseOmega = (vxPxPerMs: number, sensitivity = 920): number => {
  const safeVx = Number.isFinite(Number(vxPxPerMs)) ? Number(vxPxPerMs) : 0;
  const safeSens = Number.isFinite(Number(sensitivity)) && Number(sensitivity) > 0 ? Number(sensitivity) : 920;
  return clampTrophyOmega(safeVx * safeSens);
};

export interface ITrophyDragSample {
  dx: number;
  t: number;
}

export const computeSlidingWindowVx = (
  samples: ReadonlyArray<ITrophyDragSample>,
  nowMs: number,
  windowMs = 60,
): number => {
  if (!Array.isArray(samples) || samples.length < 2 || !Number.isFinite(Number(nowMs))) return 0;
  const safeNow = Number(nowMs);
  const safeWindow = Math.max(16, Number.isFinite(Number(windowMs)) ? Number(windowMs) : 60);
  const finite = samples.filter(
    (s) => s && Number.isFinite(Number(s.dx)) && Number.isFinite(Number(s.t)) && Number(s.t) <= safeNow + 4
  );
  if (finite.length < 2) return 0;
  const inWindow = finite.filter((s) => Number(s.t) >= safeNow - safeWindow);
  const pair = inWindow.length >= 2 ? inWindow : finite.slice(-2);
  const oldest = pair[0];
  const latest = pair[pair.length - 1];
  if (inWindow.length < 2 && safeNow - Number(latest.t) > safeWindow * 1.5) return 0;
  const dt = Number(latest.t) - Number(oldest.t);
  if (dt <= 0) return 0;
  const rawVx = (Number(latest.dx) - Number(oldest.dx)) / Math.max(8, dt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(rawVx)) return 0;
  return Math.max(-12, Math.min(12, rawVx));
};

export const stepTrophySpinPhysics = (
  state: ITrophySpinPhysicsState,
  dtMs: number,
): ITrophySpinStepResult => {
  const prevUnwrapped = Number.isFinite(Number(state?.angleDeg)) ? Number(state.angleDeg) : 0;
  const safeDtMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number.isFinite(Number(dtMs)) ? Number(dtMs) : 16.6667));
  const dtFrames = safeDtMs / (1000 / 60);
  const dtSec = safeDtMs / 1000;
  const omega = clampTrophyOmega(state?.omegaDegPerSec ?? 0);

  const nextUnwrapped = prevUnwrapped + omega * dtSec;
  const nextAngleDeg = normalizeDeg(nextUnwrapped);

  const prevRevIdx = Math.floor(prevUnwrapped / 360);
  const nextRevIdx = Math.floor(nextUnwrapped / 360);
  const didCrossRevolution = prevRevIdx !== nextRevIdx && Math.abs(omega) > 0;

  const prevHalfIdx = Math.floor(prevUnwrapped / 180);
  const nextHalfIdx = Math.floor(nextUnwrapped / 180);
  const crossedHalfTurns = Math.abs(nextHalfIdx - prevHalfIdx);

  const decayedOmega = omega * Math.pow(TROPHY_FRICTION_60HZ, dtFrames);
  const settled = Math.abs(decayedOmega) < TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  const nextOmega = settled ? 0 : clampTrophyOmega(decayedOmega);

  const rad = (nextAngleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const wobbleFactor = 0.45 + 0.55 * Math.sin(rad);
  const rawTilt = settled
    ? 0
    : (nextOmega / TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) * TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG * wobbleFactor;
  const tiltZDeg = Math.max(-TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG, Math.min(TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG, Number(rawTilt.toFixed(3))));

  return {
    angleDeg: nextAngleDeg,
    omegaDegPerSec: nextOmega,
    isSpinning: !settled,
    tiltZDeg: tiltZDeg === 0 ? 0 : tiltZDeg,
    didCrossRevolution,
    crossedHalfTurns,
  };
};

export const computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry = (
  angleDeg: number,
  size = 144,
): ITrophyRevolutionGeometry => {
  const safeSize = Math.max(24, Number.isFinite(Number(size)) && Number(size) > 0 ? Number(size) : 144);
  const thetaDeg = normalizeDeg(angleDeg);
  const rad = (thetaDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const rawCos = Math.cos(rad);
  const rawSin = Math.sin(rad);
  const cosTheta = Math.abs(rawCos) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawCos;
  const sinTheta = Math.abs(rawSin) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawSin;
  const absCos = Math.abs(cosTheta);
  const absSin = Math.abs(sinTheta);
  const activeFace: 'front' | 'back' = cosTheta >= 0 ? 'front' : 'back';

  // Revolución cilíndrica continua: la copa gira su eje óptico manteniendo grosor sólido > 0
  const bowlScaleX = Math.max(0.76, 0.78 + absCos * 0.22);
  const bowlShiftX = sinTheta * 3.8;
  const specularX = 48 + sinTheta * 15;
  const specularWidth = Math.max(3.6, 5.8 - absSin * 1.4);
  const shadowX = 68 - sinTheta * 13;
  const shadowWidth = Math.max(4, 7.5 + absSin * 2);

  const rimRx = Math.max(15.5, 22 * bowlScaleX);
  const rimRy = 6.2 + absSin * 0.9;
  const rimDepthOffset = (safeSize / 144) * sinTheta * 1.2;
  const baseRx = Math.max(20, 28 * (0.84 + absCos * 0.16));
  const baseRy = 6.2 + absSin * 0.6;

  // Asas orbitales 3D con ordenamiento Z-buffer (sinTheta controla qué asa cruza delante vs detrás)
  const leftXAnchor = 60 - 21 * cosTheta - sinTheta * 3.2;
  const leftTipX = 60 - 44 * cosTheta - sinTheta * 5.2;
  const rightXAnchor = 60 + 21 * cosTheta + sinTheta * 3.2;
  const rightTipX = 60 + 44 * cosTheta + sinTheta * 5.2;

  const leftZ = -sinTheta;
  const rightZ = sinTheta;

  const leftHandle: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom = {
    side: 'left',
    zDepth: leftZ,
    isFront: leftZ >= 0,
    thicknessRatio: Math.max(0.45, 0.5 + Math.abs(cosTheta) * 0.5),
    pathD: `M${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 45 C${((leftXAnchor + leftTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 43, ${leftTipX.toFixed(1)} 56, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 12).toFixed(1)} 71 C${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 74, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 5).toFixed(1)} 70, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 66 C${(leftTipX + cosTheta * 6).toFixed(1)} 58, ${((leftXAnchor + leftTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 51, ${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 51 Z`,
    innerHighlightD: `M${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 46.5 C${leftTipX.toFixed(1)} 50, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 10).toFixed(1)} 63, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 7).toFixed(1)} 68`,
  };

  const rightHandle: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom = {
    side: 'right',
    zDepth: rightZ,
    isFront: rightZ >= 0,
    thicknessRatio: Math.max(0.45, 0.5 + Math.abs(cosTheta) * 0.5),
    pathD: `M${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 45 C${((rightXAnchor + rightTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 43, ${rightTipX.toFixed(1)} 56, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 12).toFixed(1)} 71 C${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 74, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 5).toFixed(1)} 70, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 66 C${(rightTipX - cosTheta * 6).toFixed(1)} 58, ${((rightXAnchor + rightTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 51, ${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 51 Z`,
    innerHighlightD: `M${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 46.5 C${rightTipX.toFixed(1)} 50, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 10).toFixed(1)} 63, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 7).toFixed(1)} 68`,
  };

  const handlesOrdered = [leftHandle, rightHandle].sort((a, b) => a.zDepth - b.zDepth);

  return {
    thetaDeg,
    cosTheta,
    sinTheta,
    absCos,
    absSin,
    activeFace,
    bowlScaleX,
    bowlShiftX,
    specularX,
    specularWidth,
    shadowX,
    shadowWidth,
    rimRx,
    rimRy,
    rimDepthOffset,
    baseRx,
    baseRy,
    frontScaleX: Math.max(0.85, 0.85 + 0.15 * absCos),
    backScaleX: Math.max(0.85, 0.85 + 0.15 * absCos),
    isFrontVisible: cosTheta >= 0.06,
    isBackVisible: cosTheta < -0.06,
    handlesOrdered,
  };
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

export const DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY = '@kinetic_device_cipher_salt_v1';
export const BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY = '@kinetic_biometric_vault_v2';
export const SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY = '@kinetic_saved_accounts_real_v3';
export const CIPHER_PREFIX = 'kenc_v1:';
export const LEGACY_PLAINTEXT_AUTH_KEYS = [
  '@kinetic_saved_accounts_map_v2', '@kinetic_saved_accounts_v2',
  '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2c_v1', '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2b_v1',
] as const;

export const evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime = (devFlag?: unknown, nodeEnv?: unknown): boolean =>
  devFlag === true && String(nodeEnv ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'production';

export const isKineticDevRuntime = (): boolean =>
  evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime(typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' ? __DEV__ : false, process.env.NODE_ENV);

let _cachedDeviceSalt: string | null = null;
const HEX_LUT = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => i.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));

const getSecureStore = (): any => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try { return requireOptionalNativeModule<any>('ExpoSecureStore') || null; } catch { return null; }
};
const toSSKey = (key: string): string => key.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');

const bytesToHex = (bytes: Uint8Array): string => {
  const parts = new Array<string>(bytes.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) parts[i] = HEX_LUT[bytes[i]];
  return parts.join('');
};

const hexCharVal = (code: number): number => {
  if (code >= 48 && code <= 57) return code - 48;
  if (code >= 97 && code <= 102) return code - 87;
  if (code >= 65 && code <= 70) return code - 55;
  return -1;
};

const randomHex = (byteLen: number): string => {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  const c = (globalThis as any)?.crypto;
  if (c?.getRandomValues) c.getRandomValues(bytes);
  else {
    let s = (Date.now() ^ ((Math.random() * 0xffffffff) >>> 0)) >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < byteLen; i += 1) {
      s = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) >>> 0;
      bytes[i] = ((Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 12), 0x297a2d39) >>> 15) ^ Math.floor(Math.random() * 256)) & 0xff;
    }
  }
  return bytesToHex(bytes);
};

const fnvMix32 = (input: string, seed = 0x811c9dc5): number => {
  let h = seed >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += 1) h = Math.imul(h ^ input.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
  return (Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0;
};

// Pure 32-bit integer FNV block stepper: zero string concatenations or allocations per 4-byte block
const fnvStepBlock32 = (state: number, blockIndex: number, keySeed: number): number => {
  let h = (state ^ keySeed ^ Math.imul((blockIndex + 1) >>> 0, 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) >>> 0;
  return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0;
};

const getEnvFp = (): string => {
  const nav = Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent || '' : '';
  return fnvMix32(`knt25|${Platform.OS}|${String(Platform.Version || '')}|${nav.slice(0, 48)}`, 0x9e3779b9).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
};

const utf8ToBytes = (s: string): Uint8Array => {
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') return new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  return Uint8Array.from(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)), (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
};
const bytesToUtf8 = (b: Uint8Array): string => {
  if (typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined') return new TextDecoder().decode(b);
  let bin = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 1) bin += String.fromCharCode(b[i]);
  return decodeURIComponent(escape(bin));
};
const computeMac = (nonce: string, cipher: string, salt: string): string => {
  const m = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}|${cipher}`;
  return `${fnvMix32(m, 0x811c9dc5).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}${fnvMix32(`m:${m}`, 0x27d4eb2f).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
};

export const getOrCreateWebSaltSync = (): string => {
  if (_cachedDeviceSalt) return _cachedDeviceSalt;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const ex = window.localStorage?.getItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY);
      if (ex && ex.length >= 32) { _cachedDeviceSalt = ex; return ex; }
      const fresh = randomHex(32);
      window.localStorage?.setItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY, fresh);
      _cachedDeviceSalt = fresh;
      return fresh;
    } catch {}
  }
  return _cachedDeviceSalt || getEnvFp().repeat(8);
};

export const ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync = async (): Promise<string> => {
  if (_cachedDeviceSalt && _cachedDeviceSalt.length >= 64) return _cachedDeviceSalt;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  const sk = toSSKey(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY);
  try {
    const sVal = ss?.getItemAsync ? await ss.getItemAsync(sk) : null;
    if (sVal && sVal.length >= 32) { _cachedDeviceSalt = sVal; return sVal; }
  } catch {}
  const aVal = await AsyncStorage.getItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY).catch(() => null);
  if (aVal && aVal.length >= 32) {
    _cachedDeviceSalt = aVal;
    try { await ss?.setItemAsync?.(sk, aVal); } catch {}
    return aVal;
  }
  const fresh = randomHex(32);
  _cachedDeviceSalt = fresh;
  try { await ss?.setItemAsync?.(sk, fresh); } catch {}
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY, fresh).catch(() => {});
  return fresh;
};

export const encryptKineticString = (plainText: string, salt: string): string => {
  const nonce = randomHex(16);
  const src = utf8ToBytes(plainText);
  const out = new Uint8Array(src.length);
  const key = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}`;
  const keySeed = fnvMix32(key, 0x27d4eb2f);
  let st = fnvMix32(key, 0x811c9dc5);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i += 1) {
    if ((i & 3) === 0) st = fnvStepBlock32(st, i >>> 2, keySeed);
    out[i] = src[i] ^ ((st >>> ((i & 3) * 8)) & 0xff);
  }
  const cHex = bytesToHex(out);
  return `${CIPHER_PREFIX}${nonce}:${computeMac(nonce, cHex, salt)}:${cHex}`;
};

export const decryptKineticString = (encoded: string, salt: string): string | null => {
  if (!encoded || !encoded.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) return null;
  const [nonce, mac, cHex] = encoded.slice(CIPHER_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (!nonce || !mac || typeof cHex !== 'string' || (cHex.length & 1) !== 0) return null;
  const expected = computeMac(nonce, cHex, salt);
  if (mac.length !== expected.length) return null;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < mac.length; i += 1) diff |= mac.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
  if (diff !== 0) return null;
  const byteLen = cHex.length >>> 1;
  const out = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  const key = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}`;
  const keySeed = fnvMix32(key, 0x27d4eb2f);
  let st = fnvMix32(key, 0x811c9dc5);
  for (let i = 0; i < byteLen; i += 1) {
    if ((i & 3) === 0) st = fnvStepBlock32(st, i >>> 2, keySeed);
    const hi = hexCharVal(cHex.charCodeAt(i * 2));
    const lo = hexCharVal(cHex.charCodeAt(i * 2 + 1));
    if (hi < 0 || lo < 0) return null;
    out[i] = ((hi << 4) | lo) ^ ((st >>> ((i & 3) * 8)) & 0xff);
  }
  try { return bytesToUtf8(out); } catch { return null; }
};

export const secureVaultReadAsync = async (key: string): Promise<string | null> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  if (!ss) return null;
  const safeKey = toSSKey(key);
  try {
    if (typeof ss.getItemAsync === 'function') return (await ss.getItemAsync(safeKey)) || null;
    if (typeof ss.getValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') return (await ss.getValueWithKeyAsync(safeKey, {})) || null;
    return null;
  } catch { return null; }
};
export const secureVaultWriteAsync = async (key: string, encryptedVal: string): Promise<void> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  if (!ss) return;
  const safeKey = toSSKey(key);
  try {
    if (typeof ss.setItemAsync === 'function') await ss.setItemAsync(safeKey, encryptedVal);
    else if (typeof ss.setValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') await ss.setValueWithKeyAsync(encryptedVal, safeKey, {});
  } catch {}
};
export const purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys = async (): Promise<void> => {
  const keysToPurge = [...LEGACY_PLAINTEXT_AUTH_KEYS, BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY];
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    keysToPurge.forEach((k) => { try { window.localStorage?.removeItem(k); } catch {} });
  }
  await AsyncStorage.multiRemove(keysToPurge).catch(() => {});
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
    const ss = getSecureStore();
    const safeVaultKey = toSSKey(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY);
    try {
      if (typeof ss?.deleteItemAsync === 'function') await ss.deleteItemAsync(safeVaultKey);
      else if (typeof ss?.deleteValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') await ss.deleteValueWithKeyAsync(safeVaultKey, {});
    } catch {}
  }
};

import { CABO_BASE_COORDS, KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey, isCoordsInsideLosCabos } from './exploreRadarFilters';

export const KINETIC_CANONICAL_TIMEZONE = 'America/Mazatlan';
const MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS = -7;

export interface IMazatlanNowParts {
  isoDate: string;
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  hhmm: string;
  minutesOfDay: number;
  jsDayOfWeek: number;
  monDayIdx: number;
}

const pad2 = (n: number) => String(Math.max(0, Math.floor(n))).padStart(2, '0');

export const mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs = (
  year: number,
  month: number,
  day: number,
  hour = 0,
  minute = 0,
  second = 0,
  ms = 0
): number =>
  Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour - MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS, minute, second, ms);

export const getMazatlanNowParts = (nowRef?: Date): IMazatlanNowParts => {
  const ref = nowRef instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(nowRef.getTime()) ? nowRef : new Date();
  try {
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: KINETIC_CANONICAL_TIMEZONE,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
    const map: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const p of fmt.formatToParts(ref)) {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    }
    const year = parseInt(map.year || '', 10);
    const month = parseInt(map.month || '', 10);
    const day = parseInt(map.day || '', 10);
    const rawHour = parseInt(map.hour || '', 10);
    const minute = parseInt(map.minute || '', 10);
    if (
      Number.isFinite(year) &&
      Number.isFinite(month) &&
      Number.isFinite(day) &&
      Number.isFinite(rawHour) &&
      Number.isFinite(minute)
    ) {
      const hour = rawHour % 24;
      const jsDayOfWeek = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, 12, 0, 0)).getUTCDay();
      return {
        isoDate: `${year}-${pad2(month)}-${pad2(day)}`,
        year,
        month,
        day,
        hour,
        minute,
        hhmm: `${pad2(hour)}:${pad2(minute)}`,
        minutesOfDay: hour * 60 + minute,
        jsDayOfWeek,
        monDayIdx: (jsDayOfWeek + 6) % 7,
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback determinista UTC-7
  }
  const shifted = new Date(ref.getTime() + MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS * 3600_000);
  const year = shifted.getUTCFullYear();
  const month = shifted.getUTCMonth() + 1;
  const day = shifted.getUTCDate();
  const hour = shifted.getUTCHours();
  const minute = shifted.getUTCMinutes();
  const jsDayOfWeek = shifted.getUTCDay();
  return {
    isoDate: `${year}-${pad2(month)}-${pad2(day)}`,
    year,
    month,
    day,
    hour,
    minute,
    hhmm: `${pad2(hour)}:${pad2(minute)}`,
    minutesOfDay: hour * 60 + minute,
    jsDayOfWeek,
    monDayIdx: (jsDayOfWeek + 6) % 7,
  };
};

export const getMazatlanWeekAndDayBounds = (nowRef?: Date) => {
  const parts = getMazatlanNowParts(nowRef);
  const startOfTodayMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const endOfTodayMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  const mondayUtc = new Date(Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day - parts.monDayIdx, 12));
  const sundayUtc = new Date(Date.UTC(mondayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), mondayUtc.getUTCMonth(), mondayUtc.getUTCDate() + 6, 12));
  const mY = mondayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), mM = mondayUtc.getUTCMonth() + 1, mD = mondayUtc.getUTCDate();
  const sY = sundayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), sM = sundayUtc.getUTCMonth() + 1, sD = sundayUtc.getUTCDate();
  const startMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(mY, mM, mD, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const endMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(sY, sM, sD, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  const lastDayOfMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const monthStartMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const monthEndMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, lastDayOfMonth, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  return {
    parts,
    startOfTodayMs,
    endOfTodayMs,
    startMs,
    endMs,
    monthStartMs,
    monthEndMs,
    periodoInicio: `${mY}-${pad2(mM)}-${pad2(mD)}`,
    periodoFin: `${sY}-${pad2(sM)}-${pad2(sD)}`,
  };
};

export const parseMazatlanTimestampMs = (rawDate: unknown): number => {
  if (!rawDate) return NaN;
  const s = String(rawDate).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) {
    const [yy, mm, dd] = s.split('-').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    return mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(yy, mm || 1, dd || 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  return new Date(s).getTime();
};

let _canonicalUserOrigin: { latitude: number; longitude: number; isReal: boolean } = {
  latitude: CABO_BASE_COORDS.latitude,
  longitude: CABO_BASE_COORDS.longitude,
  isReal: false,
};

const isValidNonZeroCoordPair = (lat: number, lon: number): boolean =>
  Number.isFinite(lat) &&
  Number.isFinite(lon) &&
  Math.abs(lat) <= 90 &&
  Math.abs(lon) <= 180 &&
  Math.abs(lat) > 1 &&
  Math.abs(lon) > 1;

export const setCanonicalUserGpsOrigin = (coords?: { latitude?: number; longitude?: number } | null, isReal = true): void => {
  const lat = Number(coords?.latitude);
  const lon = Number(coords?.longitude);
  if (isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)) {
    _canonicalUserOrigin = { latitude: lat, longitude: lon, isReal };
  }
};

export const getCanonicalUserGpsOrigin = () => ({ ..._canonicalUserOrigin });

export const computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm = (
  lat2?: number | null,
  lon2?: number | null,
  userOrigin?: { latitude: number; longitude: number } | null
): number => {
  const originLat = Number(userOrigin?.latitude);
  const originLon = Number(userOrigin?.longitude);
  const origin = userOrigin && isValidNonZeroCoordPair(originLat, originLon)
    ? { latitude: originLat, longitude: originLon }
    : _canonicalUserOrigin;
  const nLat = Number(lat2);
  const nLon = Number(lon2);
  if (!isValidNonZeroCoordPair(nLat, nLon)) {
    return 1.8;
  }
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((nLat - origin.latitude) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((nLon - origin.longitude) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos((origin.latitude * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((nLat * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
  const km = R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, a))), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - a)));
  return Number(Math.max(0.1, km).toFixed(1));
};

export const parseExplicitMapsLatLon = (rawText?: unknown): { latitud: number; longitud: number } | null => {
  let txt = String(rawText || '').trim();
  if (!txt) return null;
  try { txt = `${txt} ${decodeURIComponent(txt)}`; } catch {}
  const m =
    txt.match(/!3d(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)!4d(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i) ||
    txt.match(/@(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/) ||
    txt.match(/[?&](?:q|ll|query|center|destination|daddr)=(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  const lat = Number(m[1]), lon = Number(m[2]);
  return isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)
    ? { latitud: Number(lat.toFixed(6)), longitud: Number(lon.toFixed(6)) }
    : null;
};

const toValidPair = (latRaw: unknown, lonRaw: unknown): { latitud: number; longitud: number } | null => {
  const lat = Number(latRaw), lon = Number(lonRaw);
  if (isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)) {
    return { latitud: lat, longitud: lon };
  }
  return null;
};

export interface IVenueGeoInput {
  id?: string | number | null;
  propietario_id?: string | number | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  negocio_nombre?: string | null;
  ubicacion?: string | null;
  direccion?: string | null;
  latitud?: number | string | null;
  longitud?: number | string | null;
  latitude?: number | string | null;
  longitude?: number | string | null;
}

export const resolveCanonicalVenueCoordinates = (
  venue?: IVenueGeoInput | null,
  catalogRef?: IVenueGeoInput | null,
  fallbackIndex = 0
): { latitud: number; longitud: number } => {
  const key = canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(
    venue?.nombre || venue?.negocio_nombre || catalogRef?.nombre || catalogRef?.negocio_nombre
  );
  const staticCatItem = key
    ? (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).find((a) => canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(a?.nombre) === key) || null
    : null;
  const catItem = catalogRef && catalogRef !== venue ? catalogRef : staticCatItem;
  const forceCat = Boolean(key && (key.includes('baja crossfit') || key.includes('kinetic especialista')));
  const staticPair = staticCatItem
    ? toValidPair(staticCatItem.latitude ?? staticCatItem.latitud, staticCatItem.longitude ?? staticCatItem.longitud)
    : null;
  const catPair =
    (catItem ? toValidPair(catItem.latitude ?? catItem.latitud, catItem.longitude ?? catItem.longitud) : null) ||
    staticPair;
  if (forceCat && (staticPair || catPair)) return (staticPair || catPair)!;

  const explicitUrlPair = parseExplicitMapsLatLon(venue?.ubicacion || venue?.direccion);
  const directPair = toValidPair(venue?.latitud ?? venue?.latitude, venue?.longitud ?? venue?.longitude);
  if (directPair && isCoordsInsideLosCabos(directPair.latitud, directPair.longitud)) return directPair;
  if (explicitUrlPair && isCoordsInsideLosCabos(explicitUrlPair.latitud, explicitUrlPair.longitud)) return explicitUrlPair;
  if (directPair) return directPair;
  if (explicitUrlPair) return explicitUrlPair;
  if (catPair) return catPair;

  return {
    latitud: Number((CABO_BASE_COORDS.latitude + ((fallbackIndex % 7) - 3) * 0.0045).toFixed(6)),
    longitud: Number((CABO_BASE_COORDS.longitude + ((fallbackIndex % 5) - 2) * 0.0045).toFixed(6)),
  };
};

const DAY_ALIASES: [RegExp, number][] = [
  [/\blun(?:es)?\b|\bmon(?:day)?\b/i, 0],
  [/\bmar(?:tes)?\b|\btue(?:s(?:day)?)?\b/i, 1],
  [/\bmie(?:rcoles)?\b|\bwed(?:nesday)?\b/i, 2],
  [/\bjue(?:ves)?\b|\bthu(?:r(?:s(?:day)?)?)?\b/i, 3],
  [/\bvie(?:rnes)?\b|\bfri(?:day)?\b/i, 4],
  [/\bsab(?:ado)?\b|\bsat(?:urday)?\b/i, 5],
  [/\bdom(?:ingo)?\b|\bsun(?:day)?\b/i, 6],
];

const DAY_RANGE_TOKEN =
  '(?:lun(?:es)?|mar(?:tes)?|mie(?:rcoles)?|jue(?:ves)?|vie(?:rnes)?|sab(?:ado)?|dom(?:ingo)?|mon(?:day)?|tue(?:s(?:day)?)?|wed(?:nesday)?|thu(?:r(?:s(?:day)?)?)?|fri(?:day)?|sat(?:urday)?|sun(?:day)?)';
const HAS_TIME_RANGE_RX = /\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–|hasta)\s*\d{1,2}/i;
const STARTS_DAY_RX = new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN}|fin(?:es)?\\s+de\\s+semana|weekends?|daily|diario|todos)\\b`, 'i');
const DAY_RANGE_RX = new RegExp(`\\b(${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN})\\b\\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–)\\s*\\b(${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN})\\b`, 'i');

const parseTimeTokenMinutes = (rawTime: string, mer?: string): number | null => {
  const parts = rawTime.split(':').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
  if (parts.length < 1 || Number.isNaN(parts[0])) return null;
  let hh = parts[0];
  const mm = parts.length >= 2 && !Number.isNaN(parts[1]) ? parts[1] : 0;
  const mLow = String(mer || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\./g, '');
  if (mLow === 'pm' && hh < 12) hh += 12;
  if (mLow === 'am' && hh === 12) hh = 0;
  if (hh === 24 && mm === 0) return 1440;
  return hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59 ? hh * 60 + mm : null;
};

const matchesScheduleDaysSegment = (segNorm: string, monDayIdx: number): boolean => {
  if (!segNorm || /\b(todos\s+los\s+dias|every\s+day|daily|diario|24\s*h|lun(?:es)?\s*(?:a|to|-)\s*dom(?:ingo)?|mon(?:day)?\s*(?:to|-)\s*sun(?:day)?)\b/i.test(segNorm)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (/\bfin(?:es)?\s+de\s+semana|weekends?|sab(?:ado)?\s+y\s+dom(?:ingo)?|sat\s*&\s*sun\b/i.test(segNorm)) {
    return monDayIdx === 5 || monDayIdx === 6;
  }
  const rangeMatch = segNorm.match(DAY_RANGE_RX);
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startIdx = DAY_ALIASES.find(([rx]) => rx.test(rangeMatch[1]))?.[1];
    const endIdx = DAY_ALIASES.find(([rx]) => rx.test(rangeMatch[2]))?.[1];
    if (startIdx !== undefined && endIdx !== undefined) {
      return startIdx <= endIdx
        ? monDayIdx >= startIdx && monDayIdx <= endIdx
        : monDayIdx >= startIdx || monDayIdx <= endIdx;
    }
  }
  const mentionedDays = DAY_ALIASES.filter(([rx]) => rx.test(segNorm)).map(([, idx]) => idx);
  return mentionedDays.length > 0 ? mentionedDays.includes(monDayIdx) : true;
};

const splitScheduleSegments = (norm: string): string[] => {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const chunk of norm.split(/[\/;|]+/)) {
    let acc = '';
    for (const part of chunk.split(',')) {
      const p = part.trim();
      if (!p) continue;
      if (acc && HAS_TIME_RANGE_RX.test(acc) && STARTS_DAY_RX.test(p)) {
        out.push(acc);
        acc = p;
      } else {
        acc = acc ? `${acc}, ${p}` : p;
      }
    }
    if (acc) out.push(acc);
  }
  return out;
};

export const evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan = (
  horariosRaw?: string | null,
  nowRef?: Date,
  lang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'
) => {
  const { monDayIdx, minutesOfDay } = getMazatlanNowParts(nowRef);
  const raw = String(horariosRaw || '')
    .replace(/\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\b2[5-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '21:$1')
    .trim();
  const effectiveRaw = raw || 'Lunes a Sábado • 06:00 a 21:00';
  const norm = effectiveRaw.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();

  let isOpen = false;
  if (/\b(abierto\s*24|open\s*24|24\s*horas|24\s*hrs|24\/7)\b/i.test(norm)) {
    isOpen = true;
  } else {
    const segments = splitScheduleSegments(norm);
    for (const seg of segments) {
      const daysMatch = matchesScheduleDaysSegment(seg, monDayIdx);
      if (!daysMatch) continue;
      const timePairs = Array.from(
        seg.matchAll(/(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?)\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–|hasta)\s*(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?)\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/gi)
      );
      if (timePairs.length === 0) continue;
      for (const m of timePairs) {
        const startMin = parseTimeTokenMinutes(m[1].includes(':') ? m[1] : `${m[1]}:00`, m[2]);
        const endMin = parseTimeTokenMinutes(m[3].includes(':') ? m[3] : `${m[3]}:00`, m[4]);
        if (startMin === null || endMin === null) continue;
        if (endMin > startMin ? (minutesOfDay >= startMin && minutesOfDay < endMin) : (minutesOfDay >= startMin || minutesOfDay < endMin)) {
          isOpen = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (isOpen) break;
    }
  }

  return {
    isOpen,
    badgeEs: isOpen ? ('● ABIERTO' as const) : ('🕒 PRONTO' as const),
    badgeEn: isOpen ? ('● OPEN' as const) : ('🕒 SOON' as const),
    badgeText: lang === 'en' ? (isOpen ? '● OPEN' : '🕒 SOON') : (isOpen ? '● ABIERTO' : '🕒 PRONTO'),
    minutesNow: minutesOfDay,
  };
};

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

const OAUTH_STATIC_HTTPS_ORIGINS = new Set([
  'https://kineticapp.com.mx',
  'https://www.kineticapp.com.mx',
]);
const OAUTH_LOCAL_DEV_ORIGIN_RE = /^http:\/\/(?:localhost|127\.0\.0\.1):(?:8081|19006|3000)$/i;
const OAUTH_NATIVE_DEEP_LINK_RE = /^kinetic:\/\/(?:login|oauth|auth\/callback)(?:[/?#].*)?$/i;
const OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS = [
  'code', 'state', 'id_token', 'access_token', 'refresh_token', 'provider_token',
  'provider_refresh_token', 'expires_in', 'token_type', 'error', 'error_description', 'error_code',
];

export function isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(candidateUrl: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof candidateUrl !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = candidateUrl.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 4096 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s]/.test(clean) || clean.startsWith('//') || clean.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    const authority = clean.slice('kinetic://'.length).split(/[/?#]/)[0] || '';
    return !authority.includes('@') && OAUTH_NATIVE_DEEP_LINK_RE.test(clean);
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return false;
    const origin = parsed.origin.toLowerCase();
    return OAUTH_STATIC_HTTPS_ORIGINS.has(origin) || OAUTH_LOCAL_DEV_ORIGIN_RE.test(origin);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function resolveSafeKineticOAuthRedirectTo(platformOs: string, webOrigin?: string | null): string {
  if (platformOs !== 'web') return 'kinetic://login';
  const clean = String(webOrigin || '').trim();
  if (!isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(clean) || /^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_REDIRECT_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN');
  }
  return new URL(clean).origin;
}

export function validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl: unknown): string {
  const clean = typeof oauthUrl === 'string' ? oauthUrl.trim() : '';
  if (!clean || clean.length > 4096 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(clean) || clean.toLowerCase().includes('service_role')) {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:' || parsed.username || parsed.password) {
      throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
    }
    const host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (host !== 'accounts.google.com' || parsed.pathname !== '/o/oauth2/v2/auth') {
      throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
    }
    return clean;
  } catch {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
  }
}

export function scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation(): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location || !window.history?.replaceState) return;
  try {
    let changed = false;
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || '');
    for (const k of OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS) {
      if (searchParams.has(k)) { searchParams.delete(k); changed = true; }
    }
    let nextHash = window.location.hash || '';
    if (nextHash.length > 1 && nextHash.includes('=')) {
      const rawHash = nextHash.startsWith('#?') ? nextHash.slice(2) : nextHash.slice(1);
      const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(rawHash);
      let hashChanged = false;
      for (const k of OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS) {
        if (hashParams.has(k)) { hashParams.delete(k); hashChanged = true; }
      }
      if (hashChanged) {
        changed = true;
        const rem = hashParams.toString();
        nextHash = rem ? `#${rem}` : '';
      }
    }
    if (changed) {
      const s = searchParams.toString();
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', `${window.location.pathname || '/'}${s ? `?${s}` : ''}${nextHash}`);
    }
  } catch {}
}

export function openInAppGoogleOAuthPopup(oauthUrl: string): Window | null {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || window.innerWidth < 768) return null;
  const safeUrl = validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl);
  try {
    const w = 500;
    const h = 650;
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.round((window.screenX || 0) + (window.outerWidth - w) / 2));
    const top = Math.max(0, Math.round((window.screenY || 0) + (window.outerHeight - h) / 2));
    return window.open(
      safeUrl,
      'kinetic_google_oauth',
      `popup=yes,width=${w},height=${h},left=${left},top=${top},resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
    );
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function probeAndRunWebGoogleOAuthPopup({
  oauthUrl,
  cleanupRef,
  isMountedRef,
}: {
  oauthUrl: string;
  cleanupRef: { current: (() => void) | null };
  isMountedRef: { current: boolean };
}): Promise<{ kind: 'popup_settled' | 'fallback_redirect' }> {
  const safeUrl = validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl);
  cleanupRef.current?.();

  let probeTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  try {
    const ctrl = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null;
    probeTimer = ctrl ? setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 3500) : null;
    const probe = await fetch(safeUrl, {
      method: 'GET',
      redirect: 'manual',
      ...(ctrl ? { signal: ctrl.signal } : {}),
    });
    if (probe.type !== 'opaqueredirect' && !probe.ok && probe.status >= 400) {
      const rawBody = await probe.text().catch(() => '');
      if (rawBody) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(rawBody) as Record<string, unknown>;
          throw new Error(String(parsed.msg || parsed.error_description || parsed.message || 'Unsupported provider'));
        } catch (parseErr) {
          if (parseErr instanceof Error && parseErr.message && !rawBody.trim().startsWith('{')) throw parseErr;
          throw new Error(rawBody);
        }
      }
      throw new Error('Unsupported provider');
    }
  } catch (probeErr: unknown) {
    const pm = (probeErr instanceof Error ? probeErr.message : String(probeErr || '')).toLowerCase();
    if (pm.includes('unsupported provider') || pm.includes('provider is not enabled') || pm.includes('validation_failed')) {
      throw probeErr;
    }
  } finally {
    if (probeTimer) clearTimeout(probeTimer);
  }

  const popup = openInAppGoogleOAuthPopup(safeUrl);
  if (!popup) return { kind: 'fallback_redirect' };

  await new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const cleanup = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(maxTimeout);
      clearInterval(poll);
      sub.subscription.unsubscribe();
      cleanupRef.current = null;
      scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
      resolve(true);
    };
    const { data: sub } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_ev, sess) => {
      if (!settled && sess?.user) {
        try { popup.close(); } catch {}
        cleanup();
      }
    });
    const poll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!settled && popup.closed) cleanup();
    }, 400);
    const maxTimeout = setTimeout(() => cleanup(), 180_000);
    cleanupRef.current = () => {
      try { popup.close(); } catch {}
      cleanup();
    };
  });

  void isMountedRef.current;
  return { kind: 'popup_settled' };
}
