import { Platform } from "react-native";
import * as ExpoCrypto from "expo-crypto";

let hermesEntropyCounter = 1;

// KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED: Filtra avisos de deprecación de librerías externas en React 19 Web
export function installKineticWarnFilter(): void {
  const g: any =
    typeof globalThis !== "undefined"
      ? globalThis
      : typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? window
        : {};

  if (g.KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED) return;
  if (typeof console === "undefined") return;
  g.KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED = true;

  const shouldIgnoreLog = (args: any[]): boolean => {
    const msg = args
      .map((a) => {
        if (typeof a === "string") return a;
        if (a && typeof a.message === "string") return a.message;
        return "";
      })
      .join(" ");

    return (
      msg.includes('"shadow*" style props are deprecated') ||
      msg.includes("props.pointerEvents is deprecated") ||
      msg.includes("useNativeDriver") ||
      msg.includes("RCTAnimation") ||
      msg.includes("TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated") ||
      msg.includes("Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19")
    );
  };

  if (typeof console.warn === "function") {
    const origWarn = console.warn.bind(console);
    console.warn = (...args: any[]) => {
      if (shouldIgnoreLog(args)) return;
      origWarn(...args);
    };
  }

  if (typeof console.error === "function") {
    const origErr = console.error.bind(console);
    console.error = (...args: any[]) => {
      if (shouldIgnoreLog(args)) return;
      origErr(...args);
    };
  }
}

installKineticWarnFilter();

type ListenerFn = (event: any) => void;

const hermesListenersMap: Record<string, Set<ListenerFn>> = {};
const hermesMemoryStorage: Record<string, string> = {};

export function canUseHermesDevPrngFallback(devFlag?: unknown, nodeEnv?: unknown): boolean {
  return devFlag === true && String(nodeEnv ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() !== "production";
}

export function installHermesNativePolyfills(): void {
  if (Platform.OS === "web") return;

  const g: any =
    typeof globalThis !== "undefined"
      ? globalThis
      : typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? window
        : {};

  if (typeof g.window === "undefined") {
    g.window = g;
  }

  if (typeof g.window.location === "undefined") {
    g.window.location = {
      href: "",
      pathname: "",
      hostname: "",
      search: "",
      hash: "",
      origin: "",
      assign: () => {},
      replace: () => {},
      reload: () => {},
    };
  }

  if (typeof g.CustomEvent !== "function") {
    g.CustomEvent = class CustomEvent {
      type: string;
      detail: any;
      constructor(type: string, params?: { detail?: any }) {
        this.type = String(type || "");
        this.detail = params?.detail ?? null;
      }
    };
  }

  if (typeof g.window.addEventListener !== "function") {
    g.window.addEventListener = (type: string, callback: ListenerFn) => {
      if (!type || typeof callback !== "function") return;
      if (!hermesListenersMap[type]) hermesListenersMap[type] = new Set();
      hermesListenersMap[type].add(callback);
    };
  }

  if (typeof g.window.removeEventListener !== "function") {
    g.window.removeEventListener = (type: string, callback: ListenerFn) => {
      if (!type || !hermesListenersMap[type]) return;
      hermesListenersMap[type].delete(callback);
    };
  }

  if (typeof g.window.dispatchEvent !== "function") {
    g.window.dispatchEvent = (event: any): boolean => {
      const type = typeof event === "string" ? event : event?.type;
      if (!type || !hermesListenersMap[type]) return false;
      hermesListenersMap[type].forEach((fn) => {
        try {
          fn(event);
        } catch {
          // Silencioso en Hermes
        }
      });
      return true;
    };
  }

  const safeStorage = {
    getItem: (key: string): string | null =>
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(hermesMemoryStorage, key)
        ? hermesMemoryStorage[key]
        : null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string): void => {
      hermesMemoryStorage[String(key)] = String(value ?? "");
    },
    removeItem: (key: string): void => {
      delete hermesMemoryStorage[String(key)];
    },
    clear: (): void => {
      Object.keys(hermesMemoryStorage).forEach((k) => delete hermesMemoryStorage[k]);
    },
  };

  if (typeof g.localStorage === "undefined") {
    g.localStorage = safeStorage;
  }
  if (typeof g.crypto !== "object" || g.crypto === null) {
    g.crypto = {};
  }
  if (typeof g.crypto.getRandomValues !== "function") {
    g.crypto.getRandomValues = <T extends ArrayBufferView>(arr: T): T => {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(arr.buffer, arr.byteOffset, arr.byteLength);
      try {
        const res = ExpoCrypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
        if (ArrayBuffer.isView(res)) return arr;
      } catch {
        // Fallback SplitMix32 únicamente si un dev-client antiguo no incluye ExpoCrypto nativo
      }
      const allowDevFallback = canUseHermesDevPrngFallback(
        typeof __DEV__ !== "undefined" ? __DEV__ : false,
        typeof process !== "undefined" ? process?.env?.NODE_ENV : undefined
      );
      if (!allowDevFallback) {
        throw new Error("SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE");
      }
      let seed =
        (Date.now() ^
          Math.floor((typeof performance !== "undefined" && typeof performance.now === "function" ? performance.now() : 0) * 1000) ^
          Math.imul(++hermesEntropyCounter, 0x9e3779b1)) >>>
        0;
      for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        seed = (seed + 0x9e3779b9) >>> 0;
        let z = seed;
        z = Math.imul(z ^ (z >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
        z = Math.imul(z ^ (z >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) >>> 0;
        z = (z ^ (z >>> 16)) >>> 0;
        bytes[i] = (z ^ Math.floor(Math.random() * 256)) & 0xff;
      }
      return arr;
    };
  }
  if (typeof g.sessionStorage === "undefined") {
    g.sessionStorage = safeStorage;
  }
}

installHermesNativePolyfills();

import { File } from 'expo-file-system';
import { readAsStringAsync } from 'expo-file-system/legacy';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

const B64_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
const B64_LOOKUP = (() => {
  const table = new Int16Array(256);
  table.fill(-1);
  for (let i = 0; i < B64_ALPHABET.length; i++) {
    table[B64_ALPHABET.charCodeAt(i)] = i;
  }
  return table;
})();

/**
 * Decodificador binario puro Base64 / DataURI -> Uint8Array.
 * Rechaza cadenas vacías, corruptas o malformadas devolviendo `null` sin lanzar excepciones.
 */
export function decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(rawInput: unknown): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    if (typeof rawInput !== 'string') return null;
    const trimmed = rawInput.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return null;

    let b64Payload = trimmed;
    if (/^data:/i.test(trimmed)) {
      const match = trimmed.match(/^data:[^;,]+(?:;charset=[^;,]+)?;base64,([\s\S]+)$/i);
      if (!match || !match[1]) return null;
      b64Payload = match[1];
    }

    const clean = b64Payload.replace(/[\r\n\t ]+/g, '');
    if (clean.length < 4 || clean.length % 4 !== 0) return null;
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(clean)) return null;

    const padCount = clean.endsWith('==') ? 2 : clean.endsWith('=') ? 1 : 0;
    const byteLen = (clean.length * 3) / 4 - padCount;
    if (byteLen <= 0) return null;

    const out = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 4) {
      const c0 = clean.charCodeAt(i);
      const c1 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 1);
      const c2 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 2);
      const c3 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 3);
      const a = c0 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c0] : -1;
      const b = c1 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c1] : -1;
      const c = c2 === 61 ? 0 : c2 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c2] : -1;
      const d = c3 === 61 ? 0 : c3 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c3] : -1;
      if (a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 || d < 0) return null;

      out[p++] = (a << 2) | (b >> 4);
      if (p < byteLen) out[p++] = ((b & 15) << 4) | (c >> 2);
      if (p < byteLen) out[p++] = ((c & 3) << 6) | d;
    }

    return out.byteLength > 0 ? out : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  if (!(bytes instanceof Uint8Array) || bytes.byteLength === 0) return '';
  let out = '';
  const len = bytes.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const b1 = i + 1 < len ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = i + 2 < len ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    out += B64_ALPHABET[b0 >> 2];
    out += B64_ALPHABET[((b0 & 3) << 4) | (b1 >> 4)];
    out += i + 1 < len ? B64_ALPHABET[((b1 & 15) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)] : '=';
    out += i + 2 < len ? B64_ALPHABET[b2 & 63] : '=';
  }
  return out;
}

export const ALLOWED_STORAGE_IMAGE_MIMES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic'] as const;
export type StorageImageMime = (typeof ALLOWED_STORAGE_IMAGE_MIMES)[number];
export const MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

export interface ISafeStorageImageValidationResult {
  ok: boolean;
  contentType?: StorageImageMime;
  ext?: 'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic';
  byteLength: number;
  reason?: 'empty_payload' | 'file_too_large' | 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' | 'active_content_detected' | 'invalid_magic_bytes';
}

const MIME_ALIASES: Record<string, { contentType: StorageImageMime; ext: 'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic' }> = {
  'image/jpeg': { contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg' },
  'image/jpg': { contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg' },
  'image/png': { contentType: 'image/png', ext: 'png' },
  'image/webp': { contentType: 'image/webp', ext: 'webp' },
  'image/heic': { contentType: 'image/heic', ext: 'heic' },
  'image/heif': { contentType: 'image/heic', ext: 'heic' },

const DANGEROUS_URI_EXT_RE = /\.(?:svgz?|html?|xhtml|xml|js|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx|php|jsp|asp|aspx|exe|dll|sh|bat|cmd|msi|apk|pdf)$/i;
const HEIC_FTYP_BRANDS = new Set(['heic', 'heix', 'hevc', 'hevx', 'mif1', 'msf1']);

const asciiAt = (bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, len: number): string => {
  let out = '';
  for (let i = start; i < start + len && i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
    out += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  }
  return out;
};

export function validateSafeStorageImagePayload(input: {

  uriOrName?: string | null;
  declaredMime?: string | null;
  maxBytes?: number;

  const bytes = input?.bytes;

    return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'empty_payload' };
  }
  const maxBytes = typeof input.maxBytes === 'number' && input.maxBytes > 0 ? input.maxBytes : MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES;
  if (bytes.byteLength > maxBytes) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'file_too_large' };
  }

  const rawMime = String(input.declaredMime || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(';')[0].trim();
  if (rawMime && !MIME_ALIASES[rawMime]) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
  }

  const rawUri = String(input.uriOrName || '').trim();
  if (rawUri) {
    if (/^data:/i.test(rawUri)) {
      const dataMimeMatch = rawUri.match(/^data:([^;,]+)/i);
      const dataMime = String(dataMimeMatch?.[1] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!dataMime || !MIME_ALIASES[dataMime]) {
        return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
      }
    } else {
      const cleanPath = rawUri.split(/[?#]/)[0].trim();
      if (DANGEROUS_URI_EXT_RE.test(cleanPath)) {
        return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
      }
    }
  }

  let offset = 0;
  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xef && bytes[1] === 0xbb && bytes[2] === 0xbf) offset = 3;
  while (offset < bytes.length && offset < 64 && (bytes[offset] === 0x20 || bytes[offset] === 0x09 || bytes[offset] === 0x0a || bytes[offset] === 0x0d)) {
    offset += 1;
  }
  const headText = asciiAt(bytes, offset, 24).toLowerCase();
  if (
    /^(?:<svg\b|<!doctype\b|<html\b|<script\b|<\?xml\b)/.test(headText) ||
    (bytes.length >= 2 && bytes[0] === 0x4d && bytes[1] === 0x5a) ||
    (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x7f && bytes[1] === 0x45 && bytes[2] === 0x4c && bytes[3] === 0x46) ||
    (bytes.length >= 2 && bytes[0] === 0x23 && bytes[1] === 0x21)
  ) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'active_content_detected' };
  }

  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (
    bytes.length >= 8 &&
    bytes[0] === 0x89 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x4e && bytes[3] === 0x47 &&
    bytes[4] === 0x0d && bytes[5] === 0x0a && bytes[6] === 0x1a && bytes[7] === 0x0a
  ) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/png', ext: 'png', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && asciiAt(bytes, 0, 4) === 'RIFF' && asciiAt(bytes, 8, 4) === 'WEBP') {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/webp', ext: 'webp', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && asciiAt(bytes, 4, 4) === 'ftyp' && HEIC_FTYP_BRANDS.has(asciiAt(bytes, 8, 4).toLowerCase())) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/heic', ext: 'heic', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }

  return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'invalid_magic_bytes' };
}

export function isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(uri?: string | null): boolean {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  return /^https:\/\/(?!localhost\b|127\.|10\.|192\.168\.)/i.test(clean) && !/^blob:/i.test(clean);
}

export function isLocalOrEphemeralMediaUri(uri?: string | null): boolean {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return false;
  return !isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(clean);
}

/**
 * Convierte cualquier URI multimedia (`data:image/...`, `file://...`, `content://...`, `blob:...`)
 * en `Uint8Array` puro verificando `byteLength > 0`. Prohibido usar `fetch(uri).blob()`.
 */
export async function readMediaUriAsUint8Array(rawUri: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const uri = String(rawUri || '').trim();
  if (!uri) return null;

  if (/^data:/i.test(uri)) {
    return decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(uri);
  }

  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' && /^(file|content|ph|assets-library):\/\//i.test(uri)) {
    if (/^file:\/\//i.test(uri)) {
      try {
        const fsFile = new File(uri);
        const bytes = await fsFile.bytes();
        if (bytes && bytes.byteLength > 0) {
          return bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const b64 = await readAsStringAsync(uri, { encoding: 'base64' });
      const decoded = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(b64);
      if (decoded && decoded.byteLength > 0) return decoded;
    } catch {}
  }

  if (!/^(blob:|https?:\/\/|file:\/\/|content:\/\/)/i.test(uri)) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(uri);
    if (!resp || (typeof resp.ok === 'boolean' && !resp.ok && resp.status !== 0)) return null;
    const ct = String(resp.headers?.get?.('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/text\/html|application\/json|svg|xml|javascript/.test(ct)) return null;
    const cLen = Number(resp.headers?.get?.('content-length') || 0);
    if (Number.isFinite(cLen) && cLen > MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES) return null;
    const ab = await resp.arrayBuffer();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(ab);
    return bytes.byteLength > 0 && bytes.byteLength <= MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES ? bytes : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export const translateSpanishVenueBioFallback = (text: string): string => {
  if (!text) return text;
  const direct = lookupLiveClubBioEn(text);
  if (direct) return direct;
  let out = text;
  for (const [pattern, replacement] of SPANISH_BIO_CLAUSE_RULES) {
    out = out.replace(pattern, replacement);
  }
  return out;
};

export const resolveOnAccentLock = (solidBgHex: string) => {
  const norm = String(solidBgHex || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (norm === '#00F0FF' || norm === '#00E5FF' || norm === '#00D8EB') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#008B99' };
  if (norm === '#00FF66' || norm === '#059669') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#059669' };
  if (norm === '#FFCC00' || norm === '#FFD700') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#B45309' };
  if (norm === '#9D4EDD' || norm === '#B026FF' || norm === '#7C3AED') return { textColor: '#FFFFFF', iconColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#5B21B6' };
  if (norm === '#FF3B30' || norm === '#EF4444') return { textColor: '#FFFFFF', iconColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#991B1B' };
  return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#008B99' };
};

export const DARK_ELEVATED_HEXES = new Set([
  '#080C12', '#090C12', '#0A0C12', '#0A0D14', '#0A0F18', '#0B0E14', '#0C1017',
  '#0D1117', '#0E131F', '#0F1014', '#0F1218', '#0F172A', '#111318', '#12151C',
  '#141821', '#161B26', '#181C24', '#1A1D24', '#1E2430',
]);

export const resolveParentChildTextColor = (rawColor: string | undefined, parentIsLightSurface: boolean): string => {
  const c = String(rawColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!parentIsLightSurface) {
    if (c === '#050505' || c === '#0F172A' || c === '#000000' || c === '#111827') return '#FFFFFF';
    if (c === '#9D4EDD' || c === '#7C3AED') return '#C77DFF';
    return rawColor || '#FFFFFF';
  }
  if (!c || c === '#FFFFFF' || c === '#FFF' || c === '#F8FAFC') return '#0F172A';
  if (c === '#CBD5E1' || c === '#E2E8F0' || c === '#D1D5DB') return '#334155';
  if (['#B5B5B5', '#A0A0A0', '#8E8E93', '#888', '#888888', '#94A3B8', '#64748B'].includes(c) || c.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255') || c.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255')) {
    return '#475569';
  }
  if (c === '#00F0FF' || c === '#00E5FF' || c === '#B8FFFF' || c === '#0284C7') return '#006B82';
  if (c === '#00FF66') return '#047857';
  if (c === '#FFCC00' || c === '#FFD700') return '#B45309';
  if (c === '#CD7F32') return '#92400E';
  if (c === '#FF3B30' || c === '#EF4444' || c === '#FF453A' || c === '#FF6B6B') return '#B91C1C';
  if (['#F3E8FF', '#E0AAFF', '#D8B4FE', '#C77DFF', '#B026FF', '#9D4EDD'].includes(c)) return '#6D28D9';
  return rawColor || '#0F172A';
};

export const build3DCardStyle = (isLight: boolean, accent: 'neutral' | 'cyan' | 'purple' = 'neutral'): ViewStyle => {
  if (isLight) {
    const lip = accent === 'cyan' ? '#0284C7' : accent === 'purple' ? '#7C3AED' : '#CBD5E1';
    const side = accent === 'cyan' ? '#7DD3FC' : accent === 'purple' ? '#C4B5FD' : '#E2E8F0';
    return {
      backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderLeftWidth: 1, borderRightWidth: 1, borderBottomWidth: 3.5,
      borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderLeftColor: side, borderRightColor: side, borderBottomColor: lip,
      shadowColor: '#0F172A', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.08, shadowRadius: 10, elevation: 6,
    };
  }
  const lipDark = accent === 'cyan' ? '#008B99' : accent === 'purple' ? '#4A1478' : '#020408';
  return {
    backgroundColor: '#090C12', borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderLeftWidth: 1, borderRightWidth: 1, borderBottomWidth: 3.5,
    borderTopColor: accent === 'cyan' ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.42)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)',
    borderLeftColor: accent === 'cyan' ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10)',
    borderRightColor: accent === 'cyan' ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10)',
    borderBottomColor: lipDark, shadowColor: accent === 'cyan' ? '#00F0FF' : '#000000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 5 }, shadowOpacity: 0.34, shadowRadius: 10, elevation: 8,
  };
};

const isWhiteRgbaBorder = (val: unknown): boolean => {
  const up = String(val || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return up.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255') || up.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255');
};

const capShadowAndAndroidElevation = (styleObj: Record<string, any>, isLight: boolean): Record<string, any> => {
  let out = styleObj;
  if (Number(out.shadowRadius) > 10) out = out === styleObj ? { ...out, shadowRadius: 10 } : (out.shadowRadius = 10, out);
  if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
    const hasBgProp = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out, 'backgroundColor');
    const bgl = String(out.backgroundColor || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isNonSolidBg = bgl === 'transparent' || bgl.startsWith('rgba(') || bgl.startsWith('hsla(');
    if ((hasBgProp && isNonSolidBg) || (Number(out.elevation) > 0 && (!hasBgProp || isNonSolidBg))) {
      out = { ...out, elevation: 0, shadowOpacity: 0, shadowRadius: 0 };
    } else if (Number(out.elevation) > (isLight ? 2 : 3)) {
      out = {
        ...out,
        elevation: isLight ? 2 : 3,
        shadowColor: isLight ? '#64748B' : '#000000',
        ...(isLight ? { shadowOpacity: 0.08 } : {}),
      };
    }
  }
  return out;
};

export const adaptStyleSheetForTheme = <T extends Record<string, any>>(
  baseStyles: T,
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme,
  mediaLockKeys: string[] = []
): T => {
  if (!baseStyles) return baseStyles;
  const mediaSet = new Set(mediaLockKeys);

  if (resolvedTheme !== 'light') {
    const darkAdapted: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(baseStyles)) {
      let raw = baseStyles[key];
      if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !mediaSet.has(key)) {
        const upColor = typeof raw.color === 'string' ? raw.color.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
        if (upColor === '#9D4EDD' || upColor === '#7C3AED') raw = { ...raw, color: '#C77DFF' };
        raw = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(raw, false);
      }
      darkAdapted[key] = raw;
    }
    return darkAdapted as T;
  }

  const adapted: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(baseStyles)) {
    const raw = baseStyles[key];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || mediaSet.has(key)) {
      adapted[key] = raw;
      continue;
    }
    const next: Record<string, any> = { ...raw };
    const bg = String(next.backgroundColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const isSolidAccent = ['#00F0FF', '#00E5FF', '#00FF66', '#FFCC00', '#FFD700', '#CD7F32', '#A8B2C1', '#E0AAFF', '#9D4EDD', '#B026FF', '#FF3B30', '#EF4444'].includes(bg);
    const isMediaBackdrop = bg.startsWith('RGBA(5,') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(5 ');
    if (isSolidAccent || isMediaBackdrop) {
      adapted[key] = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(next, true);
      continue;
    }
    if (bg === '#050505') next.backgroundColor = '#ECF1F8';
    else if (key.toLowerCase().includes('dragpill') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.2') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.3') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.2') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.3')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#94A3B8';
    } else if (DARK_ELEVATED_HEXES.has(bg) || /^#0[89ABCDEF]/.test(bg) || /^#1[0-9A-E]/.test(bg) || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.0')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF';
    } else if (/^#0[4567]/.test(bg)) next.backgroundColor = '#F1F5F9';
    else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(157, 78, 221') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(157,78,221') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(168, 85, 247') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(176, 38, 255')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#F5F3FF'; next.borderColor = '#7C3AED';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#7C3AED'; next.shadowColor = '#7C3AED'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.22; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 59, 48') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,59,48') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(239, 68, 68')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FEF2F2'; next.borderColor = '#DC2626';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#DC2626'; next.shadowColor = '#DC2626'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(0, 240, 255') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(0,240,255')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#ECFEFF'; next.borderColor = '#06B6D4';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#00B8D4'; next.shadowColor = '#00B8D4'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.22; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(0, 255, 102') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(0,255,102')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#ECFDF5'; next.borderColor = '#10B981';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#00C853'; next.shadowColor = '#00C853'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 204, 0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,204,0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 215, 0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(245, 158, 11')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FEF3C7'; next.borderColor = '#F59E0B';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#FFAB00'; next.shadowColor = '#F59E0B'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    }
    const bbc = String(next.borderBottomColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (/^#00[456789AB]/.test(bbc)) next.borderBottomColor = '#00B8D4';
    else if (bbc === '#4A1478' || bbc === '#4C1D95' || bbc === '#3B0764') next.borderBottomColor = '#7C3AED';
    else if (bbc === '#7F0000' || bbc === '#991B1B') next.borderBottomColor = '#DC2626';
    else if (/^#0[234]/.test(bbc)) next.borderBottomColor = '#CBD5E1';
    else if (bbc === '#1F222A' || isWhiteRgbaBorder(bbc)) next.borderBottomColor = '#CBD5E1';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderColor)) next.borderColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderLeftColor)) next.borderLeftColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderRightColor)) next.borderRightColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (next.borderTopColor && !String(next.borderTopColor).startsWith('#94')) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
    if (String(next.shadowColor || '').toUpperCase() === '#000000') { next.shadowColor = '#0F172A'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.08; }
    if (typeof next.color === 'string') next.color = resolveParentChildTextColor(next.color, true);
    adapted[key] = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(next, true);
  }
  return adapted as T;
};

let _lastRnRuleCount = -1;
let _lastEngineCss = '';

export const syncOmniSurfaceEngine = (
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme = 'dark',
  language: KineticLanguage = 'es'
): void => {
  const themeChanged = _lastSyncedTheme !== resolvedTheme;
  _lastSyncedTheme = resolvedTheme;
  const bgHex = resolvedTheme === 'light' ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS.rootCanvas : DARK_M3_TOKENS.rootCanvas;
  try {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('data-kinetic-theme') !== resolvedTheme) htmlEl.setAttribute('data-kinetic-theme', resolvedTheme);
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('data-theme') !== resolvedTheme) htmlEl.setAttribute('data-theme', resolvedTheme);
      if (htmlEl.lang !== language) htmlEl.lang = language;
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('translate') !== 'no') { htmlEl.setAttribute('translate', 'no'); htmlEl.classList.add('notranslate'); }
      if (htmlEl.style.backgroundColor !== bgHex) htmlEl.style.backgroundColor = bgHex;
      if (document.body) {
        if (document.body.style.backgroundColor !== bgHex) document.body.style.backgroundColor = bgHex;
        if (document.body.getAttribute('translate') !== 'no') { document.body.setAttribute('translate', 'no'); document.body.classList.add('notranslate'); }
      }
      if (document.head) {
        if (!document.head.querySelector('meta[name="google"]')) {
          const meta = document.createElement('meta');
          meta.setAttribute('name', 'google');
          meta.setAttribute('content', 'notranslate');
          document.head.appendChild(meta);
        }
        installKineticWebBaseCss();
        document.getElementById('kinetic-theme-engine')?.remove();
        let styleEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-3d-contrast-engine') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
        const isFirstInject = !styleEl;
        if (!styleEl) { styleEl = document.createElement('style'); styleEl.id = 'kinetic-3d-contrast-engine'; document.head.appendChild(styleEl); }
        const rnStyle = document.getElementById('react-native-stylesheet') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
        let rnCount = 0;
        try { rnCount = rnStyle?.sheet?.cssRules?.length ?? (rnStyle?.textContent?.length || 0); } catch {}
        if (isFirstInject || themeChanged || (_lastRnRuleCount <= 0 && rnCount > 0)) {
          const darkBase = 'html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"], html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"] body, html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"] #root { background-color: #050505 !important; color-scheme: dark; }';
          const nextCss = `${darkBase}\n${buildOmniWebM3Css()}`;
          if (nextCss !== _lastEngineCss) { styleEl.textContent = nextCss; _lastEngineCss = nextCss; }
          _lastRnRuleCount = rnCount;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    RNStatusBar.setBarStyle(resolvedTheme === 'light' ? 'dark-content' : 'light-content', true);
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') RNStatusBar.setBackgroundColor(bgHex, true);
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    const SystemUI = require('expo-system-ui');
    if (SystemUI?.setBackgroundColorAsync) SystemUI.setBackgroundColorAsync(bgHex).catch(() => {});
  } catch {}
};

// 1. Sanitizador contra caracteres escapados crudos (\r\n)
export function sanitizeCleanText(raw: unknown): string {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}

// 2. Comparador semantico de Amenidades (Regaderas, Lockers, Parking, Recovery)
export type TKineticAmenityFilterKey = 'all' | 'regaderas' | 'lockers' | 'parking' | 'recovery';

const AMENITY_SYNONYMS: Record<Exclude<TKineticAmenityFilterKey, 'all'>, string[]> = {
  regaderas: ['regadera', 'ducha', 'shower', 'vestidor', 'bano', 'vapor'],
  lockers: ['locker', 'casillero', 'guarda', 'seguridad'],
  parking: ['estacionamiento', 'parking', 'valet', 'cochera'],
  recovery: ['cold plunge', 'hielo', 'sauna', 'crioterapia', 'recovery', 'spa', 'fisioterapia', 'masaje', 'hiperbarica'],
};

export function matchesAmenityFilter(
  amenidades: string[] | undefined | null,
  filterKey: TKineticAmenityFilterKey,
  disciplinaFallback?: string
): boolean {
  if (!filterKey || filterKey === 'all') return true;
  const keywords = AMENITY_SYNONYMS[filterKey] || [];
  const pool = [...(Array.isArray(amenidades) ? amenidades : []), String(disciplinaFallback || '')]
    .join(' ')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  return keywords.some((kw) => pool.includes(kw));
}

// 3. Insignias dinamicas de Estado de Cupo y Alta Demanda
export function getEventCapacityBadge(cupoMaximo?: number, inscritosCount?: number): {
  label: string;
  tone: 'danger' | 'warning' | 'diamond' | 'ok';
  remaining: number;
} {
  const max = Math.max(1, Number(cupoMaximo) || 15);
  const used = Math.max(0, Number(inscritosCount) || 0);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, max - used);
  if (remaining === 0) {
    return { label: '⛔ AGOTADA', tone: 'danger', remaining: 0 };
  }
  if (used > 0 && remaining > 0 && remaining <= 3) {
    return { label: '🔥 ULTIMOS ' + remaining + ' LUGARES', tone: 'warning', remaining };
  }
  if (remaining <= Math.ceil(max * 0.35)) {
    return { label: '💎 ALTA DEMANDA • SUELE AGOTARSE', tone: 'diamond', remaining };
  }
  return { label: '✓ ' + remaining + ' CUPOS DISPONIBLES', tone: 'ok', remaining };
}

// 4. Cronometro y detector de Venta Flash (< 3h antes de iniciar)
export function getFlashSaleCountdownInfo(fechaIso?: string, horaInicio?: string): {
  isFlashWindow: boolean;
  countdownLabel: string;
} {
  try {
    if (!fechaIso || !horaInicio) return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    const cleanTime = String(horaInicio).trim().slice(0, 5);
    const parts = cleanTime.split(':').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    const hh = parts[0];
    const mm = parts[1];
    if (Number.isNaN(hh) || Number.isNaN(mm)) return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    const dateParts = String(fechaIso).slice(0, 10).split('-').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    const target = new Date(dateParts[0], (dateParts[1] || 1) - 1, dateParts[2] || 1, hh, mm, 0).getTime();
    const diffMs = target - Date.now();
    const threeHoursMs = 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (diffMs <= 0 || diffMs > threeHoursMs) {
      return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    }
    const totalSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const hours = String(Math.floor(totalSec / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
    const mins = String(Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const secs = String(totalSec % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return { isFlashWindow: true, countdownLabel: '⏱️ FLASH ' + hours + ':' + mins + ':' + secs };
  } catch {
    return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
  }
}

// 5. Detector de Horario Nocturno para sugerir Cartelera de Manana (Anti-pantalla vacia)
export function shouldSuggestTomorrowSchedule(activeDayEventsCount: number): boolean {
  const currentHour = new Date().getHours();
  return activeDayEventsCount === 0 || currentHour >= 21;
}

  }
}

// 9. Detector tactil universal Swipe-to-Close desde Portada / Cabecera (>42px hacia abajo)
let _kineticSwipeStartY = 0;
let _kineticSwipeStartX = 0;
let _kineticSwipeFired = false;
export function createSwipeDownToCloseHandlers(onClose?: (() => void) | null, threshold = 42) {
  return {
    onTouchStart: (e: any) => {
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      _kineticSwipeStartY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      _kineticSwipeStartX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      _kineticSwipeFired = false;
    },
    onTouchMove: (e: any) => {
      if (!_kineticSwipeStartY || _kineticSwipeFired || typeof onClose !== 'function') return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const curY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const curX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = curY - _kineticSwipeStartY;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(curX - _kineticSwipeStartX);
      if (deltaY > threshold && deltaY > deltaX * 1.15) {
        _kineticSwipeFired = true;
        _kineticSwipeStartY = 0;
        onClose();
      }
    },
    onTouchEnd: (e: any) => {
      if (!_kineticSwipeStartY || _kineticSwipeFired || typeof onClose !== 'function') return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.changedTouches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const endY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const endX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = endY - _kineticSwipeStartY;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(endX - _kineticSwipeStartX);
      _kineticSwipeStartY = 0;
      if (deltaY > threshold && deltaY > deltaX * 1.15) {
        _kineticSwipeFired = true;
        onClose();
      }
    },
  };
}

// 10. Bus global multi-plataforma para sincronizacion instantanea Radar + Root Refresh + Modales
const _radarListeners = new Set<() => void>();
const _rootRefreshListeners = new Set<() => void>();
let _inlineOverlayOpenCount = 0;
let _dispatchingRadarInternal = false;
let _dispatchingRootInternal = false;

export const createDebouncedEventRunner = (fn: () => void, delayMs = 150) => {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  const trigger = () => {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = null;
      try { fn(); } catch {}
    }, delayMs);
  };
  const cancel = () => {
    if (timer) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = null;
    }
  };
  return { trigger, cancel };
};

export const emitKineticRadarUpdated = (): void => {
  _dispatchingRadarInternal = true;
  try {
    _radarListeners.forEach((cb) => {
      try { cb(); } catch {}
    });
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:radar-updated'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:boveda-updated'));
      } catch {}
    }
  } finally {
    _dispatchingRadarInternal = false;
  }
};

export const subscribeKineticRadarUpdated = (cb: () => void): (() => void) => {
  _radarListeners.add(cb);
  const winHandler = () => {
    if (_dispatchingRadarInternal) return;
    try { cb(); } catch {}
  };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
    window.addEventListener('kinetic:radar-updated', winHandler);
  }
  return () => {
    _radarListeners.delete(cb);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      window.removeEventListener('kinetic:radar-updated', winHandler);
    }
  };
};

export const emitKineticRootRefresh = (): void => {
  _dispatchingRootInternal = true;
  try {
    _rootRefreshListeners.forEach((cb) => {
      try { cb(); } catch {}
    });
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:root-refresh'));
      } catch {}
    }
  } finally {
    _dispatchingRootInternal = false;
  }
};

export const subscribeKineticRootRefresh = (cb: () => void): (() => void) => {
  _rootRefreshListeners.add(cb);
  const winHandler = () => {
    if (_dispatchingRootInternal) return;
    try { cb(); } catch {}
  };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
    window.addEventListener('kinetic:root-refresh', winHandler);
  }
  return () => {
    _rootRefreshListeners.delete(cb);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      window.removeEventListener('kinetic:root-refresh', winHandler);
    }
  };
};

  _inlineOverlayOpenCount = Math.max(0, _inlineOverlayOpenCount + (open ? 1 : -1));

export const extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords = (
  rawInput?: string | null
): { cleanValue: string; url: string | null; lat: number | null; lng: number | null; detectedZone: string | null } => {
  const str = String(rawInput || '').trim();
  const urlMatch = str.match(/https?:\/\/\S+/i);
  const url = urlMatch ? urlMatch[0].replace(/[),.]+$/, '') : null;
  let lat: number | null = null;
  let lng: number | null = null;
  const atMatch = str.match(/@(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+),(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/);
  const qMatch = str.match(/[?&](?:q|query|ll)=(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)(?:%2C|,)(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i);
  const d3Match = str.match(/!3d(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)!4d(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/);
  const coordHit = atMatch || qMatch || d3Match;
  if (coordHit) {
    const pLat = parseFloat(coordHit[1]);
    const pLng = parseFloat(coordHit[2]);
    if (Number.isFinite(pLat) && Number.isFinite(pLng)) {
      lat = pLat;
      lng = pLng;
    }
  }
  let detectedZone: string | null = null;
  if (url) {
    const placeMatch = decodeURIComponent(url).match(/\/place\/([^/@?]+)/i);
    if (placeMatch?.[1]) {
      detectedZone = placeMatch[1].replace(/\+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
  }
  return {
    cleanValue: url || str,
    url,
    lat,
    lng,
    detectedZone,
  };
};

export const FAV_EVENTS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_fav_events_v25';
export const EVENT_RATINGS_MAP_KEY = '@kinetic_event_ratings_map_v25';
export const DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_direct_messages_v25';

let memoryFavEventsSet: Set<string> = new Set();
let memoryEventRatingsMap: Record<string, number> = {};

export const getCanonicalFixedEventKey = (ev: any): string => {
  if (!ev) return '';
  const club = String(ev.negocio_nombre || ev.club || 'kinetic').trim().toLowerCase();
  const title = String(ev.titulo || ev.nombre_servicio || ev.servicio || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const disc = String(ev.categoria || ev.disciplina || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (title) return `${club}::${title}`;
  return String(ev.id || `${club}::${disc}`).trim().toLowerCase();
};

export const hydrateFavoriteEvents = async (userId?: string | null): Promise<string[]> => {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(`${FAV_EVENTS_STORAGE_KEY}_${userId || 'guest'}`);
    const list: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    memoryFavEventsSet = new Set(list);
    return list;
  } catch {
    return Array.from(memoryFavEventsSet);
  }
};

export const isEventFavoriteSync = (ev: any): boolean => {
  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  const idStr = String(ev?.id || '');
  return memoryFavEventsSet.has(key) || (Boolean(idStr) && memoryFavEventsSet.has(idStr));
};

export const toggleFavoriteEventPersistence = async (
  ev: any,
  userId?: string | null
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  const idStr = String(ev?.id || '');
  const storageKey = `${FAV_EVENTS_STORAGE_KEY}_${userId || 'guest'}`;
  await hydrateFavoriteEvents(userId);
  const currentlyFav = isEventFavoriteSync(ev);
  if (currentlyFav) {
    memoryFavEventsSet.delete(key);
    if (idStr) memoryFavEventsSet.delete(idStr);
  } else {
    if (key) memoryFavEventsSet.add(key);
    if (idStr) memoryFavEventsSet.add(idStr);
  }
  const updated = Array.from(memoryFavEventsSet);
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated)).catch(() => {});
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(FAV_EVENTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated)).catch(() => {});
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:fav-events-updated', { detail: { updated } }));
  }
  emitKineticRadarUpdated();
  return !currentlyFav;
};

export const getCustomEventRatingSync = (ev: any): number => {
  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  if (key && memoryEventRatingsMap[key]) return memoryEventRatingsMap[key];
  const raw = Number(ev?.rating_evento || ev?.rating || 5.0);
  return Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : 5.0;
};

export const saveCustomEventRating = async (ev: any, stars: number): Promise<number> => {
  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  const clean = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Number(stars) || 5));
  if (key) memoryEventRatingsMap[key] = clean;
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(EVENT_RATINGS_MAP_KEY, JSON.stringify(memoryEventRatingsMap)).catch(() => {});
  return clean;
};

let disciplinePickerOpenCount = 0;
let fullScreenModalOverlayCount = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

const emit = () => listeners.forEach((fn) => fn());

export const setDisciplinePickerOpen = (open: boolean): void => {
  const next = Math.max(0, disciplinePickerOpenCount + (open ? 1 : -1));
  if (next === disciplinePickerOpenCount) return;
  disciplinePickerOpenCount = next;
  emit();
};

export const setFullScreenModalOverlayOpen = (open: boolean): void => {
  const next = Math.max(0, fullScreenModalOverlayCount + (open ? 1 : -1));
  if (next === fullScreenModalOverlayCount) return;
  fullScreenModalOverlayCount = next;
  emit();
};

const subscribe = (fn: () => void) => {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(fn);
  };
};

const getSnapshot = () => disciplinePickerOpenCount > 0;
const getFullOverlaySnapshot = () => fullScreenModalOverlayCount > 0;

export const useIsDisciplinePickerOpen = (): boolean => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
export const useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen = (): boolean =>
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getFullOverlaySnapshot, getFullOverlaySnapshot);

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  Insets,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  StyleProp,
  StyleSheet,
  ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';

export type KineticPhysicsPresetName = 'tactileChip' | 'cardFloat' | 'dockTab' | 'primaryAction';

export interface IKineticSpringConfig {
  tension: number;
  friction: number;
  pressScale: number;
  pressTranslateY: number;
}

export const KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS: Record<KineticPhysicsPresetName, IKineticSpringConfig> = {
  tactileChip: { tension: 320, friction: 20, pressScale: 0.945, pressTranslateY: 1.5 },
  cardFloat: { tension: 260, friction: 22, pressScale: 0.975, pressTranslateY: 2.0 },
  dockTab: { tension: 340, friction: 19, pressScale: 0.925, pressTranslateY: 1.5 },
  primaryAction: { tension: 290, friction: 18, pressScale: 0.955, pressTranslateY: 2.5 },
};

export interface ITactilePressFrame {
  scale: number;
  translateY: number;
  opacity: number;
}

export const computeTactilePressFrame = (
  preset: KineticPhysicsPresetName,
  pressed: boolean,
  disabled = false,
): ITactilePressFrame => {
  const cfg = KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS[preset] || KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS.tactileChip;
  if (disabled) {
    return { scale: 1, translateY: 0, opacity: 0.56 };
  }
  if (!pressed) {
    return { scale: 1, translateY: 0, opacity: 1 };
  }
  return {
    scale: cfg.pressScale,
    translateY: cfg.pressTranslateY,
    opacity: 0.96,
  };
};

interface KineticPhysicsPressableProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  preset?: KineticPhysicsPresetName;
  onPress?: (e?: any) => void;
  onLongPress?: (e?: any) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  contentContainerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  hitSlop?: number | Insets;
  accessibilityRole?: any;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
  accessibilityState?: any;
  testID?: string;
  activeOpacity?: number;
  dataSet?: Record<string, string>;
}

export const KineticPhysicsPressable: React.FC<KineticPhysicsPressableProps> = ({
  children,
  preset = 'tactileChip',
  onPress,
  onLongPress,
  disabled = false,
  style,
  contentContainerStyle,
  hitSlop,
  accessibilityRole = 'button',
  accessibilityLabel,
  accessibilityState,
  testID,
  dataSet,
}) => {
  const cfg = KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS[preset] || KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS.tactileChip;
  const pressAnim = useRef(typeof Animated?.Value === 'function' ? new Animated.Value(0) : null).current;
  const activeAnimRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      try {
        activeAnimRef.current?.stop?.();
      } catch {}
    };
  }, []);

  const animateTo = useCallback(
    (toValue: number) => {
      if (!pressAnim || typeof Animated?.spring !== 'function') return;
      try {
        activeAnimRef.current?.stop?.();
        const anim = Animated.spring(pressAnim, {
          toValue,
          tension: cfg.tension,
          friction: cfg.friction,
          useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
        });
        activeAnimRef.current = anim;
        anim.start();
      } catch {}
    },
    [pressAnim, cfg.tension, cfg.friction],
  );

  const flatStyle = (StyleSheet.flatten(style as any) || {}) as ViewStyle;
  const outerStyle: ViewStyle = {};
  if (flatStyle.flex !== undefined) outerStyle.flex = flatStyle.flex;
  if (flatStyle.width !== undefined) outerStyle.width = flatStyle.width;
  if (flatStyle.minWidth !== undefined) outerStyle.minWidth = flatStyle.minWidth;
  if (flatStyle.maxWidth !== undefined) outerStyle.maxWidth = flatStyle.maxWidth;
  if (flatStyle.height !== undefined) outerStyle.height = flatStyle.height;
  if (flatStyle.minHeight !== undefined) outerStyle.minHeight = flatStyle.minHeight;
  if (flatStyle.maxHeight !== undefined) outerStyle.maxHeight = flatStyle.maxHeight;
  if (flatStyle.alignSelf !== undefined) outerStyle.alignSelf = flatStyle.alignSelf;
  if (flatStyle.position !== undefined) outerStyle.position = flatStyle.position;
  if (flatStyle.top !== undefined) outerStyle.top = flatStyle.top;
  if (flatStyle.bottom !== undefined) outerStyle.bottom = flatStyle.bottom;
  if (flatStyle.left !== undefined) outerStyle.left = flatStyle.left;
  if (flatStyle.right !== undefined) outerStyle.right = flatStyle.right;
  if (flatStyle.zIndex !== undefined) outerStyle.zIndex = flatStyle.zIndex;
  if (flatStyle.marginBottom !== undefined) outerStyle.marginBottom = flatStyle.marginBottom;
  if (flatStyle.marginTop !== undefined) outerStyle.marginTop = flatStyle.marginTop;
  if (flatStyle.borderRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderRadius = flatStyle.borderRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderTopLeftRadius = flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderTopRightRadius = flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius = flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderBottomRightRadius = flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius;
  if (
    flatStyle.overflow !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius !== undefined
  ) {
    outerStyle.overflow = flatStyle.overflow ?? 'hidden';
  }

  const animTransform = pressAnim
    ? [
        {
          scale: pressAnim.interpolate({
            inputRange: [0, 1],
            outputRange: [1, cfg.pressScale],
          }),
        },
        {
          translateY: pressAnim.interpolate({
            inputRange: [0, 1],
            outputRange: [0, cfg.pressTranslateY],
          }),
        },
      ]
    : undefined;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={disabled ? undefined : onPress}
      onLongPress={disabled ? undefined : onLongPress}
      onPressIn={() => {
        if (!disabled) animateTo(1);
      }}
      onPressOut={() => animateTo(0)}
      disabled={disabled}
      hitSlop={hitSlop}
      accessibilityRole={accessibilityRole}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      accessibilityState={accessibilityState}
      testID={testID}
      {...(dataSet ? ({ dataSet } as any) : {})}
      style={outerStyle}
    >
      <Animated.View
        style={[
          style,
          outerStyle.width ? { width: '100%' } : undefined,
          outerStyle.height === '100%' ? { flex: 1, height: undefined } : undefined,
          outerStyle.flex !== undefined
            ? { flex: undefined, flexGrow: 1, flexShrink: 1, flexBasis: 'auto' }
            : undefined,
          outerStyle.position === 'absolute' ? { position: 'relative', top: undefined, bottom: undefined, left: undefined, right: undefined } : undefined,
          outerStyle.marginBottom !== undefined ? { marginBottom: 0 } : undefined,
          outerStyle.marginTop !== undefined ? { marginTop: 0 } : undefined,
          outerStyle.overflow !== undefined ? { overflow: outerStyle.overflow } : undefined,
          contentContainerStyle,
          animTransform ? { transform: animTransform } : undefined,
          disabled ? { opacity: 0.56 } : undefined,
        ]}
      >
        {children}
      </Animated.View>
    </Pressable>
  );
};

export const KineticPhysicsTabBarButton: React.FC<any> = ({
  children,
  onPress,
  onLongPress,
  accessibilityState,
  accessibilityLabel,
  testID,
  style,
}) => {
  const cfg = KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS.dockTab;
  const pressAnim = useRef(typeof Animated?.Value === 'function' ? new Animated.Value(0) : null).current;
  const animRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      try {
        animRef.current?.stop?.();
      } catch {}
    };
  }, []);

  const springTo = useCallback(
    (toValue: number) => {
      if (!pressAnim || typeof Animated?.spring !== 'function') return;
      try {
        animRef.current?.stop?.();
        const anim = Animated.spring(pressAnim, {
          toValue,
          tension: cfg.tension,
          friction: cfg.friction,
          useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
        });
        animRef.current = anim;
        anim.start();
      } catch {}
    },
    [pressAnim, cfg.tension, cfg.friction],
  );

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      onLongPress={onLongPress}
      onPressIn={() => springTo(1)}
      onPressOut={() => springTo(0)}
      accessibilityRole="tab"
      accessibilityState={accessibilityState}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      testID={testID}
      style={[style, { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}
    >
      <Animated.View
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          transform: pressAnim
            ? [
                {
                  scale: pressAnim.interpolate({
                    inputRange: [0, 1],
                    outputRange: [1, cfg.pressScale],
                  }),
                },
                {
                  translateY: pressAnim.interpolate({
                    inputRange: [0, 1],
                    outputRange: [0, cfg.pressTranslateY],
                  }),
                },
              ]
            : undefined,
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </Animated.View>
    </Pressable>
  );
};

export const renderKineticPhysicsTabButton = (props: any) => (
  <KineticPhysicsTabBarButton {...props} />
);

// Caché síncrona del último rol confirmado (memoria de módulo + localStorage web) para pintar pestañas en 0 ms
// sin cortina de carga durante la navegación habitual.
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

const ROLE_CACHE_KEY = '@kinetic_last_role_v1';
let memoryRoleCache: { userId: string; role: string } | null = null;

export const readCachedRoleSync = (userId?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!userId) return null;
  if (memoryRoleCache?.userId === userId) return memoryRoleCache.role;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage?.getItem(ROLE_CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
      if (parsed?.userId === userId && parsed?.role) {
        memoryRoleCache = parsed;
        return parsed.role;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
};

export const persistRoleCache = (userId?: string | null, role?: string | null): void => {
  if (!userId || !role || (memoryRoleCache?.userId === userId && memoryRoleCache.role === role)) return;
  memoryRoleCache = { userId, role };
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      window.localStorage?.setItem(ROLE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(memoryRoleCache));
    } catch {}
  }
};

// Motor de Traducción Semántica Inteligente ES/EN con Preservación de Entidades (Entity-Lock)

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP, translateAmenityLabelEn } from '../constants/kineticAmenitiesTranslations';
import {
  CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP,
  DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP,
  DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP,
  ENTITY_LOCK_BRAND_NAMES,
} from '../constants/kineticDisciplineMap';
import {
  lookupLiveClubBioEn,
  translateSpanishVenueBioFallback,
} from './kineticBioTranslatorEn';
import type { KineticLanguage } from '../constants/kineticTranslations';

let activeKineticLanguage: KineticLanguage = 'es';

AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_language_v25')
  .then((saved) => {
    if (saved === 'en' || saved === 'es') activeKineticLanguage = saved;
  })
  .catch(() => {});

export const getActiveKineticLanguage = (): KineticLanguage => activeKineticLanguage;

export const setActiveKineticLanguage = (lang: KineticLanguage): void => {
  activeKineticLanguage = lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
};

const SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES = [...ENTITY_LOCK_BRAND_NAMES].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);

const escapeRegex = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

export const protectEntities = (text: string): { masked: string; tokens: string[] } => {
  const tokens: string[] = [];
  let masked = text;

  const lockMatch = (val: string) => {
    const idx = tokens.length;
    tokens.push(val);
    return `__KNT_ENT_${idx}__`;
  };

  masked = masked.replace(/\bKNT-[A-Z0-9-]+\b/g, lockMatch);
  masked = masked.replace(/@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, lockMatch);

  for (const entity of SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES) {
    if (!entity || !masked.includes(entity)) continue;
    const re = new RegExp(escapeRegex(entity), 'g');
    masked = masked.replace(re, lockMatch);
  }

  return { masked, tokens };
};

export const restoreEntities = (masked: string, tokens: string[]): string =>
  masked.replace(/__KNT_ENT_(\d+)__/g, (_, i) => tokens[Number(i)] ?? '');

export const isEntityLockedBrand = (name?: string | null): boolean => {
  const clean = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean) return false;
  return SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES.some((b) => b.toLowerCase() === clean);
};

const normalizeDisciplineLookupKey = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

const NORMALIZED_DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP: Record<string, string> = (() => {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP)) {
    map[normalizeDisciplineLookupKey(k)] = v;
  }
  map['ninguno'] = 'None';
  map['ninguna'] = 'None';
  map['sin filtro'] = 'None';
  map['voleibol'] = 'Volleyball';
  map['padel'] = 'Padel';
  map['futbol'] = 'Soccer';
  map['natacion'] = 'Swimming';
  return map;
})();

export const translateDiscipline = (
  cat?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const raw = String(cat ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || lang !== 'en') return raw;

  if (DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw]) {
    return raw === raw.toUpperCase() ? DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw].toUpperCase() : DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw];
  }

  const normKey = normalizeDisciplineLookupKey(raw);
  const directHit = NORMALIZED_DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[normKey];
  if (directHit) {
    return raw === raw.toUpperCase() ? directHit.toUpperCase() : directHit;
  }

  for (const sep of ['•', '|', '/', ',']) {
    if (raw.includes(sep)) {
      const joiner = sep === ',' ? ', ' : ` ${sep} `;
      return raw.split(sep).map((part) => translateDiscipline(part.trim(), lang)).join(joiner);
    }
  }
  return raw;
};

const RARITY_RULES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/CARGA (\d+\/\d+)\s*•\s*LEGENDARIO DORADO/gi, 'CHARGE $1 • LEGENDARY GOLD'],
  [/CARGA (\d+\/\d+)\s*•\s*ÉPICO PÚRPURA/gi, 'CHARGE $1 • EPIC PURPLE'],
  [/CARGA (\d+\/\d+)\s*•\s*COMÚN CIAN/gi, 'CHARGE $1 • COMMON CYAN'],
  [/COFRE VOLUMÉTRICO\s*•\s*NIVEL I/gi, 'VOLUMETRIC CHEST • TIER I'],
  [/COFRE ÉPICO\s*•\s*NIVEL II/gi, 'EPIC CHEST • TIER II'],
  [/COFRE LEGENDARIO\s*•\s*APERTURA TOTAL/gi, 'LEGENDARY CHEST • FULL UNLOCK'],
  [/\bLEGENDARIO\b/gi, 'LEGENDARY'], [/\bMÍTICO\b/gi, 'MYTHIC'], [/\bÉPICO\b/gi, 'EPIC'],
  [/\bRARO\b/gi, 'RARE'], [/\bCOMÚN\b/gi, 'COMMON'], [/\bFÁCIL\b/gi, 'EASY'],
  [/\bINTERMEDIO\b/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE'], [/\bAVANZADO\b/gi, 'ADVANCED'], [/\bLEYENDA\b/gi, 'LEGEND'],
];

export const translateRarity = (rarity?: string | null, lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage): string => {
  const raw = String(rarity ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || lang !== 'en') return raw;
  return RARITY_RULES.reduce((acc, [re, rep]) => acc.replace(re, rep), raw);
};

export const translateChallenge = <T extends Record<string, any>>(
  challenge: T,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): T => {
  if (!challenge || lang !== 'en') return challenge;
  const id = String(challenge.id || '');
  const divLabelEn = translateRarity(String(challenge.divisionLabel || ''), 'en')
    .replace(/\bSESIONES\b/g, 'SESSIONS').replace(/\bRACHA\b/g, 'STREAK').replace(/\bCLUBES\b/g, 'VENUES')
    .replace(/•\s*(.+)$/, (_, tail) => `• ${translateDiscipline(tail.trim(), 'en').toUpperCase()}`);
  const starter = STARTER_CHALLENGE_EN[id];
  if (starter) {
    return { ...challenge, divisionLabel: divLabelEn, titulo: starter.titulo, desc: starter.desc, requisitoCorto: starter.req };
  }
  const titulo = String(challenge.titulo || '')
    .replace(/^Potencia QR • Nivel (\d+)$/i, 'QR Power • Level $1')
    .replace(/^Racha de Hierro (\d+)D$/i, 'Iron Streak $1D')
    .replace(/^Conquistador de Sedes #(\d+)$/i, 'Venue Conqueror #$1')
    .replace(/^Especialista en (.+) #(\d+)$/i, (_, d, n) => `${translateDiscipline(d, 'en')} Specialist #${n}`);
  const desc = String(challenge.desc || '')
    .replace(/^Completa (\d+) sesiones validadas con pase QR de acceso en la red\.$/i, 'Complete $1 sessions validated with a dynamic QR access pass across the network.')
    .replace(/^Mantén tu escudo activo durante (\d+) días consecutivos\.$/i, 'Keep your streak shield active for $1 consecutive days.')
    .replace(/^Reserva y entrena en (\d+) sedes afiliadas distintas\.$/i, 'Book and train at $1 distinct affiliated venues.')
    .replace(/^Completa (\d+) sesiones certificadas de (.+) en clubes de la red\.$/i, (_, m, d) => `Complete ${m} certified ${translateDiscipline(d, 'en')} sessions at network clubs.`);
  const req = String(challenge.requisitoCorto || '')
    .replace(/^(\d+) Sesiones QR$/i, '$1 QR Sessions')
    .replace(/^Racha (\d+) Días$/i, '$1-Day Streak')
    .replace(/^(\d+) Sedes Distintas$/i, '$1 Distinct Venues')
    .replace(/^(\d+) en (.+)$/i, (_, m, d) => `${m} in ${translateDiscipline(d, 'en')}`);
  return { ...challenge, divisionLabel: divLabelEn, titulo, desc, requisitoCorto: req };
};

  [/\bJueves\b/gi, 'Thursday'], [/\bViernes\b/gi, 'Friday'], [/\bS[áa]bados\b/gi, 'Saturdays'],
  [/\bS[áa]bado\b/gi, 'Saturday'], [/\bDomingos\b/gi, 'Sundays'], [/\bDomingo\b/gi, 'Sunday'],
  [/(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s+a\s+(\d{1,2}:\d{2})/gi, '$1 to $2'],
];

export const translateOperatingHours = (raw?: string | null, lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage): string => {
  const str = String(raw || '').trim().replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1');
  if (!str) return '';
  const rules = lang === 'es' ? HOURS_ES_RULES : HOURS_EN_RULES;
  return rules.reduce((acc, [re, rep]) => acc.replace(re, rep), str);
};

const normalizeTeamTerminology = (text: string, lang: KineticLanguage): string => {
  if (!text) return text;
  if (lang === 'en') {
    return text.replace(/\b(Escuadr[óo]n|Tribu|Squad)\b/gi, (m) => {
      if (m === m.toUpperCase()) return 'TEAM';
      if (m[0] === m[0].toUpperCase()) return 'Team';
      return 'team';
    });
  }
  return text.replace(/\b(Escuadr[óo]n|Tribu|Squad)\b/gi, (m) => {
    if (m === m.toUpperCase()) return 'EQUIPO';
    if (m[0] === m[0].toUpperCase()) return 'Equipo';
    return 'equipo';
  });
};

export const translateDynamicContent = (
  text?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const raw = String(text ?? '');
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return raw;
  if (lang === 'es') {
    if (/(Monday|Tuesday|Mon[–-]|Tue[–-]|Weekends|\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+to\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2})/i.test(trimmed)) {
      return normalizeTeamTerminology(translateOperatingHours(trimmed, 'es'), 'es');
    }
    return normalizeTeamTerminology(raw, 'es');
  }
  if (isEntityLockedBrand(trimmed)) return raw;

  const liveBioDirect = lookupLiveClubBioEn(trimmed);
  if (liveBioDirect) return normalizeTeamTerminology(liveBioDirect, 'en');
  if (CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[trimmed], 'en');
  if (DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[trimmed], 'en');
  const amenityDirectHit = translateAmenityLabelEn(trimmed);
  if (amenityDirectHit) return amenityDirectHit;
  if (DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[trimmed];
  if (ALERT_AND_UI_EXACT_EN[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(ALERT_AND_UI_EXACT_EN[trimmed], 'en');

  const athleteCapMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+Atletas?$/i);
  if (athleteCapMatch) {
    const n = Number(athleteCapMatch[1]);
    return `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'Athlete' : 'Athletes'}`;
  }
  const spotsCapMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+Lugares?$/i);
  if (spotsCapMatch) {
    const n = Number(spotsCapMatch[1]);
    return `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'Spot' : 'Spots'}`;
  }
  const minsMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+min(?:utos)?$/i);
  if (minsMatch) return `${minsMatch[1]} min`;

  // Extract optional [Frecuencia Programada: X] suffix
  let freqSuffix = '';
  let working = trimmed.replace(/\s*\[Frecuencia Programada:\s*([^\]]+)\]\s*$/i, (_, f) => {
    const fEn = DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[f.trim()] || f.trim();
    freqSuffix = ` [Scheduled Frequency: ${fEn}]`;
    return '';
  });

  const liveBioWorking = lookupLiveClubBioEn(working);
  if (liveBioWorking) return liveBioWorking + freqSuffix;
  if (CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[working]) return CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[working] + freqSuffix;
  if (DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[working]) return DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[working] + freqSuffix;

  // Comma-separated requirements or amenities list
  if (working.includes(', ')) {
    const parts = working.split(', ').map((p) => p.trim());
    if (parts.every((p) => Boolean(DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[p] || DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[p] || translateAmenityLabelEn(p)))) {
      return (
        parts
          .map((p) => DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[p] || translateAmenityLabelEn(p) || DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[p] || p)
          .join(', ') + freqSuffix
      );
    }
  }

  // Schedules ("Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 22:00 | Lun-Sáb • 06:00 a 21:00")
  if (
    /(Lunes|Martes|Mi[ée]rcoles|Jueves|Viernes|S[áa]bados?|Domingos?|Lun\s*[-–a]|Mar\s*[-–a]|Fines de Semana|D[íi]as Personalizados)/i.test(
      working
    ) ||
    /\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+a\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}/i.test(working)
  ) {
    return translateOperatingHours(working, 'en') + freqSuffix;
  }

  // Autogenerated club bio template
  const autoClubMatch = working.match(
    /^Ubicado en (.+?),\s*(.+?)\s+es un espacio verificado dentro de la red Kinetic dedicado al entrenamiento deportivo y bienestar de alto nivel(?:\s+en Los Cabos)?\.?$/i
  );
  if (autoClubMatch) {
    return `Located in ${autoClubMatch[1]}, ${autoClubMatch[2]} is a verified training & wellness space in the Kinetic network dedicated to high-performance fitness and recovery.${freqSuffix}`;
  }

  // Autogenerated session template: "Sesión certificada de X en Y..."
  const autoSessionMatch = working.match(/^Sesión certificada de (.+?) en (.+?)\.?$/i);
  if (autoSessionMatch) {
    const discEn = translateDiscipline(autoSessionMatch[1].trim(), 'en');
    return `Certified session of ${discEn} at ${autoSessionMatch[2].trim()}.${freqSuffix}`;
  }

  // General semantic pass with Entity-Lock protection
  const { masked, tokens } = protectEntities(working);
  let translated = masked
    .replace(/^Ubicado en el corazón de /i, 'Located in the heart of ')
    .replace(/^Ubicado estratégicamente en /i, 'Strategically located in ')
    .replace(/^Ubicado en /i, 'Located in ')
    .replace(/es un espacio verificado dentro de la red Kinetic/gi, 'is a verified training & wellness space in the Kinetic network')
    .replace(/Sesión certificada de /gi, 'Certified session of ')
    .replace(/Experiencia oficial de /gi, 'Official experience of ')
    .replace(/Lugar asegurado en /gi, 'Spot secured at ')
    .replace(/40% en Garantía Escrow:/gi, '40% Escrow Deposit:')
    .replace(/60% en Recepción QR:/gi, '60% at Front Desk QR:')
    .replace(/Tu pase QR de acceso te espera en la Bóveda\./gi, 'Your dynamic QR access pass awaits in your Vault.')
    .replace(/Requiere (\d+) KC \(40% en Garantía Escrow\)\./gi, 'Requires $1 KC (40% Escrow Deposit).');

  translated = translateSpanishVenueBioFallback(translated);
  return normalizeTeamTerminology(restoreEntities(translated, tokens) + freqSuffix, 'en');
};

export const translateAmenityString = (
  raw?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const clean = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!clean || lang !== 'en') return clean;
  return translateAmenityLabelEn(clean) || translateDynamicContent(clean, 'en');
};

export const translateAmenity = <
  T extends { id?: string; title?: string; titleEn?: string; desc?: string; descEn?: string },
>(
  item: T,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): T => {
  if (!item || lang !== 'en') return item;
  if (typeof item === 'string') return translateAmenityString(item, 'en') as unknown as T;
  const idKey = String(item.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const byId = idKey ? AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP[idKey] : undefined;
  return {
    ...item,
    title:
      item.titleEn ||
      byId?.titleEn ||
      (item.title ? translateAmenityString(item.title, 'en') : item.title),
    desc:
      item.descEn ||
      byId?.descEn ||
      (item.desc ? translateAmenityString(item.desc, 'en') : item.desc),
  };
};

const parseSafeLocalDate = (isoOrDate: string | Date | number): Date | null => {
  if (isoOrDate instanceof Date) return Number.isNaN(isoOrDate.getTime()) ? null : isoOrDate;
  if (typeof isoOrDate === 'number') {
    const d = new Date(isoOrDate);
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }
  const s = String(isoOrDate || '').trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  const ymd = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  if (ymd) {
    return new Date(Number(ymd[1]), Number(ymd[2]) - 1, Number(ymd[3]), 12, 0, 0);
  }
  const d = new Date(s);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
};

export const formatKineticDate = (
  isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
): string => {
  const raw = String(isoOrDate ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (/^hoy$/i.test(raw)) return lang === 'en' ? 'TODAY' : 'HOY';
  if (/^ma[ñn]ana$/i.test(raw)) return lang === 'en' ? 'TOMORROW' : 'MAÑANA';

  const d = parseSafeLocalDate(isoOrDate as any);
  if (!d) return raw;
  const locale = lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'es-MX';
  const fmtOpts: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = options || {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
  };
  return d.toLocaleDateString(locale, fmtOpts);
};

export const formatKineticDateTime = (
  isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
): string => {
  const d = parseSafeLocalDate(isoOrDate as any);
  if (!d) return String(isoOrDate ?? '');
  const locale = lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'es-MX';
  return d.toLocaleString(
    locale,
    options || { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }
  );
};

export const formatDistanceLabel = (
  km: number | string | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  fromYou = false
): string => {
  const cleanStr = String(km ?? '').replace(/\s*km.*$/i, '').trim();
  const cleanKm = Number(cleanStr);
  const val = Number.isFinite(cleanKm) && cleanStr !== '' ? Number(cleanKm.toFixed(1)) : cleanStr || '1.2';
  const display = typeof km === 'number' && Number.isFinite(km) ? Number(km.toFixed(1)) : val;
  if (lang === 'en') {
    return fromYou ? `${display}\u00A0km from you` : `${display}\u00A0km away`;
  }
  return fromYou ? `A ${display}\u00A0km de ti` : `A ${display}\u00A0km`;
};

export const formatActiveEventsCount = (
  count: number,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const n = Math.max(0, Number(count) || 0);
  if (lang === 'en') return n === 1 ? '1 active event' : `${n} active events`;
  return n === 1 ? '1 evento activo' : `${n} eventos activos`;
};

const parseRgba = (val: string): [number, number, number, number] | null => {
  const m = val.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)(?:\s*,\s*([0-9.]+))?\s*\)/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  return [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]), m[4] !== undefined ? Number(m[4]) : 1];
};

export const installKineticWebBaseCss = (): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.head) return;
  const styleId = 'kinetic-3d-tactical-obsidian-v275';
  if (document.getElementById(styleId)) return;
  document.getElementById('kinetic-3d-tactical-obsidian-v271')?.remove();
  document.getElementById('kinetic-3d-tactical-obsidian-v25')?.remove();
  document.getElementById('kinetic-studio-glass-v25')?.remove();

  const styleEl = document.createElement('style');
  styleEl.id = styleId;
  styleEl.textContent = `
    [role="button"], button {
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      outline: none !important;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
      transition: transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 0.14s ease !important;
    }
    [role="button"]:hover, button:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.03);
    }
    [role="button"]:active, button:active {
      transform: translateY(1.5px) scale(0.99) !important;
    }
    input, textarea, [contenteditable="true"] {
      user-select: text !important;
      -webkit-user-select: text !important;
      font-size: max(16px, 1em);
    }
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) input:-webkit-autofill,
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) input:-webkit-autofill:active {
      -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px #05070B inset !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px #05070B inset !important;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: #FFFFFF !important;
      caret-color: #00F0FF !important;
      transition: background-color 99999s ease-out 0s !important;
    }
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) input::placeholder,
    html:not([data-kinetic-theme="light"]) textarea::placeholder {
      color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44) !important;
    }
    div[style*="border-radius"] {
      background-clip: padding-box !important;
    }
    .leaflet-marker-icon, .kinetic-radar-pin {
      will-change: transform !important;
      backface-visibility: hidden !important;
      -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden !important;
      transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
    }
    .leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-zoom-animated {
      transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
    }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
};

export const buildOmniWebM3Css = (): string => {
  const bgRoot: string[] = [], bgLvl1: string[] = [], bgLvl2: string[] = [], bgWell: string[] = [];
  const lipDark: string[] = [], lipCyan: string[] = [], solidLightAccent: string[] = [], solidDarkAccent: string[] = [];
  const onMediaBg: string[] = [], txtPrimary: string[] = [], txtSecondary: string[] = [], txtMuted: string[] = [];
  const txtCyan: string[] = [], txtPurple: string[] = [], txtGreen: string[] = [], txtAmber: string[] = [];
  const txtRed: string[] = [], bgTintPurple: string[] = [], bgTintRed: string[] = [];
  const bgTintGreen: string[] = [], bgTintAmber: string[] = [], bgDragPill: string[] = [];

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const rnStyle = document.getElementById('react-native-stylesheet') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
    const rawRules: string[] = [];
    try {
      if (rnStyle?.sheet?.cssRules) {
        for (let i = 0; i < rnStyle.sheet.cssRules.length; i += 1) {

    } catch {

    for (let i = 0; i < rawRules.length; i += 1) {

      if (!m) continue;

      if (body.includes('background-color:')) {

        ) {

        ) {

        } else if (
          (r === 5 && (g === 7 || g === 8) && (b === 12 || b === 15) && a >= 0.68 && a <= 0.94) ||

        ) {

        } else if (r >= 140 && r <= 185 && g <= 95 && b >= 200 && a >= 0.06 && a <= 0.35) {

        } else if (r >= 240 && g >= 150 && b <= 30 && a >= 0.05 && a <= 0.35) {

        } else if (r === 5 && g === 5 && b === 5 && a >= 0.9) {

        } else if (r >= 4 && r <= 8 && g >= 6 && g <= 11 && b >= 10 && b <= 18 && a >= 0.92) {

        } else if (r <= 30 && g <= 36 && b <= 48 && a >= 0.82) {

        } else if (r >= 240 && g >= 240 && b >= 240 && a >= 0.03 && a < 0.2) {

        }
      } else if (body.includes('border-bottom-color:')) {

        } else if (r <= 18 && g <= 30 && b <= 48 && a >= 0.8) {

      } else if (/^\s*color:/i.test(body)) {

  }

  const solidLightChildren = solidLightAccent

  ].join(', ');
  const notSolidLight = `:not(:where(${lightInkExclusions}))`;
  const inlineDarkInkTargets = [

    '[style*="background-color: rgb(0, 240, 255)"]',

    )

  return [

    bgTintPurple.length ? `${bgTintPurple.join(',')} { background-color: #F5F3FF; border-color: #7C3AED; }` : '',

import { Image as RNImage } from 'react-native';
import {
  buildOfficialPinSvgMarkup,
  OfficialPinSvgKind,
} from '../components/explorar/kineticOfficialRadarSvgs';

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
const KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET = require('../../assets/logo.png');

export const resolveKineticOfficialLogoWebUri = (): string => {
  try {
    const src = RNImage?.resolveAssetSource?.(KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET);
    if (src?.uri) return String(src.uri);
  } catch {}
  if (typeof KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET === 'string' && KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET.trim()) {
    return KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET.trim();
  }
  return '/logo.png';
};

export const OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_DARK = 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark';
export const OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_LIGHT = 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron';

const FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_VAR_RE = /(?:^|_)(GEMINI_API_KEY|GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)$/i;
const FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_SECRET_RE = /(?:^|[_-])(sk_(?:live|test)|rk_(?:live|test)|whsec_|service_role|gemini_api_key|google_maps_server_api_key)/i;

export function assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(val: unknown, varName = 'EXPO_PUBLIC_ENV'): string {
  if (FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_VAR_RE.test(String(varName || '').trim())) {
    throw new Error(`SECURITY_VIOLATION: Private credential variable ${varName} is forbidden in public client.`);
  }
  const clean = typeof val === 'string' ? val.trim() : '';
  if (!clean) return '';
  const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
  if (
    FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_SECRET_RE.test(clean) ||
    clean.startsWith('sk_') ||
    clean.startsWith('rk_') ||
    clean.startsWith('whsec_') ||
    lower.includes('service_role') ||
    lower.includes('gemini_api_key') ||
    lower.includes('google_maps_server_api_key')
  ) {
    throw new Error(`SECURITY_VIOLATION: Private credential detected in public variable ${varName}.`);
  }
  return clean;
}

export function resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey(
  platform: 'web' | 'android' | 'ios' = 'web',
  envSource?: Record<string, unknown>
): string {
  const env = envSource || (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process?.env ? process.env : {});
  const specificVar =
    platform === 'android'
      ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY'
      : platform === 'ios'
      ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_IOS_KEY'
      : 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY';
  const specificVal = assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(env[specificVar], specificVar);
  if (specificVal) return specificVal;
  return assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY');
}

export const KINETIC_WEB_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY = resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey('web');
