export const escHtml = (s: unknown): string =>
  String(s ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

export const safeImgUrl = (u: unknown): string => {
  const s = String(u ?? '').trim();
  return /^(https?:\/\/|data:image\/|blob:|\/)/i.test(s) ? escHtml(s) : '';
};

export const safeHex = (c: unknown, fallback = '#00F0FF'): string => {
  const s = String(c ?? '').trim();
  return /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(s) ? s : fallback;
};

export const isWebGlSupported = (): boolean => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    return Boolean(
      canvas.getContext('webgl2') ||
        canvas.getContext('webgl') ||
        canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export const buildKineticMapLibreStyle = (isLightMode: boolean): string =>
  isLightMode ? OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_LIGHT : OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_DARK;

});

export const buildPinMarkerHtml = (
  pin: {
    color: string;
    avatar: string;
    isOfficial: boolean;
    isHidden: boolean;
    svgKind: OfficialPinSvgKind;
  },
  pinScale: string,
  hiddenLabel: string
): string => {
  const officialLogoUri = safeImgUrl(resolveKineticOfficialLogoWebUri()) || '/logo.png';
  const cleanColor = safeHex(pin.color, '#00F0FF');
  const safeAvatar = safeImgUrl(pin.avatar);
  const imgSrc = pin.isOfficial ? officialLogoUri : safeAvatar;
  const numScale = Number(pinScale);
  const safeScale = Number.isFinite(numScale) ? String(Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.5, numScale))) : '1';
  const svgMarkup = buildOfficialPinSvgMarkup(pin.svgKind, cleanColor, 20);
  const inner = pin.isOfficial
    ? `<img src="${imgSrc}" onerror="if(!this.dataset.fb){this.dataset.fb='1';this.src='/logo.png';}" alt="" />`
    : imgSrc
      ? `<img src="${imgSrc}" onerror="this.style.display='none';if(this.nextElementSibling)this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';" alt="" /><div class="knt-pin-svg-box" style="display:none;">${svgMarkup}</div>`
      : `<div class="knt-pin-svg-box">${svgMarkup}</div>`;
  const hiddenTag = pin.isHidden ? `<div class="knt-hidden-tag">${escHtml(hiddenLabel)}</div>` : '';
  const wrapOpacity = pin.isHidden ? 'opacity:0.62;' : '';
  return (
    `<div class="knt-pin-zoom-wrap" style="transform:scale(${safeScale});${wrapOpacity}">` +
    `<div class="knt-pin-outer" style="background:${cleanColor}24;border:1px solid ${cleanColor}66;">` +
    `<div class="knt-pin-ring" style="border-color:${cleanColor};">${inner}</div></div>${hiddenTag}</div>`
  );
};

  '</div></div><div class="knt-user-pill">' +
  escHtml(userLabel) +
  '</div></div>';

const injectCriticalMapCss = () => {
  const existingCrit = document.getElementById('kinetic-leaflet-critical-css');
  if (!existingCrit) {
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'kinetic-leaflet-critical-css';
    st.textContent = CRITICAL_MAP_CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  } else if (existingCrit.textContent !== CRITICAL_MAP_CSS) {
    existingCrit.textContent = CRITICAL_MAP_CSS;
  }
};

const loadStylesheetWithFallback = (id: string, urls: string[]) => {
  if (document.getElementById(id)) return;
  const lk = document.createElement('link');
  lk.id = id;
  lk.rel = 'stylesheet';
  lk.href = urls[0];
  if (urls[1]) {
    lk.onerror = () => {
      lk.onerror = null;
      lk.href = urls[1];
    };
  }
  document.head.appendChild(lk);
};

export const ensureMapLibreEngine = (): Promise<any> => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_DOM'));
  }
  if (!isWebGlSupported()) {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_WEBGL'));
  }
  injectCriticalMapCss();
  loadStylesheetWithFallback('kinetic-maplibre-cdn-css', MAPLIBRE_CSS_URLS);

  const win = window as any;
  if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') {
    return Promise.resolve(win.maplibregl);
  }
  if (_maplibrePromise) return _maplibrePromise;

  _maplibrePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let idx = 0;
    const tryNext = () => {
      if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') {
        resolve(win.maplibregl);
        return;
      }
      if (idx >= MAPLIBRE_JS_URLS.length) {
        _maplibrePromise = null;
        reject(new Error('MAPLIBRE_CDN_UNAVAILABLE'));
        return;
      }
      const sc = document.createElement('script');
      sc.src = MAPLIBRE_JS_URLS[idx++];
      sc.async = true;
      sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      sc.onload = () => {
        if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') resolve(win.maplibregl);
        else tryNext();
      };
      sc.onerror = () => {
        sc.remove();
        tryNext();
      };
      document.head.appendChild(sc);
    };
    tryNext();
  });
  return _maplibrePromise;
};

export const ensureLeafletEngine = (): Promise<any> => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_DOM'));
  }
  injectCriticalMapCss();
  loadStylesheetWithFallback('kinetic-leaflet-cdn-css', LEAFLET_CSS_URLS);

  const win = window as any;
  if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') {
    return Promise.resolve(win.L);
  }
  if (_leafletPromise) return _leafletPromise;

  _leafletPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let idx = 0;
    const tryNext = () => {
      if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') {
        resolve(win.L);
        return;
      }
      if (idx >= LEAFLET_JS_URLS.length) {
        _leafletPromise = null;
        reject(new Error('LEAFLET_CDN_UNAVAILABLE'));
        return;
      }
      const sc = document.createElement('script');
      sc.src = LEAFLET_JS_URLS[idx++];
      sc.async = true;
      sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      sc.onload = () => {
        if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') resolve(win.L);
        else tryNext();
      };
      sc.onerror = () => {
        sc.remove();
        tryNext();
      };
      document.head.appendChild(sc);
    };
    tryNext();
  });

  return _leafletPromise;
};

import type React from 'react';

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
const ReactDOM = require('react-dom') as {
  createPortal?: (children: React.ReactNode, container: Element) => React.ReactPortal;
};

export const renderInWebPortal = (node: React.ReactNode): React.ReactElement | null => {
  if (!node) return null;
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.body && typeof ReactDOM?.createPortal === 'function') {
    return ReactDOM.createPortal(node, document.body) as unknown as React.ReactElement;
  }
  return node as React.ReactElement | null;
};

    // =====================================================================================
// KINETIC OS v2.5 — SUPABASE PRO IMAGE TRANSFORMATION ENGINE
// Misión: Reducción drástica de Egress (ancho de banda) mediante renderizado WebP en CDN.
// Docs: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage/serving/image-transformations
// =====================================================================================

export interface SupabaseImageTransformOptions {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  quality?: number; // Valor 1-100 (Default: 80)
  format?: 'webp' | 'origin' | 'avif'; // Default: 'webp'
  resize?: 'cover' | 'contain' | 'fill'; // Default: 'cover'
}

const SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT = '/storage/v1/object/public/';
const SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT = '/storage/v1/render/image/public/';

/**
 * Transforma una URL de Supabase Storage al endpoint de Renderizado Supabase Pro
 * aplicando compresión WebP, redimensionamiento al vuelo y caché de borde.
 */
export function getOptimizedImageUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  options: SupabaseImageTransformOptions = {}
): string {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';

  // 1. Omitir URLs no optimizables en Edge CDN (Base64, Blob, rutas locales)
  if (
    trimmed.startsWith('data:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('blob:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('file:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')
  ) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  // 2. Soporte nativo Supabase Pro Image Transformations
  const isSupabasePublicObject = trimmed.includes(SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT);
  const isSupabaseRendered = trimmed.includes(SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT);

  if (isSupabasePublicObject || isSupabaseRendered) {
    const [baseUrlAndPath, rawQuery] = trimmed.split('?');
    const transformedBase = baseUrlAndPath.replace(
      SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT,
      SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT
    );

    const params: string[] = [];

    // Priorizar parámetros solicitados con valores por defecto Pro
    const width = options.width ? Math.round(options.width) : undefined;
    const height = options.height ? Math.round(options.height) : undefined;
    const quality = options.quality ?? 80;
    const format = options.format ?? 'webp';
    const resize = options.resize ?? 'cover';

    if (width && width > 0) params.push(`width=${width}`);
    if (height && height > 0) params.push(`height=${height}`);
    params.push(`quality=${quality}`);
    params.push(`format=${format}`);
    params.push(`resize=${resize}`);

    // Preservar query params no conflictivos si venían en la URL original
    if (rawQuery) {
      const existingParams = rawQuery.split('&').filter((p) => {
        const key = p.split('=')[0];
        return !['width', 'height', 'quality', 'format', 'resize'].includes(key);
      });
      if (existingParams.length > 0) {
        params.push(...existingParams);
      }
    }

    return `${transformedBase}?${params.join('&')}`;
  }

  // 3. Optimización complementaria para imágenes de demostración Unsplash
  if (trimmed.includes('images.unsplash.com')) {
    const [base, rawQuery] = trimmed.split('?');
    const width = options.width ? Math.round(options.width) : 600;
    const quality = options.quality ?? 80;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(rawQuery || '');
    params.set('w', String(width));
    params.set('q', String(quality));
    params.set('auto', 'format');
    params.set('fit', options.resize === 'contain' ? 'max' : 'crop');
    return `${base}?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  return trimmed;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PRESETS TÁCTICOS KINETIC OS (RESOLUCIÓN EXACTA SEGÚN DENSIDAD DE PANTALLA)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Avatar circular de atleta o club (1:1 en WebP).
 * Ej. listas, modales de perfil, ranking KinetiClub.
 */
export function getAvatarUrl(url?: string | null, size = 160): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    quality: 80,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Portada principal de club, gimnasio o evento (16:9 en WebP).
 * Ej. Cartelera, cabecera de explorar y modales de detalle.
 */
export function getCoverUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  width = 720,
  height = 405
): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    height,
    quality: 80,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Miniaturas para tarjetas compactas, feeds o listas (WebP ultra-ligero).
 */
export function getThumbnailUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  width = 320,
  height = 200
): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    height,
    quality: 75,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Fotografías de alta definición para galería de instalaciones del club.
 */
export function getGalleryUrl(url?: string | null, width = 1080): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    quality: 85,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'contain',
  });
}
